jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI Engineer Mid\-Level \| Dallas, TX (Hybrid) \| Full\-Time WHO WE ARE Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) is a Dallas\-based AI software development firm that helps businesses achieve AI sovereignty and get off the SaaS treadmill. We don't believe in renting someone else's roadmap. We believe in building solutions purpose\-built for each client's business, powered by the latest in agentic AI and intelligent automation. We work across industries, including manufacturing, construction, investment management, and hospitality, helping organizations use agentic technology to transform how they operate. Our engagements range from replacing bloated SaaS stacks with custom AI\-driven workflows to building multi\-agent systems that automate entire business processes. At CV.AI, we see agentic development and vibe coding as personal multipliers. Agents represent a fundamental shift in how software gets built and delivered. Our team members respond, “I'll get my agent on that,” for everything from architecture design to task updates. If that mindset resonates with you, keep reading. POSITION DETAILS Job Title: AI Engineer Level: Mid\-Level Employment Type: W2, Full\-Time Location: Hybrid — Dallas, TX (Galleria / Addison area) Reports To: VP, AI Engineering Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a mid\-level AI Engineer who uses AI agents as a personal force multiplier to architect, test, document, and ship production\-grade solutions for our clients. You'll work on client engagements across industries, translating business requirements into agentic workflows, deploying intelligent systems, and ensuring every deliverable meets enterprise standards for security, scalability, and repeatability. You'll also regularly interact with clients, explaining technical deliverables clearly and confidently. You'll work alongside senior engineers and engagement leads in small, fast\-moving teams where every team member has an outsized impact. To meet our clients' requirements, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. An offer of employment may be contingent on a background check. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions, from single\-agent workflows to multi\-agent orchestration, with agents serving as core functionality, user interfaces, or both. * Use spec\-driven and test\-driven development practices with AI agents to produce reliable, secure, tested, and well\-documented code. * Identify and bring new applications of AI to our clients' businesses. * Evaluate agent\-produced code for quality, security, and alignment with client requirements. * Build and integrate client\-facing applications that embed AI capabilities where users work, replacing manual processes and legacy SaaS tools. * Contribute to agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory architectures, and shared human\-agent wikis. * Document architectures, decision criteria, integration patterns, and deployment configurations to support knowledge transfer. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of production deployments. * Experience using AI agents, coding assistants, or agentic frameworks to deploy production\-grade code at a company or for a client. * Experience with spec\-driven and test\-driven development workflows. * Ability to critically evaluate agent\-produced code and identify hallucinations, security gaps, and quality issues before deployment. * A strong focus on security, scalability, repeatability, and well\-documented deliverables. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Comfort presenting technical deliverables and progress directly to clients. * Familiarity with modern web frameworks, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD workflows. * Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Dallas offices in the Galleria / Addison area. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience building or implementing agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory systems, or wikis designed for shared human\-agent use. * Hands\-on experience integrating computer vision technologies into production systems. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or equivalent, and prompt engineering patterns. * Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI, and integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client\-embedded delivery. * Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or both. THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're hiring for technical skills and a way of thinking. The right candidate sees AI agents as teammates. When a problem lands on your desk, your instinct is to consider which agent can help tackle it, whether that means writing tests, researching an API, scaffolding a service, or reviewing a pull request. You're curious, you ship, and you hold yourself to a high standard of quality even when agents are doing the heavy lifting. WHY CV.AI * Build production systems for real clients at the cutting edge of agentic AI. * Join small, high\-impact teams where your contributions are visible and valued from day one. * Work a hybrid schedule from our offices near the shops and restaurants of the Galleria and Addison. Some of our coolest work happens in the real world. * Work with a leadership team that uses agents daily and practices what it preaches. Yes, an agent helped write this posting, and a human edited it. * Gain exposure to a diverse range of industries and technical challenges. No two engagements are the same. * Earn competitive W2 compensation with a firm that invests in long\-term relationships with its engineers. Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) www.cvaius.com (http://www.cvaius.com) Dallas, TX

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **What is PlayerZero?** ----------------------- Building great software takes more than writing code. It takes teams working together, and too often, the information they need is scattered across tools, conversations, and systems. PlayerZero is an AI platform that connects work across enterprise Support, Engineering, Product, QA, and SRE teams, helping them resolve issues faster, improve software quality, and plan what to build next. At its core is our Engineering World Model: a living understanding of a company’s software, how it runs, and the people and decisions behind it. By connecting codebases, tickets, production telemetry, and the conversations that shape the work, our model links what software is intended to do with how it actually behaves in production—and learns from where the two diverge. Our agents (we call them Players :) use that context to take on work across the software lifecycle. They learn from each outcome, earning trust and taking on more responsibility over time. We’re building a future where AI plays an active role in how teams plan, build, and run software. We’re looking for people across disciplines to help shape it. **About the AI Infra team** --------------------------- Most AI tools help one person perform a task faster, a session at a time. But real software work doesn’t happen in one session or one tool. A bug moves from a customer to a ticket to a Slack thread to a PR to a deploy, across people and systems that never see the whole picture. The most interesting context lives between those systems of record, and so does the real work. For our agents to take on that work, something has to sit in between. The AI Infrastructure team builds it: where agents execute, what context they access, and how work moves between agents and people. Because the work runs through this infrastructure, it’s also what lets the Engineering World Model learn from every outcome and earn our agents the right to do more. It has to be fast, composable, and built to scale. We’re hiring infrastructure engineers who like hard distributed\-systems problems and want to own them end to end. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Build agentic infrastructure.** Our agents don’t answer a question and disappear. They take on units of work that run for hours or days, change hands, and keep driving toward completion. You’ll build the runtime that creates continuity for that work: long\-running sessions that survive failures, durable workflow state, lifecycle and cancellation, and workflows that track each piece of work across every stage and every party involved. * **Architect how context is represented and delivered.** Because work flows through our platform, we’re present when the connections between code, tickets, units of work, and past decisions are made. The context between these systems of record is necessary for agents to do their work well, and the data models behind it shape everything an agent can know. You’ll design how that context is represented and delivered: what gets precomputed ahead of time versus resolved on demand, and how the right slice reaches each agent at the right moment. * **Build the communication layer.** Real work doesn’t happen in isolation. Agents work alongside other agents (subagents, teammates, agents on customer machines, agents over MCP) and alongside people. You’ll build the layer that connects them: messaging between agents within and across sessions, escalations that pull in the right person at the right time, and agents that can be interrupted when new information arrives. * **Scale sandboxes and fleets.** An organization’s work is spread across laptops, QA fleets, production hosts, and ephemeral scripts. You’ll build our own sandbox infrastructure, environments that spin up instantly and run by the hundreds, and the fleet layer that lets agents work on the machines where customer work already happens. You don’t need experience in all of these. We expect you to go deep on one or two and pick up the rest along the way. **What you bring** ------------------ * A builder mindset. You own projects end to end, think carefully about data models, performance, and maintainability, and have taken prototypes to production with a clear sense of the reliability and scale tradeoffs. * 3–5\+ years building backend systems, ideally real\-time, stateful, or event\-driven workloads, with strong distributed systems fundamentals: message queues (Pulsar, Kafka), distributed locks, pub/sub, and their failure modes. * Experience building infrastructure for LLMs in production: tool calling, streaming, token budgets, or evaluation harnesses, and a sense of what agents need from the systems beneath them. * Experience designing data models for messy, interconnected domains. You know how to structure data so it stays correct as it grows and changes, and you think about how it will be queried and served before you write the schema. You’ve made schema and storage decisions that held up under scale, and you know the cost of getting them wrong. * You keep work moving. You balance speed of execution with code quality, unblock yourself when you can, and pull in the right people at the right time when you can’t. **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Turbopuffer) or hybrid search systems * Experience with Kotlin/JVM (our primary stack) or Rust, MongoDB, Turbopuffer, or Redis, and WebSockets or other real\-time patterns * You’ve built sandboxing or isolation systems with containers or microVMs (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor), or managed fleets across heterogeneous machines * You’ve worked on filesystem layers such as FUSE, overlay filesystems, or remote\-backed storage * You’ve worked with event sourcing, lineage, or provenance data, where the record of what happened is itself a product **What success looks like** --------------------------- In your first month, you’ve shipped to production, learned how work moves through the platform end to end, and taken ownership of a real component in one of the layers above. By three months, you own a meaningful piece of the system and have made it measurably better: longer\-running work that survives failures, faster sandbox startup, context that reaches agents more reliably, or fewer dropped handoffs between agents and people. By six months to a year, you’re the person the team trusts with a layer of the machine. You set its technical direction, anticipate where it will break as customers and workloads grow, and your work shows up directly in how much our agents can take on. **Why PlayerZero?** ------------------- PlayerZero is an early leader in AI\-powered production engineering, defining how enterprises use AI to understand, improve, and operate their software. We’re a small team with meaningful problems to solve and room for each person to make their mark. Whether you’re building the technology, working with customers, or growing the business, you’ll help shape the product, the company, and what customers expect from this emerging category. If you’re excited by work where the answers aren’t all written yet, and want a hand in writing them, you’ll fit right in. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer Direct Hire Hybrid

Keeping an eye on our scheduled data pipelines, you ll handle first\-line troubleshooting when something fails. You'll work closely with the Sr. Manager, Data \& Analytics, and with business stakeholders across Finance, Operations, and other functions who depend on accurate, well\-modeled data. This is a great fit for someone who wants breadth real ownership across the data stack on a team small enough that your work visibly matters. **Key Responsibilities** * **Data modeling \& SQL:** Design, build, and maintain SQL views, staging tables, and fact/dimension models in our Azure SQL data warehouse, including deduplication and business\-rule logic (e.g., status\-based routing, multi\-source reconciliation). * **Semantic models \& reporting:** Build and maintain Power BI semantic models relationships, DAX measures, security roles and the reports and dashboards built on top of them for business stakeholders and company\-wide reporting. * **Pipeline support:** Share responsibility with the Sr. Manager, Data \& Analytics for monitoring scheduled Azure Data Factory pipelines and Power BI dataset refreshes. Respond to failures and perform basic troubleshooting. * **Pipeline modifications:** Make minor modifications to existing pipelines to support new or changing business requirements, as your familiarity with the tooling grows. * **Business partnership:** Partner with business SMEs to translate reporting requests and business logic (commission structures, revenue recognition, inventory rules, etc.) into accurate, well\-documented data models. * **Documentation:** Write and maintain documentation for data models, metric definitions, and report logic so that data lineage and ownership are clear beyond any one person. * **Standards \& quality:** Follow and help evolve team standards for naming conventions, DAX style, and semantic model design as the team's practices mature. * **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively identify opportunities for process improvements, optimize current data workflows, and incorporate new technologies or tools to enhance data analytics capabilities. **Knowledge and Skills** **Required** * 3\+ years in a data\-focused role (analytics engineer, BI developer, data analyst, or similar) with hands\-on SQL work comfortable with CTEs, window functions, and reading/writing complex, multi\-source views. * Solid Power BI experience beyond report formatting you've built semantic models from scratch and written DAX involving CALCULATE, filter context, and context transition, not just basic aggregations. * Dimensional modeling fundamentals (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions). * A track record of working directly with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements or business rules into a working data model. * Strong attention to detail with data integrity you double\-check your joins and know how a bad join or an inclusive date boundary can quietly break a report. **Preferred** * Exposure to an ERP or other core business system as a data source (order, invoicing, or GL data) \- you understand that business rules, not just dates, often drive how records should be deduplicated or classified. * Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and working knowledge of orchestration tools like Azure Data Factory or similar tools for automating data pipelines. * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric Administration and Environment (Lakehouses, Dataflows Gen2\) not required, but a plus given our platform direction. * Basic Git / source control experience. * Python for data tasks. * Knowledge of data quality frameworks and data governance practices. **Qualifications** * Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master s degree is a plus. * 3\+ years in a data\-focused role (analytics engineer, BI developer, data analyst, or similar) with hands\-on SQL work comfortable with CTEs, window functions, and reading/writing complex, multi\-source views. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer

jobs.title: Data, Analytics, and AI Manager
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Data, Analytics, and AI team runs the company data warehouse, the central database that brings together information from NetSuite, the online store, and the shipping partner, and turns it into reports, metrics, and tools the business can trust. The Manager leads that distributed team: sets its direction, decides the future of the data warehouse (two data warehouse efforts exist today and the company needs one), and builds the team as the work grows. The Manager owns every report that combines data from more than one system and the standard for how key numbers are defined and checked. The Manager also owns the automation and AI tools built on that data. **Key Responsibilities** Percentages are the approximate share of time over a year. * **Decide the data warehouse platform and consolidate it (20%).** Two data warehouse efforts exist today. Evaluate both with the Senior Data Engineer, decide whether and how to combine them, and own the resulting platform: architecture, cost, security, and the automated feeds from NetSuite, the online store, and the shipping partner. * **Own cross\-system reporting and metric standards (20%).** Any report that mixes NetSuite data with data from another system belongs to this team. Define how each key metric (revenue, margin, cost, inventory, channel profitability) is calculated and tested so every report uses the same definition. Own the monthly product data quality report delivered to Enterprise Systems and the monthly comparison of online store products against NetSuite. * **Set the team's direction and priorities (15%).** Keep one backlog of data, reporting, and AI requests from leadership, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Digital Commerce. Rank the work and make sure the team delivers the highest\-value items first. * **Build and lead the team (15%).** Manage the Senior Data Engineer, the Analytics Engineer, and the BI Analyst, Commercial. Hire for open seats, set priorities, review work, run performance reviews, and take over the interim technical lead duties the Senior Data Engineer carries today. * **Deliver automation and AI tools on the warehouse (15%).** Identify where automation or AI on top of trusted data removes manual work or improves decisions. Pilot, measure, and deploy those tools with clear ownership and guardrails for data access and accuracy. * **Govern data dependencies on upstream systems (15%).** The warehouse reads from NetSuite and the online store. Make sure every upstream change that alters how data is stored is reviewed by this team before it goes live, follow the integration standards set by the Technical Lead: ERP, and keep daily loads and quality checks running with backup coverage. **Qualifications** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. **Experience:** * Seven or more years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including three or more years leading a data team. * Built or ran a cloud data warehouse in production, including the pipelines that feed it and the tests that protect it. * Delivered reporting for a retail, ecommerce, consumer products, or manufacturing business. * Shipped at least one automation or AI application on top of a data platform and measured its results. * Preferred: NetSuite and Shopify as source systems; consolidation or migration of a data platform. **Knowledge:** * Dimensional and analytical data modeling, ELT pipeline design, and orchestration. * SQL at an expert level, and at least one cloud warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks. * Data transformation and testing frameworks (dbt or similar) and data quality monitoring. * BI tools such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau, and the design of a metric layer with one definition per measure. * Large language model and automation patterns for business use, including their limits, cost, and data access controls. * ERP, ecommerce, and logistics data structures: orders, items, bills of materials, costs, inventory, shipments, and marketplace settlements. * Data governance, access control, and privacy basics for customer and financial data. **Skills:** * Making and defending a platform decision with cost, risk, and migration effort laid out plainly. * Turning vague business questions into defined metrics and reliable data sets. * Reading and reviewing pipeline and transformation code written by the team. * Managing a small distributed team across time zones, including remote staff. * Plain written and spoken communication with executives, Merchandising, Marketing, and Finance. **Decision making:** Decides which data platform the company runs on, how key company metrics are defined, what the team works on and in what order, and which automation and AI tools are built. Numbers produced by this team are used for channel profitability, inventory, and financial decisions, so errors in definition or data quality reach leadership directly. **Problem Solving:** Typical problems: two reports that disagree because they use different definitions; a NetSuite or online store change that breaks a feed; a question (such as profit by sales channel) that needs product cost, store, and shipping data joined correctly; a request for an AI tool where the underlying data is not yet trustworthy; limited team capacity against a long request list. **Physical Activity / Environmental demands:** Office and computer work: prolonged sitting, keyboard and screen use, and video and phone meetings. Travel averages once per quarter, to the Portland office, the manufacturing operation in Mexico, or US retail locations. **Language Skills:** English: fluent in speaking, reading, and writing. Required for all essential functions of the position. *Employees must reside in a state where the company is currently registered to conduct business and process payroll. At this time, we are able to hire in the following states: Oregon, Texas, Washington, Florida, Virginia, South Carolina, Nevada, Illinois, Michigan, Ohio, Colorado, Tennessee, New Hampshire and Georgia.* **What we can offer you!** * Health, dental \& vision insurance (75% cost covered by PLG for team member) * 401(k) with 4% company match * Discounted pet insurance * Holidays (including 1 floating holiday), vacation \& sick time * Store discount * Dynamic \& collaborative team environment **About Portland Leather** We’ve come a long way since the garage days. Portland Leather Goods was founded in 2016 to solve a simple problem: Why was it so hard to find an affordable, full\-grain leather bag that actually looked and felt great? We’ve grown fast by staying focused — on quality, on value, and on creating a brand people actually love to be part of. Now, we’re building something even bigger. And we’re doing it with people who love taking ownership, bringing energy, and making a real impact. If that’s you — we’d love to meet you. **At Portland Leather Goods, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join our team. Check us out at portlandleathergoods.com and on Instagram @portlandleather

jobs.title: Forward-deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- GripFusion is building the next generation of sports performance technology with Tactile Intelligence. As our Forward\-Deployed Software Engineer, you will expand every surface where GripFusion meets the athlete, from the ForceBall to the iPad, mobile, and web experiences that turn tactile data into decisions. This is a product\-facing engineering role reporting to Will Shawn, Head of Software. You will work across the full stack, spend time with players and coaches to understand how they use novel tactile data, and turn what you learn into shipped product. You will bring design and athlete thinking to every decision. You will work alongside our product, embedded, data science, and design teams to build new visualizations, connect GripFusion to the systems our customers already use, and carry common design practices across our baseball and golf platforms. **What You'll Build** --------------------- * **The iPad app.** Extend and harden our primary product, built in React Native on an AWS backend and used by teams today. * **The web dashboard.** Build a new React dashboard where coaches and staff review sessions, compare athletes, and share insights. * **The mobile** **app.** Build a mobile app that communicates directly with the ForceBall and supports broader use cases at the field. * **Novel visualizations.** Invent new ways to show tactile and athlete data, including 3D graphics that make the invisible obvious. * **Integrations.** Pull in data from the other systems teams already use, so GripFusion fits naturally into their workflow. * **The golf platform.** Contribute to our golf product and carry common design patterns and components across baseball and golf. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Work across the full stack, from BLE device communication and cloud services to mobile and web interfaces. * Partner with players, coaches, and team staff to understand user needs and how they interact with tactile data. * Balance quick prototyping and discovery with production\-level engineering, testing, and deployment. * Work with design to shape the user experience, and establish shared design practices across verticals. * Partner with embedded and data science to define device data transmission, state handling, and data formats. * Visit MLB teams to test with athletes and coaches, and bring product thinking back to the software stack. * Use AI development tools every day, and help shape how the software team builds with them. **Desired Skills \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------ * 4\+ years shipping production software across mobile and web, ideally with React Native, React, and TypeScript. * Full\-stack experience, including cloud backends on AWS and the CI/CD and release pipelines that get apps to users. * A track record of working directly with clients, users, or stakeholders to shape what gets built. * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. * Experience with hardware systems, Bluetooth or other device data transmission, and device state diagrams (preferred). * Offline\-first mobile architecture and on\-device data analysis (preferred). * Data visualization or 3D graphics on web or mobile, such as three.js, WebGL, or React Three Fiber (preferred). * Experience integrating third\-party data sources and APIs (preferred). * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. **Who You Are** --------------- * **An owner.** You take product and technical ownership end to end, from first conversation to shipped feature. * **A builder who explores.** You love quick prototypes and discovery, but you know when a prototype needs to become a product. * **Product\- and design\-minded.** You care about how an experience feels, not just whether it works. * **An athlete at heart.** You have competed or coached, and you understand how players train, compete, and take feedback. * **A great communicator.** You are as comfortable in a clubhouse with players and coaches as you are in a code review. * **AI\-first.** You embrace AI tools as a core part of how you design, build, and ship. **Impact \& Growth** -------------------- This role is designed to grow with the company. You will shape how GripFusion shows up for athletes and coaches across every surface we build. As our baseball and golf platforms expand, you will have a seat at the table on product direction, design practices, and how our AI\-first engineering team works. **Benefits Summary** -------------------- * Healthcare, dental, vision. * Health Savings account with company contribution. * 401K with match. * PTO * Paid holidays. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Full\-time, in\-person role based at GripFusion's Performance Lab headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, including our in\-house pitching lab, with up to 10% travel to MLB/NCAA teams and partners. * Collaborative, innovation\-first startup environment working across hardware, firmware, software, design, and data science. * Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to build a new category of sports performance technology from the ground up. * Career development opportunities and professional growth. * Family first, with a close\-knit team that enjoys solving hard problems.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Data centers run on thousands of sensors, meters, and control systems, and the teams who run their power infrastructure have to make sense of all of it in real time. Teserac is building Neuron™, an AI\-native observability and automation platform that gives those teams full visibility into their power operations and helps them get ahead of problems. At its core is an AI teammate that works alongside every operator around the clock: detecting anomalies, correlating events, and recommending what to do next. As a Full Stack Developer, you'll own features end to end, from the ingestion path that pulls telemetry off a BMS in a live facility, through the time\-series layer that stores it, to the dashboard an operator is watching at 2am. This is a small team with real customers in production. Your code ships in days, not quarters, and it runs in facilities where being wrong has physical consequences. You'll work directly with the Principal Software \& Architecture Lead, Product, and Solution Engineering. We move fast, avoid bureaucracy, and expect engineers to own outcomes rather than tickets. This is a hybrid role based in our Santa Clara office, and visa sponsorship is available. **Who We Are Looking For** You're a full\-stack engineer who is comfortable on both sides of the line, and who gets interested rather than annoyed when the data is messy, the vendor's API is undocumented, and the protocol spec is a PDF from 2009\. You likely: * Build front to back. You can trace a value from a Modbus register to a rendered chart without handing off, and you know where it's likely to break. * Take databases seriously. You know that a query plan, an index, and a migration on a large table are engineering decisions, not configuration. * Have worked with real time\-series data at a volume where naive approaches stop working, and understand what that costs at read time and write time. * Debug production calmly. When CPU is pinned and a queue is backing up, you reason from evidence rather than restarting things. * Use AI tooling well. You get real leverage from Cursor, Claude Code, or similar, and your standards didn't drop when you started using it. **What You'll Do** **Product and front end** * Build operator\-facing features for Neuron™ in React and TypeScript: real\-time dashboards, alerting, alarm and ticket workflows, capacity planning views, and power\-flow visualizations. * Build the interfaces the AI teammate works through: interaction panels, recommendation displays, approval workflows, and audit trails. * Keep large, data\-dense views fast and responsive across devices. **Data ingestion and integrations** * Build and maintain the ingestion path that brings telemetry from customer sites into Neuron™: edge collectors, MQTT over AWS IoT Core, queue\-based workers, and normalization into a canonical metric model. * Write integration modules against real building and power systems: Siemens Desigo, Schneider PME and EcoStruxure, Niagara, Eaton, and generic BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP sources. * Own the correctness of what lands: point mapping, unit and phase semantics, deduplication, and backfill. **Time\-series platform** * Develop against PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB: hypertables, continuous aggregates, compression, and retention. * Design schema and migrations that stay safe as tables grow into the billions of rows. * Find and fix the performance problems that only appear with real customer data volumes. **Quality and operations** * Write tested, reviewed code, and contribute to CI/CD and automated testing. * Troubleshoot production issues across the stack, and share on\-call as the platform scales. **Why Teserac** We're not building incremental improvements to legacy tools. We're re\-architecting how data centers see, understand, and act on their own operations. * Ship features that directly shape how some of the world's most critical AI infrastructure is powered and managed. * Join a small engineering team where every developer has outsized impact and direct visibility into product decisions. * Work where AI, real\-time systems, and physical infrastructure meet. * Grow with the company from Series A through scale. **Requirements** * **Required** * + 7\+ years building and shipping production software across the stack + Strong Python, ideally Django. Our backend is Django and Celery, and it's the language you'll write most days. + Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query performance, and migrations you'd run against a live production database + Practical time\-series experience. TimescaleDB is ideal, and deep experience with another time\-series or high\-volume streaming store transfers. + Solid React and TypeScript, and the judgment to keep a data\-heavy interface fast + Experience with asynchronous and event\-driven systems: task queues, pub/sub, streaming, or WebSockets + Comfortable on AWS. We run ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, and IoT Core. + Able to work independently, define your own scope from a rough requirement, and ship * **Preferred** * + Industrial or IoT telemetry experience: BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar OT data sources + Hands\-on experience with industrial protocols: BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, or vendor BMS APIs + Data center infrastructure familiarity: power distribution topology, UPS and PDU behavior, or PUE + Experience building observability or monitoring products, commercial or internal + Early\-stage startup experience, Seed through Series B * Nobody checks every box here. If some of these describe you, apply. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Free Food \& Snacks * Stock Option Plan * 401(k)

jobs.title: IT Director
jobs.description: **About SpyGlass Pharma:** At SpyGlass Pharma (NASDAQ: SGP), we are focused on improving and preserving the vision of patients living with chronic eye diseases, while minimizing the burden treatment can place on their daily lives. We are advancing innovative long\-term ophthalmic drug delivery technologies designed to provide sustained therapy through cataract surgery and help improve patient outcomes. We have built a highly collaborative team with deep expertise across ophthalmology, drug delivery, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices. Our scientists, engineers, and clinical leaders bring decades of experience developing and commercializing breakthrough technologies, united by a shared commitment to patients and our guiding principle: “We create for patients.” That mindset shapes how we build our products, our teams, and our culture. Backed by strong clinical progress, significant funding, and a growing organization, SpyGlass Pharma is entering an exciting stage of growth as we advance our lead program, the SpyGlass BIM\-IOL, through Phase 3 clinical development. **Summary:** The Director of IT will serve as SpyGlass Pharma’s first dedicated in\-house IT leader — a hands\-on builder who also brings the experience to know what good looks like. This role owns IT strategy, systems administration, and infrastructure across SpyGlass’s Microsoft 365\-based environment and directs our managed IT and security services provider (MSP/MSSP), responsible for IT service delivery and security operations and partners closely with our fractional CISO, who owns cybersecurity strategy, AI governance, and third\-party security risk. The ideal candidate will operate independently as an individual contributor initially, while leveraging the services and skills of our Managed Service Provider (MSP). Eventually, this individual will be a key contributor to the strategy for building out SpyGlass’ IT infrastructure as the company scales. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead the design, implementation, and administration of SpyGlass Pharma’s IT infrastructure, including its Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, networking, and cloud environment. * Own the full lifecycle of enterprise IT systems — configuration, security, maintenance, monitoring, and upgrades — across platforms including Egnyte (file storage), NetSuite (ERP), MasterControl (QMS), Bamboo (HRIS \& ATS), and Veeva Vault and iMednet/Medrio (clinical systems). * Direct and manage SpyGlass’s outsourced IT and help desk provider, including SLAs, escalation, and an ongoing evaluation of what should remain outsourced versus move in\-house as the company scales. * Partner with SpyGlass’s fractional CISO to operationalize cybersecurity, AI governance, and access\-control policy — the CISO sets policy and risk direction; jobs.title: ML Researcher
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Conduit is a frontier AI research company, training on a new modality of data: brain signals. Our first goal is to decode thought into text through a non\-invasive headset. We're a team of about ten ML researchers and software engineers, working together in San Francisco. Conduit's mission is to increase the communication bandwidth between humans and AIs—and to do so soon. We believe AGI is about to be a solved problem, but keeping humans empowered is not. We have about 30,000 hours (and counting) of time\-aligned brain signals and typing data, from about 1% of San Franciscans. Your job is to 1\) train useful models given the data, and 2\) steer our data collection operation so we get more useful data. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Train models:** We're in a data\-limited regime. As we scale up to 100x the amount of data we have now, we hope to also get 10\-60x data efficiency wins. Research spans encoders, decoders, synthetic data, multimodal training, scaling laws, evals, post\-training, and more. **Steer data collection:** As we expand data operations, we want to track where our data collection can be improved. You'll be answering questions like: does sensor X or sensor Y lead to better downstream model performance? If we put the sensors on a dummy head that has known physical properties, do we see sensors performing as expected? Answering these questions involves physical experiments, statistical heuristics, and training many models. **Optionally, a bit of everything:** We're a team of about ten. If you want to wear many hats – hardware, fundraising, recruiting, product – we welcome your efforts! If you prefer to focus solely on research, we welcome that too. Your analyses will heavily rely on AI, and you'll have all the AI tokens you could want. **Who you are** --------------- Most important qualities: * Brilliant and curious * Deep and broad knowledge of ML * Bonuses: undergrad\-level physics and/or neuroscience intuitions Example current employees include: * Former lead of an AI alignment fellowship who studied physics and ML. * PhD in ML architecture research with a B.A. in math, who questions everything from first principles. * Top\-5 college computer science dropout who joined a frontier AI company at age 21 and had previously interned at a top quant finance firm. Our bar is a bit higher than the bar for researcher hiring at OpenAI/Anthropic/DeepMind, with the exception that we'll consider candidates with exceptional physics intuitions. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: San Francisco, fully in office * Schedule: Full\-time * Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance. Free food for lunch, dinner, and whenever you're hungry. Personal trainer available. We pay for your commute. **Application process** ----------------------- Our process: * A 30\-minute call to get to know each other. * A 2\-hour coding assignment, where you're allowed to use AI. * An hour\-long chat about ML and the company. * An approximately two\-day work trial, where you'll do real tasks alongside us. * Offer.

This leader owns the strategic development, deployment, and maturity of the **BLUvera Operating System (BOS)** while ensuring operational processes, systems, and teams are aligned to support BLUvera's aggressive growth objectives. The Senior Operational Excellence Manager serves as the organization's primary change agent and operational transformation leader. This role integrates Lean Manufacturing, Daily Management Systems, Business Process Optimization, Digital Enablement, Oracle ERP adoption, and enterprise\-wide continuous improvement into a single operating framework that drives measurable business results. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable setting strategy, coaching leaders, facilitating transformation, and driving hands\-on process improvements throughout manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, and support functions. **Primary Responsibilities** **BLUvera Operating System (BOS) Leadership** * Own the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of the BLUvera Operating System (BOS). * Establish enterprise standards for Daily Management Systems, visual management, leader standard work, tier meetings, KPI reviews, and problem\-solving processes. * Define and maintain BOS maturity assessments and improvement roadmaps. * Ensure BOS standards are consistently applied across all manufacturing facilities and functions. * Facilitate operational reviews and ensure business performance is managed through standardized routines. **Lean Enterprise Transformation** * Lead BLUvera's Lean Manufacturing strategy and deployment roadmap. * Facilitate Kaizen events, value stream mapping initiatives, 3P workshops, and operational transformation projects. * Develop Lean capability throughout the organization through training, coaching, and certification programs. * Drive productivity improvements, waste reduction, and process simplification efforts. * Identify and scale best practices across all facilities and value streams. **Process Optimization \& Business Systems** * Lead cross\-functional process improvement initiatives spanning Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Project Management. * Drive business process standardization and simplification. * Partner with IT and business leaders on Oracle ERP deployment, process integration, and adoption. * Develop enterprise process maps, governance models, and business system roadmaps. * Ensure operational processes support scalability, automation, and future growth. **Continuous Improvement Governance** * Establish enterprise KPI dashboards and operational review processes. * Drive accountability for KPI performance through structured action planning and follow\-up. * Facilitate root cause problem\-solving activities for chronic business performance issues. * Develop standard methodologies for RCCA, A3 problem solving, and PDCA execution. * Monitor and report operational excellence progress to executive leadership. **Organizational Capability Development** * Develop operational excellence competencies across all levels of the organization. * Coach Operations Managers, Plant Managers, Value Stream Managers, and functional leaders. * Create training programs on Lean, BOS, leadership routines, and continuous improvement. * Build internal operational excellence talent and succession plans. * Serve as a mentor and thought leader for transformation initiatives. **Strategic Growth \& Innovation** * Support new product introductions, facility launches, and operational scaling activities. * Partner with Manufacturing Engineering on automation and capital deployment strategies. * Lead enterprise productivity initiatives that improve capacity and labor efficiency. * Develop operational readiness frameworks for future growth initiatives. * Evaluate emerging technologies that enable operational excellence and business scalability. **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Collaborate closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Safety, Finance, Product Development, and Project Management. * Align improvement priorities with business strategy. * Lead enterprise transformation steering committees. * Support strategic planning efforts through operational capability assessments and maturity planning. **Key Performance Indicators** The Senior Operational Excellence Manager is accountable for improving: **BOS \& Transformation** * BOS Maturity Score * Daily Management System Adoption * Standard Work Compliance * Tier Meeting Effectiveness * Leader Standard Work Completion **Continuous Improvement** * Kaizen Event Success Rate * Annual Productivity Improvement * Cost Savings Realization * Process Cycle Time Reduction * Labor Hours per Unit Reduction **Quality** * First Pass Quality (FPQ) * RCCA Closure Effectiven  * Experience implementing or optimizing Oracle ERP systems. * Multi\-site manufacturing leadership experience. * Experience supporting rapid organizational growth. * Knowledge of modular construction, prefabrication, industrialized construction, or engineered products manufacturing environments. **Success Profile** A successful Senior Operational Excellence Manager at BLUvera: * Thinks strategically while executing tactically. * Creates scalable business systems rather than isolated improvements. * Builds organizational capability and leadership capacity. * Leads change without relying solely on authority. * Uses data to drive decision\-making. * Balances operational discipline with innovation. * Builds a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and learning. * Embodies BLUvera's commitment to safety, quality, customer success, and operational excellence. **A few benefits offered include:** *(for Non\-Craft \& Non\-Union Craft working 25\+ hours / week)* * Medical and prescription drug plans that includes no additional cost vision coverage * Dental plan * 401k retirement plan with a generous Mortenson match * Paid time off, holidays, and other paid leaves * Employer paid Life, AD\&D, and disability insurance * No\-Cost mental health tool and concierge with extensive work\-life resources * Tuition reimbursement * Adoption Assistance * Gym Membership Discount Program **The base pay range for this role is $118,600 \- $178,000** (Actual range is higher for the following office locations: Denver, CO and Chicago, IL – 5%, Seattle, WA, and Portland, OR – 10%, Washington, D.C. – 12\.5%). Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience, with consideration given to internal equity. This position is eligible for Mortenson’s incentive plan. **\#LI\-CB1** **Please make note:** * Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position. * Our postings are typically open a minimum of 5 days and an average of 44 days. **ABOUT BLUvera** BLUvera, a Mortenson affiliate, is the leading manufacturer creating solutions that are industrializing the construction industry. We provide innovative building solutions that deliver a faster, safer, and more predictable experience for construction projects. Our products are fabricated with unprecedented precision, accuracy, and speed, providing customers with a fast, cost\-effective, and safer building solution. Let’s Redefine Possible® BLUvera, Mortenson’s vertically integrated manufacturing and fabrication affiliate, utilizes advanced design, engineering, 3D modeling, and manufacturing to deliver a safer, faster, and more predictable experience to the built environment. By utilizing DfMA principles (design for manufacturing and assembly), BLUvera leverages technology in the manufacture and fabrication of off\-site construction products\- enabling our customers to realize the schedule and cost savings that the industrialized process creates. Our aim is to transform the way we build things, turning digital models into precision specified building components, not just by being at the leading edge of industry disruption, but creating it! **Equal Employment Opportunity** Your uniqueness brings new and creative perspectives to the team. Mortenson is committed to providing equal opportunities of employment (EOE) to all individuals, regardless of your race, religion, gender, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, marital status or any other legally protected category. **Other Items to Note** * Mortenson reserves the right to hire any individual without legal or financial obligation on unwanted solicitations. *No agency emails, calls, or solicitations are accepted* without a valid agreement. * Must be currently legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status, 0\-1, TN, CPT, OPT, etc.). We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral AI Scientist
jobs.description: **Postdoctoral AI Scientist** **Palo Alto, California \| 12\-24Month Appointment** **About AIVista** NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, develops AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. Based in Palo Alto, we combine deep AI product expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems\-integration experience, working with NTT companies to deploy solutions for enterprise clients. **The Opportunity** AIVista is seeking a **Postdoctoral AI Scientist** to conduct research on foundational problems at the intersection of machine learning, knowledge representation, formal methods, and AI agents for enterprise systems. You will work alongside scientists and engineers to define and pursue ambitious research questions, develop new methods and systems, and evaluate them against complex, production\-scale problems and data. You will conduct research that advances the state of the art while creating a path toward performant and trustworthy AI systems that can operate reliably in real enterprise environments. This is an an initial 12\-month appointment with the option to extend it to 24 months **postdoctoral research appointment** designed for researchers who have completed their PhD and want to continue developing a strong research agenda while working closely with real\-world AI systems. Pursuing publication of research at top\-tier conferences and journals is highly encouraged, and projects are selected to support both rigorous scientific contribution and practical relevance. **Science Focus** * **Neurosymbolic methods and trustworthy reasoning:** Combine learning\-based and symbolic techniques to improve reliability, transparency, and alignment with domain constraints. * **Knowledge representation and semantic AI:** Develop methods that help AI systems organize, connect, and reason over complex enterprise information. * **Adaptive and model\-agnostic AI systems:** Explore flexible approaches that integrate models, tools, context, and memory across diverse tasks and environments. **Scalable domain model development:** Develop scalable methods for building domain\-specialized models, spanning automated generation of training and agentic environments, mid\-training on domain data, post\-training through fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning, and rigorous domain\-grounded evaluation. * **Learning from feedback:** Develop methods that enable AI systems to improve safely and effectively from human and operational feedback. * **Evaluation, verification, and interpretability:** Advance rigorous approaches to assessing AI reliability, robustness, safety, and transparency. * **AI for complex workflows:** Explore how intelligent systems can support and improve multi\-step enterprise processes while maintaining appropriate oversight and control. **What You'll Do** * Define and independently drive research questions across one or more of AIVista's science focus areas. * Develop novel algorithms, models, methods, prototypes, and system designs and evaluate their effectiveness through rigorous experimentation. * Design experiments and benchmarks that measure correctness, robustness, calibration, privacy, latency, cost, and process outcomes. * Work with scientists, engineers, and domain experts to translate enterprise data, policies, feedback, and operational constraints into research problems, research artifacts, and deployable systems. * Develop inspectable AI systems and analyses that connect model and agent decisions to evidence, rules, and outcomes. * Move promising research from early experimentation through simulation, controlled evaluation, and potential application in production\-scale AI systems. * Communicate research findings internally and externally and contribute high\-quality research to leading conferences, journals, and the broader scientific community. * Collaborate with and contribute to AIVista's broader research agenda while developing an independent body of research during the postdoctoral appointment. **Qualifications** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Operations Research, or a closely related technical field. **The PhD must be completed prior to the start of the appointment.** * Demonstrated research record in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, or a related technical discipline, evidenced through peer\-reviewed publications, significant research projects, or comparable scientific contributions. * Strong foundations in machine learning, algorithms, statistical methods, experimental design, and empirical research. * Deep research experience in one or more of the following areas: large language models, knowledge representation or knowledge graphs, formal methods, agentic systems, continual learning, multimodal learning, evaluation and interpretability, or process mining. * Ability to independently formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and communicate scientific findings. * Proficiency in Python and experience implementing and evaluating machine learning or AI systems. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across research, engineering, and domain teams. **Areas of Additional Research Experience** Relevant research experience may include: * Neurosymbolic methods, autoformalization, formal verification, theorem proving, or constraint solving. * Ontology construction, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, graph learning, or graph\-based retrieval. * Mid\-training (continued pretraining), supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for building domain\-specialized models. * Synthetic data and task generation, verifiable reward design, or scalable pipelines for training and evaluating domain models. * Agent memory, context engineering, model routing and orchestration, planning, tool use, or multi\-agent systems. * Continual, federated, or privacy\-preserving learning; uncertainty calibration; human\-in\-the\-loop systems; or regression\-safe adaptation. * Process mining, digital twins, simulation, workflow systems, or graduated\-autonomy deployments. * Robust and scalable benchmarking, agentic environment construction, and complex task metric design. * Research involving AI systems deployed in regulated, safety\-sensitive, or other high\-stakes environments. **Compensation \& Benefits** The estimated annual base salary for this role is **$150,000USD**. Individual compensation is determined based on job\-related factors including education, research experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and market conditions. Eligible employees may participate in Company\-sponsored benefits in accordance with applicable Company policies. **Housing and relocation assistance may be available based on individual circumstances and business needs. Eligible postdoctoral researchers may also receive travel assistance associated with relocation to and from the Palo Alto area, in accordance with Company policy.** NTT DATA AIVista is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

working experience on large scale machine learning * Strong knowledge of and experience implementing AI/ML technologies and applying mathematical and statistical concepts. * Proficient in Java, Engineering teams * Passionate about understanding the ad business, applying advanced research to relevant business scenarios, and seeking innovation opportunities to enhance business effectiveness. * Passionate about technology, open to interdisciplinary collaborations, and experienced in building data\-driven services and applications. * A proven track record of thriving in a fast\-paced, data\-driven, and collaborative work environment is required. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in large scale machine learning using tools such as scikit\-learn, Spark MLLib, pytorch * Experience with LLM\-based application development, using LLM\-as\-a\-service providers such as AWS Bedrock, Azure Cognitive Services, or Google's Vertex AI * Experience using frameworks such as LangGraph, Crew AI, and strands sdk for developing agents * Experience with vector databases and retrieval\-augmented generation * Experience with best practices in agentic development such as LLM guardrails, tool calling, and consistent APIs such as MCP and A2A * Experience with designing and implementing agentic architectures in multiple modalities such as text, image, video, and audio. * Experience in the advertising, digital video advertising, or digital marketing domain **Required Education:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related equivalent experience. **Preferred Education:** * Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, Information Systems or related equivalent experience. \#TECHATDISNEY **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Seattle, WA is $220,600 to $295,900 per year and in Glendale, CA is $210,500 to $282,300 per year. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Dockware** ------------------ Dockware is relentlessly driving toward the error free dock. Every day across the world, millions of freight handlers scan, count, inspect, measure, photograph, label, read, and transcribe shipment data tens of millions of times, and errors are the rule, not the exception. Every error on the dock ripples across the rest of the value chain, leading to inventory management discrepancies, misroutes, under/over pricing, disputes, sub\-optimal asset utilization, and many flavors of claims and chargebacks. As logistics underpins roughly 10% of global GDP, even marginal improvements at the dock translate into massive gains for businesses, workers, and consumers everywhere. Using computer vision, edge hardware, and real\-time ML systems, Dockware captures dimensions, condition, and identifiers for every shipment \- in seconds. That data becomes a verifiable digital twin: a continuously updated, shareable record that moves with the shipment from origin to destination.‍ Our platform integrates directly into existing workflows, eliminating manual data entry, barcode dependency, and costly delays \- while turning messy, real\-world freight into clean, actionable data. The result is a system that reduces disputes, improves operational accuracy, and unlocks better decisions across the supply chain. For the full company vision, read here. Dockware has deep Midwestern roots. Jerks, credit hogs, and elitists need not apply. We come to work and give everything because we know our teammates are doing the same. Similarly, the logistics professionals we serve make modern life possible – full stop. They deserve tech that works and real humans who answer the phone. **About the Role** ------------------ As a **Product Engineer** for our Scan Mobile app, you will bridge the gap between user research and technical implementation. The Scan Mobile app can be used by shippers or drivers, and allows either party to quickly and affordably capture all the accurate data required to originate, track, and/or validate a shipment (Demo of one version of app here). Dockware is also expanding mobile offerings in new customer segments where freight handlers and supervisors need phone or tablet based interaction on the dock. This role is designed for a technically inclined product manager, or an engineer with a talent for customer facing engagement and UX. * **Customer Feedback and Experience:** You'll engage directly with our customers through user interviews and ride\-alongs with drivers to gather insights, then use that feedback to shape the design and functionality of both our web and mobile applications. * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Actively engage at every stage of the product’s lifecycle—from early development to warehouse integration and support. * **UI development**: You may also contribute directly to the UI, writing code for the frontend and mobile platforms. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** Proficiency in at least two of the following areas, with a strong interest and enthusiasm for the rest: * Product Management: + Making decisions for the overall product strategy, roadmap, and feature prioritization based on customer impact. + Defining functional requirements and acceptance criteria for mobile and web features. + Balancing technical feasibility, user needs, and business goals to prioritize engineering deliverables. * User Data gathering: + Experience conducting user research, such as interviews or field observations. + Ability to translate user feedback into actionable product enhancements. + Strong communication skills to effectively bridge technical engineering teams and non\-technical stakeholders * UX and Design: + Understanding of user\-centered design principles to craft intuitive, user\-friendly experiences that align with customer expectations. + Experience producing clear design artifacts, including wireframes, user flow diagrams, and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs). * UI Development for Android and iOS + Ideally Kotlin Multi\-platform and Java, but not required. + Familiarity with Android and iOS testing frameworks **Preferred:** * Knowledge and/or experience in supply chain and logistics. **BonusL** * Hands on development experience in both iOS and Android development. * Track record of shipping production software systems * Experience with Machine Learning or Computer Vision products * You have refined your own AI\-augmented development workflow **What Makes You Successful Here** You don't get stuck in the weeds. You commit and follow through. You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make progress without complete specifications. You ask "why" before diving into "how," and you're not afraid to challenge assumptions when something doesn't make sense. This is a high\-ownership environment where your work directly impacts customers and revenue. You'll have autonomy, but you'll also be expected to take initiative and drive projects to completion. **Location** Striking distance of Tulsa, OK preferred, but we're open to exceptional candidates regardless of location. This role may require periodic travel to customer sites and our Tulsa headquarters. *Dockware is building the primary data capture layer for global logistics. If you're ready to tackle computer vision challenges at warehouse scale while keeping world\-class engineers aligned and shipping, we want to hear from you.*

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **About Faex Health** Faex Health turns stool images into gut\-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer\-vision models, color\-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval\-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP\-1 gut\-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems. **The Role** We are hiring a QA automation engineer to expand and formalize our existing test suite and CI. Today we run a Django test suite and browser regression tests, and an Azure DevOps pipeline runs tests and a secret scan on every pull request to our main and release branches. You will strengthen the frameworks, extend coverage across the web app, APIs, mobile apps, and image\-analysis pipeline, and make test results part of every release decision. You will work directly with our CTO and developers. **What You Will Do** * **Test frameworks.** Expand and formalize our automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and regression testing, building on the existing Django test suite, with clear structure, reusable components, and reporting. * **Azure Pipelines integration.** Extend the Azure Pipelines YAML checks that already run tests and a secret scan on every pull request, publish results, and add quality gates that block failing builds. * **Azure DevOps test management.** Organize test plans, suites, and cases, using Azure Test Plans where it adds value; log and track defects in Azure Boards linked to stories and builds; keep tests in Azure Repos. * **Web UI automation.** Expand browser regression tests for the Django web app using tools such as Playwright or Selenium, covering our new Bootstrap 5 interface. * **API testing.** Test REST and partner APIs, including FHIR\-based integrations, authentication, and error handling. * **Mobile testing.** Test the iPhone and Android apps that wrap our web app, covering photo upload, deep links, sign\-in flows, and device differences, using tools such as Appium and cloud device testing. * **Image\-analysis pipeline testing.** Build regression checks that run labeled reference images through new model releases to confirm detection, color\-density, and scoring results stay within agreed limits. * **Release verification.** Run and extend smoke tests after Elastic Beanstalk deployments, building on the /health/ check in our deploy pipeline, and help decide whether to proceed or roll back. * **Performance testing.** Create load and performance tests for scan processing, queues, and peak traffic, using tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter. * **Test data and compliance.** Build safe test data using synthetic or de\-identified records, never real patient information, and support SOC 2 and HIPAA audit evidence. * **Quality metrics.** Track coverage, flaky tests, and defect trends, and work with developers to improve testability. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years in software quality assurance, including 3\+ years building test automation. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining an automation framework, not just writing scripts within one. * Experience running and maintaining automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, triggered on pull requests and releases. * Strong Python testing skills (Django test framework / unittest; pytest also valuable); experience testing Django or other Python web apps. * Experience with browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. * Experience with API testing tools and frameworks, such as Django’s test client, Python HTTP clients, or Postman. * Solid understanding of CI/CD, Git branching, and test strategies such as unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and regression. * Clear defect reporting and communication with developers. * Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change. * Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with the Faex app or experience testing health, wellness, or medical software. * Experience with Azure DevOps: Azure Pipelines YAML, Azure Test Plans, Azure Boards, and Azure Repos. * Experience with mobile automation using Appium or cloud device testing services. * Experience testing machine\-learning or computer\-vision outputs. * Experience with performance testing tools such as Locust, k6, or JMeter. * Experience testing on AWS, including Elastic Beanstalk deployments and environment management. * Experience with PostgreSQL and validating data in tests. * Experience working under HIPAA, SOC 2, or FDA software quality requirements. * ISTQB or a similar testing certification. **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership: you will set our testing standards, not just follow them. * Evidence\-led: every release decision should be backed by test results. * Privacy by default: test data must never expose real health information. Pay: $70,700\.00 \- $85,300\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance. Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform. ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls. We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2\.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a **Senior Analytics Engineer** to take ownership of our client reporting data models and pipelines. This crucial role involves managing the layer of our data models responsible for transforming raw data into reliable, structured, and performant assets for reporting, analysis, and AI initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of analytics and data engineering, ensuring data is production\-grade, auditable, and easily accessible across the organization and our customers. You will own client reporting, standardize our data modeling practices, manage the orchestration of analytical workflows, and provide hands\-on analytical support for high\-stakes operational business functions, including reporting and performance management. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Client Reporting \& Infrastructure:** Scope and develop new client reports, while also maintaining and enhancing existing reporting pipelines. Collaborate with external clients and our internal client success team to effectively manage and triage inbound requests. Partner with Valon Technologies' data team to improve the underlying infrastructure for client reporting. * **Data Modeling \& Transformation:** Design, build, and maintain the production\-grade data models and analytical layers using our existing stack of BigQuery, dbt, and Airflow to ensure reliability and structure at scale. * **Data Governance \& Quality:** Partner with engineering and product teams to define and implement **data contracts** and **observability frameworks** to guarantee data quality and auditability for a regulated environment. * **Analytical Support:** Write complex **SQL queries**, build dashboards (in tools like Hex or Looker), and conduct ad hoc analysis to empower operational leaders and provide deep root\-cause insights into business performance. **Ideal Background \& Qualifications** -------------------------------------- * **Experience:** 7\+ years of combined experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a highly technical data analytics role, ideally at a technology company or financial institution (Series B–E startup experience is a plus). * **Technical Stack:** Expertise in **SQL** (required), strong proficiency in **Python**, and proven experience with core modern data stack tools like **dbt** and **Airflow**. * **Communication:** Communicate effectively with external clients, clearly synthesizing their requests, establishing realistic timelines, and proactively managing expectations, including pushing back when necessary to ensure successful outcomes. * **Architecture \& Quality:** Deep understanding of data architecture patterns (e.g. medallion architecture) and experience implementing data quality frameworks, observability tools, or data contracts at scale. * **Analytical Tools:** Experience with data visualization tools (Hex, Looker, or equivalent) and proficiency in Google Sheets/Microsoft Excel. * **Mindset:** A strong product mindset, focusing on the usability, reliability, and developer experience of the data systems you build. * **Problem\-Solving:** Proven ability to solve complex problems independently and build repeatable processes around novel situations. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a similar field.t professional experience in Computer
