jobs.title: Senior Computational Chemist
jobs.description: **Adiabatic Materials \| Somerville, MA** ***Reinvent chemistry. Decarbonize industry. Electrify the future.*** Today, most chemicals are still made using heat from burning fossil fuels in energy\-intensive, polluting processes. Adiabatic Materials has developed a fundamentally new approach: an electrochemical synthesis platform that uses clean electricity instead of heat. The platform grew out of 15 years of Harvard research and has been demonstrated for a broad range of chemicals. Adiabatic recently spun out of Harvard and is scaling its operations in the Boston area. **Why Adiabatic might be great for you** We’re a small, early\-stage team working on hard, meaningful problems. If you get energy from making things actually work and want your contributions to directly shape a company’s trajectory, this could be a great fit. * You'll be our first dedicated computational chemist. You'll own the computational side of our chemistry, reporting to our CEO and working closely with our Chief Scientific Officer. * Direct strategic impact. Your data and ideas will help decide which products and targets we pursue, and they will feed directly into our conversations with partners and investors. * Computation close to the lab. You'll work side by side with the chemists who run the experiments, and see your proposals tested at the bench. * Chemistry that is genuinely new. Electrochemical reactions with high functional group tolerance, opening shorter routes to pharmaceutical and fine chemical targets. * Equity and upside. You'll share in the value you help create, alongside a mission\-driven team that cares about science and sustainability. **The Role** We're looking for a Senior Computational Chemist who provides well\-founded data and new ideas for our product strategy decisions, and builds out our ability to access new routes efficiently. A big part of the job is code for retrosynthetic analysis and Bayesian optimization: adapting open\-source tools such as ASKCOS, extending them with our own reactions, and developing new proprietary code, together with the data and parameters behind it. The goal is route planning and process optimization that is commercially useful, e.g. which targets benefit most from our reactions and what a product would cost along a proposed route at different scales. You're a cheminformatics and machine learning expert with a strong interest in chemistry. You enjoy a balance of chemistry discussions and time with your tools and code, and you understand enough chemistry to judge the output of your tools and to answer simple chemistry questions on your own. **What You'll Do** **Synthesis Planning:** Review the available open\-source tools, incl. ASKCOS and RetroAgent, recommend the best fit for our use cases and set it up. Then adapt its code, data and parameters so it proposes the new routes our reactions enable. **Target and Route Screening:** Screen promising pharmaceutical and fine chemical targets for places where our reactions shorten a route or solve a selectivity problem, estimate what a product would cost along a proposed route, and back each opportunity with data. The goal is a ranked shortlist of targets for experimental route validation. You'll also help judge which reactions in development are worth pursuing by their possible economic value. **Reaction Data and Experiment Design:** Set up structured capture of reaction and process data that fits the lab team's daily work, and apply design of experiments or Bayesian optimization to live optimization campaigns. **Working with the Lab:** Spend time with the chemists on site, hand them experiment designs for the most promising proposals, and feed the lab results back into the models. **New Materials:** Get up to speed on structure/property prediction for new materials we may develop, and rank novel structures for synthesis. **AI Tools and Code:** Lead our in\-house AI tools for route planning, optimization and cost prediction, built on third\-party or open\-weight LLMs, and be our go\-to\-person for AI tools more broadly. Write code quickly with AI coding tools, and keep it clean and documented so the team can use it. **What We're Looking For** Many strong candidates don’t fit a standard blueprint. If you bring relevant experience and are excited about what we’re building, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box. **Required:** * PhD in cheminformatics, computational chemistry, chemical engineering, computer science or a closely related field, with a focus on cheminformatics or machine learning for chemistry, or a master's degree plus two years of relevant experience * Strong programming skills in Python and efficient use of AI coding tools, with a track record of code that others use, e.g. a tool, a package, a public repository or a publication with code * Hands\-on cheminformatics and machine learning for chemistry: RDKit or similar toolkits, molecular and reaction representations, and reaction and molecular databases * At least an undergraduate\-level understanding of organic chemistry, enough to judge whether a proposed route is plausible and what a reaction template represents * Hands\-on experience in at least one of: synthesis planning and retrosynthesis, reaction outcome or condition prediction, reaction data curation, Bayesian optimization or design of experiments, automated or high\-throughput experimentation **Nice to Have:** * Experience with a retrosynthesis planner such as ASKCOS or CAS SciFinder (a strong plus) * Hands\-on synthetic lab experience, e.g. a bachelor thesis in a synthetic lab * Pharmaceutical process chemistry, API supply chains, techno\-economic analysis or quantum chemistry (e.g. DFT) * Industry or startup experience is a plus, not a requirement * Electrochemistry experience is not required **Working Style \& Character:** * You like building tools people use: you ship a working first version within weeks and improve it step by step * You seek out the scientists and engineers, ask what they need, and enjoy working with them on site * You are clear about what a model or a dataset can and can't tell us, and you know when computation or AI is the right tool and when it isn't * You can explain a model's answer and its uncertainty to non\-specialists, e.g. for a partner or investor conversation * You pick up adjacent work when the company needs it, e.g. a techno\-economic check or a look at market data * You take high\-level direction, run with it and manage your own time against milestones, you're comfortable with less structure than in a big company, and you care about building a great team culture as we grow **Logistics** * **Location:** Greentown Labs, Somerville, MA. On site four days a week * **Work style:** Flexible, family\-friendly schedule * **Compensation:** $130K to $185K/year, plus meaningful equity and benefits (negotiable). The range is deliberately broad because it spans a strong recent PhD through to about five years of experience **How to Apply** Please submit your resume and include a few sentences about why you're excited about Adiabatic and how this role aligns with your experience. This is also an opportunity to highlight experiences that you feel are particularly relevant for the role. This doesn't need to be a formal cover letter; we just want to understand what motivates you. **The pay range for this role is:** 130,000 \- 185,000 USD per year(Somerville, MA)

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Data Center
jobs.description: **About You:**Do you have an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for engineering? Do you love designing *and* implementing complex electrical systems? Are you looking for a company that is constantly trying to push the boundaries of what it means to offer a better construction solution process by using design/build? If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies. ARCO/Murray Engineering is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Mission Critical Engineering team in Downers Grove, Illinois. In this role, you will lead the full mechanical scope for hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data center projects, guiding the development of complex cooling and mechanical infrastructure systems essential to high\-availability facilities. You will join an established but rapidly growing design/build group focused on delivering reliable, scalable, and efficient data center solutions. Our team collaborates closely with internal construction partners, project managers, and commissioning teams—working together to deliver world\-class mission\-critical environments. **A Day in the Life:** * Lead the mechanical design process for mission\-critical data centers, including chilled water systems, DX systems, CRAH/CRAC, heat rejection, and white\-space cooling. * Guide system development from early concept and basis\-of\-design through construction documentation, commissioning, and turnover. * Apply ASHRAE TC 9\.9 guidance and critical environment standards to ensure reliability and efficiency. * Perform cooling load calculations, CFD coordination, and mechanical equipment sizing. * Coordinate with electrical, controls, and architectural teams to ensure system integration supporting N, N\+1, and 2N redundancy. * Generate design and construction documents using Revit and AutoCAD. * Support construction by reviewing RFIs, submittals, and field conditions. **Necessary Qualifications:*** 7–20 years of mechanical engineering experience with data centers or mission\-critical systems * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or related field * Proficiency with Revit and AutoCAD * Strong understanding of critical cooling systems and redundancy strategies * Ability to manage multiple fast\-paced projects * Experience in design/build is a plus * Willingness to travel to project sites as required (e.g., 10\-30%). * Familiarity with engineering deliverables in a GC setting (i.e., design\-build or EPC support) is a plus. **What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world. * Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * Traditional and Roth 401k * Tuition reimbursement for associates * Scholarship for associates' children up to $28,000 per child * 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel * 1\-week paid volunteer leave each year * 100% charitable match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage * Paid parental leave Typical base compensation for the Senior Mechanical Engineer role is between $95,000 and $165,000\. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company. At ARCO, our first core value is to treat people fairly and do the right thing. We are committed to building and sustaining a culture that supports diversity and inclusion. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack engineer with focus on infrastructure to build the tools and systems that help Pramaana’s engineers and researchers develop, test, deploy, and operate their work more effectively. Your initial focus will be **DevOps and MLOps**: improving development environments and deployment workflows, making experiments and evaluations reproducible, and helping teams understand the behavior, performance, and cost of AI systems. You’ll build across interfaces, backend services, and infrastructure automation—not just maintain scripts or configure dashboards. This is an early\-stage role with scope across the company. As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API\-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self\-serve tools. We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well\-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Improve how software gets built and deployed.** Develop repeatable local environments, automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows. Help make configuration, secrets, releases, and rollbacks easier to manage safely. * **Build tools for the AI development lifecycle.** Create workflows for running experiments and evaluations, versioning datasets and configurations, tracking results and artifacts, and deploying or integrating model services. Make runs easier to reproduce, compare, and investigate. Help researchers get from a recipe to a running job, and from a failed job to the cause.. * **Create full\-stack, self\-serve applications.** Build interfaces and APIs that let teams launch jobs, manage configurations, inspect results, and troubleshoot failures without relying on repeated manual assistance. * **Make systems observable and costs understandable.** Connect logs, metrics, traces, and usage data so teams can diagnose issues, identify bottlenecks, and understand where time and compute are being spent. * **Contribute to shared platform services.** Help build and integrate identity, access controls, LLM routing, API keys, budgets, and usage metering across Pramaana’s products and internal workflows. * **Use existing tools thoughtfully.** Evaluate and extend open\-source or managed solutions where they fit. Build custom software where it solves a real gap, rather than recreating infrastructure unnecessarily. * **Improve tools through direct feedback.** Work alongside engineers and researchers to identify recurring problems, prioritize improvements, and measure whether tools reduce setup time, manual work, and failed runs. Maintain tests, documentation, and operational guidance for what you ship. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2\-3 years of software engineering experience**, including hands\-on work with backend services, full\-stack applications, internal tools, or deployment automation. * **A solid foundation in building software across the stack.** You can develop services and automation in Python or TypeScript, work with APIs and databases, and build usable interfaces with React or a similar framework. * **Practical cloud and deployment experience.** You’ve deployed applications using containers and a cloud platform such as AWS, worked with CI/CD, and used logs or metrics to investigate problems. * **Some hands\-on exposure to AI or ML workflows.** This could include integrating model APIs, running evaluations, tracking experiments, or operating model\-backed applications through work or substantial projects. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Ruxlo** LinkedIn is your professional network. Facebook and Instagram are your social networks. Ruxlo is your home's network. *Your**home**.**Your**neighborhood**.**Your**town**.* Ruxlo benefits everyone involved in real estate. Builders, architects, contractors and realtors do work that is quickly forgotten. A lawn sign stays up for a month or two, and after that no one knows who did the work. We're replacing that with one durable digital record attached to the parcel itself. Work is recorded by the professional who did it and confirmed by the owner who paid for it. When the house sells, the record stays. Think Carfax for homes. Around the property is your neighborhood, where you can comfortably connect and communicate with neighbors through the Ruxlo app, see other property profiles and ask about the contractors your neighbors used. Further out is your town, where you choose the notifications you want, such as recycling, bulk waste pickup, farmers markets or any other event the town sponsors. Underneath all of it, is our database of 150 million properties, users can leverage AI natural language search to get the information they are looking for quickly. We're backed by an experienced SaaS founder and CEO who bootstrapped and exited a GovTech SaaS company in early 2026\. We've assembled a fantastic team and have a unique opportunity to help define a category at the intersection of AI, data and real estate, the largest asset class in the country. **The Role** We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI. You'll set the technical strategy for how Ruxlo builds AI into the product, from a single well\-designed LLM call to long\-running autonomous agents, and you'll be the technical anchor for applied AI across teams. The range is the point. One week you're tuning natural language search over property records or extracting structured data from a scanned receipt. The next you're designing an agent that runs in the background for hours, calls dozens of tools, pauses for a human approval, and resumes exactly where it left off after a failure. Some of these agents act on a user's behalf. A homeowner might ask an agent to request quotes from contractors their neighbors used, file a receipt and warranty, or follow up until a contractor confirms a job. A contractor might hand an agent the import of their work history. These agents carry a user's authority, so they ask before anything consequential, stay inside what that user is allowed to do, and leave a record the user can review. You know when a prompt is enough, when retrieval is needed, and when only an agent will do. The engineer who succeeds here ships all three to production, measures them honestly, keeps their cost in check, and leaves behind a platform other engineers build on. **What's hard:** The patterns for production agents are still being invented, and you'll be setting direction without a playbook to lean on. If that sounds like the appeal rather than the warning, we should talk. What You'll Own * Own the architecture of Ruxlo's AI systems end to end: model access and routing, retrieval, prompt and tool layers, agent runtime, evaluation and cost * Ship LLM\-powered product features, including natural language search, summarization, structured extraction and classification over property, ownership and contractor records. * Ship autonomous background agents that verify, reconcile and enrich records and keep them fresh. * Ship agents that act on a user's behalf, such as requesting quotes, following up with contractors, importing work history and filing documents, with the user's consent at each consequential step. * Design durable, long\-running agent workflows on a durable\-execution engine such as Temporal, with retries, timeouts, idempotent tool calls and safe resume after failure. * Stand up evaluation for every AI feature: golden datasets, offline evaluation, regression gates in continuous integration and production sampling. * Set the standards for safe AI use, including prompt\-injection defense, least\-privilege tool access, delegated authority scoped to what the user could do themselves, and audit trails the user can review. * Make sound build\-versus\-buy calls across model providers, frameworks and vector stores, and treat cost and latency as first\-class constraints alongside * Build shared AI tooling, skills and Model Context Protocol servers, and mentor engineers on building with AI. **What You Bring** *Core Competencies* * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to work well independently or as part of a team * Adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguity * Strong ownership and follow\-through * Effective use of AI tools in daily work * Sound decision\-making and prioritization * Open to feedback, and able to give it well * Collaborative across functions **Position Specific Requirements** * 8\+ years of engineering experience, including a technical lead role on systems other engineers built on. * LLM\-powered features you shipped to real users, such as retrieval\-augmented search, extraction or classification. You can walk us through what worked, what failed and how you measured it. * At least one autonomous, non\-conversational agent you took to production: triggered by events, schedules or data, and completing multi\-step work without a person in a chat window. * Agents you built that act for a user in other systems, including delegated permissions, consent and confirmation flows, and undo. * Hands\-on experience with durable execution or workflow Temporal is strongly preferred; Restate, Inngest, AWS Step Functions or similar also count. * Deep command of prompt design, structured outputs, tool use, Model Context Protocol, embeddings and vector search, and context\-window management. * A track record of evaluation and observability for AI in production: tracing, cost metering and quality measurement without a human grading every * Strong backend fundamentals in Python or TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and distributed systems on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes. **Preferred Experience** * Agent frameworks and runtimes such as the OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or OpenClaw. * Classic machine learning for entity resolution or record matching over large structured or geospatial datasets. * Fine\-tuning or distilling smaller models for high\-volume, narrow * Cost engineering at scale: model selection per task, prompt caching, batching and token budgets. * Open\-source contributions to agent runtimes, workflow engines or Model Context Protocol servers. * Experience at a founder\-led or bootstrapped startup This is a dedicated, in\-house role, we are not considering fractional, part\-time or consulting arrangements. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States, we do not offer visa sponsorship. We do not accept candidate submissions from agencies or third\-party recruiters for this role. Unsolicited resumes sent to Ruxlo or any of our employees will be treated as direct applications and no fee will be paid for any resulting hire. **Ruxlo** **LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** AI disclosure: As part of our recruiting process, Ruxlo may use AI\-assisted tools to help screen, review, and organize applications, as well as to support scheduling and communication. These tools assist our team and all final hiring decisions are made by humans. We work to ensure these tools are used fairly and without unlawful bias. If you have questions about how AI is used in your application, would like to request a reasonable accommodation or an alternative review process, please contact us at (848\) 321\-5588\.

jobs.title: Director of Data Architect
jobs.description: Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together! Our Values **Best Life** We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. **Growth Mindset** We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally. **One Team** From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. What You’ll Do * Define and communicate ABC’s data architecture strategy, roadmap, and standards. * Lead the architectural evolution from batch and latency\-driven processing toward real\-time data. * Partner with executive, product, and engineering leaders to connect data architecture decisions to business and customer outcomes. * Identify practical opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity, data generation, quality, and decision\-making. * Lead, coach, and develop a global team of four to five senior data architects. * Establish consistent design review practices across the Data and Reporting organization. * Guide architecture decisions related to data quality, governance, security, compliance, scalability, and reliability. * Partner with Product leaders early in the planning process to shape data and reporting capabilities. * Explain complex technical strategies clearly to both executive and technical audiences. * Build alignment across teams and influence decisions beyond your direct reporting relationships. What You’ll Need * 10\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including experience leading senior technical professionals. * Demonstrated experience moving data platforms from batch processing toward real\-time or near\-real\-time architectures. * Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture. * Experience with AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog is highly valued. * Strong foundations in data modeling, data warehousing, data governance, and distributed data systems. * Working knowledge of SQL and Python sufficient to review designs and engage credibly with engineers. * Practical experience using AI in your own work, along with sound judgment about where AI creates meaningful value. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to make technical strategy clear to executive leaders and design decisions clear to engineers. * Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying solely on formal authority. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. And It’s Great to Have * Experience in fitness, wellness, SaaS, payments, or another subscription\-based business. * Experience building customer\-facing analytics or reporting products. * Experience with Databricks SQL, Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms. * Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones. What Success Looks Like * ABC’s data architecture strategy is clear, credible, and supported by executive leadership. * The first real\-time capabilities are live, with a practical roadmap for continued transformation. * Data and Reporting teams work against shared architecture, quality, governance, and design standards. * AI is embedded into the team’s everyday approach to building and improving data capabilities. * Product and engineering leaders involve the architecture team early in strategic decisions. * Your team is highly capable, well\-developed, and trusted across the organization. Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is \- $173,000 \- 198,000 USD\- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset * Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO! * Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam * Parental \& Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws! * Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement * Medical/Dental/Vision coverage * EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period. * Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16 * And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here! At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement. **ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com **About ABC Fitness** ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness.com \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Augmented Development
jobs.description: **At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference** Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for inclusivity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better \- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose. ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which every team member has an equal opportunity to grow. We want our team members to have the well\-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, to help us fulfill that mission. The **Senior Software Engineer** applies advanced knowledge, skill, and expertise to software delivery. Work is both independent and collaborative in nature. This role emphasizes using AI coding tools to develop software efficiently, while owning the judgment calls AI can't make, including reviewing, testing, and correcting AI\-generated work, and taking end\-to\-end ownership of delivery from specification through production. Beyond using AI tools well, this role is expected to actively drive how the team adopts new AI\-assisted development practices by piloting new tools and techniques, and championing what actually works. This is primarily a hands\-on senior engineering role within the team, with the opportunity to grow into a cross\-team responsibility for advancing how the broader engineering organization uses AI\-assisted development tools as the role matures. The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. **For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary between $110,000 and $135,000**. ACT manages salaries within this range based on relevant factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity. This position is not incentive eligible. **Location:** This is a remote position, based in the United States. **Visa:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship. **What you will be working on:** * Technical Leadership \& Complex Problem\-Solving + Solve complex technical problems across the team's core systems, using AI\-assisted approaches to move faster, including integrations with related platforms. + Contribute senior\-level technical judgment to active modernization initiatives within the team, using AI tools to accelerate legacy\-to\-modern platform migrations. * AI Tooling Strategy \& Adoption + Pilot new AI\-assisted development tools, models, and techniques within the team (e.g., new agentic coding workflows, MCP integrations, updated model versions), evaluating them against real delivery work rather than vendor claims. + Propose and champion new use cases for AI in the team's engineering practice, backed by a measured before/after comparison — time saved, defect rate, or review burden. + Feed adoption learnings back into team practice, updating norms, playbooks, or tooling recommendations as new approaches prove out (or don't). * Deep Domain Knowledge + Apply deep familiarity with the team's platform architecture, history, and constraints to guide technical decisions, including where AI\-assisted approaches can speed modernization work. * AI\-Directed Development \& Delivery Ownership + Direct AI coding tools and agents to implement features from specs, tickets, or requirements, and own end\-to\-end delivery of the feature from specification through production. + Review, test, and correct AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit; catch both subtle errors (a plausible\-but\-wrong calculation, an approach that won't scale) and obvious ones. + Act as a steward against AI\-specific security and supply\-chain risk, scrutinizing AI\-suggested dependencies, flagging unfamiliar or unverified packages before they're accepted, and treating AI\-generated code that touches auth, data access, or external integrations with elevated review. + Write specs detailed enough for an AI tool to implement correctly on the first or second pass; for ambiguous problems, exercise judgment on whether to escalate or proceed independently. + Maintain and extend I\-specific security risk, e.g., unverified or malicious dependencies suggested by AI tools, injected logic in auto\-accepted code; and habits for catching it before it reaches production. * Strong engineering fundamentals (programming, data modeling, API design, security, and distributed systems) that hold up independent of AI tooling; treats AI tools as an amplifier of skill. * Demonstrated ability to work from ambiguous specs, with sound judgment for when to escalate and when to proceed independently. * Experience working (or ability to work) across a mixed legacy and modern technology stack. * Experience owning delivery end to end, from specification through production, including writing specs clear enough for an AI tool to implement correctly. * Bachelor's degree in computer or data science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired. **It’s a plus if you have:** * Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and colleagues outside of a direct reporting relationship, or interest in growing into this scope. * Experience evaluating or comparing multiple AI coding tools or models for team fit. * Familiarity with test administration or assessment delivery systems, or a comparable domain is valued as a plus alongside strong engineering fundamentals and AI\-directed development skill. * Experience mentoring or setting technical standards across multiple teams. * Background in education technology or a similarly regulated, integration\-heavy domain. * Experience building or extending eval or guardrail frameworks for AI\-generated code. **About ACT** When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. By leveraging our expertise and authority in assessment and research, we will again disrupt the industry—helping more people learn, better measure their progress, and improve their navigation through life’s transitions. More than ever before, ACT is fulfilling its mission of helping people achieve education and workplace success. We’re doing it by pushing the boundaries of learning innovation through the work of our people, who we call team members because we’re all in this together. We know transformation does not come without challenge. That’s why ACT invests in a variety of experiences for team members to strengthen their connections, explore ideas, learn from customers, and celebrate success. Learn more about working at ACT at act.org! *ACT is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. ACT participates in E\-verify. ACT's online position announcements are intended only to provide general descriptions of employment opportunities; none of the information provided for any position should be interpreted as a commitment by ACT to specific terms and conditions for employment.* Completion of the ACT National Career Readiness Certificate is recommended. Find a testing site near you to register for the WorkKeys assessments. Finalists for this position will be subject to a criminal background check as a condition of employment. **\*\*If you have received an ACT employment\-related communication from an email address that is not affiliated with @act.org and/or that requests personal or financial information, please do not reply. Instead, reach out to us at** **careers@act.org** **with the details. ACT's recruitment team appreciates your interest in working with us to transform college and career readiness pathways for all learners and wishes you the best of luck in your career journey.\*\***

jobs.title: Technology Engineer - Decatur, IL
jobs.description: **Technology Engineer \- Decatur, IL** **Job Summary** The role of the E\&I Reliability Engineer has evolved into a highly specialized position bridging the gap between field expertise and data science. Acting as a data scientist on the shop floor, the primary goal is not to execute rapid emergency repairs, but rather to design and implement prescriptive strategies that ensure the asset never requires an emergency intervention in the first place. This role is responsible for the site’s Electrical, Instrumentation, and Packaging equipment reliability. The engineer will apply statistical reliability methods, and root cause analysis to guarantee the optimum availability of the plant's assets, aligning maintenance strategies and total business objectives. **Essential Job Functions** * Safety \& Electrical Compliance: Support electrical equipment reliability by ensuring the site stays 100% compliant with infrared (IR) scans, required switchgear maintenance and testing, and arc flash studies. Review arc flash studies and help the plant team create proactive hazard remediation plans. * Asset Criticality \& Strategy Development: Conduct criticality screening and risk analysis for E\&I assets. Utilize Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) to develop Equipment Maintenance Strategies (EMS), optimizing Preventive Maintenance programs to ensure the right tasks are performed at the right intervals. * Defect Elimination \& RCA: Participate in and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for Electrical, Instrumentation, and Packaging equipment failures using methodologies such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa, and Fault Tree Analysis to eliminate recurrence. * Condition Monitoring \& Industry. Help the site create, audit, and upgrade electrical preventative and predictive programs. Transition from basic monitoring to Predictive 4\.0 (telemetry, advanced IR, acoustic emission). Monitor and validate anomaly detection models (AI/ML concepts) and IIoT sensor data. * Capital Improvement \& Project Integration: Identify E\&I and packaging capital improvement projects through failure analysis and bad actor/threat list development. Work with site leadership to prioritize projects based on Life Cycle Costing (Capex vs. Opex). Write and manage AFEs for approved capital improvement projects. * Technical SME \& Standardization: Act as the Plant Subject Matter Expert (SME) to ensure Best Practices and the Most Effective Technologies (MET) are proposed during project scope development. Serve as the site Focal Point for high voltage contractors repair and inspections. * Data\-Driven Analytics: Review all preventative and predictive data collection reports to provide analytical recommendations for repair or replacement. * Craft Training \& Assessment: Help lead skill gap assessments for craftspeople. Build training materials, standards, and training plans for the site's E\&I craft technicians to foster a Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) culture. **Job Requirements** * Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field. Additional advanced certifications in Reliability Engineering or Data Analytics are highly desired. * Experience: Proven experience in an industrial manufacturing setting focusing on electrical systems, instrumentation, and automation. * Professional experience with RCM, FMEA/FMECA, and RCA methodologies is mandatory. * Technical Skills (Hard Skills): Proficiency in CMMS (Maximo). Knowledge of IIoT protocols, Big Data extraction. Familiarity with Digital Twins concepts and prescriptive maintenance architectures. * Competencies \& Soft Skills: * Systemic Vision: Understanding that maintenance is an integrated part of the supply chain and production, striving for optimal business availability. Bridge Communication: * Change Management: Resilience to foster a proactive reliability culture. * Data\-Driven Decision Making: The courage to halt a critical machine if data indicates imminent failure. A constructive skeptic who trusts trends over superficiality. **Working Conditions** * Environment: Industrial setting with potential exposure to dust, chemicals, and irritants. * Temperature: Ability to work in inside areas where temperatures may exceed 100°F. * Safety Hazards: Exposure to high\-voltage equipment and machinery; strict adherence to LOTO, Arc Flash, and safety protocols. * Physical Mobility: Walking 1–3 hours daily; ability to climb stairs/ladders and perform audits. * Stationary Work: Sit for 5–8 hours for computer\-based analysis and dashboard development. **Physical Requirements** * Lifting: Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. from waist to shoulder on an occasional basis. * Mobility: Must be able to walk 1–3 hours daily, including walking long distances across the facility to perform equipment audits. * Postures: Must be able to squat, kneel, and climb stairs/ladders on an occasional basis. * Stationary Work: Must be able to sit for 5–8 hours for computer\-based analysis and keyboarding.  out this role but don’t think you meet every requirement listed? The candidate should be capable of independently contributing to the design, development, deployment, and support of enterprise applications. In this role, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain web applications. You will develop REST APIs and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Node.js. You will build responsive user interfaces using Angular and React. You will develop and optimize database queries, procedures, and integrations using Oracle SQL. jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.** We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy. AES Clean Energy (CE) is seeking a Performance Engineer to support the O\&M Engineering team by analyzing and optimizing the performance of our rapidly growing portfolio of photovoltaic and battery storage projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring our assets operate above industry standards for reliability, safety, and performance. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with the experience and drive to implement programs and processes that ensure reliable, safe, and optimal generation. A day in the life of an AES CE Performance Engineer will include, but is not limited to: **Operations** * Analyze operational performance and trends of solar plus storage sites. * Lead execution of performance tests in accordance with production and capacity commitments. * Remotely investigate site performance and review system design to identify root causes of lost energy. * Configure and validate performance alerts in DAS. * Review third\-party reporting to inform performance analysis. * Support the transition from projects under construction to operating assets. * Troubleshoot systems in operation and review performance data to identify issues. * Perform or review capacity and performance ratio tests for projects in operation. * Review production estimates and meteorological data sources for accuracy. * Measure fleet performance against established KPIs and compare actual to forecasted results. * Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports with detailed variance analysis. * Seek and evaluate proposals for analysis services and consultants as needed. * Perform job safety assessments and safety walks to identify job\-site hazard. **Collaboration** * Coordinate with field service and asset management teams to improve site performance. * Collaborate with Operations and Engineering teams to identify underperformance and recommend improvements. * “Close the loop” between Operations and Engineering by recording and communicating issues that can be mitigated through better design. * Utilize technology such as drones, LiDAR, thermal imaging, and 3D modeling to reduce field labor and improve operational performance. * Lead operations engineering coordination with field service and asset management teams. **Growth and Leadership** * Participate in AES CE’s growth planning process by contributing to process improvement task forces and strategic planning activities. * Improve and develop processes for the execution of safe, quality, and high\-performance projects. * Educate the team on changing trends in technology, best practices, and safety. The Performance Engineer supports a larger operations team and serves as the subject matter expert for technical and engineering matters related to the overall performance of photovoltaic plants and grid\-scale battery storage systems. Excellent communication, task management, and planning skills are needed, in addition to technical breadth. While performance analysis is the primary qualification, the role will require the review of information related to all practical elements of photovoltaic and battery system design. The successful applicant, while not an expert, will be comfortable with high\-level review of all elements of practical system design. **The position may include up to 10\-15% travel to project locations and partner offices.** **Skills and Qualifications** **Primary Qualifications** * Undergraduate degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field. * Strong understanding of industry trends in production tools and processes. * Proficiency with advanced analysis and database tools for development of metrics and dashboards. * Ability to work effectively with Microsoft software programs, including but not limited to Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint. * Demonstrated ability to read and comprehend equipment/facility schematics. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * High degree of commitment to a quality safety culture and an incident\-free work environment. * Willingness to travel within the U.S. to support company’s portfolio of PV solar/BESS assets. * Personal values consistent with those of the AES Corporation: Safety, Integrity, Excellence, Agility, and Fun. **Plus Qualifications** * PE qualifications, or on track to become qualified. * Master’s degree in Engineering. * Experience with PV and Battery Energy Storage System design and interconnection. * Proficiency with PowerBI, machine learning, or advanced analysis tools. * Professional experience in engineering with focus on measuring and maintaining system performance. * Experience with Data Acquisition and SCADA systems. * Spanish language skills. jobs.description: **\*\* No sponsorship offered for this position \*\*** **\*\* No relocation benefits for this position \*\*** **Pay:** $35\.00–$45\.00/hr *Please note: This role requires in\-office work in Temecula, CA, at least 4 days per week, and is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.* **About ASM** At ASM, we build best\-in\-class products for health care administration and quality assurance. Since 1982, we’ve grown a strong team that serves more than 1,200 health care organizations worldwide on a modern technology stack. **About the role** This is an entry\-level role for someone early in their IT career who wants to grow into a well\-rounded systems engineer. You’ll work alongside our senior team to maintain and scale a modern SaaS hosting environment that spans Windows Server, VMware, Azure, and enterprise networking and security. You’ll also learn how a SOC 2 and HIPAA\-compliant organization operates day to day. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. We’re looking for someone curious, careful, and eager to learn, and we’ll help you get there. **What you’ll do** * Manage user and group access in Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) and Active Directory to ensure appropriate access * Help maintain and document our infrastructure, including Windows servers, VMware vSphere/ESXi, Azure resources, Cisco switching, and \[Palo Alto] firewalls * Investigate and troubleshoot issues flagged by our monitoring systems or reported by users, and escalate when needed * Support patch management for Windows Servers, VMware, and network devices, and help us automate more of it * Help maintain system hardening standards and the policies, procedures, and documentation behind our SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance * Assist with audits and security assessments, and occasionally help clients understand our security posture * Take part in scheduled maintenance windows and, after onboarding, our on\-call rotation **What you’ll learn** * Hands\-on administration of a production, compliance\-driven SaaS environment * Identity and access management in Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, and hybrid identity with on\-prem Active Directory * Azure, VMware, and enterprise networking and firewall management * Automation with PowerShell * How SOC 2 and HIPAA audits work from the inside **Schedule and on\-call** During onboarding, you may be in the office up to 5 days per week. The role includes occasional evening and weekend maintenance work. After you’ve completed onboarding, you’ll join our 24/7 on\-call rotation, which may include on\-call shifts up to several times per week. Time spent handling after\-hours calls is paid at standard overtime rates. **Who thrives here** You take pride in your work and think about security and availability by default. Before you make a change, you consider how it will affect end users. You enjoy digging into problems that don’t have obvious answers. You’re careful without being slow, you like being part of a team, and you’re happy to take on everything from routine tasks to complex projects. **Requirements** **Required** * 0–2 years of experience in IT support, help desk, or system administration (internships, homelab projects, and coursework count) * A solid grasp of computing fundamentals, including operating systems, file systems, and networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) * Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID * Some exposure to PowerShell or another scripting language * Strong attention to detail and a habit of documenting your work * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Nice to have** * Experience with Azure, VMware vSphere/vSAN, or Group Policy * Experience with Microsoft IIS web servers, reverse proxies such as NGINX, or Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door * Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+, or Microsoft AZ\-900, SC\-900, or AZ\-104 * Exposure to a compliance framework such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST * Basic SQL Server knowledge **Benefits** * **Compensation:** In accordance with California pay transparency requirements, the anticipated hourly pay range for this position is $35\.00 to $45\.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. * A **competitive PTO structure** (non\-accrual, granted immediately after the probationary period) * **100% medical, dental, and vision coverage for all employees** * + Several medical coverage options to choose from (free and at cost) + Potential partial coverage for dependents (based on the plan chosen) * Several **supplemental benefit options** (hospital confinement, accident insurance, disability, cancer insurance, etc.) * **FSA** (Flexible Spending Account) * **DCFSA** (Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account) * **401(k)** with employer match * **Weekly catered company lunches** (Wednesdays) * Summer and holiday parties * A modern, regularly updated technology stack

jobs.description: **Data Engineer: Streaming \& Sensor Data** **Location: Primarily Colorado Springs, CO; Denver, CO, also considered** We are seeking a Data Engineer to build the data foundation for our machine learning applications. Our development environment is primarily Python, with AWS as the preferred cloud platform. **In this role, you will:** * **Understand our data sources**. Investigate available interfaces, message formats, historical coverage, data volumes, arrival rates, and quality limitations. Document decisions and support the architecture’s evolution as requirements become clearer. * **Deliver trusted datasets.** Establish consistent schemas, timestamps, units, identifiers, and source metadata while preserving measurement meaning. Implement validation and traceability, and define dependable access methods with the ML team. Handle duplicate, missing, delayed, and out\-of\-order data, and implement recovery and reprocessing procedures. **We’re looking for someone with:** * Experience designing, implementing, and operating production streaming and batch data pipelines and their supporting storage systems. * Strong software engineering skills, including maintainable code, automated testing, version control, and deployment. * Practical understanding of streaming behavior, including filtering, consumer progress, buffering, failure recovery, and replay. * Experience organizing time\-series, telemetry, sensor, or similarly complex data, with an understanding of schema evolution, partitioning, and efficient access patterns. * Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and communicate recommendations while balancing reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost. **Additional experience that would be valuable:** * Python\-based data processing and AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Radar, OPIR, or other sensor measurement data. * Workflow orchestration, containers, infrastructure as code, and automated delivery. * Dataset versioning, feature generation, labeling, or training\-data preparation.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (AI)
jobs.description: **About AiPrise** ----------------- AiPrise is a YC\-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross\-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world. Through a single integration, we connect 800\+ data sources and 80\+ verification partners across 200\+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge. Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount. We're \~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day. Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the team that builds AiPrise's AI agents. This is a player\-coach role: you will manage, hire and develop engineers, and you will also stay close enough to the code to design agent architectures, review prompts and tool definitions, and debug a failing eval yourself. You will own how our agents are built, measured and shipped: the skills and tools they call, how they remember context across a case, and the evals that tell us whether a change made them better or worse. In a regulated domain like KYC and KYB, an agent that is confidently wrong costs our customers real money and audit risk, so quality and observability matter as much as speed. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Lead the team** * Manage a team of 5\-6 AI and backend engineers: weekly 1:1s, clear goals, honest feedback and career growth plans. * Hire the next wave of AI engineers. You will own the interview loop for agent\-engineering roles and raise the bar on it. * Run planning and delivery for the AI roadmap with product, so the team ships on predictable cycles without burning out. * Build a culture where engineers write evals before they claim a win, and where incidents lead to fixes, not blame. **Build the agents, hands on** * Design and review our compliance agents, from single document checks to multi\-step investigations that hand off to human reviewers. * Build the reusable skills, tools and memory our agents rely on to call registries and data vendors and carry context across a case. * Own the eval stack: golden datasets built with compliance experts, regression tests in CI and production monitoring. * Write and review code about 50% of the time, and choose models based on accuracy, cost and latency. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **People leadership** * 2\+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring, performance reviews and at least one hard conversation you handled well. * A track record of growing engineers: someone you managed got promoted or took on a bigger scope because of your support. * Experience running planning and delivery for a team in a fast\-moving startup or scale\-up. **Hands\-on agent engineering** * 6\+ years as a software engineer, with strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript. * You have built and shipped LLM agents to production, not just prototypes, and can explain what broke and how you fixed it. * Practical experience with each of these: designing tool and function\-calling interfaces; packaging reusable skills or prompt modules; implementing agent memory (short\-term context, long\-term stores, retrieval); and building evals that gate releases. * Comfort with at least one major model API (Anthropic, OpenAI or similar) and the trade\-offs between agent frameworks and plain code. * A habit of measuring: you can show an eval you built, the metric it tracked and a decision it changed. **How you work** * Clear written communication. You can explain an agent failure to a compliance lead and to an engineer. * Good judgment on when to build, when to buy and when to keep a human in the loop. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in fintech, regtech, fraud, identity verification or another regulated domain where AI decisions need an audit trail. * Document AI experience: OCR, document classification or extraction across many languages and formats. * Experience with LLM observability and tracing tools, and with cost and latency optimization at scale. * Contributions to open\-source agent, eval or retrieval projects, or public writing on the topic. jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Corporate Development Finance
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — more than $200 billion in value across 700\+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial\-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury. When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real\-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non\-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset). We are a small, high\-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non\-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen. You will manage a team of 2 to 4 software developers \- setting technical direction, unblocking the team, conducting code reviews, and raising the bar on engineering quality. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M\&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end\-to\-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near\-term operational needs with longer\-term platform investments. Tech stack: a serverless, event\-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure\-as\-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI\-assisted development tools used daily. Key job responsibilities * Own the architecture and the hardest technical problems in IMS, including the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree. * Own the data model and the financial calculations (such as internal rate of return, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress), and write the code and tests that the rest of the team builds on. * Build the React web application that business users work in every day, and own the Amazon Bedrock–based AI assistant that lets them ask questions about the portfolio in plain language. * Work directly with leaders across the M\&A ecosystem to turn open\-ended requests into concrete requirements, sequence the work, manage dependencies, and deliver each program. You own the outcome, not just your part of it. * Run the deadline\-bound work the team cannot miss, including the quarterly close. * Lead integrations with partner data teams across multiple systems. * Define infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, raise the bar in code and design reviews, and keep stakeholders and engineers aligned as work progresses. About the team Corporate Development Finance (CDF) is a cross\-functional team that serves as the finance partner to Amazon’s corporate venture capital funds (the Industrial Innovation Fund, the Alexa Fund, and the Climate Pledge Fund), to Amazon’s warrant program, and to portfolio management across Amazon’s global investment and warrant portfolio. The team comprises finance professionals, program managers, and technical roles building the infrastructure to support a growing and increasingly complex portfolio.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent The base salary range for this position is listed below. jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** **Ambiq** is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest\-power semiconductor solutions. Built on our proprietary sub\- and near\-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi\-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI\-powered edge applications. Our cross\-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology. We're looking for self\-motivated, creative problem\-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency. At Ambiq, we live by five values: **Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.** If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here. **This role will be on\-site 5 days a week in NW Austin.** ### **Scope** As the Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Power Management at Ambiq, you will drive the software architecture, requirements, development, testing, and performance optimization of the SDK power management software for our latest family of low\-power Edge AI MCUs. In this role, you will work closely with SoC hardware power architects, product marketing, validation, and our IP vendors to define the software architecture, functional partitioning, and requirements for the platform's power management infrastructure. You will provide technical leadership and architectural direction to the software development and system test teams, ensuring the delivery of robust, production\-quality software on schedule. The role encompasses the power management infrastructure, memory control and retention, clock management, low\-power operating modes, and software techniques for optimizing system\-level power consumption. The successful candidate will have extensive experience in early\-stage software architecture and hands\-on embedded software development. They must have a proven track record of designing, implementing, debugging, profiling, and optimizing embedded software for ARM Cortex\-M processors using an RTOS. Experience developing low\-level firmware, power management software, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers is essential. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader who enjoys solving complex technical problems while remaining actively involved in software design, implementation, code reviews, and debugging. **Responsibilities** * Define software requirements and functional allocations based on evolving input from SoC hardware architects, product marketing, software architects, validation and software development teams. * Design, develop, debug, profile, and optimize the AmbiqSuite SDK power management software, including power modeling and characterization under a wide range of operating conditions. * Own the SoC software architecture, performance, and power optimization, identifying opportunities to reduce power consumption while maintaining system performance and functionality. * Work closely with product marketing, field engineering, validation, and system test teams to understand customer use cases and translate them into software architecture, implementation, and test requirements. * Serve as the technical authority for power management software, reviewing software designs, architecture, code, test plans, and validation results to ensure quality, performance, and low\-power operation. * Drive cross\-functional technical discussions with hardware architects, firmware developers, validation, and IP vendors to resolve architectural issues and ensure successful product execution. * Diagnose complex system\-level issues spanning hardware and software, and evaluate architectural trade\-offs to achieve the optimal balance of power, performance, cost, and implementation complexity. * Develop software for low\-power operating modes, clock management, memory retention, wake\-up sequencing, and other power management infrastructure components. * Define and implement methodologies, tools, and metrics for measuring, profiling, and optimizing software power consumption. * Work with relevant teams to ensure power\-optimized implementation of the RTOS ports for Ambiq SoCs. * Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, technical mentoring, and by establishing software development best practices. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience developing embedded software for ARM Cortex\-M–based systems in bare\-metal and RTOS environments. * Expert\-level C/C\+\+ programming skills, with experience developing low\-level firmware, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HAL), and startup code. Experience with ARM assembly language is a plus. * Strong understanding of SoC architecture, including processor subsystems, memory hierarchy, bus interconnects, interrupts, DMA engines, cache architectures, memory protection, inter\-processor communication, and shared memory systems. * Proven experience designing, implementing, debugging, profiling, and optimizing software for ultra\-low\-power embedded systems. * Strong understanding of embedded power management techniques, including clock management, voltage and frequency scaling, power domains, memory retention, clock gating, and low\-power operating modes. * Experience profiling and analyzing power consumption across software and hardware boundaries, including identifying and resolving system\-level performance and power bottlenecks. * Hands\-on experience using embedded development and debug tools, including JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power analyzers, and software profiling tools. * Experience developing software using modern software engineering practices, including Git\-based source control, code reviews, continuous integration, and automated testing. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions across hardware and software disciplines. * Experience defining software architectures and technical requirements for complex embedded systems is preferred. Knowledge of the power requirements of wireless protocols (BLE, WiFi, 802\.15\.4\) is a plus. * Experience working with FreeRTOS \& Zephyr is preferred. * Familiarity with at least one MCU IDE on Windows from ARM/Keil, IAR, Eclipse, or others. * The candidate must independently manage assigned tasks, prioritize workload, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. Proactive problem\-solving skills and the ability to seek clarification when needed are essential. Must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer. We do not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas (now or in the future) for this role.
