jobs.title: Senior Principal Fiber Optic Engineer
jobs.description: Amphenol Custom Cable is a leading provider of connectivity solutions with a strong national presence and global distribution network. Established in 1980, the company is a trusted partner to Fortune 500 organizations and is certified to TL9000:2008 and ISO 9001:2008 standards for excellence in manufacturing and installation connectivity services. Known for its rapid response, Amphenol Custom Cable delivers custom solutions that are efficient, cost\-effective, and tailored to meet diverse customer needs. The company prides itself on providing quality, precision, and high performance for a wide range of requirements. SUMMARY Amphenol Custom Cable is seeking a highly experienced Senior Principal Fiber Optic Engineer to serve as a senior technical resource supporting the growth of our fiber optic assembly business. This is a critical technical hire intended to strengthen our ability to respond quickly to new customer opportunities, develop and manufacture complex fiber optic assemblies, solve challenging production issues, and expand our engineering capabilities. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Fiber Optic Assemblies \& Connectivity * Extensive experience with single mode and multimode fiber optic assemblies. * Advanced knowledge of MPO/MTP multifiber connector systems, including termination, polishing, testing, and troubleshooting. * Strong knowledge of LC, SC, and other common fiber connector platforms. * Experience with high\-density fiber solutions, trunks, breakout assemblies, patch cords, and custom fiber configurations. * Strong understanding of fiber polarity, optical performance, connector compatibility, and loss budgets. * Ability to interpret customer drawings, specifications, and technical requirements. Manufacturing Process Expertise * Hands\-on experience developing and optimizing fiber optic assembly manufacturing processes. * Expertise in fiber preparation, stripping, cleaving, termination, polishing, inspection, and testing. * Ability to troubleshoot insertion loss, return loss, end\-face geometry, contamination, and manufacturing defects. * Experience establishing manufacturing work instructions, process controls, and quality acceptance criteria. * Ability to improve yields, reduce scrap and rework, and increase manufacturing throughput. New Product Introduction \& Engineering * Proven experience taking new fiber products from concept or customer RFQ through successful production launch. * Ability to evaluate new customer opportunities quickly and determine technical feasibility. * Experience developing BOMs, manufacturing routings, labor requirements, and production processes. * Ability to support technical costing, quoting, and pricing decisions. * Experience building prototypes, validating designs, and qualifying new products. * Ability to work directly with suppliers to evaluate components, tooling, and manufacturing equipment. Business \& Commercial Capabilities * Rapidly assess incoming RFQs and identify viable technical solutions. * Recommend alternative components or manufacturing approaches when specifications create challenges. * Work directly with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, and Quality to accelerate opportunity turnaround. * Communicate confidently with customers on complex technical requirements. * Identify potential manufacturing risks before committing to new business. * Support cost\-effective product designs that balance performance, manufacturability, lead time, and profitability. * Help differentiate AFCC through technical expertise, responsiveness, and manufacturing quality. Leadership \& Mentorship * Serve as the senior technical authority for fiber assembly engineering. * Mentor and develop less\-experienced engineers. * Establish repeatable engineering practices and documentation. * Provide technical direction during complex manufacturing issues. * Collaborate effectively with production personnel and plant management. * Remain actively involved in hands\-on engineering rather than operating exclusively in a management capacity. Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Highly Desired Specialized Expertise * Experience with US Conec connectivity products and manufacturing processes. * Advanced MTP/MPO assembly engineering and high\-density multifiber connectivity. * Familiarity with MMC, Very Small Form Factor (VSFF) connectivity, and emerging connector technologies. * Knowledge of TMT ferrules, advanced polishing requirements, and related manufacturing challenges. * Experience establishing or qualifying a new connector assembly manufacturing capability. * Experience supporting data center, hyperscale, telecom, and high\-speed optical connectivity applications. * Familiarity with relevant IEC, TIA, Telcordia, and customer\-specific fiber optic performance and inspection requirements. Education \& Experience * Ideally 10–15\+ years of directly relevant fiber optic manufacturing engineering experience. * Significant experience in a fiber optic cable assembly, connector, or interconnect manufacturing environment. * Background with an established fiber connectivity manufacturer or specialized assembly producer. * Demonstrated success launching new products and resolving complex manufacturing challenges. * Engineering degree is preferred, but equivalent extensive hands\-on experience is highly valued.

jobs.title: WordPress/WooCommerce Developer — Existing Website Completion & Final QA
jobs.description: WordPress/WooCommerce Developer — Existing Website Completion ONE\-TIME PROJECT — $400 TOTAL FIXED PRICE — PAYMENT BY MILESTONES Seeking an experienced, detail\-oriented, independent U.S.\-based WordPress/WooCommerce developer to finish an existing wellness and lifestyle website. The total fixed project price is $400, divided into three milestones. Each payment is released after the agreed milestone work has been completed, reviewed, and accepted by the owner. The selected developer must have a Fiverr or Freelancer.com account, or create one before contracting. The agreed platform will be used for the contract, milestone payments, and written project communication. PROJECT OVERVIEW The website uses WordPress, Elementor, and WooCommerce on GoDaddy Managed WordPress. Desktop is approximately 95% complete or slightly higher by the owner’s assessment. Known remaining corrections will be provided through screenshots and written instructions. The previous developer reported mobile completion, but the owner has reviewed only a few mobile areas. A comprehensive, independent mobile/tablet review and correction are required. Preserve the approved design, branding, wording, and page structure. This is completion and refinement work. No redesign or rebuild. The complete remaining scope will be agreed before hiring. Additional work or charges require written owner approval. Target completion: within one week of the agreed start date. Confirm feasibility after inspecting the website. MILESTONE 1 — DESKTOP COMPLETION: $125 * Fix incorrect cart quantities and unrelated Beanie/Cap products appearing at checkout. * Correct the agreed checkout payment\-option display issues while preserving the existing approved payment gateway. * Ensure the complete customer purchase process works correctly. Any real purchase requires prior owner approval. * Correct awkward word wrapping in Coaching headings and documented desktop alignment, spacing, and layout issues. * Complete Blog \& News post listings and individual\-post layouts to match the existing website. * Ensure the owner can create, edit, preview, and publish posts independently. * Resize the oversized Donation QR code and verify that it scans and opens the owner\-approved destination. * Check desktop navigation, header/footer, buttons, links, forms, and redirects; complete the agreed corrections. * Submit the organized desktop review ZIP described below. Desktop work must be completed and accepted before proceeding to mobile/tablet work. MILESTONE 2 — MOBILE AND TABLET COMPLETION: $200 * Independently review all existing pages and customer\-facing functions on mobile and tablet. * Correct agreed issues involving readability, text clipping, word wrapping, images, navigation, buttons, spacing, overflow, forms, and checkout. * Identify problems proactively without requiring the owner to direct every adjustment. * Preserve the approved desktop work while making responsive corrections. * Submit the completed mobile/tablet work for owner review. MILESTONE 3 — FINAL CORRECTIONS AND DELIVERY: $75 * Confirm that the completed desktop, mobile, and tablet website works correctly across the agreed scope. * Resolve outstanding defects in the agreed work. * Provide an updated desktop review ZIP if subsequent corrections affect desktop. * Provide a concise change summary and brief written instructions for independently managing blog posts. * Retain a final backup within GoDaddy. * Submit the completed website for final owner review and acceptance. WORKING AND SECURITY REQUIREMENTS * All inspection, development, and verification must remain within the existing GoDaddy hosting environment. No downloading or hosting website copies on local computers or external servers. * Staging requires prior written owner authorization and must remain within GoDaddy. * Preserve the owner’s hosting, website ownership, approved content, and existing working systems. * No new plugins or themes, hosting/DNS changes, migrations, payment\-gateway replacement, or major structural changes without prior written authorization. * Do not rewrite, shorten, expand, or replace approved content without written permission. * If another issue is discovered, explain it in writing and obtain approval before making changes outside the agreed scope. * No AI\-generated or AI\-modified code. Use existing WordPress/Elementor settings where appropriate; necessary custom code must be written by the developer. * All communication must be in writing. No voice or video calls. * Coming Soon must remain active. No public launch without explicit written owner approval. * Create a backup within GoDaddy before making changes. * Assessment access will be provided individually through a temporary WordPress account for a mutually scheduled two\-hour inspection window. Inspection does not authorize changes. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE Provide an organized desktop review ZIP with clearly labeled, page\-by\-page visitor\-facing views in a format agreed before hiring. Videos or a collection of isolated screenshots are not the requested delivery format. Preparation of this owner\-requested review package does not authorize copying the WordPress installation or database outside GoDaddy. The completed website must also be available for direct desktop, mobile, and tablet review. Visual evidence alone does not establish that functionality works. The developer is responsible for confirming that the delivered work functions correctly before submitting each milestone. This is included in the $400 fixed project price. The owner will review submissions promptly and provide consolidated feedback. HONEST ASSESSMENT AND FOLLOW\-THROUGH We value a developer who gives small corrections the same care as larger tasks, works independently, and respects everyone’s time. Review the website and requirements before accepting. If you cannot complete the agreed work for $400 within these boundaries, please say so upfront. If an inability to deliver arises after hiring, report it promptly. Cancellation and refund terms must be agreed in writing before funding. HOW TO APPLY Please confirm: * Relevant experience correcting WooCommerce checkout problems and responsive Elementor layouts. * Acceptance of the $400 total fixed price and three\-milestone structure. * Acceptance of the GoDaddy\-only working requirement and other project boundaries. * Whether you have a Fiverr or Freelancer.com account or will create one before contracting. * Your availability and ability to complete the agreed work within one week of the agreed start date. The final scope, milestone deliverables, and completion date will be confirmed in writing before hiring. Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our engineers depend on infrastructure we run ourselves: Kubernetes clusters on bare metal and in the public cloud, plus the CI/CD and observability systems behind every robot software release. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will manage and scale the Devops platform. Your job is to make it more resilient, faster to build on and safer to change as the robot fleet and the engineering team grow. You own your work end to end, from architecture decisions down to the Linux kernel, the network and the disk when something misbehaves. We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who builds systems that are reliable by design and keeps digging until they understand why something broke. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Manage and scale our Kubernetes platform on bare metal, virtual machines and public cloud, including cluster provisioning, networking, storage and upgrades. * Build the CI/CD infrastructure our robotics engineers ship with: build runners, remote build execution and caching, container registries, and autoscaling that adds capacity on\-prem or in the cloud as demand changes. * Design for failure: backups, multi\-site recovery, and recovery drills that prove the company keeps working when a data center goes down. * Make change safe with GitOps delivery, progressive rollouts, and automatic rollback when a release fails its health checks. * Decide what to measure. Define SLIs and SLOs for the platform, and build the monitoring and alerting around them. * Debug production issues across the stack, from Kubernetes down to the Linux kernel, the network and the disk, and fix the root cause so they do not come back. * Manage infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Helm and Ansible, and write tooling in Go or Python to remove manual work. * Build security into the platform: single sign\-on and role\-based access, certificate and secret management, and minimal, patched operating systems. * Partner with robotics software teams on architecture and production readiness, and set the standards other teams build on. * Plan capacity and cost across on\-prem and cloud as the robot fleet and the engineering team grow. #### **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * **Linux**: deep knowledge of operating system internals, the networking stack, file systems, process and resource management, and performance tuning. * **Kubernetes in production**: you have built clusters, upgraded them, and debugged them when networking, storage or scheduling broke. * **Hands\-on debugging**: you work in a shell and reach for tools such as strace, tcpdump, ss and perf. * **Infrastructure as code and GitOps** with tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm and Argo CD. * **Software skills** in Go or Python. jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack AI Engineer

Engineering, Product, and Architecture, aligning investments to business value, feasibility, risk, and total cost of ownership. * Lead the architecture and delivery of the most complex processing, conventional application logic, workflow automation, or a hybrid approach. * Own reference architectures and engineering standards for web applications, APIs, distributed services, integrations, data flows, model access, retrieval services, prompt and version management, evaluation, observability, security, and resilience. * Identify emerging technologies and architectural integration, data, and AI layers. * Ensure AI capabilities are embedded in coherent, usable, secure, and supportable applications rather than delivered as isolated model or service components. * Lead the design of modern web experiences, REST APIs, event\-driven and distributed services, enterprise integrations, identity and access patterns, and cloud infrastructure where required by the initiative. * Resolve systemic technical constraints and cross\-team dependencies, and create platform capabilities that allow multiple teams to deliver safely and consistently. * Set standards for technical leadership across multiple products, teams, platforms, or business domains. * Deep full\-stack engineering experience covering modern web applications, REST and event\-driven services, data access, system integration, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operations. * Expert\-level capability in at least one general\-purpose application framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or a comparable framework, including the architectural concerns of production user\-facing applications. * Deep hands\-on expertise with LLM and GenAI patterns, including RAG, structured outputs, prompt and context design, tool/function calling, agents, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and cost management. * Experience evaluating model quality, cost, orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Strands, or Model Context Protocol * Experience with machine learning operations tooling, model registries, feature jobs.title: Copy of Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Audien Hearing** Audien Hearing is on a mission to make hearing affordable, accessible, and stigma\-free for everyone. Proudly serving over 1 million customers, we lead the way in the over\-the\-counter (OTC) hearing aid industry by combining innovative technology with a direct\-to\-consumer model. Our team is passionate about building high\-impact products that empower individuals to reconnect with the world around them—at a fraction of traditional hearing aid costs. **Full Stack Software Engineer** *Data\-Powered Web Applications* **About the Role** ================== We're hiring a full stack engineer to build data powered web applications on top of our CX and marketing data stack. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, application development, and analytics. You'll own features end to end, from piping raw event data into our warehouse to shipping polished, AI\-driven user\-facing products. If you love writing SQL as much as you love writing React, and you're excited by the idea of turning messy behavioral and marketing data into tools people actually use, this is for you. **What You'll Do** ================== You'll build and ship full stack applications in React and Next.js deployed on Vercel, backed by Snowflake and supporting data infrastructure. On any given week you might be architecting a new customer\-facing dashboard, writing complex SQL across rich CX and marketing data streams, building ETL pipelines that land clean data in Snowflake, standing up reverse ETL flows that push modeled data back into operational systems, or wiring LLM capabilities into product surfaces so that non\-technical teammates can get answers from data conversationally. Dashboarding work in Omni is also part of the mix, both building dashboards directly and building web experiences that embed or extend them. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Strong full stack experience with **React, Next.js, and SQL**. You can move fluidly between frontend components, API routes, and warehouse queries. * Comfort deploying and operating on **Vercel**. * Hands\-on experience with **Snowflake** (or a comparable cloud warehouse), including schema design, performance tuning, and writing non\-trivial analytical SQL. * Experience building **ETL pipelines** to ingest data from SaaS sources, event streams, and APIs into a warehouse. * Experience with **reverse ETL** patterns to sync warehouse data back out to marketing, CX, or operational tools. * Ability to design and build **dashboards and data visualizations**, ideally in Omni (or tools like Looker, Hex, Mode). * A track record of shipping production web applications, not just prototypes. **Nice to Haves** ================= * Experience integrating LLMs or agentic AI into production apps (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, RAG, tool use, embeddings, vector search). * Prior work on AI\-powered internal tools, conversational analytics, or natural language to SQL interfaces. * Familiarity with modern data stack tooling like **dbt** and **Fivetran**. * Experience working with CX platforms such as **Kustomer, Five9, and Salesforce**. * Experience with marketing platforms such as **Klaviyo**.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, Cloud Detection & Response
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** We're searching for a Staff Cybersecurity Engineer to help mature Cloud \& Enterprise Detection within our Detection \& Response (D\&R) team, under the Technical Assurance division. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on driving cross\-functional projects that strengthen Aurora's detection infrastructure and expand detection coverage across our cloud infrastructure, enterprise environments. You will scope and lead multi\-quarter initiatives that raise the maturity of our detection program and powering detection at scale, executing through your own hands\-on work and through close partnership with Cloud Infrastructure, IT, and Platform Engineering teams. **In this role you will** * Drive cross\-functional projects to mature Aurora's detection infrastructure, log ingestion and normalization, detection\-as\-code pipelines with testing, versioning, and CI/CD for detection content, and scalable, cost\-aware telemetry collection * Expand detection coverage across cloud and corporate environments and prioritize coverage improvements * Design, build, and tune detections for cloud control plane and workload activity, identity\-based attacks, endpoint, SaaS threats, abuse of CI/CD and service\-to\-service communication paths * Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, IT, and Platform Engineering to embed logging and detection requirements into system design, and represent D\&R in cross\-functional working groups and design reviews * Integrate threat intelligence and adversary emulation into detection coverage priorities, and conduct proactive threat hunting across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS data * Respond to cloud and enterprise security incidents and participate in an on\-call rotation, feeding lessons learned back into detection coverage and infrastructure improvements * Collaborate with and mentor SOC engineers on cloud and enterprise detection practices, and contribute to quarterly planning for detection infrastructure and coverage initiatives **Required qualifications** * 10\+ years of security experience; demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional security projects or programs from scoping through delivery * Strong technical foundation in threat detection, incident response * Expertise with cloud security across one or more major providers, including cloud\-native telemetry and detection sources * Experience building or maturing detection infrastructure \- SIEM or security data lake pipelines, log onboarding and normalization, detection\-as\-code workflows * Expertise with endpoint detection and response (EDR) and SaaS security monitoring, or comparable host and application telemetry depth * Expertise authoring and maintaining detections (anomalous, network, host, identity, or cloud activity) and measuring detection coverage against adversary behavior * Experience with incident management, driving cross\-departmental collaboration for containment and remediation * Expertise with MITRE ATT\&CK framework and modern adversarial techniques; understanding of NIST CSF * Ability to write quality, testable code in Python **Desirable qualifications** * Experience designing and implementing Zero Trust Architecture * Experience scaling SOC, Detection Engineering with AI/LLM * Experience building and architecting data lakes * Experience with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) *For roles based in Mountain View:* The salary range for this position is $189,000 \- $303,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA,:* The salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $273,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.description: **About AutoRABIT** AutoRABIT is revolutionizing DevOps and data protection for Salesforce teams operating in complex, highly regulated environments. Our platform integrates CI/CD, compliance, release orchestration, and AI powered automation to improve software delivery, reduce risk, and increase velocity. With a foundation in Lean principles, we focus on eliminating waste, driving innovation, and delivering scalable value for our customers. **Position Summary** AutoRABIT is seeking an exceptional Distinguished Software Engineer (IC\-7\) to serve as one of the highest level technical individual contributors in our global Engineering organization. This role is intended for an engineer with extraordinary technical depth, demonstrated industry expertise, and a proven ability to solve complex engineering challenges that impact multiple products, teams, and business objectives. This is not a traditional architect or people management position. We are looking for a highly accomplished, AI forward, hands on engineer who combines strategic technical leadership with the ability and willingness to write production code, build sophisticated solutions, and personally drive critical engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Java, distributed systems, enterprise SaaS platforms, and modern cloud technologies. They must also bring meaningful, demonstrated experience applying artificial intelligence to software products and engineering workflows. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will influence AutoRABIT's long term technical direction, establish engineering standards, mentor senior technical leaders, and lead the implementation of our most complex and business critical solutions. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, and Executive Leadership to translate technical innovation into measurable business and customer outcomes. **Key Responsibilities:** **Enterprise Technical Strategy \& Leadership** * Serve as one of AutoRABIT's most senior technical authorities, influencing engineering strategy across products and teams. * Define and guide long term technical direction, architectural principles, and engineering standards. * Identify and solve complex technical challenges that span multiple engineering teams, products, and platforms. * Partner with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other senior leaders to align technical investments with business priorities. * Evaluate major technical decisions, platform investments, and modernization initiatives. * Provide technical leadership through expertise, influence, and execution rather than formal management authority. **AI Innovation \& Engineering Leadership** * Drive the adoption of AI technologies that meaningfully improve AutoRABIT's products, engineering productivity, and customer outcomes. * Architect, develop, and deliver AI powered product capabilities and intelligent automation solutions. * Lead technical initiatives involving Large Language Models, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic workflows. * Establish practical standards for AI assisted software development, including code quality, security, validation, and responsible use. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine where they provide measurable value. * Mentor engineering teams on AI implementation, technical limitations, evaluation methods, and effective development practices. * Demonstrate a proven ability to move AI initiatives beyond experimentation into reliable production solutions. **Hands On Engineering \& Execution** * Remain actively involved in software development, including writing, reviewing, testing, and deploying production code. * Personally lead the design and implementation of highly complex, business critical software capabilities. * Serve as a technical escalation point for the organization's most difficult engineering and production challenges. * Drive engineering excellence across Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud native platforms. * Build reference implementations, prototypes, and foundational components that accelerate development across teams. * Ensure technical solutions meet enterprise expectations for scalability, security, reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Lead by example through strong coding practices, technical problem solving, and consistent delivery. **Architecture, Scalability \& Modernization** * Guide the evolution of AutoRABIT's enterprise SaaS architecture. * Identify architectural limitations, technical debt, and systemic risks that could impact long term product scalability. * Lead modernization initiatives across application services, integrations, infrastructure, and development practices. * Establish reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, and technical standards. * Improve platform performance, resilience, observability, and operational efficiency. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend inv  in Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and enterprise application architecture. * Deep experience designing and delivering highly scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise SaaS platforms. * Demonstrated success leading major technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams or product areas. * Proven experience building and delivering AI powered software capabilities in production environments. * Strong practical experience with AI assisted software development tools and modern AI engineering workflows. * Experience with technologies such as Large Language Models, RAG, AI agents, MCP, or comparable AI frameworks. * Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, including cloud architecture, distributed systems, and AI integration capabilities. * Extensive experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, containers, and Infrastructure as Code. * Strong understanding of enterprise security, application performance, reliability, and operational excellence. * Demonstrated ability to resolve highly complex technical challenges and critical production issues. * Experience influencing architectural direction and technical standards across multiple teams. * Proven ability to mentor senior technical contributors and elevate engineering capabilities across an organization. * Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence executive and technical stakeholders. * A track record of translating technical innovation into measurable product, engineering, or business outcomes. * Demonstrated technical leadership through major engineering contributions, open source projects, publications, patents, industry recognition, or equivalent achievements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Salesforce technologies, APIs, metadata, DevOps workflows, or enterprise applications built for the Salesforce ecosystem. * Experience developing DevSecOps platforms, CI/CD tooling, release automation, or data protection solutions. * Experience introducing AI powered capabilities or agentic workflows into enterprise software products. * Experience guiding major architectural modernization initiatives. * Experience working in highly regulated industries or security sensitive enterprise environments. * Experience collaborating with globally distributed engineering and product teams. **What Success Looks Like** A successful Distinguished Engineer at AutoRABIT will: * Deliver major technical solutions that materially improve our products and platform. * Establish technical direction that strengthens scalability, reliability, security, and engineering efficiency. * Turn AI opportunities into working production capabilities with measurable value. * Personally contribute to critical engineering implementations rather than operating exclusively at the architectural level. * Reduce systemic technical risks and improve the long term maintainability of our software. * Elevate the technical capabilities of Principal Engineers, architects, and engineering teams. * Become a trusted technical partner to Engineering leadership and executive stakeholders. **Compensation** $265,000 \- $295,000 depending on experience, plus bonus **Why Join AutoRABIT?** This is an opportunity to become one of the most influential technical leaders at AutoRABIT. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will help define the future of our enterprise software platform, lead meaningful AI innovation, and solve complex engineering challenges that directly impact our customers and business. You will have the opportunity to influence technical strategy at the highest levels while remaining actively involved in software development and implementation. If you are an exceptional engineer who thrives on solving difficult problems, building sophisticated software, mentoring technical leaders, and turning innovation into measurable results, we'd love to hear from you. **THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE. You must live in and be eligible to work in the US.** GmVN9Av5QY

jobs.title: HR Experience & AI Transformation Architect
jobs.description: What You'll Do: Avalara makes tax compliance faster, easier, more accurate, and more reliable for businesses. We're now applying that same standard to how we run our own People \& Culture (P\&C) function, Avalara's term for Human Resources. A new internal team, AI Transformation \& Operational Excellence, has been created to redesign how P\&C delivers services to employees, managers, and the business, using AI and automation as core tools rather than afterthoughts. This team's mandate is to rebuild P\&C's processes and technology from the ground up: not just make today's processes faster, but decide, process by process, what should be fully automated, what should be enhanced with AI, and what should remain human\-led. This role owns that end to end: you dig into how a process actually works today, document it clearly, decide what belongs on each side of that automate / augment / human line, and then build or oversee the build of the solution, partnering closely with Avalara's People Technology (engineering) team where needed. This role calls for someone who has genuinely done architecture work for process before: not just documented how something works today, but designed what it should become, end to end. Paired with deep, hands\-on AI fluency: the ability to dig into a messy, real\-world process, understand it fully, document it clearly, and see exactly where AI can fully automate a step, where it should augment a person doing the work, and where the work should stay human, and then design for it. The impact of this role is to completely reimagine how People \& Culture's processes work: building a genuinely strong operating model underneath P\&C, and envisioning what the experience should be for each persona who touches it, including employees, people managers, candidates, the business, and P\&C itself. This role owns the process architecture, the operating model, and the vision for each solution. From there, the actual AI tool build can go either way: hand it to the People Technology (engineering) team to build, or build it yourself, including building AI agents directly, depending on the complexity of the tool and where capacity sits at the time. You'll operate with significant autonomy on ambiguous, cross\-functional problems, and be a trusted partner to P\&C leadership and to Avalara's People Technology (engineering) leadership alike. \#LI\-Remote What Your Responsibilities Will Be: **Dig Into \& Document Current State*** Get into the details of how a process actually works today, not just what's documented, through direct observation, data review, and conversations with the people doing the work. * Build clear, step\-by\-step process maps and a prioritized list of pain points and gaps that others can act on. * Gather baseline data on existing processes, such as cycle time, volume, and error rates, to ground redesign decisions in evidence, not assumptions. **Envision the Future Experience by Persona*** Reimagine what the process should look and feel like for each persona it touches (employee, people manager, candidate, business, and P\&C itself), rather than incrementally improving the current experience. * Turn that persona\-based vision into a clear target state: what changes for the person going through it, and what has to be true of the process and technology to deliver it. * Use that target\-state vision as the basis for the automate, augment, or human\-led decisions that follow. **Decide What's Automated, Augmented, or Human*** For each step of a process, make the call: fully automate with AI, augment a person with AI, or keep it human\-led, and be able to explain why. * Translate that judgment into concrete technical requirements and specifications an engineering team can build against. * Assess build\-vs\-buy for each opportunity: build in\-house, buy a vendor solution, or integrate with an existing platform (e.g., Workday), and sequence the work into phases that deliver value quickly. **Design \& Build the Solution*** Design the target\-state solution architecture for each process, not just the requirements, but how the pieces fit together, and decide whether to hand the AI tool build to People Technology or build it yourself, based on complexity and where capacity sits. * Where you build it yourself, build the AI agents and automations directly. Where People Technology builds it, partner closely with their engineers on requirements, testing, and QA throughout. * Identify upstream and downstream impacts on other processes, systems, and teams before committing to a build. **Own the Operating Model \& Roadmap*** Own and maintain the AI \& automation roadmap for the processes you're responsible for, aligning priorities with P\&C leadership and People Technology. * Build a strong, durable operating model underneath each redesigned process: one that holds up after the initial build, not just at launch. * Build ROI models and success measures for each tool or automation, track performance against t lds. * Experience partnering with software engineers through implementation: testing, deploying, and iterating, not just handing off a spec. * Experience sequencing large initiatives into phases that deliver value quickly and can be adjusted along the way. * Strong communication skills: credible with engineers, understandable to business and operations stakeholders. **Nice to Have*** Experience in HR, People Operations, or a comparable operations function (recruiting, employee lifecycle, service delivery). Helpful context, not a prerequisite. * Hands\-on Workday experience (configuration, reporting, or implementation). * Background in solutions architecture, technical product management, or a similar hybrid business/technical role. * Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or RPA tools beyond agentic AI. * Experience defining org structure or governance models for AI agents or automated systems. **Pay Range Details** The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may different in other locations. Colorado $153,300\-$252,900 (annually) Washington $153,300\-$279,600 (annually) California $153,300\-$306,300 (annually) NYC $169,400\-$306,300 (annually) The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business consideration This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role. Avalara is an AI\-first Company: AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here. * You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers. * You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too. How We'll Take Care of You: Total Rewards In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses. Health \& Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance. Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship. What You Need To Know About Avalara: We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech. We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world. We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too. **We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer** Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Insurance is one of the largest industries in the world, and it still runs on manual work nobody wants to do. Claims is the clearest case: high\-volume, repetitive workflows handled over the phone, by email, and across 200\-page PDFs, most of it sitting in systems built in the early 2000s. Software has circled this problem for decades without touching the core of it, because nothing could make the calls or read the documents. AI finally can. Avallon builds agents that run the full claims lifecycle, from intake to settlement, so teams can move faster, eliminate busywork, and get more right. Out of YC we went from zero to seven figures of ARR in twelve months, and are now growing 3X quarter over quarter while working with some of the largest carriers in the world. Avallon is backed by top investors, and our founding team includes builders from MIT, Harvard, and Cornell. We aim to become the automation layer for the entire insurance industry, and we intend to get there with a talent\-dense team where everyone is enabled to do the best work of their careers. No one can predict the future of insurance, so we're building it. **The Role** ============ We're looking for an exceptional Product Engineer. You'll build the platform that lets insurance teams put AI to work on real operations, and trust it when it matters. Your job is to find what the platform needs next and build it. Our forward\-deployed engineers run customer deployments on top of the platform. You build the platform itself. Working closely with them, design, and customers, you'll spot the hard problems that keep coming up and turn them into product: the smallest version that creates value now and extends cleanly later. **What You'll Work On** ======================= * **Shape the product from the start.** You come in early, working with customers, design, and product strategy to decide what gets built and why, not picking up tickets after the decisions are made. * **Build the rails insurance will run on.** From public chat interfaces where claimants report and follow their claims, to branded portals our largest carrier customers host on Avallon, you build the surfaces the industry will soon run on. * **Help teams confidently automate more.** Build clear, auditable claim context and the experiences that let people review and approve agent work, giving teams control where it matters and letting them expand automation with confidence. * **Own it end to end, in production.** Build the whole flow yourself, from data model to backend to interface, then own how it performs: instrument it, watch how real users move through it in Datadog RUM, and keep pushing it as more teams rely on it. The work is broad, and your impact will grow wherever the platform needs you most. You will take on a meaningful challenge, ship it quickly, watch what changes in production, and go again. **You** ======= * You have 3\+ years building and owning meaningful software in production. You can point to a difficult challenge you solved or a system you built that changed what was possible, explain the judgment behind it, and answer for the outcome once it was live. * You are a full\-stack product engineer who builds whole flows yourself. TypeScript and SQL are your working tools; you design the data model and backend as readily as the interface on top of it. You work closely with design and product strategy, have opinions about what to build, and can explain them clearly. This is not a frontend\-only role. * You have built and operated LLM\- or agent\-powered products in production, and understand the challenges of making them reliable at scale. * You want to be in the room. This role is in person in New York. **Nice to Have** ================ * You know insurance, claims, or another regulated operational domain where reliability and traceability matter. * You have worked as a product manager, or owned product decisions and roadmap in a similar role. * You have worked at an early\-stage company. * You have been a founder or founding engineer. **A Few Things We Believe In** ============================== * **Eating well:** We provide lunch and dinner every workday from local restaurants. * **Health \& Wellness:** Your health is on us. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, offer up to $17,000 toward fertility and family\-forming through Carrot, and give you a monthly gym stipend to stay active. * **Getting out of the office together to recharge:** quarterly offsites somewhere you actually want to go. * **And our favorite:** unlimited token budget. No caps, no rationing. Build with whatever makes you fastest. Compensation Range: $165K \- $270K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** At Avenue Z, we are a dynamic media and technology company with a powerful influence across all channels. Our leadership has been at the forefront of digital marketing and communications for over 30 years, pioneering innovative strategies that drive meaningful change in brand performance and business growth. When you join Avenue Z, you become part of a team that doesn’t just adapt to change but leads it, guiding some of the world’s most influential leaders and brands to new heights. We are driven by a deep passion for our craft and an unwavering commitment to integrity in everything we do. If you share our passion and values, explore our current job openings to see how you can make an impact with us.**The role** ------------ We are hiring a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to build and ship the agent systems that run social commerce for our brands and for our own platform. You will embed with the teams doing the work, performance media, creator and influencer, ecommerce, and analytics, find the process where throughput is lost or money is left on the table, and build a production agent that owns it. Then you move to the next one. Concretely, this is work like: agents that detect and re\-authorize expiring TikTok Shop affiliate codes and Meta partnership permissions before spend stalls, systems that reallocate ad budget toward top\-performing creators automatically, pipelines that launch new creator content across every platform daily without a human touching it, and reporting infrastructure that tells a brand what actually drove GMV. You own the problem end to end: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, evals, adoption, and what breaks at 2am. If your instinct on a messy problem is to open an editor rather than schedule a working session, this is your role.**What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with a business unit, diagnose where throughput or margin is lost, and ship a working agent against it inside the first few weeks. * Build production agent systems: tool use, planning loops, memory, retrieval, orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates where money or brand safety is on the line. * Integrate deeply against the commerce and ad platforms our revenue runs on: TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads, Meta and Instagram, Amazon, Shopify, Google, Snap, and affiliate and creator APIs. * Build data pipelines and analytics infrastructure that tie creator content, ad spend, and attributed GMV into one picture. * Build the evaluation harness alongside the agent. Nothing ships to production without a way to measure whether it is right. * Own the infrastructure: APIs, queues, auth and token refresh, observability, error handling, rate limits, and cost controls. * Instrument everything. Every system you ship gets tied to a number: hours returned, cycle time cut, spend efficiency, GMV or revenue supported. * Document it, drive adoption with the team that uses it, and keep improving it after launch. **Who you are** --------------- * Computer science or another technical background, or equivalent hands\-on experience as a developer or as a self\-taught AI\-native builder. We care about what you have shipped and whether it works, not where you learned it. * 3 to 5 years building and shipping software that other people depended on. * You can read, write, and debug Python or TypeScript. You have deployed and maintained real services and you understand what is happening underneath, whether you wrote every line yourself or built it alongside AI coding tools. * Hands\-on experience building LLM agent systems: function and tool calling, RAG, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, agent evals. * Real experience integrating third\-party marketing, ad, or commerce APIs. You know what OAuth token expiry, rate limiting, webhook replay, and undocumented API behavior actually cost you. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), containers, CI/CD, and SQL. * You work fluently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. We expect you to build with them. We also expect you to be able to explain, debug, and defend what comes out of them. * You understand how performance marketing works: ROAS, CAC, attribution, creative testing, funnel mechanics, affiliate and creator economics. Or you can learn a domain fast and go deep, and you can prove it. * Entrepreneurial. You have built something of your own, a startup, a product, a side venture, an open source project, and can point to what you shipped and what it did. * High agency. You gather your own requirements, make the call, and ship. You do not wait for a spec, a committee, or a change management plan. * Able to sit with a senior executive or a brand's head of ecommerce, understand the business problem in their language, and translate it into a system without a translator in the room. **Nice to have:** direct experience with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, or Amazon Seller/Ads APIs. Background at a DTC brand, an ecommerce platform, a creator or affiliate network, or a performance agency. Prior forward deployed, applied AI, or founding engineer experience. **Benefits*** Competitive salary \+ equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. * 401(k) plan with employer match. * Unlimited paid time off policy to support work\-life balance. * Professional development opportunities and budget. Please note that we do not offer Visa support of any type, and that the position is on\-site in Miami 4\-5 days per week.

traditional IT management role.** We want someone who enjoys building and improving technology directly rather than managing teams or delegating technical work. **Key Responsibilities** **Application Development \& Modernization** * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance business\-critical applications using C\#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, and PHP. * Contribute directly to the continued modernization of our internal CRM and operational applications. * Develop modern web applications using Blazor and related .NET technologies. * Maintain and enhance existing PHP applications, performance, indexing, locking, and connectivity issues. * Support database architecture, maintenance, backup, recovery, and reliability. * Improve application and database performance through storage, and system security issues. * Maintain and improve backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, and business continuity systems. * Automate infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting and other appropriate technologies. * Ensure reliable and secure operation of production applications and supporting systems. **Artificial Intelligence \& Automation** * Identify practical opportunities to integrate AI into existing business applications and processes. * Develop and implement AI\-powered features using commercial or locally hosted large language models (LLMs). * Integrate AI services and APIs with .NET and PHP applications. * Explore applications involving conversational AI, speech\-to\-text, intelligent search, document processing, and workflow automation. * Evaluate AI solutions development practices. * Evaluate new technologies and determine their suitability for our business environment. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional, hands\-on software development and/or systems engineering experience, including substantial application development experience. * Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development. * Practical experience developing, maintaining, or enhancing PHP applications. * Experience designing and developing web applications, REST APIs, and database\-driven business systems. * Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or comparable relational databases. * Experience with Linux server administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of web application hosting, networking, security, and production environments. * Experience with Git or comparable source control systems. * Ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and troubleshoot production applications. * Strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Blazor Server or other modern .NET web frameworks. * Experience with modern .NET application architecture and legacy application modernization. * Strong PHP and LAMP stack development experience. * Experience with Dapper or other .NET data access technologies. * Experience with PostgreSQL and MySQL database administration and performance tuning. * Experience with KVM, VMware, Hyper\-V, or other virtualization platforms. * Familiarity with Nginx, Apache, IIS, Docker, and reverse proxies. * Experience with Linux scripting, infrastructure automation, and monitoring. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs, telephony systems, or contact center platforms. * Familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, or other cloud\-based and locally hosted AI technologies. * Experience building AI integrations, intelligent automation, or LLM\-powered applications. jobs.title: Senior Agentic Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Mobility is experiencing a fundamental change, with software taking center stage. ETAS’ products and solutions include vehicle basic software, middleware, development tools, cloud\-based operations services, cybersecurity solutions as well as end\-to\-end engineering and consulting. In this role, you will be responsible for orchestrating robust Python\-based back\-end architecture, integrating state\-of\-the\-art Large Language Models (LLMs), optimizing high\-performance vector databases, and deploying scalable, secure APIs natively on Microsoft Azure. You will work closely with our Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) customers to agree on new requirements, develop plans to deliver solutions using Agile processes, and ensure strict adherence to software quality standards throughout the development lifecycle. Proven ability to build relationships with customers, preferably in the automotive industry. * Strong abstraction skills: decomposing complex problems, choosing the right level of abstraction, and recognizing patterns that generalize across domains. * Hands\-on production experience with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agents), including running several agents in parallel and running agents unattended in automated pipelines. * Product thinking: able to translate user and business intent into specifications precise enough for autonomous execution. * Prompt and context engineering: writing instructions, specs, and repo conventions that agents follow reliably. * Strong verification mindset \- treats generated code as untrusted until independently checked. * Adaptability: productive in unfamiliar languages, frameworks, and domains, with security awareness for AI\-assisted development (secret handling, prompt injection, supply\-chain risks). * Bachelor’s Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or similar field of study. **Additional Information** **Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.** **Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.** * ETAS adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug\-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date. Your well\-being matters at ETAS. We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success!

footprint, model size, compute efficiency, and power usage. * Develop and maintain repeatable workflows for model training, conversion, compilation, simulation, validation, and performance analysis. * AI\-assisted engineering tools that can improve model development, deployment, debugging, and optimization workflows. * Document experiments, technical findings, deployment learnings, and reusable engineering practices. * Mentor interns and co\-op engineers. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, including model architecture design, training, evaluation, and optimization. * Working knowledge of Efficient ML techniques such as quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures. * Understanding of how model optimization techniques affect model accuracy, latency, memory footprint, compute requirements, and deployment compatibility. * Proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar. * Strong Python programming, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of C/C\+\+ and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working on embedded and production systems. * Understanding of Edge ML concepts and common resource constraints, including computation, memory, latency, and power. * Ability to analyze model behavior and troubleshoot issues across training, conversion, deployment, and integration workflows. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with quantization\-aware training, post\-training quantization, mixed\-precision inference, structured or unstructured pruning, operator replacement, or hardware\-aware model optimization. * Experience adapting model architectures or training workflows in response to deployment and integration constraints. * Experience deploying machine learning models on edge devices, DSPs, NPUs, mobile platforms, wearable devices, or other resource\-constrained systems. * Familiarity with deployment frameworks and toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite, TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX Runtime, TVM, MLIR, or vendor\-specific SDKs. * Understanding of deployment and performance metrics such as latency, memory footprint, model size, MACs, memory bandwidth, and power consumption. * Experience with audio ML, speech processing, acoustic sensing, or multimodal models involving audio. * Familiarity with LLM\- or agent\-based engineering workflows, including knowledge retrieval, tool calling, technical documentation analysis, structured data extraction, failure diagnosis, benchmark analysis, or optimization recommendations. * Experience building or evaluating AI\-assisted tools that improve ML development, deployment, debugging, or engineering productivity. * Curiosity about the interaction between machine learning models, software toolchains, and hardware platforms. \#LI\-Hybrid At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $141,000\-$193,950\.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic\-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** Box Shield is an add\-on security layer that protects the flow of information and reduces content\-centric risk without adding friction. It uses classification\-based controls to prevent data loss and AI\-powered, context\-aware alerts to detect malware, compromised accounts, and malicious behavior at scale. Shield's mission is to secure enterprise content while delivering a seamless user experience, ensuring Box remains the platform of choice for secure Intelligent Content Management. jobs.title: Technical Architect – Wealth and Retirement
jobs.description: Company Overview: At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth\-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more. Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive. Position Description: Bridgenext is seeking a Principal Engineer / Technical Architect with deep hands\-on engineering experience and demonstrated domain knowledge in US Retirement, wealth management, asset management, or adjacent financial services platforms. This role will play a key part in the modernization of a business\-critical retirement recordkeeping landscape built on legacy Visual FoxPro applications and data components, as plans transition onto a modern SaaS recordkeeping platform and the legacy environment is progressively retired. The architect will work closely with long\-tenured business and technology SMEs to capture system knowledge, understand undocumented or partially documented business logic, reverse\-engineer existing applications where necessary, and ensure each capability is either carried correctly onto the target platform or deliberately retired. The ideal candidate brings a combination of legacy application understanding, retirement recordkeeping conversion experience, and modern cloud engineering depth. They should be comfortable moving from Visual FoxPro code, data structures, batch processes, integrations, and embedded business rules to the design of data conversion, integration, and service layers on Azure and Java\-based platforms. This is not primarily a legacy application support role, and it is not a line\-by\-line code rewrite. The objective is to understand and safely transition critical business capabilities from the existing environment into a modern technology platform, while protecting business continuity and preserving complex Wealth and Retirement domain logic. The architect will determine which legacy behaviors the target recordkeeping platform absorbs natively, which must be built as surrounding services, and which can be retired. Deep US Retirement / retirement plan recordkeeping experience is strongly preferred; strong wealth or asset management experience with transferable domain depth will also be considered. **Key Responsibilities:*** Lead the technical discovery and modernization of legacy Visual FoxPro applications, including application components, business rules, data structures, interfaces, batch processes, reports, and operational dependencies, and define the technical path to retire them as business moves to the target platform. * Work directly with existing business and technology SMEs to drive structured knowledge transfer and knowledge capture, converting institutional knowledge into sustainable technical documentation, architecture artifacts, domain models, and implementation specifications. * Analyze and reverse\-engineer existing Visual FoxPro applications and undocumented or partially documented code to identify critical business rules, processing flows, data dependencies, integrations, exception handling, and operational behaviors. * Develop current\-state architecture and dependency views covering legacy applications, databases/files, interfaces, downstream consumers, scheduled processing, security, and operational workflows. * Produce and maintain a disposition decision for every legacy component (absorbed by the target platform, rebuilt as a surrounding service, re\-pointed, or retired), captured as defensible architecture decision records. * Define the migration strategy for moving plans from the legacy environment to the target recordkeeping platform, including wave planning by plan complexity, controlled coexistence of legacy and target platforms, cut\-over and rollback approaches, and progressive legacy decommissioning. * Own the technical design of legacy data extraction, cleansing, conversion, and reconciliation across plan, participant, payroll, investment, transaction, and document data, moving through an interim staging repository into the target platform with auditable reconciliation at each stage. * Translate legacy capabilities into the target architecture, distinguishing what the SaaS recordkeeping platform provides natively from what must be built around it, such as Java/Spring Boot microservices, APIs exposed through Azur  Proven experience designing production APIs and integration solutions using REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, asynchronous messaging, file\-based integration, retries, idempotency, and error\-handling patterns. * Strong understanding of relational databases and modern data architectures, including schema design, transactional processing, query/performance considerations, data migration, reconciliation, and consistency. * Relevant financial\-services domain experience in US Retirement, wealth management, asset management, investment platforms, brokerage/custody, or closely related recordkeeping and transaction\-processing environments. * Ability to work directly with long\-tenured SMEs, conduct effective technical KT sessions, ask the right questions, identify undocumented behavior, and turn acquired knowledge into clear technical specifications and sustainable engineering artifacts. * Strong consulting and engineering\-leadership posture: able to communicate with business and technology stakeholders, produce clear architecture documentation, defend technical decisions, mentor teams, and operate effectively in complex modernization programs. **Preferred Skills:*** Deep US Retirement / retirement plan recordkeeping experience, including defined contribution plans such as 401(k), 403(b), and 457(b), IRA/rollover flows, and lifecycle processes such as eligibility/enrollment, contributions/payroll, vesting, trades/pricing, distributions, loans, QDROs, and RMDs. * Experience converting plans onto, or integrating with, FIS OMNI or a comparable recordkeeping platform, including SaaS deployments, plan\-setup configuration, and conversion tooling. * Experience modernizing Visual FoxPro\-based enterprise applications, including familiarity with FoxPro/Visual FoxPro application architecture, DBF\-based data models, legacy integrations, reporting, batch processing, and migration considerations. * Experience taking ownership of legacy applications during SME transition, technology sunset, or application transformation programs, including structured knowledge capture and reverse engineering. * Experience migrating legacy application capabilities to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including Azure SQL Managed Instance, API Management, Data Factory, ADLS, Databricks, and Azure DevOps or equivalent services. * Familiarity with retirement regulations and operating constraints such as ERISA, IRS/DOL rules, non\-discrimination testing, SECURE 2\.0, participant\-data privacy, and high\-volume processing around payroll, trading, or market events. * Experience with legacy core platforms such as OBI, SunGard, mainframe COBOL/CICS, or similar legacy financial\-services environments, and modernization patterns that allow legacy and new services to coexist safely. * Experience with wealth or asset\-management workflows such as account/portfolio servicing, holdings and transactions, trading, custody, fund administration, or investment platforms. * Familiarity with retirement and investment ecosystem integrations or standards such as payroll/provider files, SPARK conventions, NSCC/DTCC or Fund/SERV, custodians, plan sponsors, TPAs, and downstream reporting platforms. * Familiarity with the surrounding retirement servicing ecosystem, such as CRM (e.g., Salesforce), document generation and e\-signature, payroll integration providers, and BPM/workflow platforms. * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools for legacy code analysis, code understanding, documentation generation, dependency analysis, test generation, and modernization, while independently validating generated outputs. * Experience establishing automated characterization/regression tests around legacy applications before modernization, enabling business rules and existing system behavior to be validated as functionality is progressively replaced. **Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer** US citizens and those authorized to work in the US are encouraged to apply \#LI\-CG1 \#LI\-REMOTE
