jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description: At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people\-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here. At Cabi, technology is at the heart of delivering an exceptional experience for our Stylists and clients. Every customer order flows through our fulfillment platform, connecting Shopify, warehouse operations, inventory management, shipping, and enterprise systems into a seamless experience. We're looking for a hands\-on Full\-Stack Developer to own and evolve this platform. You'll design, build, deploy, and support software that directly impacts thousands of customer orders while helping modernize one of the company's most critical business systems. While fulfillment is your primary focus, you'll be a full member of our engineering team and a full\-stack contributor to The Studio, Cabi's Shopify\-based platform that powers how our Stylists and clients shop. Like every developer on the team, you'll build features, integrations, and enhancements across The Studio alongside your fulfillment work. This role is based in Indiana to provide close partnership with our warehouse operations and local technology environment. **What You'll Do** As the primary developer responsible for our fulfillment platform, you will: * Design, build, and maintain Cabi's custom Fulfillment Service and related applications. * Provide mission\-critical technology support to Receiving, Inventory, Put\-away, Pick, Pack and Ship operations * Develop APIs, services, and integrations supporting inventory allocation, warehouse operations, order fulfillment, shipping, and returns. * Build and maintain integrations between Shopify, Oracle EBS, CRM, warehouse systems, shipping carriers, and other enterprise platforms, including through middleware and workflow automation platforms such as Pipedream. * Own software throughout its lifecycle—from solution design and development through deployment, monitoring, production support, and continuous improvement. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable long\-term solutions. * Improve platform performance, reliability, observability, and automation while reducing technical debt. * Partner with Product Management and Warehouse Operations to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. * Collaborate with Infrastructure when software, AWS, networking, and warehouse technology intersect. * Participate in Agile planning, estimation, code reviews, testing, and production releases. * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. * Work as a full\-stack developer on The Studio, Cabi's Shopify\-based platform, delivering front\-end and back\-end features, integrations, and enhancements alongside the broader engineering team, while maintaining primary ownership of the fulfillment platform. **What You'll Bring** **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in a backend or full\-stack role. * Experience building enterprise applications and backend services. * Strong API development experience in distributed applications environment using REST and GraphQL based webservices * Strong SQL and relational database experience, including writing and optimizing queries and working with object\-relational mapping (ORM) tools. * Full\-stack development experience across backend services and modern frontend frameworks such as React. * Proven ability to leverage AI to assist in development workflows. * Experience developing applications in AWS. * Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Eagerness to learn new technologies and contribute across both backend and frontend as needed. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred** * Shopify development or Shopify integrations, including familiarity with Hydrogen and Remix. * Retail, ecommerce, fulfillment, warehouse, or supply chain experience. * Oracle EBS or ERP integrations. * Ruby on Rails, or experience with other server\-side frameworks such as Django or Spring. * Middleware and workflow automation platforms such as Pipedream. * Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or Order Management Systems (OMS). * Docker, Kubernetes, or container technologies. * Event\-driven or distributed system architectures. **Technologies You'll Work With** * Shopify / The Studio (Cabi's Shopify\-based platform) * AWS * React, Node.js, Go, Ruby on Rails * REST \& GraphQL APIs * Pipedream (middleware \& workflow automation) * SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL * Oracle EBS * Warehouse Systems * Shipping Carrier Integrations * Git \& CI/CD **What We Offer** At cabi, we believe our people should be recognized for the impact they make. Our compensation philosophy is designed to provide fair and competitive pay based on the value and scope of each role, as well as relevant experience, skills, and the market in which the role is based. **The anticipated salary range for this position is $110,000 \- $115,000\.** Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of job\-related factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for a **discretionary bonus.** **Benefits \& Perks** At cabi, we believe benefits should support the whole person—at work, at home, and for the future. We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your **health and well\-being, financial security, time away, personal growth, and connection.** Our benefits include: * Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible spending account options * Company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with a company match * Paid time off and paid holidays * Employee purchase discounts of up to 85% * Additional employee appreciation and clothing perks * Opportunities for training and professional development * Team celebrations, catered lunches, and other employee appreciation experiences Benefits eligibility and offerings may vary based on employment status and applicable plan requirements. Cabi regularly reviews its compensation and benefits programs to promote fair and consistent practices across the organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Cabi is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants and employees who require an accommodation for a sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance, consistent with applicable law. We'll consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. **Candidate Safety** Your safety matters to us. As you explore career opportunities, be cautious of fraudulent job postings, fake websites, and individuals impersonating recruiters or company representatives. Cabi recruiters will only contact candidates through @**cabiexperience.com** or through our official applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. Cabi recruiters will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment or gift cards, deposit a check, or provide sensitive financial information as part of the recruiting process. If you're unsure whether a communication is legitimately from cabi, contact jobs@cabiexperience.com before providing any personal information. Joining cabi means more than stepping into a role—it's stepping into a mission. We're passionate about uplifting women, supporting growth, and celebrating individuality in everything we do. As you explore this opportunity, imagine the impact you could make as part of a company that values innovation, authenticity, and connection at every level. If you're ready to bring your talents to a team that's as driven as it is supportive, we'd love to see what you can do with us.

and integrations to validate technical feasibility, architecture assumptions, platform capabilities, and key risks without over\-engineering experiments as production applications. * Creates concise design artifacts, experiment documentation, technical decision records, and reusable patterns that meet Enterprise Architecture and engineering standards. * Evaluates APIs, cloud services, AI practices for the scope and risk of each experiment. * Uses modern build, integration, testing, source control, and automation practices to ensure experiments are reproducible, secure, and technically credible. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Technology Transformation & AI Enablement
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** Aetna Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer, Architecture, AI \& Enablement to serve as a strategic technical leader responsible for accelerating modernization, improving engineering effectiveness, enabling responsible AI adoption, and helping guide technology transformation across a complex enterprise technology portfolio. This role operates at enterprise scale and serves as a key partner to Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Platform Engineering, Security, Product, Infrastructure, and Delivery organizations. The successful candidate will help translate enterprise technology strategy into practical engineering execution by developing modernization roadmaps, establishing technology standards, promoting engineering best practices, and enabling adoption of emerging technologies. The Principal Engineer will play a critical role in helping engineering teams modernize legacy systems, adopt cloud\-native technologies, improve software delivery practices, and evaluate opportunities to leverage AI capabilities in a responsible and scalable manner. This individual will influence technical direction across multiple platforms and business domains while partnering closely with senior technology leaders to drive consistent and sustainable technology outcomes. The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering and architecture expertise with experience leading large\-scale modernization initiatives, cloud transformation efforts, engineering enablement programs, and enterprise\-wide technology change. This position can work remotely from anywhere in the continental USA. Primary Responsibilities **Enterprise Technology Leadership** * Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders. * Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture to translate enterprise technology standards into actionable engineering guidance and implementation patterns. * Influence technology strategy, engineering practices, modernization priorities, and architectural decisions across multiple organizations. * Drive alignment between long\-term technology strategy and engineering execution. * Promote consistent adoption of enterprise technology standards, architectural principles, and engineering best practices. **Modernization \& Transformation** * Lead and support modernization initiatives across a diverse portfolio of enterprise applications, platforms, and services. * Develop modernization roadmaps that support application transformation, cloud adoption, platform evolution, technology simplification, and operational improvement. * Evaluate existing technology landscapes and define future\-state architectures that improve scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and business agility. * Guide engineering organizations through complex technology transformations while balancing business objectives, delivery commitments, and technical debt reduction. * Identify opportunities to improve platform consistency, accelerate delivery, and increase engineering efficiency through reusable solutions and architectural patterns. **Architecture \& Engineering Enablement** * Define and promote engineering standards, reference architectures, implementation frameworks, and reusable technology patterns. * Partner with engineering teams to accelerate adoption of cloud\-native, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and software engineering best practices. * Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and governance forums. * Guide engineering teams in evaluating technology options, architectural approaches, modernization strategies, and platform capabilities. * Promote security, resiliency, observability, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence throughout the software development lifecycle. **AI Enablement \& Emerging Technology Adoption** * Identify opportunities to leverage AI technologies to improve engineering productivity, delivery efficiency, automation, and operational effectiveness. * Help establish governance frameworks, standards, and guardrails for responsible AI adoption. * Partner with architecture, engineering, security, and compliance stakeholders to evaluate emerging AI technologies and implementation approaches. * Provide technical leadership on AI\-assisted software development, testing, automation, and engineering workflows. * Guide technology adoption decisions by balancing innovation, business value, security, compliance, and operational considerations. **Technical Leadership \& Collabora  systems, and modern software delivery methodologies. * Experience partnering with architecture and engineering organizations to drive enterprise technology strategy and execution. * Strong experience with cloud platforms, modern application architectures, and platform engineering concepts. * Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, engineering automation, and developer productivity solutions. * Experience evaluating and enabling AI\-assisted engineering capabilities and emerging technology adoption. * Demonstrated success influencing technical decisions across large organizations without direct management authority. * Strong communication skills with the ability to engage engineering teams, architects, executive stakeholders, and business leaders. * Experience mentoring senior technical contributors and technical leadership teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience within healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience modernizing complex legacy application portfolios and supporting enterprise technology transformation initiatives. * Experience with cloud\-native platforms, Kubernetes, OpenShift, containerization, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering practices. * Experience establishing engineering standards, governance models, operating frameworks, and technology adoption strategies. * Experience evaluating AI technologies including generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, model orchestration, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, monitoring, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Experience with architecture decision records (ADRs), domain\-driven design, event\-driven architectures, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. * Experience developing internal engineering platforms, paved\-road engineering patterns, or engineering enablement programs. * Relevant cloud, architecture, Kubernetes, DevOps, security, or AI\-related certifications. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and practical experience. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Technology, or a related discipline preferred. **Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $144,200\.00 \- $288,400\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Systems and Backend
jobs.description: ***This role is full\-time, in\-office at our Long Beach, CA headquarters. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so please only apply if you're able to work onsite full\-time.*****ABOUT US** We are a fast\-growing technology company building products used by hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by a supply chain spanning multiple distribution centers and a data platform processing millions of events daily. Engineering is not a support function here — it is a core driver of every major business outcome. We move fast, hold ourselves to a high bar, and believe the best engineering decisions are made by people who are close to the business. We are embracing AI not as a trend, but as a genuine multiplier — using it to ship better software, faster, while never losing sight of the craftsmanship that makes software great. **THE ROLE** This is a forward\-deployed engineering role with AI at its core. You will architect systems, write production\-grade code, design databases, and own your projects end to end — with a primary focus on deploying AI capabilities directly into the business and products that serve real users. What defines this role is the expectation that you bring strong engineering fundamentals together with a hands\-on, deployment\-first mindset for AI\-powered tools and workflows. You are not required to be an AI researcher or an ML specialist. You are expected to be an excellent engineer who deploys AI where it creates real value — using it to accelerate delivery, build intelligent features, and solve hard problems, while applying your own judgment to validate, refine, and own the outcome. **Strong Engineering Core*** Design robust, scalable systems from the ground up * Write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code * Optimize database performance and data models * Debug complex issues across the full stack * Own code quality through rigorous peer review * Deliver reliable software with measurable outcomes **AI as a Force Multiplier*** Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development * Leverage LLMs to generate boilerplate, tests, and docs * Build AI\-powered features where they add real user value * Apply AI to improve code review, debugging, and analysis * Evaluate AI outputs critically — judgment still wins * Stay current and bring new AI tools to the team **OUR CULTURE****What We Believe*** Outcomes over activity — we measure what ships and what works. * Speed is a feature — long approval chains kill great products. * Radical candor — honest feedback is a form of respect. * Learning is non\-negotiable — every sprint is a chance to improve. * No politics, no silos — collaborate openly across every team. **How We Work*** Fast\-paced sprints with a strong bias toward shipping. * Engineers own requirements, architecture, and roadmap input. * AI tools are standard kit — we share what works. * Blameless post\-mortems — failure is a learning event. * Async\-first with intentional synchronous collaboration. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****Core Software Engineering (50%)*** Design, build, and maintain scalable, high\-quality software systems and APIs that serve real users in production. * Write clean, well\-structured code with appropriate test coverage — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end. * Architect and optimize relational and non\-relational database schemas, queries, and data models for performance and reliability. * Conduct meaningful code reviews that improve team quality and share knowledge, not just catch syntax errors. * Debug, profile, and resolve performance bottlenecks and production issues with urgency and rigor. * Contribute to technical architecture decisions — propose solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and document outcomes. * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement. **AI\-Forward Deployment (35%)*** Deploy AI solutions end\-to\-end — from identifying the right use case, to building and shipping LLM\-powered features directly into products and internal workflows. * Incorporate LLM APIs and AI frameworks into product features where they create genuine user value: search, summarization, recommendations, intelligent automation, and decision support. * Apply critical engineering judgment to evaluate, refine, and validate all AI\-generated outputs before they reach production — you own the result, not just the prompt. * Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) as a daily accelerator — and champion effective AI tool patterns and prompt strategies across the team. * Stay at the front edge of the AI tooling landscape — evaluate new models, frameworks, and techniques and bring back deployment\-ready recommendations that move the business forward. **Cross\-Team Collaboration \& Communication (15%)*** Partner with Marketing, Customer Experience, Data Science, Merchandising, Warehouse Ops, and Finance to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions. * Translate technical concepts clearly ode. * **Cloud \& DevOps:** Familiar with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and basic infrastructure practices. * **Version Control:** Strong Git workflow: branching strategies, pull requests, and code review culture. **AI Literacy — Expected \& Growing*** **AI Tool Adoption:** Actively uses AI coding assistants in day\-to\-day development and can demonstrate concrete productivity or quality improvements as a result. * **LLM Integration:** Has built or integrated at least one LLM\-powered feature or workflow in a real project — even if exploratory or side\-project experience counts. * **Prompt Awareness:** Understands the basics of prompt design, few\-shot examples, and how to get reliable, structured outputs from LLM APIs. * **Critical Evaluation:** Applies engineering discipline to AI outputs — tests them, validates them, and knows when not to trust them. * **Curiosity:** Genuinely interested in how AI tooling is evolving and proactively experiments with new approaches. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience building RAG pipelines or working with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, etc.). * Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools. * Exposure to ML concepts: embeddings, model evaluation, fine\-tuning, and working with data science teams. * Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent). * Background in microservices architecture and event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.). * Knowledge of security best practices: OWASP Top 10, authentication/authorization, input validation. * Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like Jira or Linear. * Open\-source contributions or public portfolio demonstrating your engineering work. **CORE COMPETENCIES*** **Engineering Craft:** Clean, tested, maintainable code * **Database Acumen:** SQL, NoSQL, schema \& performance * **AI Fluency:** Tools \+ LLMs as force multipliers * **Performance Mindset:** Measures, optimizes, validates * **Quality Discipline:** Tests like production depends on it * **Cross\-Team Voice:** Fluent in code AND in business * **Sound Judgment:** Knows when — and when NOT — to use AI * **Ownership Drive:** Ships end\-to\-end, measures impact **TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE****Languages:** Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, SQL**Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, pgvector**Cloud \& Infra:** AWS / GCP / Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform**APIs:** REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OpenAPI / Swagger**AI \& LLM:** OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini — integrated as features, not the foundation**AI Dev Tools:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code — used daily to accelerate engineering**Observability:** Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana**Data:** PostgreSQL, dbt, Airflow, Spark, Kafka**CI/CD:** GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Jenkins, CircleCI **Equal Opportunity Employer** *CarParts.com is an equal\-opportunity employer. As the nature of business demands change so, too, may the essential functions of this position.*

trade\-offs to executives and business problems to engineers * Comfortable with ambiguity: you can meet a client who wants to talk about AI and leave with a scoped first project * Willing to travel jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** The CloudBees platform is the foundation everything else is built on. When it works well, engineers ship faster, customers trust us more, and the product compounds. When it doesn't, every team feels it. This is that team — and the future of the platform depends on you. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Platform Engineering team, developing microservices using Go and running in AWS. You will be directing, leading, and contributing to build and operate the platform. You bring deep back\-end engineering expertise and, just as importantly, a product mindset — you understand that “platform is a product”, and that the quality of your work defines what we can build and what our customers will experience. You are excited about the future of software development with coding agents, and you have full\-embraced agentic AI for doing your everyday work. You ship production\-quality code, you design resilient systems that outlast you, and you have the judgment to know when to optimize for speed and when to optimize for correctness. You are fluent in the tradeoffs of distributed systems, curious about how the platform affects the full software delivery lifecycle, and you are committed to leaving things better than you found them. Requirements: **What You'll Do** Own the Platform Foundation: * Understand the existing platform code and architecture, forming a strong, evidence\-based opinion on its strengths, its weaknesses, and what to do about them. * Define the technical roadmap with measurable goals and sequence the work to deliver incremental value. * Write the hardest code yourself. Own the critical\-path refactors, the performance work, and the stability fixes. Bring the Team with You: * Earn the trust of an established team. Listen first, then show your reasoning and let the code make the case. * Guide teams through execution by setting direction, defining standards, and unblocking the hard problems. * Lead design reviews and code reviews with rigor and honesty. Make Quality the Default: * Establish development practices that hold up as the team and platform evolve: testing, interfaces, service boundaries, and release discipline. * Drive observability (metrics, structured logs, tracing) and use it to find root causes. * Write down architecture decisions and the reasoning behind them for the next evolution to learn and improve upon.. **You May Be a Good Fit If** * You have 12\+ years of relevant experience as a founding, principal, or staff engineer. * You have built and operated a complex microservices platform in production, and can explain what broke, why, and what you did about it. * You have extensive distributed\-systems experience, including concurrency, event\-driven architectures, message buses, and their failure modes. * You have taken over a complex codebase and measurably made it better. * You still contribute code that ships to production every week. **Your Mindset** * You think like a technical founder. You own outcomes for the whole system, not just your piece. * You have high emotional intelligence. You can critique a design without making it personal, and you change your mind when the data tells you to. * You prefer simple solutions to clever ones. * **Customer Obsessed** — You treat customer problems as your own and build relationships with the people behind the logo, not just the account. You can point to decisions you changed because of what a customer told you. * **High Agency** — You own problems beyond your job description and move without waiting to be asked. When the path isn't defined, you make the call and bring people with you rather than working around them. * ** esult, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **Strong Candidates May Also** * Have led a simplification or stabilization effort on an existing SaaS platform. * Have built or operated CI/CD systems, workflow engines, or developer platforms. * Have contributed to open source in the Kubernetes, Tekton, NATS, Jenkins, or broader DevOps ecosystem. * Have background in identity and access management, multi\-tenancy, or regulated environments. * Have experience with LLM\-powered features or MCP tooling in production backends. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. jobs.title: Director of Critical Infrastructure

approval authorities for departmental operating and capital expenditures. * Determine engineering consultant requirements, negotiate rates, terms, conditions, and contracts with appropriate approvals, application to CoServ operations. * Promote continuous improvement through post\-event reviews, operational assessments, and process optimization initiatives, using established performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities. * Maintain knowledge of applicable electric and gas codes and regulations, utility practices, engineering principles, and CoServ tariffs, service rules, policies, and line extension requirements. * Attend meetings, conferences, schools, workshops, and required CoServ University training to maintain and expand relevant technical, regulatory, and professional knowledge. * Participate in CoServ’s Leadership Communications Team (LCT) and Emergency Response Program (ERP). * Actively promote CoServ’s objectives, plans, programs, and goals. * Stay informed about public and political questions affecting areas of responsibility and develop informed responses. * Perform other duties and activities as directed. **Position Requirements** **Education, Experience, and Certifications Required** * High School Diploma or G.E.D equivalency. * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field, AND twelve (12\) years of utility distribution and/or operations experience with a minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience * Registration as Professional Engineer in Texas OR ability to be licensed within 6 months of hire. **Education, Experience, and Certifications Preferred** * NERC Operator Certification OR Master’s in Business Administration, Engineering, or related technical field. **Skills and Abilities Required** * Proficient in oral and written communications. * Ability to manage multiple tasks and strict timelines. * Excellent decision making, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills. * Proven planning, organizing, and leadership skills while being team oriented. * Must be capable of effectively executing company objectives and goals. * Results oriented leader with proven success in managing expectations, communications, and technical areas of expertise. * Demonstrated strengths in time management, project management, follow\-up, and execution. * Ability to create win/win situations in conflict jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Automation
jobs.description: #### **About us** Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks. Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition. #### **About the role** Coalition is building an AI Automation team to eliminate manual work and improve how teams across the company operate. As a Senior Software Engineer, AI Automation, you will lead the design and delivery of reliable, production\-grade AI agents and workflows that solve meaningful business problems. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an AI\-native engineer who can move from ambiguous business problems to durable technical solutions. You will work closely with internal operators, product and data partners, and engineering teams to understand complex processes, develop reusable agent capabilities, and establish the technical patterns that allow AI automation to scale safely across Coalition. You will balance rapid experimentation with strong engineering judgment. You will define system architecture, establish evaluation and reliability practices, and ensure that production agents operate with the appropriate controls for permissions, auditability, human review, and rollback. #### **Responsibilities** * Lead the technical design and delivery of AI agents, reusable skills, and automation workflows used by Coalition's internal teams. * Translate complex, ambiguous business processes, judgment calls, and edge cases into reliable, maintainable software. * Design and evolve integrations between agents and systems of record using MCP and comparable tool\-integration frameworks. * Define architecture, interfaces, data contracts, and operational standards for production AI systems. * Establish evaluation strategies, quality baselines, and release criteria; use results to make sound deployment and iteration decisions. * Build systems with robust controls for permissions, observability, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop review, failure containment, and rollback. * Partner with data engineering and business stakeholders to ensure automations use trustworthy data and have sustainable ownership. * Drive technical decisions across multiple workflows, identify reusable patterns, and raise the engineering bar for the team. * Mentor engineers and technical partners through design reviews, implementation guidance, and practical AI engineering standards. * Document systems, decisions, and operating practices so that teams can safely maintain and extend what you build. #### **Skills and Qualifications** * 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including substantial recent experience building and shipping LLM\-backed applications used by real users. * Demonstrated experience taking AI agents or multi\-step automation workflows from prototype through reliable production operation. * Strong Python engineering skills and practical SQL expertise, including the ability to work directly with production data models. * Deep experience with prompting, tool use, agentic loops, structured outputs, multi\-step workflows, error handling, and production deployment. * Experience designing and operating systems that integrate with business\-critical systems of record. * Strong judgment around evaluation methodology, reliability, safety controls, and the tradeoffs required to deploy AI systems responsibly. * Solid production engineering fundamentals across Git, CI/CD, containers, deployment, monitoring, testing, permissions, and rollback. * Ability to lead technical work in ambiguous environments, influence stakeholders, and turn incomplete requirements into practical, high\-quality solutions. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with both technical and non\-technical partners. #### **Bonus Points** * Experience building or maintaining MCP servers, agent platforms, or reusable tool/skill frameworks. * Experience designing evaluation harnesses, test datasets, and monitoring for LLM\-backed systems. * Background in internal tools, solutions engineering, professional services, startup environments, or founding teams. * Familiarity with systems such as Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, or Snowflake. * Experience in insurance, fintech, cybersecurity, or another regulated environment where correctness, traceability, and controls have meaningful business impact. * Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead for complex cross\-functional initiatives. #### **Compensation** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $130,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $195,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay with overage * 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer match * Flexible PTO * Up to 14 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks of paid parental leave for non\-birthing parents * Annual home office stipend and WeWork access * Mental \& physical health wellness programs like One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more! * Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement #### **Why Coalition?** Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote\-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition's exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real\-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion. We're always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join \#OurCoalition. Visit our Newsroom \> #### **Privacy Notice** Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled. Our Privacy Policy \> #### **Safe Hiring Notice** All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you've been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). #### **Anti\-Discrimination Notice** Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. #### **Accommodations** Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. jobs.title: Adjunct Instructor, Applied AI Engineering - New Mexico State University - Spring 2027 (In-Person, Master’s Degree Preferred)
jobs.description: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000\+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world. We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work. We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0\-to\-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it. **About the Role** **Location:** New Mexico State University, Las Cruces, NM, United States **Role\-Type:** Seasonal Part\-Time, W2 Employee (up to 10 hours/week) **Duration:** January 2027 \- May 2027 (Training start and the Spring Academic Term) **Reports To:** Program Manager **Compensation:** All new hires begin at $75/hour Adjunct Instructors serve as the primary facilitators of CodePath’s university courses, delivering engaging in\-class instruction and representing CodePath to students nationwide. They prepare and lead interactive lessons using CodePath’s curriculum, ensuring that each course meets program key performance indicators (KPIs) and continuously evolves based on student feedback. Instructors may also collaborate with co\-instructors and teaching assistants to coordinate classroom activities and provide comprehensive support to students. **We are looking for instructors preferably with a Master’s Degree or PhD in a field related to Computer Science to lead our Artificial Intelligence (AI) courses as we develop partnerships between CodePath and various universities across the country.** The AI course covers theory, algorithms, and practical applications of generative models, including modern large language models (LLMs) and multimodal systems. **You will need to be free during the Spring Academic Term which runs between January through May, 2027\.** The full date range listed also includes time needed for pre\-course instructor training. The course time(s) you could be assigned are set to take place on: * Mondays/Wednesdays, 1:30pm\-2:45pm MT **Key Activities** * Lead in\-person class sessions of approximately 20\-30 college students, supporting students in achieving learning objectives * Review course material and plan for lessons to be highly engaging and industry relevant, with CodePath provided curriculum * Work with the Program Manager to oversee the course and work with other co\- instructors as needed * Participate in regular syncs with instructors and teaching assistants leading up to the start of the course * Use course feedback to implement course improvements and propose curriculum changes that ensure KPIs are met * Participate in check\-ins with instructors during the course, optionally shadowing some of the other instructor’s sessions, to provide instructors feedback * Engage with University faculty and staff to ensure consistent alignment with our curriculum and their overall program * Manage teaching assistants to ensure students receive appropriate support **Qualifications** * (Preferable) Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer science (or closely related field) * 4\+ years of full\-time working experience in a software development/engineering role * Availability to lead lectures during the course times listed above * Available to meet with teaching assistants once per week outside of class * Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI\-assisted development workflows * Experience with open source development practices and large codebases * Proficiency with Python * Experience working through shifting priorities and learning, while maintaining organization and control * A passion for training the next generation of developers and some experience teaching in an educational, volunteer or work setting, for online learning environments * ***(Preferred)*** 1\+ years of instructional experience with a demonstrated track record of educational excellence **Seasonal/Part\-Time Employee Benefits** * Wellness: Employee Assistance Program * Financial Security: 401(k) * Additional Perks: Exclusive marketplace savings **\* This position is not eligible for medical, dental, or vision benefits or paid time\-off** Pay range $75 \- $75 USD

You will partner with software, data science, security, and platform teams to ensure our AI systems meet high standards for availability, latency, performance, cost, and operational safety. rollback procedures. * Collaborate with engineering and ML teams to make AI systems production\-ready. * Maintain clear runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures. * Participate in an on\-call rotation and help build a sustainable, low\-noise operational culture. **Required Qualifications** * 4\+ years of experience in SRE, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or production engineering. * Strong Linux, networking, cloud, and distributed\-systems experience. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Proficiency in Python, Go, or another programming language used for automation and production systems. * Experience with observability platforms, metrics, logs, traces, and incident\-management practices. * Experience operating production services with defined availability and performance targets. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and systems\-thinking skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating machine\-learning or generative\-AI workloads in production. * Familiarity with GPUs, CUDA, model\-serving systems, vector databases, or high\-performance computing. * Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Argo CD, Helm, or service meshes. * Knowledge of MLOps practices, model lifecycle management, and ML/data pipelines. * Experience with reliability testing, chaos engineering, load testing, or capacity modeling. * Understanding of AI security, data privacy, model\-safety controls, and access management. **Success in This Role** Within the first year, you will help reduce critical incidents, improve detection and recovery times, increase platform availability, improve infrastructure utilization, and create repeatable operational standards for deploying and running AI systems at scale. The salary range for this role is between $142,000 and $167,500 depending on skills and qualifications of the candidate. Applications will be accepted till 10/31/2026

Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud\-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large\-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform\-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission\-critical systems are built and evolved. **About the Team** The Deliver team is responsible for building and operating the core products that deliver high\-stakes digital assessments to millions of students each year. You will contribute to systems built on modular, scalable architectures, and support delivery through CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps practices. **In this role, you have:** **Design performance, reliability, and security **Team Operations \& Success (30 mers’ business processes and operations * Share knowledge and contribute to improving team practices and engineering quality * Mentor junior developers and support growth within the team **About you, you have:** * 7\+ years of experience in full stack development, building, testing, and managing web\-based applications * At least 3 years of recent, hands\-on experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS * Experience building serverless applications on AWS, including services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, Step Functions, IAM, CloudFront, WAF, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and DynamoDB * Experience building applications using modular, component\-driven architectures * Experience with AWS CDK to define infrastructure as code and integrate it into deployment pipelines for environment\-specific deploys * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows shared across services, improving consistency and reducing duplicated pipeline maintenance across teams * Experience with automated testing, ideally Playwright * Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Grafana) including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting to diagnose and resolve production issues * Experience working in Agile environments with strong collaboration skills * Strong problem\-solving ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies * Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science, systems engineering, information systems, or a similar field (preferred) **All roles at College Board require:** * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving jobs.title: Deputy Resident Engineer - Track/Civil
jobs.description: Overview: Ramos CS, now part of Colliers Engineering \& Design, is an engineering, program, and construction management firm providing quality transit, transportation, and infrastructure consulting services on public projects across the Western United States. We focus our solutions on mobility\-related projects that serve the needs of our communities within the municipal, transit, transportation, airport, and port sectors. With a staff of diversified, licensed professionals, our philosophy stems from the idea that successful project execution starts with people. We are seeking a Deputy Resident Engineer for Track/Civil to perform a wide variety of professional engineering work in a field and office setting as Owner's Representative on a light rail extension program's trackwork and systems construction contract. The Deputy Resident Engineer supports the Resident Engineer in day\-to\-day contract administration and leads oversight of the trackwork and civil scopes, including trackwork and special trackwork, at\-grade guideways, utility relocations, drainage, subgrade preparation, duct banks, walkways, foundations for signal houses, TPSS, and OCS poles, MSE and ballast walls, fencing, finishes, and landscaping. The Deputy Resident Engineer reviews the work of the Contractor in accordance with the applicable Design Criteria Manual, Construction Management Manual, and all governing specifications. Responsibilities: * Acts as the Resident Engineer's deputy for contract administration in accordance with the Authority's Construction Manual, and steps in for the Resident Engineer as needed. * Directs the Track and Civil Construction Engineers and inspection staff and coordinates daily inspection assignments. * Ensures safety of Authority employees, Contractor employees, and the traveling public by observing contractor operations, making recommendations, and taking corrective action when necessary. * Reviews contractor operations for compliance with OSHA regulations and Authority safety requirements. * Performs field inspections of trackwork and civil work to determine compliance with plans, specifications, special provisions, and permit conditions. * Reviews Inspector Daily Reports (IDRs) and non\-conformance reports (NCRs) from Construction Engineers and inspectors in documenting the Contractor's activities. * Coordinates RFIs, submittals, and field clarifications for track and civil scopes with the design consultants. * Calculates and documents field quantities for payment purposes and supports review of progress payment applications. * Identifies field conditions that require a contract change order and prepares change documentation and independent estimates. * Coordinates utility relocations, traffic control, and work zone interfaces with utilities, SDOT, and other agencies. * Monitors stormwater, erosion and sediment control, and environmental compliance for track and civil work. * Reviews CPM schedules and identifies sequencing risks between civil, track, and systems installation. * Documents as\-built conditions and supports punch list, substantial completion, and closeout activities. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. * Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred; Washington PE preferred. PMP or DBIA certification a plus. * Approximately 8\+ years of construction management or inspection experience on light rail, heavy rail, or heavy civil projects. * Experience as an Assistant Resident Engineer, Deputy Resident Engineer, or Lead Inspector on trackwork, guideway, or heavy civil work. * Working knowledge of trackwork construction and heavy civil construction methods. * Must be able to work on\-site in Seattle full\-time during construction. * Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions. Compensation: $145,000 to $200,000 per year (depending on qualifications) What We Offer: Ramos Consulting Services, now a part of Colliers Engineering \& Design, offers competitive benefits that support our employees in their life and career. This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to:* **Employer\-Provided Healthcare:** 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee base plans. We also provide a 40% employer contribution toward dependent or family coverage plans. * **Paid Time Off:** 120 hours of combined PTO and Sick Time annually, in addition to paid holidays. * **Retirement Planning:** Participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with a generous company match of 50% on the first 6% of employee contributions. * **Flexible Spending Accounts:** Pre\-tax FSA/HSA options for medical, dental, and dependent care expenses to help manage out\-of\-pocket costs. * **Employee Wellness \& Support:** 100% employer\-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) providing 24/7 confidential support for work\-life balance, financial wellness, and emotional well\-being. * **National Resources \& Career Growth:** As part of the Colliers Engineering \& Design national platform, employees have access to expanded technical resources, mentorship, and diverse career development opportunities across the Western United States and beyond.
