Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business. **Job Description** =================== Location: New York, NY Condé Nast's commerce team builds the technology behind product discovery, personalized shopping, and checkout experiences across our portfolio of brands. We're looking for a Software Engineer III to help design and scale backend systems that power commerce initiatives, including styling and product recommendations, catalog, inventory, and order infrastructure, built to serve multiple brands, not just one. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers across the org to build systems that are fast, reliable, and designed for reuse and scale across Condé Nast's diverse editorial and commerce properties. **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * 6\+ years building production backend systems, ideally with some exposure to e\-commerce, retail, or content\-commerce platforms * Deep proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript, with a track record of designing services that hold up under real user traffic, including seasonal or campaign\-driven spikes * Experience building and evolving REST and GraphQL APIs that serve both internal teams (editorial, styling, merchandising) and external partners (retail affiliates, payment providers, product data feeds) * Comfort designing event\-driven systems (Kafka, SQS, EventBridge) for things like inventory sync, price updates, order status, and affiliate commerce events * Strong database design instincts across relational and NoSQL systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) * Experience designing systems with multi\-tenancy or configurability in mind: building once and adapting across different use cases, teams, or brands, rather than one\-off solutions * Basic fluency in React, enough to collaborate closely with frontend engineers building shoppable articles, styling widgets, and product carousels * Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design, applied pragmatically rather than academically * Comfortable owning the full development lifecycle, from version control and code review to automated testing and CI/CD deployment. * A collaborative streak: you'll be pairing with product, editorial, and design stakeholders across multiple brands, each with its own voice and priorities * AI\-native mindset. Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow, and look for opportunities to apply AI to solve real engineering and product problems, not just to write code faster. **Description** --------------- As a backend engineer on Condé Nast's commerce team, you'll design and build services spanning multiple commerce initiatives, including product catalog and inventory systems, retail partner integrations, styling and recommendation features, and checkout infrastructure, with an eye toward reusability across our brands. You'll work closely with product managers to translate business goals into technical designs, and with frontend and other backend engineers to ship features end to end. You'll make architectural calls that balance speed of iteration with the reliability commerce demands, while thinking ahead about how a given system might need to flex for a different brand's catalog structure, traffic pattern, or editorial workflow. You'll participate in code reviews and design discussions, and mentor other engineers to help raise the technical bar across the team. Day to day, the specific project might shift: optimizing a product\-matching query for styling recommendations one quarter, hardening a retail partner integration the next. But the core of the work stays the same: partnering closely with product and engineering to build commerce systems that are reliable, well\-designed, and scalable across Condé Nast's portfolio of brands. **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6\+ years of professional backend software development experience required. *The expected base salary range for this position is from $175,000\-195,000\. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.* **What happens next?** ====================== If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile. ***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Constellation is creating the AI\-human translation layer that ensures humanity evolves alongside our technology. Our mission is to leverage AI towards addressing deep and meaningful problems at the core of the human experience: empowering people towards their goals, augmenting our cognition and emotional wellness, and understanding ourselves and each other. Our path forward is to move away from AI that captures human knowledge towards AI that truly understands what it is to be human. We are generating the richest multimodal dataset ever collected to build a new class of foundation models and we're seeking the founding team of engineers to build the infrastructure that makes this ambitious future a reality. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for a Hardware Engineer to own the hardware behind our data collection. Our multimodal collection rigs combine biosensors with video and audio capture, and every stream has to stay synchronized and running, session after session. Your job is to keep that growing fleet of rigs synchronized, healthy, and repeatable, and to build the custom hardware and firmware that make it work better. This is a generalist role on a small founding team, spanning analog electronics, embedded firmware, and the software glue between devices and our data pipeline. It's research hardware, not volume manufacturing: we move quickly to answer questions, then make what works reliable enough to run every day. You'll work closely with our data collection team, software engineers, neuroscientists, and researchers. We're hiring at multiple levels and will set title and scope to your experience. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Keep our fleet of collection rigs synchronized and healthy: integrate and maintain off\-the\-shelf devices, such as biosensors, cameras, and audio equipment, and diagnose failures quickly. * Own time synchronization across every device and data stream. * Build reliable, documented rigs, test fixtures, and automated validation that let researchers focus on the science. * Design and bring up custom boards and sensor integrations where you determine off\-the\-shelf equipment falls short, from schematic and PCB layout through assembly and testing. * Write and debug C/C\+\+ firmware for microcontrollers and Python tooling for device control, signal\-quality checks, and data validation; work with the Linux drivers on our capture machines. * Partner with our software team on the interface between devices and our data ingestion infrastructure. * Handle light mechanical work: enclosures, connectors, mounts, and 3D\-printed parts that keep hardware durable and comfortable for participants. * Decide what to build in\-house versus contract out, and manage vendors and contractors when we do. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years of experience designing and bringing up electronic hardware, with significant hands\-on work in both board design and embedded firmware. * A track record of building physical things that worked in real use: instruments, devices, or research rigs. * Able to work independently, make sound technical calls, and explain trade\-offs clearly to non\-hardware teammates. * Hands\-on experience with biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, EMG) or other low\-noise measurements, including electrode contact, noise sources, grounding, and shielding. * Schematic capture and PCB layout in Altium or KiCad, including mixed\-signal boards. * Strong C/C\+\+ skills for writing microcontroller firmware (e.g., on ARM Cortex\-M, ideally with an RTOS such as Zephyr or FreeRTOS). Comfortable going below the application layer on Linux to debug device drivers, USB and serial issues, and kernel behavior when hardware misbehaves. * Python for test scripts, device control, and data analysis. * Hands\-on experience synchronizing data across multiple devices (hardware triggers, shared clocks, timestamping). * Comfortable at the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD debuggers. * Demonstrably adaptable and excited about finding creative solutions to problems nobody has solved before. * Passionate about positively impacting the well\-being of humanity and not just capitalizing on it. * You thrive in a high\-bandwidth, collaborative environment. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience writing Linux kernel modules or device drivers. * FPGA or HDL experience (e.g., Verilog, VHDL). * Prior work with research\-grade sensing equipment, such as eye trackers or EEG systems, and with synchronization tools such as Lab Streaming Layer (LSL). * Familiarity with other physiological sensing, such as fNIRS, EDA, or PPG. * Medical electrical isolation and safety for equipment used with human participants (e.g., IEC 60601\). * A background in designing wearable, battery\-powered, or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. * Basic mechanical CAD and 3D printing. * Interest in neurotech, mental health, or human\-AI interaction. **Benefits** ------------ * Comprehensive, high\-quality health, dental, and vision insurance with premiums fully covered. * A renovated, light\-filled office with a quirky layout in the heart of San Francisco's Mission District, surrounded by world\-class food and coffee. * Relocation assistance for those joining us in SF and workspace setup stipend. * Monthly team dinners and outings, plus twice\-yearly off\-sites and retreats. * Fully stocked kitchen (snacks!) * Sponsorship for travel to relevant conferences and regular professional development activities to help you level up. * A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave with a “soft\-landing” transition back. * Paid time off (PTO) Compensation Range: $180K \- $260K

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality\-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team. **Analytics Engineer** We're hiring Analytics Engineers to join Convene Hospitality Group's (CHG) Technology organization. We're building out the foundational platform to democratize data at CHG so that a venue GM, a finance lead, and an AI agent are all able to ask a question and get the same trusted answer. Analytics engineers own the full path from ingestion to visualization, including governance and observability. You'll bring data in from source systems, model it through bronze, silver, and gold, define the semantic layer, and breathe life into the visualizations, conversational analytics, and business agents that teams rely on to make decisions. You'll join the Data Platform team, reporting to its Engineering Manager, and work closely with other analytics engineers and business partners across the company. You'll build on Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran, using Snowflake\-native capabilities like semantic views and Cortex to power ThoughtSpot and beyond. **What You'll Do:** * **Partner with the business.** Work with Finance, Sales, Operations, and venue teams to understand their needs and turn them into models and metrics they trust. * **Own ingestion for your domains.** Set up and maintain Fivetran connectors, land data in bronze, and handle schema drift and load failures. * **Model the business.** Build dbt models that move data through bronze, silver, and gold, and shape gold around how CHG runs so people outside the data team can understand and use it. * **Own the semantic layer.** Set metrics, dimensions, and relationships so a number means the same thing in a dashboard, a search, or an agent's answer. Tune synonyms and descriptions so a model picks the right measure, trace wrong answers to the root cause, and help us decide where each definition lives. * **Power self\-service in ThoughtSpot.** Build the models and Liveboards that let teams explore data on their own, and turn the questions people actually ask into new test cases. * **Own the quality of conversational analytics.** Test answers the way you'd test code. Build and maintain a golden question set of real business questions paired with certified answers as your test cases, run them as a regression suite on every model or semantic change, and block releases that fail. Back your models with dbt tests and clear documentation. * **Apply governance day to day.** Tag sensitive data at ingestion, apply access controls such as tag\-based masking and row access policies, and follow the standards the team sets, so an agent only returns what the person asking is allowed to see. * **Keep it fast and fresh.** Monitor freshness, data quality, and pipeline health so problems surface to you before they reach a dashboard or an agent's answer. Tune query and model performance, from incremental dbt models to warehouse sizing, so answers come back fast and Snowflake costs stay in check. * **Work AI\-native.** Lead with specs, then hand agents end\-to\-end tasks, from exploring source data to building models, tests, and documentation. Let agents run loose in the wild (with some guardrails in place). You hold agent and human work to the same review bar, so code from Claude and code from a teammate get the same scrutiny. Share what you learn, and help set the playbook for agentic data work. **What We Look For:** * You have 3\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development, building data products people rely on. * You write strong SQL and have built and maintained dbt models in production. * You've worked in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. * You've worked with ELT ingestion tools like Fivetran and can troubleshoot source\-data issues such as schema changes, late\-arriving data, and API limits. * You understand data modeling: dimensional models, medallion layering, and clear reasoning about grain, slowly changing dimensions, and event lifecycles. * You've built dashboards or self\-service data products that people use to make decisions. * You test and document your work as a habit. * You're curious about the business. You ask what decision a request supports before you start building. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work, like writing SQL and dbt models, generating tests, and drafting documentation, and you verify what they produce. * You explain your work clearly to technical and non\-technical partners. * You take ownership. You see work through, ask for help when you're stuck, and look for ways to make things better. Bonus Points * You've evaluated LLM or natural\-language analytics output, for example with golden sets or regression testing. * You've worked in hospitality, events, real estate, or another customer\-centric, multi\-location business. **Compensation:** The above job definition information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions. Salary Min: $120,000 Salary Max: $160,000 This role is also eligible for Convene's annual incentive performance bonus plan. This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors. **We're Here For You:** At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here's what you can expect: * **Health \& Wellness:** Day\-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well\-being support, and fertility \& family planning benefits. Because your well\-being matters, inside and outside of work. * **Time Off \& Balance:** Generous PTO, your birthday off (because, of course!), paid parental leave, and a year\-end holiday closure to recharge. * **Financial Growth:** 401K with company match and support for education, courses, and certifications. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally. * **Development \& Recognition:** Ongoing career growth opportunities plus recognition programs to celebrate milestones. * **Community \& Impact:** Volunteer and give\-back opportunities, and the chance to make a real impact in the work you do. At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you're excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we'd love to have you on the team. Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. \#LI\-DK1

Coach through code review, pairing, and clear expectations. * **Keep your hands on the keyboard.** Write dbt models, review PRs, debug pipelines and prototype new approaches. Expect to build a lot, especially early on. **What We Look For:** * You have 7\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering or data architecture, including building a modern data platform that people rely on in production. * You use AI agents for real multi\-step work: building models, writing tests, debugging pipelines and documenting what exists. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** ------------ At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people, “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity. **About the Information Service and Technology (IST) Department****:** Connecting our community and local government through innovative, accessible technology solutions. * **Customers:** Enable departments through partnerships, responsiveness, and innovation; prioritizing their needs and fulfilling their expectations. * **Solutions:** Be Innovative Business Leaders who identify opportunities early and apply technology to drive better, faster public services. **Culture:** Cultivate leadership at all levels to drive IST’s success while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. In addition to a full benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension/Retirement, deferred compensation, and flexible spending accounts, we offer our employees: * Hybrid (telework/onsite) work schedules. * Options for Alternative Work Schedules (such as 4\-5/9’s). * A culture of public service collaboration and work/life balance. * Training and career development opportunities. * County benefits such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Tuition Assistance Program (TAP). **Remote Work Options:** The IST Department has embraced a hybrid work schedule that recognizes some duties of this position may be performed remotely. Candidates must be able to work**a minimum of** **three (3\) days per week in the office**and report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule. **About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology\-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success. **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- **We currently have one (1\) full\-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior\-level IT project management, not hands\-on systems engineering. This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes. Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals. **ABOUT YOU** ------------- The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. jobs.title: Technical Analyst I
jobs.description: **Cox Automotive** is seeking a **Technical Analyst I (TA**) is the primary point of contact for Technology at Revenue Generating Locations (i.e. Manheim Auto Auction). The TA collaborates with members of project teams and business owners to bring forth its technology to the client. The TA assists in design, development, testing, and post\-release. The TA ensures service delivery for all interconnected network devices and workflow processes. The TA is responsible to maintain system integrity and security. The TA manages fixed infrastructure inter\-connectivity and assists or designs expansions after evaluating the business need. The TA is expected to manage, initiate, and/or participate in projects ranging from construction, business changes, and corporate\-wide initiatives. When third parties are introduced, the analyst will be expected to engineer a solution or collaborate with the appropriate parties. The TA advocates and escalates issues. They will assist locations with a client base ranging from 200 to 1000 team members. They will assist with client training, adoption, and satisfaction. The TA's role requires participation in location management team meetings with the expectation to assist business needs and/or changes. They will influence the local management team with operations and technology decisions with a strict adherence to company standards and best practices. TA's are required to have an awareness of operational knowledge specific to the client. This includes a wide scale knowledge of service portfolios to provide guidance and assistance. The TA provides Service Delivery management by providing high uptime, managing local service contracts, and managing high\-pressure issues and conflicts that arise during revenue generating sale\-days. **What You'll Do:** **Hardware/Software Installation** * Hardware procurement, delivery, implementation, and maintenance. * Maintains documentation of physical assets in configuration and asset management records. **Preventive Maintenance** * Monitors the availability, performance, and throughput of supported technology infrastructure to proactively identify issues and remediate. * Manages and maintains all infrastructure hardware and software ensuring they remain available at all required times. Tests and provides recommendations for replacement or upgrade of hardware or software to ensure business continuity. * Maintains technology infrastructure support technical documentation. * Leads location in disaster recovery for technology. **Incident Management** * Performs technology support, troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile phones, and peripheral devices. * Performs research and develops solutions for hardware and software issues. * Updates incident records and knowledge base with appropriate and timely information **Problem Management** * Recommends and develops solutions, resolve problems associated with incidents, and update problem records. * Conducts root cause analysis. * Submits requests for change records to remove errors. * The role requires a high level of autonomy correlating to workflow. This is a results\-driven position requiring knowledge of all facets of technology such as networking, software, and hardware. * Works with project teams to review and assess impact of new business requirements. * Contributes to technical aspects of key change documentation (e.g. technical requirements, change impact assessments, change implementation plans, change rollout plans). * Ensures the capacity, availability, security, and service support requirements are considered in all technology infrastructure changes. * Implements, tests, and monitors technology infrastructure changes in line with change implementation plans. * Ensures technology infrastructure changes meet agreed service acceptance criteria. * Maintains asset and configuration management records. **Training** * Trains end users for Corporate initiatives such as device or software deployment for teams such as Security, Device Engineering, and Software teams. **Technology Operations** * Provide technical expertise to enable the correct application of operational procedures. * Contribute to the planning and implementation of maintenance and installation work. * Implement agreed changes and maintenance routines. * Identify operational problems and ensuring they are managed in accordance with agreed standards and procedures. * Provide reports and proposals for improvement. **Client Services Management** * Act as the routine contact point. * Assist with the development of and applies solutions to resolve or escalate clients' service problems. * Monitor client services function and collects performance data. * Data retention management is required for this role for the client's legal archive. **Who You Are:** **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as 4 years' experience in a related field. * Working experience supporting end\-user computing devices * Working experience working with incident, problem, and change management * Working experience in an ITIL\-based environment * Working experience as a participant in a change management process * Working experience of Microsoft Office products * Willingness to travel 5 to 10%. * Ability to walk, stand, squat, kneel and climb to perform essential job duties required to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain technology equipment * Excellent customer service skills required. The ability to meet SLAs and update customer with progress. **Preferred Qualifications** * Additional Tech Certification: A\+, Network\+, MCP, MCDST * Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) * Network certificates * Experience in Series/AS400 support * Experience in wireless (Mobile, WiFi, WAP) * Experience in network * Experience in audio/visual * Exposure to Project Management * Experience communicating with stakeholders USD 67,200\.00 \- 100,800\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $67,200\.00 \- $100,800\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. EOE, including disability/vets

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Full-stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** We are looking for a full\-stack engineer with strong React, Node.js, and SQL experience to join a forward\-deployed team delivering a new AI product to enterprise clients. You will connect client data systems to the product, build the pipelines behind each business metric, and tailor the platform to each client’s needs. This role suits an engineer who enjoys working directly with end users, navigating unfamiliar systems, and shipping quickly. **General Overview** The client is a global management consulting firm launching an AI product that gives leadership a single view of business performance. The product connects to each client’s data sources, applies proven performance\-management frameworks, and highlights where the business stands, which conversations to hold at each level of the organization, and which actions to take. The core product is already built, and each client is served by a small pod made up of a product lead and two engineers working alongside the firm’s consultants. As one of the two engineers in the pod, you will work on site with a client based in Waltham, MA, Cincinnati, OH, or Dallas, TX, turning business questions into reliable data feeds. Expect messy, undocumented systems and a fast feedback loop with the people using what you build. **Tasks and Deliverables** * Integrate client data sources, including warehouses, ERP, CRM, operational systems, and APIs, into the product. * Write and tune SQL queries and data pipelines that turn raw client data into reliable metrics. * Extend the product’s frontend and backend to meet client\-specific needs. * Use the product’s agent and SDK tooling to configure and extend client workflows. * Debug data quality issues on site with client IT teams and data owners. * Collaborate closely with the product manager and consultants to deliver client customizations. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience with React and Node.js in production. * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Redux. * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on data integration experience (ETL/ELT, APIs, data warehouses). * Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks, including prompting, tool use, and evaluation. * Experience working directly with customers or end users, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to join an unfamiliar codebase and ship within the first week. **Nice to Have** * Previous experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions, or consulting engineering role. * Experience with Snowflake, dbt, or a similar modern data stack. * Experience with healthcare or medical services data, such as EHR, claims, scheduling, or revenue cycle, is a strong plus. * Familiarity with HIPAA\-aware data handling. **Engagement Highlights** * 3 to 6 month engagement. * Start date beginning November. * On\-site work Monday through Thursday, with remote work on Fridays. * Location restricted: candidates must live in the Greater Boston area (Waltham, MA), Cincinnati, OH, or Dallas, TX. * Must be authorized to work in the US.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** We are seeking a Lead Forward\-Deployed Product Manager to drive delivery on the ground. You will lead a dedicated, forward\-deployed pod consisting of yourself and two engineers working alongside senior consulting partners. This is a technical product role with true delivery accountability—you will own stakeholder alignment, define metric definitions and data roll\-ups, manage the technical backlog, and drive product adoption directly within executive operating reviews. **Tasks and Deliverables:** Conduct deep discovery with executive stakeholders and data owners to translate high\-level business goals into precise source\-system queries, data tables, and feeds. Write detailed technical requirements, manage and prioritize the backlog, and run agile sprints for a forward\-deployed pod of two engineers. Own day\-to\-day client relationship management and executive stakeholder alignment in partnership with the consulting team. Drive product adoption by embedding platform outputs directly into the client’s executive leadership and operating reviews. Serve as the feedback loop between client on\-site requirements and the central product/engineering organization to inform the core platform roadmap. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, or leading forward\-deployed/solutions engineering teams. * Proven track record of shipping data products built on enterprise architectures (data warehouses, ERP, CRM, BI). * Strong stakeholder management skills. * Strong focus on stakeholder management and requirements gathering for complex enterprise software deployments. **Nice to Have** * Background in management consulting or technical client\-facing solution delivery. * Technical background with hands\-on proficiency in SQL and data modeling to evaluate architecture and validate engineering output. * Hands\-on experience with modern cloud data platforms, specifically Snowflake. * Domain expertise in Healthcare/Medical Services (EHR, claims, scheduling, revenue cycle) or the Entertainment industry. * Experience shipping AI/LLM production systems to enterprise users. **Engagement Highlights** * Full\-time commitment (40 hours/week) for an initial 3 months contract with strong potential for long\-term project renewal. * High\-visibility strategic leadership role embedded within a top\-tier management consulting firm’s enterprise AI initiative.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, Platform** -------------------------------------- **Team:** Platform Engineering **Location:** Portland, Oregon. Full time (hybrid) **Salary range:** $132,300–$161,700 *Unfortunately, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.* ### **About CreativeX** CreativeX is building the system of creative control for an AI\-first marketing world. As AI rewrites how content is made, evaluated, and distributed, marketers need a foundation they can trust and a way to bring consistency, intelligence, and governance to creative at scale. For over a decade, we've powered smarter creative decisions for the world's biggest brands, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, shipped category\-defining products, and proven that creative is the single biggest driver of marketing performance We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance. This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end\-to\-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift. Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data. ### **Platform Engineering Team** As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own the reliability, performance and scalability of the production infrastructure behind every CreativeX product. You'll be a part of the Platform Engineering team, which builds the infrastructure, shared services and self\-service tools our engineers rely on, and runs the systems that collect, process and serve the ad data and creative scoring our customers depend on. We're investing in our core architecture: evolving our data layer, scaling our processing pipelines for higher throughput and automating more of how we process creative assets. You'll lead the database migrations and rearchitecture work that make this possible, and build the tooling that lets other engineers deploy, test and debug. This is a systems\-level role so you'll write code, but most of your impact will come from how our systems are designed, run, observed and scaled. You enjoy taking a system that works and making it faster, more reliable and easier to run, and this role is an opportunity to shape the platform that CreativeX's next stage of growth is built on. ### **What you will do:** * Be the owner and go\-to expert for the reliability and performance of our production systems * Lead database migrations and rearchitecture projects across teams, from planning and risk assessment through cutover, with minimal disruption to customers * Scale our infrastructure and data processing pipelines to keep pace with growing data volumes and throughput * Build self\-service tools and automation that let engineers deploy, test and debug on their own * Maintain and improve staging and development environments, deployment automation and testing infrastructure * Improve observability across our systems, using AI\-assisted workflows to cut manual investigation and repetitive operational work * Respond to production incidents and lead post\-incident reviews that result in lasting fixes * Collaborate with Information Security, Product and the wider engineering team to keep our systems secure and flag feasibility and scalability risks early * Set and meet reliability and performance targets for the platform ### **Who you are:** * Experience leading a database migration or significant architectural change on a live production system * Deep, hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms in production, including performance tuning and query optimisation * A track record of scaling existing web applications and the infrastructure behind them, with a strong grounding in observability, monitoring and alerting * Comfort reading and writing production code, ideally in Ruby on Rails * Day\-to\-day use of AI tools such as Claude to build workflows and automation, not only as a search engine * Clear communication: you explain technical trade\-offs to engineers and non\-engineers, and write documentation others can follow * Experience with a major cloud platform like AWS or DigitalOcean; infrastructure as code (e.g. Ansible); Datadog or similar monitoring * *Nice to have:* High\-volume data or media pipelines; internal developer platforms or self\-service tooling; working within a formal information security programme ### **What success looks like** **In your first 90 days** * You know our production architecture, data layer and deployment pipeline well enough to make changes safely, and you have shipped improvements to production. * You have assessed our current database setup and agreed a plan with engineering leadership for the first major migration or rearchitecture, including risks, sequencing and rollback. * You have delivered at least one reliability or observability improvement that other teams notice, such as fixing a noisy alert or replacing a recurring manual request with a self\-service tool. **After one year** * You have led at least one major database migration or rearchitecture to completion without unplanned customer\-facing downtime. * Our systems handle higher data volumes and pipeline throughput, and reliability and performance are tracked against agreed targets. * Engineers across CreativeX use self\-service tooling you built to deploy, test or debug, and wait less on the platform team. At CreativeX, we encourage applicants of all backgrounds and identities to apply for roles that align with their own interests and career trajectory. If you fit the description above and see yourself in this role, we would love to see your application! ### **What we Offer:** Fully paid medical, dental, and vision (US) and Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan (UK) ✈️ Generous time off \+ bank holidays Education budget to be used for individual learning experiences or grouped with your team for joint learning Annual subscription to Calm and Headspace for your mental wellbeing Monthly coaching to talk to a trained professional about career goals, relationships, and personal development Competitive salary and commission plan including stock options, as we believe that everyone should have a stake in the business 4\-month full pay parenting leave for all employees who have been with the company for one (1\) year Employee contributions to a 401(k) once they have completed their eligibility period ***CreativeX provides equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees.*** As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, CreativeX conducts standard right to work and background checks on all potential employees. This process is designed to verify the accuracy of information provided by candidates and to ensure a safe environment for all employees. Background checks are conducted via a secure third party application and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Crisis Text Line, Engineering, Product, and Design work together to create a trusted, innovative, and deeply human\-centered Crisis Care Platform. Our technology supports millions of people in moments of need and enables global partners to deliver crisis support at scale. We’re looking for a mid\-level full\-stack software engineer to join our Conversational Application Team. This is a backend\-leaning role for an engineer who can independently deliver well\-defined work across the software development lifecycle—from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. You’ll contribute to APIs, data models, caching, background processing, and user\-facing or internal tools. Your work will help improve the resilience, stability, and scalability of systems used by people during some of their most vulnerable moments. ### **Role:** As a Mid\-Level Full\-Stack Software Engineer, you will design, build, test, deploy, and operate core platform features. After completing your initial onboarding and becoming familiar with our environments, you’ll be trusted to take ownership of assigned work with support available from technical leads, architects, and other members of the team. You’ll work primarily on backend systems while contributing across the stack as needed. This includes implementing approved technical designs, developing and maintaining APIs, working with relational databases and caching technologies, and supporting systems that use queues, schedulers, and other asynchronous processes. You’ll also help address technical debt, improve production reliability, and strengthen the tools and practices that allow us to deliver software safely. **Our Stack** You’ll work across a modern, cloud\-based environment, including: * **Backend:** PHP with Symfony, Golang, Node.js, services, and APIs * **Frontend:** React and Redux * **APIs:** REST and GraphQL * **Data:** MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis * **Cloud:** AWS * **Infrastructure as code:** Terraform * **Observability:** Datadog and Grafana * **Delivery:** Automated CI/CD pipelines and shared ownership of production reliability ### deliver scalable, secure solutions. * Champion security: Contribute to authentication, authorization, and platform security practices. * Build for scale: Improve service architecture, APIs, and system reliability as we grow globally. * Collaborate deeply: Partner with product, design, and engineering peers to deliver high\-impact solutions. * Raise engineering quality: Improve testing, CI/CD, observability, and developer workflows. * Support production: Participate in on\-call rotation to ensure platform reliability. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Approximately three to five years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful backend or full\-stack responsibilities. * Professional experience programming in at least one high\-level language. * Experience developing and maintaining production APIs. * Experience working with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Experience testing, debugging, and supporting production software. * Familiarity with cloud\-based environments such as AWS. * Experience working with automated CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. * The ability to independently complete well\-defined engineering work while asking questions and seeking Full alignment when needed. * The ability to explain technical analysis, decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly. * A collaborative approach to working with engineering and cross\-functional partners. * A commitment to building secure, reliable, and accessible technology for people with diverse needs and experiences. **Preferred Qualifications** The following experience would be useful, but we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every item: * PHP or the Symfony framework. * Golang or an interest in developing Golang proficiency. * Node.js, React, or Redux. * REST and GraphQL APIs. * Redis or another caching technology. * Queues, schedulers, background processing, or event\-driven systems. * AWS services and cloud\-based application architecture. * Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code tool. * Datadog, Grafana, or comparable telemetry and observability tools. * Improving CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, or release processes. * Designing for availability, performance, security, and observability. * Contributing to service\-oriented or API\-first architectures. * Participating in technical design reviews or architectural discussions. * Working in a mission\-driven, regulated, safety\-sensitive, or high\-trust environment. ***Reliable High\-Speed Internet Required:*** Must have a stable high\-speed internet connection to support seamless remote collaboration, virtual meetings, online job tasks, etc. The full salary range for this position, across all United States geographies, is $99,704 to $116,990\. The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for existing employees who demonstrate strong performance over time. Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience; during the interview process, candidates will learn the starting salary range applicable for their location. We pay competitively in the tech\-forward nonprofit space and offer a robust benefits package. This is a remote position within the United States. jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer, AI Security Systems (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Lab:** ------------------ AI is changing cyber offense and defense simultaneously. Adversaries use models to inspect code, hunt vulnerabilities, adapt tooling, and conduct longer operations. CrowdStrike built the Cybersecurity Superintelligence Lab to ensure defenders stay ahead. You may have worked on the endpoint, where every millisecond, megabyte, and CPU cycle matters, or at cloud scale, where systems reason over trillions of events and design decisions affect cost, latency, and efficacy across millions of protected assets. Ideally, you understand both. As one of the Lab’s most senior technical leaders, you will architect systems that turn frontier AI into autonomous, trustworthy cyber defense—from the sensor to the cloud. You will write code, design experiments, set technical direction across research and engineering teams, and carry breakthroughs into the Falcon platform. If you have shipped AI that stops adversaries in production and want to build what comes next, we want to talk. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- * Architect the Lab’s AI security systems end to end, including models, agents, security telemetry, tools, execution environments, on\-sensor inference, and cloud\-scale reasoning. * Bring frontier AI to the endpoint using distillation, quantization, compact and specialized models, and integration with kernel\- and user\-mode telemetry. * Build cloud\-scale streaming detection and inference systems across trillions of events per day, with GPU\-efficient serving, intelligent model routing, and disciplined control of cost, latency, and reliability. * Build autonomous defenders that investigate, hunt, write and validate detections, and drive response and remediation. * Create systems that learn from investigations, adversary emulation, simulations, expert feedback, reinforcement learning, post\-training, reward modeling, and synthetic data. * Engineer for adversarial conditions, including evasion, poisoning, prompt injection, tool abuse, sandboxed execution, and autonomous action in customer environments. * Establish benchmarks, cyber ranges, and evaluation harnesses measuring efficacy, false\-positive cost, reliability, latency, and spend. * Lead through technical depth by working on the hardest problems, mentoring principal\-level engineers and research scientists, and aligning cross\-functional teams. * Carry research into production in the Falcon platform, solving the scale, safety, and operability challenges required for customer\-grade capabilities. * Represent CrowdStrike through publications, open\-source work, standards, and collaboration with frontier AI labs, universities, and the security research community. **What You’ll Need:** --------------------- * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field; PhD preferred. * 15\+ years of industry experience in software engineering, machine learning, or security engineering; 12\+ years with a PhD. * 8\+ s:** ----------------- * Cybersecurity industry experience across endpoint, cloud, identity, SIEM, or threat intelligence. * Experience at a frontier AI lab in pre\-training, post\-training, reinforcement learning, inference, evaluation, or safety. * Experience with adversarial machine learning, AI red teaming, autonomous cyber reasoning systems, or AI\-driven offensive security. * Experience building extensible AI or agentic platforms that enable teams to safely develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy AI applications at scale. * Recognized technical contributions, including publications, patents, influential open\-source projects, or conference talks spanning AI and security. **Why Join the Lab:** --------------------- * Work on frontier technology with real\-world consequences, protecting organizations that keep economies, hospitals, and critical infrastructure running. * Access trillions of daily Falcon events, deep adversary intelligence, and high\-fidelity cyber environments. * Help define the technical culture, architecture, and standards of a new frontier lab. * Collaborate with AI researchers, offensive operators, threat hunters, and incident responders who understand how real attacks happen and how they are stopped. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-CS1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This is where David AI comes in. David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors. Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight\-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI. **About our Research team** --------------------------- Our Research team sits at the intersection of cutting\-edge research and production systems, transforming raw audio into high\-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. We own the full ML lifecycle \- from researching novel speech processing algorithms to deploying models processing terabytes of audio daily. **About this role** ------------------- As a **Research Engineer** at David AI, you'll build algorithms and systems that turn large\-scale speech and audio collections into high\-quality datasets. You'll tackle questions like: What makes a recording useful? jobs.title: Senior/Staff Applied AI Engineer, Agent Harness
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a pre\-seed AI startup in San Francisco building AI coworkers for IT teams: a security\-focused product where an agent registers as a governed identity in a customer's directory, requests scoped access per task, escalates for human approval, and drives systems it was never given an API for. ### **About the Role** This role builds the layer that turns model capability into systems that actually work for users. You'll develop the core agent harness (the execution loop, tool\-use strategies, context construction, and model\-facing experimentation) and iterate on agent behaviors across real customer workflows and long\-horizon tasks. A defining stance: the creative step happens once, at authoring, and what executes afterward is deterministic, compiled, type\-checked code rather than stochastic tool\-chaining. You'll own that boundary between what the model decides at runtime and what ships as code. You'll build and run evals against replicas of real customer environments rather than synthetic tasks, reliable enough to gate a release; analyze production failures and attribute them to the right layer (model, prompt, tool contract, environment state, or retry logic); and extend the computer\-use agent to systems with no API, owning the guarantees that let it run in production at all: a fresh microVM per task, credentials injected at session start and never seen by the model, every action recorded, and any session killable mid\-run. ### **What You'll Own** * The core agent harness: execution loop, tool\-use strategies, context construction, and model\-facing experimentation * Agent behaviors across real customer workflows and long\-horizon tasks * The boundary between runtime model decisions and deterministic, compiled, type\-checked execution * Evals against replicas of real customer environments, reliable enough to gate releases * Production failure analysis and systematic robustness improvements, attributed by layer * Extending computer\-use to API\-less systems, with production guarantees (per\-task microVM, model\-blind credentials, full action recording, killable sessions) * Feedback loops and data systems that get better real\-task data into eval and training ### **Requirements** **Must\-Have** * 4\+ years of engineering experience * Experience with agent frameworks or tool\-using LLM systems * Strong in Python or TypeScript, comfortable with modern AI tooling * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, or prompt design * Can own systems end\-to\-end and debug across the stack * Thinks in terms of systems and user outcomes, not just model metrics * Enjoys debugging messy, real\-world failures and turning them into improvements * Wants to work in the layer that turns model capability into systems that work for users * Able to work in person in San Francisco, Monday to Friday, at startup intensity **Strong candidates may also** * Have built computer\-use or browser\-automation agents * Have experience with virtualization and sandboxed execution environments, and scaling them * Have done AI research and published at top conferences * Have shipped something where correctness had to survive partial failure (idempotency, resumability, compensating actions) * Have integrated enterprise SaaS APIs (identity providers, directory services, ticketing, ERPs) * Have experience with large, messy datasets or production logs * Have been an early engineer somewhere they also had to talk to customers ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person, Monday to Friday) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Level:** Senior / Staff * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $300,000 USD per year * **Visa Sponsorship:** Available (H\-1B, O\-1, OPT) ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Meals in office * Health insurance * Unlimited PTO ### **Interview Process** * Culture screen * Second culture screen * Technical interview * One\-day onsite * Offer

jobs.description: **OUR COMPANY:** EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees. We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency. **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** As a Senior Data Engineer, you will lead data engineering initiatives and build end\-to\-end scalable, stable, and secure analytical solutions. You are passionate about working with huge datasets and have experience with the organization and curation of data for analytics. You have a strategic and long term view on architecting advanced data eco systems. You are experienced in building efficient and scalable data services and have the ability to integrate data systems. In this assignment you will support the RL Data Engineering team (Burlingame, CA \+ vendor office as applicable), backfilling production ownership of demo, yield/funnel, and asset\-tracking pipelines — onboarding new datasets, keeping recurring batch jobs and dashboards healthy, and making onboarding repeatable through documentation and automation. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, implement and operate large\-scale, centralized high\-volume, high\-performance data structures for analytics and data science. * Implement data ingestion routines both real time and batch using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes. * Work with Project Manager to understand business and functional requirements and translate these requirements into robust, scalable, operable solutions with a flexible and adaptable data architecture. * Assist SWE team with identifying in code key events and data to be logged to populate the data structures used for dashboarding. * Help continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self\-service modeling and production support for customers. * Onboard new datasets end to end: requirements, access provisioning, packaging and CI/CD configuration, partition/snapshot validation, go\-live checks. * Own recurring batch jobs — monitoring, triage, test plans, and partition recovery — including backfills via notebooks and SQL. * Build and maintain flow/funnel, quality\-check, and operations\-health dashboards in the team's BI platform; maintain internal web tools (bug fixes, duplicate\-record cleanup, prod/test tagging). * Author and maintain runbooks, end\-to\-end documentation, release notes, and user guides; keep them current with a scheduled audit cadence. **ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:** * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field or 7\+ years industry experience. * Demonstrated strength in data modelling, ETL development, and data warehousing experience with Oracle, Redshift, PostgreSQL, etc. * Advanced SQL and query performance tuning skills. * Experience building data products incrementally and integrating and managing data sets from multiple sources. * Coding proficiency in Python programming language. * Experience with scheduled batch orchestration (e.g. Airflow or equivalent) and partitioned lake/warehouse tables. * Experience with CI/CD, version control, and task tracking; ability to own production issues and write clear runbooks. * Experience building operational dashboards and reporting on delivery KPIs (freshness, completeness, on\-time delivery, accuracy). * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; self\-motivated in an autonomous, fast\-paced environment. * Ability to work on\-site in Burlingame, CA per assignment **DESIRABLE CRITERIA:** * Hardware / field data collection, demographic data, or yield/funnel analytics. * Flow/funnel visualizations, asset\-tracking DAGs, or lineage tooling. * Internal tooling, form builders, or AI\-assistant guides for onboarding automation. * Capture\-management systems, search APIs, or permission models. *The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.* *EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.* \#INDNAMER

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer - Manager
jobs.description: Location: New York Other locations: Anywhere in Country Salary: Competitive Date: Oct 21, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- Requisition ID: 1754575 Location: Anywhere in Country At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. **The opportunity** Build AI agents that carry meaningful work from intent to a verified outcome, not merely produce an impressive response. You will engineer the execution loops, tools, context, permissions, evaluations, and runtime controls that let agents operate across complex workflows while remaining understandable, steerable, and safe when systems or assumptions fail. This role sits where applied AI, distributed systems, and product engineering meet. You will work on long\-running behavior, real enterprise integrations, and difficult production failures, deciding when a deterministic workflow is enough, when autonomy adds value, and whether each added degree of freedom earns its operational and user\-experience cost. **About Challenger** Challenger is a new EY program focused on building the firm’s next generation of services. It pursues opportunities where AI enables a fundamentally different service and way of delivering it, including rethinking existing offerings and developing new ones. Small, dedicated teams build and test ideas in real conditions. Solutions that demonstrate clear business value and operational readiness transition to the business for adoption and scale. Challenger Core develops and maintains the shared technology, methods, and risk and quality guardrails that support this work. Each team contributes reusable tools and practices, helping make the next service faster and less costly to build. **Your key responsibilities** * **Choose the right execution model.** Design agent architectures that use deterministic steps, a single\-agent loop, or coordinated agents only when measured performance justifies the complexity. * **Build dependable tools.** Create connectors and interfaces with clear contracts, validated outcomes, narrow authorization, and errors that help the agent recover or escalate. * **Engineer agent behavior.** Shape planning, routing, delegation, stopping, retry, and handoff behavior across complete workflows. * **Create durable context.** Combine instructions, user state, retrieval, memory, and environment feedback while preserving relevance, provenance, freshness, and permitted access. * **Bound agent authority.** Implement scoped identities, credentials, budgets, approval points, and emergency containment so agents act within explicit limits. * **Evaluate complete trajectories.** Build representative tests that measure verified task success, tool use, recovery, human takeover, and prohibited actions rather than isolated responses. * **Operate long\-running execution.** Use durable state, checkpointing, safe retries, versioned releases, rollback, and graceful degradation to keep work recoverable. * **Make behavior observable.** Instrument end\-to\-end traces and replay so teams can understand failures, diagnose patterns, and turn production evidence into improvements. * **Protect user control.** Design clear intervention points so people can inspect, interrupt, redirect, and safely resume agent work. * **Build shared capability.** Partner across product, platform, knowledge, security, and evaluation teams and publish reusable agent patterns and operational lessons. **Skills and attributes for success** * **Production engineering:** Strong software engineering and distributed\-systems judgment, with practical experience building services that remain dependable under failure. * **Agent architecture:** Ability to reason about planning, tools, state, handoffs, and coordination while choosing a simpler workflow when it performs better. * **AI application depth:** Practical knowledge of model APIs, structured outputs, context, retrieval, memory, experimentation, and tool use. * **Evaluation discipline:** Experience measuring complete trajectories and verified outcomes for systems whose behavior is variable. * **Security and operability:** Strong instincts for least privilege, tool boundaries, observability, resilience, recovery, and accountable human intervention. * **Product judgment:** Ability to balance quality, latency, cost, and user control and explain technical trade\-offs clearly across disciplines. **To qualify you must have** * Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field of study. * **Relevant experience:** 7\-9 years of experience in software or applied machine\-learning engineering, with ownership of production systems and their live behavior. * **Agent delivery:** Hands\-on evidence of shipping large\-language\-model applications, agents, or complex model\-driven workflows used for real work. * **Programming depth:** Strong capability in Python, TypeSc ontrol. * **Ecosystem contribution:** Practical contributions to agent, evaluation, developer tooling, applied AI, or open\-source communities We welcome exceptional candidates from product, service design, operations, transformation, policy, domain, and entrepreneurial backgrounds; no particular degree or certification is required. **What we offer you** At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers. * We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is: * + New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $150,700 to $251,200 + Bay Area California offices – $157,100 to $261,600 + All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $125,500 to $230,200 * Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. * Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being. **Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.** * To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period. * EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis. * For those living in California, please click here for additional information. * At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment. **EY \| Building a better working world** EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. All in to shape the future with confidence. EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities.
