jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join EarthOptics as a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)! At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting\-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost\-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have \~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world *see soil differently.* Our **Senior Software Engineer** will join our **Software Engineering** team to impact our mission through individual contributor responsibilities to design, build and maintain the technology that powers EarthOptics’ products and operations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role requiring strong full\-stack engineering capabilities, experience with modern cloud infrastructure, and the ability to independently own complex software systems. You'll work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure while helping shape technical decisions and improve engineering practices. **The digs:** * **Job Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime) * **Work Location:** This remote position is open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who reside in the contiguous 48 states, with a preference for those who can consistently align their working hours with US Central Time. * **Travel:** 5% of the time * **Target Start Date:** December 2026 * **Application Deadline:** Applications will be accepted through November 30, 2026\. * **Compensation:** $125,000 to $165,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below). + - This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job\-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay. **What you’ll cultivate as a** **Senior Software Engineer****:** *(Your responsibilities)* * Own the end\-to\-end design, development, deployment, and maintenance of full\-stack applications, spanning user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations. * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable cloud\-based systems, including infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability, security, and production operations. * Take technical ownership of existing applications and services, developing a deep understanding of their architecture, identifying risks, addressing technical debt, and improving long\-term maintainability. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through architectural decisions, code reviews, mentorship, and close collaboration with Product and other engineering teams. * Evaluate, develop, and integrate AI\-powered solutions across engineering workflows, internal applications, and customer\-facing products, identifying opportunities to improve productivity and deliver new capabilities while maintaining strong standards for security, correctness, and maintainability. * Collaborate directly with internal stakeholders and external customers to understand their needs, translate requirements into effective technical solutions, and support the successful delivery and adoption of software capabilities. **What you can expect to accomplish within your first 60\-120 days** * **System Ownership \& Knowledge Transfer:** Develop a strong understanding of EarthOptics' applications, architecture, and cloud infrastructure. Successfully transition ownership of critical systems and identify key technical risks. * **Full\-Stack Feature Delivery:** Independently design, implement, and deploy a meaningful full\-stack feature or enhancement, demonstrating proficiency across frontend, backend, and cloud services. * **Technical Debt \& Reliability:** Identify and begin addressing high\-priority technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, with actionable recommendations for improving system maintainability. * **AI\-Assisted Engineering:** Evaluate AI development tools, demonstrate practical applications, and recommend approaches that improve engineering productivity without compromising quality. **Are you our soil\-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:** *(Your qualifications)* * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and maintaining production software. * Strong full\-stack engineering experience, including mode g, and maintaining applications using modern cloud infrastructure, including cloud\-native architecture, deployment automation, and production operations. * Proficiency with modern frontend and backend programming languages, with the ability to quickly learn and contribute to new technologies. * Experience designing and working with relational databases, SQL, REST APIs, and common application integration patterns. * Practical experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools, containerization, and modern deployment technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent solutions. * Strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability, secure software development, debugging, and production incident response. * Experience making architectural decisions, independently owning complex systems, and helping other engineers improve through technical guidance and mentorship. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software development tools and the ability to use them effectively while critically evaluating generated code for accuracy, security, and maintainability. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering, product, and other business functions. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. *\*\*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.* **Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:** * Production experience with **Python and TypeScript**, ideally including frameworks such as FastAPI, React, or similar technologies. * Experience developing geospatial or data\-intensive applications, including GIS, spatial databases such as PostGIS, mapping technologies, or large\-scale scientific data pipelines. * Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities, large language models, or agentic workflows into production software applications. * Experience thriving in a small, fast\-moving engineering team where individuals take broad ownership, adapt to changing priorities, and work closely with stakeholders to solve technical and business challenges. **Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:** * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance \- 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit\-eligible employees and 55% for dependents * Company\-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance * Meaningful equity option grants * 401k Plan \+ Employer Match up to 4% * Tenured PTO Accrual Policy starting with 17 days of paid time off per year, * 11 Paid Company Holidays **Equal Opportunity and Inclusion at EarthOptics:** EarthOptics is an equal opportunity employer, and we stand against any form of discrimination or harassment. We base all hiring and promotion decisions on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or family status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are deeply committed to welcoming and including every qualified individual. jobs.title: Principal AI Architect
jobs.description: **Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting opportunity open for a **Principal AI Architect.** **Job Summary** The Principal AI Architect is a hands\-on individual contributor who owns the AI technical function at ElevatePFS, including the technical vision, the architecture, and the quality and cost of the solutions the company builds with AI. The role serves as the company's deepest AI technical authority and reports to the VP, AI \& Automation. ElevatePFS is building its AI, automation, and intelligence capabilities in\-house on a centralized Databricks data platform. Business and product leaders define the problems worth solving. The Principal AI Architect determines whether AI is the right tool for each problem and, if so, designs the solution, builds it, and runs it in production. Training foundation models from scratch is the only work outside the scope of the role. The position is expected to grow into Head of AI Engineering as the team develops. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Set the technical vision and roadmap for AI with the VP, AI \& Automation, giving leadership a clear view of feasibility, value, cost, and risk. * Partner with the Product delivery team to turn workflow problems and improvement opportunities identified in the field into scoped, feasible AI and application opportunities. * Decide which parts of each solution should be deterministic (rules, parsers, schema validation, SQL, classical ML) and which should be dynamic (LLM reasoning, agentic tool use), using LLMs where inputs are ambiguous and plain code elsewhere. * Recommend build versus buy and closed versus open models for each solution, and track new models and tooling. * Design single\-agent and multi\-agent systems, including routing, planner/executor patterns, tool calling and MCP, state and memory, durable execution, retries, idempotency, human approval gates, and tool permission scoping. * Define with Product what the application needs to support AI in daily use, such as changed screens, wizards, intelligent interfaces, and approval steps. * Build and tune retrieval\-augmented generation end to end, including parsing, chunking, embedding selection and fine\-tuning, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, vector search with Delta index sync, and grounded citations. * Build knowledge graphs and ontology\-driven retrieval, including entity resolution and GraphRAG\-style hybrids, in partnership with the Data organization. * Develop document intelligence for contracts, payment files, and correspondence, including OCR, layout\-aware parsing, table and field extraction, and multimodal models. * Design the Databricks data layout that AI depends on, including medallion architecture, Delta table design, liquid clustering, Change Data Feed, Unity Catalog governance and lineage, and feature and serving tables. * Select models by task, accuracy, latency, cost, and data\-handling constraints, fine\-tune where it pays off (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference tuning), and distill into smaller, lower\-cost models. * Deploy and serve models on Databricks Model Serving and self\-hosted inference such as vLLM, and manage the lifecycle in MLflow, including tracking, tracing, registry, release management, and CI/CD for models, prompts, and agents with shadow, canary, and A/B rollouts. * Build evaluation and monitoring tied to business outcomes, including golden datasets, field\-level precision, recall, and F1, retrieval metrics, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge calibrated to human labels, release\-gating regression suites, and production drift and agent\-trace monitoring. * Own token and compute spend through routing and cascading, prompt and semantic caching, context compression, batch inference, smaller models, an AI gateway, and cost attribution per agent and workflow. * Measure ROI and adoption for every AI initiative and recommend whether to scale, rework, or retire it. * Defend against prompt injection, tool\-based data exfiltration, and over\-permissioned agents through least privilege, guardrails, PII/PHI redaction, and full audit logging. * Work with the AI Center of Excellence, Information Security, Compliance, and Legal on model approval and data\-handling standards, including standards for PHI. * Lead the technical build from design through production, write the specs, patterns, and standards for everyone building AI at ElevatePFS, and review code, prompts, and evaluations from employees, contractors, and vendors. * Hand off completed designs to the Product delivery team, who own implementation and adoption, and provide the specs and guidance they need. * Keep the intelligence the company builds documented, understood, and owned internally. * Mentor engineers, help recruit the AI engineering team that forms around the role, and explain technical tradeoffs clearly to executives. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications and Requirements** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities. * 10\+ years of experience in software, data, or ML engineering, including 7\+ years in machine learning with increasing scope. * Strong current Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build, test, and debug AI systems personally. * Production experience with LLM agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, closed and open\-weight models, fine\-tuning, and model deployment. * Record of proving ROI, controlling AI cost, and choosing well between deterministic and LLM\-driven design. * Experience securing AI systems in regulated or sensitive\-data environments. * Record of setting technical direction that others executed, including across employees, contractors, and vendors. * Preferred: Healthcare, healthcare IT, or revenue cycle management background, including HIPAA and PHI\-compliant AI deployment. * Preferred: Knowledge graph or ontology experience, and document intelligence or claims and contract extraction experience. * Preferred: Deep Databricks and MLflow experience, including Delta, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, and Vector Search. * Preferred: Azure, event\-driven architecture, and workflow automation or RPA experience. * Preferred: Experience standing up an AI Center of Excellence or internal AI platform. **Benefits** ElevatePFS believes in making a positive impact not only within our industry but also with our employees – the organization’s greatest asset! We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that contribute to the present and future well\-being of our employees and their families. * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance * 401K (100% match for the first 3% \& 50% match for the next 2%) * 15 days of PTO * 7 paid Holidays * 2 Floating holidays * 1 Elevate Day (floating holiday) * Pet Insurance * Employee referral bonus program * Teamwork: We believe in teamwork and having fun together * Career Growth: Gain great experience to promote to higher roles The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and Employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change. **ElevatePFS is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

The brand\-new facility also known as Lilly Medicine Foundry will utilize the latest technology to augment the current clinical supply chain for small molecules (SM), oligonucleotides, peptides, and Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADCs), monoclonal antibodies and bioconjugates, and add new capabilities including mRNA. The new site will be built using the latest high\-tech equipment, advanced highly integrated and automated manufacturing systems, and have a focus on minimizing the impact to our environment. What You'll Be Doing As a Data Engineer based at the Lilly Medicine Foundry, you will design and build data pipelines for the site's many systems. Working closely with the Data Architect and Data Scientists, you'll engage directly with business and operational collaborators to understand how data flows across the Foundry — from lab systems, process engineering, and manufacturing execution to quality and process analytics — and translate that understanding into reliable, scalable data products. Your core focus will be integrating IT and OT source systems with cloud data Lakehouse architecture spanning AWS and Azure, enabling the advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities that will define how the Foundry operates. This includes the full data value chain: capture, ingestion, integration, contextualization, harmonization, and delivery as reusable data domains and data\-as\-a\-product. You will work across enterprise and edge systems, navigate a diverse technology landscape, and ensure that everything you build meets the data integrity and compliance standards required in a GMP\-regulated manufacturing environment. How You'll Succeed * Build and deliver high\-quality data solutions.: You design and develop robust data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and integration across cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), applying modern patterns such as medallion architecture, streaming ingestion, and API\-based extraction. You write clean, maintainable code, optimize for performance, and think carefully about how data flows from source systems into trustworthy, analytics\-ready products. * Ensure compliance: You understand the data integrity requirements of a GxP manufacturing environment and apply Quality guidelines and Good Manufacturing Practices from the start. You participate in design reviews, maintain traceability, and contribute to governance frameworks that keep the Foundry consistently compliant. * Translate business needs into technical outcomes. You engage proactively with stakeholders across multiple modalities and business teams including Operations, Quality, Lab, and Engineering to understand their data needs. You're comfortable eliciting requirements, identifying gaps, and translating operational realities into sound technical designs — and explaining your architectural decisions back to a non\-technical audience. * Navigate a diverse enterprise landscape: The Foundry operates within a broader Lilly ecosystem of enterprise systems including ERP, ELN, MES, LIMS, Historians, PLM, and QMS platforms. You invest time in understanding upstream and downstream dependencies, seek opportunities to reuse existing services and integrations, and build with the broader data architecture in mind. * Continuous learning: You track emerging tools and technologies across the AWS and Azure data ecosystems, bring informed perspectives on what's worth adopting, and actively contribute to the team's collective capability. * Bring a foundational set of knowledge in: communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving skills, solution definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g. blueprinting, reference architecture, governance, etc.), technical standards, project delivery, and industry knowledge. * Staying abreast of tools and technologies to influence Technology at Lilly strategy so that it provides best usage opport  and formal database designs (3NF, Dimensional Models). * Experience with Agile Development, CI/CD, Github, Automation platforms. * Demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex data domains and craft practical solutions for subsequent data exploitation via analytics. * Ability to review and provide practical recommendations on design patterns, performance considerations \& optimization, database versions, and database deployment strategies. * Knowledgeable in data functions such as Data Governance, Master Data Management, Business Intelligence. * Prior work experience working in pharma or other GMP setting. * Solid knowledge of Computer System Validation process. * Demonstrated ability to analyze, anticipate, and resolve complex issues through sound problem\-solving skills. * Demonstrated learning agility and curiosity. * Desire and ability to communicate using a variety of methods in diverse forums. **Other Information:** * This position is onsite in Lebanon, IN beginning late 2027\-2028\. Until then the work location is Indianapolis, IN. **About the Organization:** Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business. Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace\-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response. Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ\+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL). Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is $129,000 \- $231,000 Full\-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). jobs.title: Associate AI Deployment Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **Job Summary** =============== The Associate AI Deployment Manager executes scoped work inside client AI engagements, helping turn discovery into useful product delivery or client adoption. We’re interested in candidates with depth in either of two areas: Build, helping organize product definition and delivery with engineering teams; or Enablement, helping client teams learn and apply AI through training, workshops, and workflow development. You’ll work with an AI Deployment Manager or other workstream owner who sets direction and priorities. You’ll own assigned tasks and delivery artifacts, keep progress visible, and raise questions and blockers early. You are not expected to arrive with expertise in both Build and Enablement; you’ll have opportunities to learn across the full AI Deployment craft. Eliza is AI\-native: you will use AI tools across discovery, requirements, workshop preparation, workflow building, and client communication, and explain where they help and where they fall short. Client work moves quickly and can change as new information emerges; we value sound judgment, clear communication, and reliable follow\-through. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. Turn discovery into clear plans and artifacts** ----------------------------------------------------- * Participate in stakeholder and user discovery; document workflows, needs, constraints, and desired outcomes. * Translate conversation and research into clear requirements, user stories, workshop plans, decision logs, product roadmaps, and next steps for the workstream owner. * Maintain current use\-case and action trackers so priorities, dependencies, and open questions stay visible. **2\. Build: keep product and delivery work moving** ---------------------------------------------------- * Maintain backlogs, requirements, roadmaps, and delivery artifacts as client needs and priorities change. * Coordinate practical dependencies with client partners, designers, and engineers, such as data, access, calendars, and decisions. * Run test sets or evaluation steps when needed; log failure modes and summarize evidence for review. **3\. Enablement: prepare and deliver practical learning** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Prepare and help facilitate trainings, persona\-specific workshops, and office hours for client teams. * Build and refine exercises, prompts, skills, and workflows with client champions; document how to use them, known limitations, and review needs. * Gather participant feedback and update learning materials and follow\-up actions based on what users need. **4\. Make progress and outcomes visible** ------------------------------------------ * Track delivery progress and adoption signals such as usage, realized business outcomes, and time savings; distinguish measured results from early indications. * Prepare concise client readouts on progress, decisions, risks, and next steps. * Keep notes, action items, workshop materials, and assigned engagement artifacts current. **5\. Work well across the delivery team** ------------------------------------------ * Coordinate with client stakeholders and Eliza delivery partners to keep assigned work on track. * Raise blockers, feasibility concerns, and risks early so the workstream owner can respond. * Use feedback and evidence to improve the work and contribute reusable delivery or learning assets. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ You should bring meaningful experience in at least one of the following areas. Experience across both is welcome but not required. **Build background** -------------------- * Experience in product, consulting, technical program management, customer success, or a related setting, with examples of turning conversations into requirements, plans, or delivery artifacts. * Strong organization and follow\-through across tasks, backlogs, dependencies, testing, or client workstreams. **Enablement background** ------------------------- * Experience in client\-facing delivery, training, facilitation, learning and development, adoption, or a related setting. * Ability to prepare clear learning materials, explain AI in practical terms, and help users apply new tools in their workflows. **Shared strengths** -------------------- * Strong AI fluency: practical use of current AI tools and a working understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and safeguards. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work with business stakeholders and technical teams without jargon or overselling. * Human\-centered design mindset: translate user needs into intuitive AI experiences, apply sound UX judgment, and use research and testing to refine solutions. * Sound organization, reliable follow\-through, comfort with changing needs, and a habit of asking sharp questions and escalating early. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience across both Build and Enablement. * Hands\-on experience with prompts, skills, or lightweight automations; or experience designing training content or facilitating workshops. * Exposure to enterprise software delivery, including requirements, backlogs, sprints, QA, or evaluation work. **How we’ll know it’s working** =============================== * Competitive compensation (base salary \+ performance incentives tied to client outcomes). * Equity options in a growing AI services company. * Exposure to a wide range of industries and high\-impact AI problems. * Travel opportunities for on\-site client engagements (if desired). * Deliver inside real client engagements and build the full AI Deployment craft through hands\-on work. * Work with client teams on practical AI products, workflows, and adoption. * Partner with AI Deployment Managers, engineers, client champions, and leaders. * Contribute to reusable playbooks, workshop materials, and delivery assets.

jobs.title: AI Innovation Engineer

This person enhances efficiency, improves quality, and drives competitive advantage in a manufacturing environment. The AI Innovation Engineer monitors emerging trends, supports pilot projects, and collaborates with cross\-functional partners to drive digital transformation across the business. Successful candidates blend creativity with technical rigor and able to experiment rapidly while ensuring solutions can scale within enterprise IT standards. This position is located in New Castle PA. Essential Functions and Responsibilities * Research, evaluate and analyze emerging technology trends and manufacturing methods to identify opportunities for innovation in IT and across the organization that drives improved productivity, cost reduction and/or enhanced product quality. * Evaluate the potential of new tools, methodologies, and practices to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes. * Lead innovation projects from concept to implementation. * Collaborate with engineering, production, quality, and finance teams to identify process inefficiencies and develop innovative solutions. * Support digital transformation initiatives such as automation, robotics, IoT integration, and data\-driven manufacturing. * Collaborate with cross\-functional department to generate and manage pipeline of innovation ideas. * Scout vendors and recommend buy\-vs\-build paths. * Develop and maintain documentation for innovation projects, prototypes, and intellectual property considerations. * Build and maintain an IT innovation roadmap. * Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business challenges and propose technology\-driven solutions. * Facilitate brainstorming sessions, workshops, and innovation labs to promote a culture of innovation. * Collect and analyze data to measure the effectiveness of new technologies and solutions. • Map current processes, baseline KPIs * Support the planning, execution, and evaluation of pilot projects, proof\-of\-concepts, and innovation initiatives. * Work closely with development, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure feasibility, compliance, and scalability of solutions. * Prepare presentations, reports, and business cases to communicate findings and recommendations to leadership. * Assist in change management and communication efforts to ensure adoption of new technologies. * Maintain confidentiality and adhere to company compliance and IT security standards. * Other duties as assigned. ***Education and Experience*** * + Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). ***Core Competencies*** * Strong understanding of IT systems, digital tools, and project lifecycles. * Exposure to data analysis, automation tools, or continuous improvement concepts is a plus. * Familiarity with governance, privacy and security practices * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills. * Ability to critically evaluate technical designs, vendor proposals, and solution architectures to identify risks, gaps, feasibility issues, and unrealistic assumptions. * Ability to translate business needs into clear technical concepts, high\-level requirements, or prototype workflows. * Comfort digging into technical details, diagnosing issues across applications, integrations, data flows, and automation platforms, and proposing pragmatic solutions. * Strong analytical thinking with the ability to evaluate ROI, scalability, long\-term maintainability, and operational impact of new technologies. ***Preferred Technical Skills*** * Experience with AI/ML platforms * Exposure to modern programming/scripting such as Python, C\#/.NET, SQL, or similar for automation and integrations. * Familiar with Azure services and Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse). * Knowledge of AI agent frameworks. * Understanding of REST APIs, JSON structures * Experience with OCR, Intelligent Document Processing, or AI\-assisted workflow automation Job Requirement * Willingness to travel occasionally to manufacturing sites to provide on\-site support. (10%) Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **LiveX AI · AI Engineer (Machine Learning Engineer)** Palo Alto, CA · Full\-time, on\-site · Department: Engineering Source: https://livex.ai/careers/ai\-engineer (posted May 27, 2026\) ### **About the Role** LiveX AI is building realtime, interactive AI avatars: digital humans that see, listen, and respond with natural speech and expressive motion. This engineer trains, fine\-tunes, and serves the generative models behind these avatars across the full model lifecycle, from data curation and training diffusion, video, and multimodal models to low\-latency inference for live streaming. ### **Responsibilities** * Train and fine\-tune generative models for talking\-head synthesis, audio\-driven facial animation, and full\-body avatar video (diffusion models, DiT, 3D Gaussian Splatting, GAN\-based, transformer\-based video generators). * Design data pipelines for large\-scale video, audio, and multimodal datasets: collection, cleaning, labeling, alignment, augmentation. * Optimize models for realtime serving with sub\-200ms end\-to\-end latency: distillation, quantization, pruning, caching, streaming inference, custom CUDA/Triton kernels where needed. * Build and maintain training, evaluation, and deployment infrastructure on GPU clusters (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray, Kubernetes). * Define and track quality metrics (lip\-sync accuracy, identity preservation, expression naturalness, latency, throughput) and drive measurable gains. * Work with backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar features and iterate on user feedback. * Keep up with research in generative video, multimodal AI, and neural rendering; bring useful techniques into the stack. ### **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering, or strong research experience with production\-quality code, with a record of shipping deep learning models. * Deep expertise in PyTorch and modern DL workflows; able to read, reproduce, and extend research papers. * Strong background in one or more of: diffusion models, video generation, generative AI, computer vision, multimodal (audio\+vision) AI, speech synthesis, neural rendering. * Solid Python engineering; distributed training on multi\-GPU / multi\-node setups. * Proven realtime inference optimization: TensorRT, ONNX, Triton Inference Server, CUDA, mixed precision, streaming pipelines. * Comfortable in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments; proactive, ownership\-driven. * Fast\-learning startup mentality; eager to push what interactive avatars can do. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Talking\-head, audio\-driven animation, lip\-sync, or digital human systems; 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, face reenactment, avatar synthesis. * Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, ICLR, ICML) or notable open\-source contributions. ### **Compensation** Competitive salary, equity, and benefits; jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: **LiveX AI · Project Manager** Palo Alto, CA · Full\-time, on\-site · Department: Operations / Deployments · Reports to: founding team Source: https://livex.ai/careers/project\-manager (posted Jul 24, 2026\) ### **About the Role** LiveX AI builds AI infrastructure for the physical world, deploying interactive AI agents and hardware into high\-foot\-traffic venues such as hotels, retail flagships, convention centers, and stadiums. Each deployment is custom and requires sales, solution engineering, warehouse readiness, and a third\-party delivery partner to stay in sync. This role owns each deployment end to end and works daily with sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics. ### **Responsibilities** **End\-to\-End Deployment Ownership** * Single accountable owner for each deployment, from signed contract to a live, working installation at the customer site. * Run the deployment schedule: define milestones, sequence dependencies, track status, surface risks and blockers early. * Internal hub across sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics so nothing falls between teams. **Scope \& Solution Engineering** * Drive a clear, complete SOW from sales and sales engineering before each deployment starts; push back when scope is ambiguous. * Track solution engineers through implementation against the SOW, keeping configuration and readiness on schedule. * Translate customer requirements and site constraints into a concrete deployment plan. **Logistics \& Warehouse Coordination** * Coordinate with the office/logistics owner and the third\-party delivery partner on delivery windows, pickup, and destination readiness. * Confirm warehouse readiness before each deployment: items staged, configured, health\-checked before shipping. * Manage installation scheduling and any returns or de\-installations. **Customer \& Communication** * Customer\-facing point of contact during rollout: set expectations, communicate timelines, manage change requests. * Run deployment kickoffs and post\-deployment reviews; capture lessons; feed improvements into the playbook. * Report deployment status and the pipeline of upcoming installs to the founding team. **Process \& Systems** * Build and maintain the deployment playbook, checklists, and tracking so the process is repeatable and scalable. * Own the tooling that tracks deployment status, asset location, and readiness across the fleet. ### **Requirements** * Hungry, startup mindset above all: thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, takes extreme ownership, does what it takes to make each install land. * 3\+ years in project management, implementation/deployment management, technical program management, or field\-services coordination, ideally at a startup, hardware, or solutions company. * Proven ability to run multi\-stakeholder projects on a schedule and hold others accountable without direct authority. * Comfortable reading and reasoning about a technical scope of work; talks credibly with solution engineers. * Strong coordination and communication across internal teams, external partners, and customers. * Highly organized and self\-directed; builds process from scratch. * Calm under pressure; biased toward closing gaps and driving at\-risk deployments to resolution. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience deploying hardware or physical installations into venues or field sites. * Familiarity with project/deployment tracking tools and a CRM (e.g., HubSpot). * Background in logistics, shipping, or warehouse operations. * PMP or similar credential (not required). ### **Compensation** Not listed. ### **How to Apply (original posting)** Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application \- Project Manager".

jobs.description: **LiveX AI · Senior Product Manager** Palo Alto, CA · Full\-time, in\-person · Department: Product · Reports to: CEO Source: https://livex.ai/careers/senior\-product\-manager (posted Oct 17, 2026\) ### **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI builds human\-AI interfaces for physical spaces (stores, hotels, hospitals, airports, stadiums). Its 4K full\-body AI agents speak 140 languages, show products in 3D, and run on\-prem or in the cloud. Developed with NVIDIA on the AI City initiative; live with Walmart, PUMA, and the NFL Super Bowl. LiveX builds every layer in\-house (IP design, hardware, interaction, enterprise AI agent, deployment) with two form factors: Gateway (freestanding, life\-size) and Portal (wall\-mounted, shelf edge). Early\-stage startup in Palo Alto. ### **About the Role** Own the end\-to\-end customer experience across LiveX's hardware and software, from a passerby noticing a device to the customer leaving with their question answered. Set quality standards, find gaps between what ships and what should ship, prioritize fixes, and drive design and engineering to polished launches. The product is already live with customers; the job is to improve it and make each launch succeed. Works directly with the CEO (who owns product) and the founders leading AI and engineering. ### **Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end experience across hardware (screen, camera, microphones, speakers, mounting, installation) and software (character, conversation, touch/voice interface, 3D content, enterprise AI agent, admin portal) as one product. * Set experience quality standards for each journey step (approach, greeting, conversation, product display, handoff, error recovery) with measurable targets: response latency, recognition accuracy, conversation completion, uptime, time to install. * Identify gaps by visiting live deployments, running walk\-up tests, reviewing conversation logs and customer feedback, auditing new builds; maintain a ranked list of what is broken, rough, or missing. * Prioritize fixes: build a sequenced roadmap and decide between fixes, polish, and new features, backed by field evidence. * Drive design and engineering to delivery: write specs and acceptance criteria, run the product review cadence, remove blockers, hold the team to a high bar. * Drive launch readiness for every release and customer go\-live: readiness checklists, go/no\-go decisions, on\-site or remote acceptance, day\-one monitoring, fast post\-launch fixes. No release reaches a customer floor without your sign\-off. * Close the loop with customers: work with sales, deployment, and customer success to turn field issues into product fixes and fixes into customer updates. * Represent the user across all five layers of the stack. ### **Requirements** * 4–8 years of product management experience, including several years on hardware\-plus\-software products (devices, kiosks, robotics, consumer electronics, in\-venue technology). * Early\-stage startup experience (seed to Series B, under \~50 people), owning a product end to end without a product team behind you. * Track record of taking products from working to polished, where quality rather than scope was the deliverable. * Product judgment for walk\-up physical experiences using touch, voice, and large screens in public spaces. * Experience with AI or conversational products and a clear method for measuring quality in probabilistic systems. * Writes clear specs, acceptance criteria, and readiness checklists; works from logs, metrics, and dashboards. * Field orientation: has personally run site acceptance in stores, lobbies, or stadiums. * Credibility with engineers and designers: technical enough to debate tradeoffs, design\-literate enough to judge finished work. * Required: hands\-on use of AI tools in your own work (analysis, prototyping, writing). * Required: proactive — spots gaps before others report them, proposes fixes, drives them forward unasked. * Ownership and a clear point of view on what the product should be. * Able to work on\-site in Palo Alto; lives in or will relocate to the SF Bay Area. *Product judgment and a high quality bar are the most important hiring criteria.* ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * **Strongly preferred:** launch or quality ownership for a hardware\-plus\-software product deployed at scale in retail, hospitality, healthcare, or venues, especially across many sites. * Digital human, avatar, voice assistant, or conversational AI products. * Hardware programs: build validation, manufacturing partners, installation, field service. * End\-to\-end product ownership in a startup or small team. ### **Compensation** Not listed. ### **How to Apply (original posting)** Email resume and a short note to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application \- Senior Product Manager". The note should describe one product you took from working to polished: the gaps, how you prioritized them, and how the launch went.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer** **Era Supports · Engineering** Full\-time · Individual contributor · *\[Remote — TBC]* *Own the platform that decides which patient in recovery gets a call today, helps shape what is said to them, and makes sure the clinic gets paid for making it.* **About Era Supports** Era Supports exists to change how people recover from substance use disorder. We deliver evidence\-based collaborative care inside community health centers, embedding behavioral health care managers alongside primary care teams so that physical, emotional and social needs are treated together rather than in separate silos. The software is not a side project — it *is* the operating model. Our platform runs the clinical registry, the daily patient outreach engine, assessment scoring and acuity tiering, the billing pipeline for collaborative care, and the integrations with our partners' electronic health records. When a care manager knows who to reach today, or a health center gets reimbursed correctly for collaborative care minutes, that is our code doing its job. **The role** You would be our senior engineer, and you would be building. **This is deliberately an individual contributor role.** The platform is currently maintained by a very small team, and what we need first is someone who ships — who can own significant parts of the system end to end, from schema design through to the deploy and whatever happens afterwards. As the team grows you would have the first claim on shaping how we hire and how we work, if that is something you want. But that is later. Today the job is to build. The surface area is wide and we are not going to pretend otherwise: a NestJS backend with a domain\-driven core, three React applications, a Python scheduling service, an SFTP\-based ETL pipeline, a GraphQL integration with an external EHR, and a growing body of AI\-assisted clinical tooling. You will not be handed a narrow slice of this. **What you would actually work on** Not hypotheticals — these are live on the roadmap right now. * **AI inside the clinical workflow.** Help develop responsible AI used in a clinical setting using evaluation, guardrails, human review, and real limits on what data may inform a model. These are some of the most consequential engineering projects we have. * **Multi\-region architecture.** Improving our systems and care platform to have full support for partners and billing in multiple regions. * **Deeper EHR interoperability.** We integrate with EHRs via API today. Partners increasingly want ADT feeds, FHIR endpoints and health information exchange connectivity. This is protocol work with immediate clinical consequences. * **The outreach engine.** A Python service scores every enrolled patient daily against a set of clinical rules to decide who the care team should contact and in what order. Extending and tuning that logic is one of the most direct levers we have on patient outcomes. * **Billing correctness.** Collaborative care, behavioral health integration and chronic care management billing all depend on cumulative time tracking, documentation state and payer\-specific rules. Mistakes here are expensive and slow to surface. * **Hardening what we have.** We are a small team that has moved quickly, and it shows in places — test coverage, authorization edge cases, observability. You would have a mandate to fix that, not merely permission. **Our stack** **Backend** TypeScript and NestJS, domain\-driven design with CQRS and an event bus, PostgreSQL, Redis and BullMQ for queues and scheduled work **Frontend** React 18, TypeScript, MUI, Zustand, SCSS **Services** Python 3\.12 and FastAPI, running on AWS Lambda **AI / ML** LLM\-backed clinical tooling — patient messaging, risk stratification and population health focused **Integrations** Multiple EHRs via API and HL7 standard interfaces, Auth0 for identity, SFTP\-based ETL for partner data, Metabase for analytics **Infrastructure** Docker, AWS, Aptible, GitHub Actions, Sentry You do not need to have used all of this. You do need to be genuinely fluent in TypeScript on both sides of the wire, and untroubled by picking up the rest. **What we are looking for** * **Substantial production experience** building and running web applications, with real depth in TypeScript, Node and React — not a passing familiarity with each. * **Genuine end\-to\-end ownership.** You have designed the schema, written the API, built the interface, and then debugged the whole thing in production when it mattered. * **Judgement about pace.** Knowing when to build carefully and when to build fast, and the honesty to say out loud which one you just did. * **Early\-stage temperament.** You have worked somewhere without a platform team, a QA team or a dedicated SRE, and you treated that as the conditions rather than a grievance. * **You have shipped AI features, not just tried them.** You have taken LLM\-backed functionality to production and dealt with what that actually involves: evaluation, failure modes, guardrails, cost, latency, and a clear view of where a human has to stay in the loop. This matters to us considerably more than model\-training experience. * **Care about correctness where it counts.** Some of our bugs are cosmetic. Some of them mean a patient in recovery does not get a phone call, or that a generated message reaches someone it should never have reached. Knowing the difference is most of the job. **Valuable, but not required** * Healthcare experience — particularly behavioral health, collaborative care, or revenue cycle * Deeper ML or data science background: predictive modelling, feature engineering, or working with claims and clinical data at population scale * Exposure to value\-based care, risk contracts, or population health analytics * Healthcare data standards: FHIR, HL7v2, ADT, X12 * Working knowledge of HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 in practice rather than in principle * Python, for the scheduling service **What this role is not** * **Not a management role, for now.** This role is not responsible for managing a team, there may be opportunities to take on team management as we grow. * **Not greenfield.** You would be working in a real codebase with real history, some of it considered and some of it the product of a startup moving fast. * **Not ticket\-taking.** You will play a role in defining the technical implementation and system architecture based upon product specifications in requirements docs and tickets. **How we work** Small team, direct communication, and a short path from problem to production. We work with clinicians every day, which means feedback arrives fast and specific — you will hear about it when a workflow does not fit the way care actually happens. We take privacy and security seriously because we hold some of the most sensitive health data there is. Substance use records carry protections beyond HIPAA under 42 CFR Part 2, and that genuinely shapes how we design systems rather than being a compliance box at the end. It also makes applying AI here harder, and a good deal more interesting, than in most domains. What data may inform a model, what a model may be permitted to draft to a patient, and who signs off before it is sent are design inputs from the first line of code — not questions to answer after the demo works. **What we offer** * Meaningful equity and competitive cash compensation * Ownership of the technical direction of a platform that measurably affects whether people stay in recovery * Direct access to leadership and to the clinicians using what you build * Health, dental and vision benefits; paid time off Pay: $101,000\.00 \- $123,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Software Development Engineer II** **Introduction to the team** Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Software Development Engineer II position is part of the Servicing team, which builds the agentic AI systems that power traveler self\-service experiences across all Expedia brands and partners. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the agents and supporting infrastructure that enable travelers to resolve complex servicing needs end\-to\-end — without human intervention. This includes working on agent orchestration, tool integration, LLM\-powered reasoning pipelines, and the backend services that make these experiences reliable at scale. You will collaborate closely with Product, XD, and Program Management to shape both the technical direction and the traveler experience. As an SDE II, you will own features end\-to\-end, contribute to technical design, and help raise the bar for engineering quality through rigorous testing, observability, and operational excellence. **In this role, you will:** * Design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure services and components using Expedia Group's standard technologies, including clean APIs, robust data models, and well\-factored low\-level designs. * Deliver high\-quality production code through test automation, code reviews, and continuous integration practices, contributing to services that operate reliably at scale across multiple products or domains. * Collaborate with peers, product managers, technical program managers, and other partners to refine requirements, break down complex problems, and deliver incremental value in an Agile environment. * Instrument services to monitor performance, reliability, and availability; triage and resolve production issues; and participate in on\-call or support activities to improve system stability and operational excellence. * Apply secure coding practices, follow engineering standards and patterns, and contribute to improving shared libraries, tooling, or platforms that accelerate development for multiple teams. Work with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows to enhance developer productivity and product capabilities, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes. * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience in software development. * Professional experience in software engineering building, testing, and operating backend, frontend, or full\-stack services or applications, including ownership of at least one significant service or feature in production. * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language used at Expedia Group and familiarity with service\-oriented or microservices architectures, including API design, data modeling, and low\-level system design. * Experience with standard software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, code review, debugging, and monitoring in a collaborative, Agile team environment. Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing and evolving services or components that support multiple use cases or products, including effective API contracts, data models, and integration patterns across teams. * Track record of improving performance, reliability, or cost efficiency of production systems through data\-driven analysis, observability, and systematic incident prevention and resolution. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and configuration management to confidently build, release, and operate services at scale. * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI\-assisted development tools, code generation, or intelligent automation to improve engineering velocity while maintaining code quality and safety. * Experience incorporating or consuming AI/ML‑enabled capabilities within applications or services, including safely integrating and operating these solutions in production environments. \#LI\-DNI The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $119,000\.00 to $166,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $190,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa; Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life . **Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation . **About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. **Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ . **Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (CA - Remote)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of the First American family of companies, First American Trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full\-service basis for more than five decades. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for hands on coding as well as supporting and contributing to the architecture, design of cloud\-native applications \& mentoring junior software engineers. We're interested in talking to you if you're passionate about new opportunities and you have a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. You love coding and find yourself keeping up with the latest technology trends. You tinker, explore and regularly read to stay in touch with the development community and are passionate about discovering ways to improve quality, reusability, extensibility, and consistency. You are multi\-faceted with a great mix of technical and interpersonal skills, which enables you to succeed in highly collaborative and agile work environments.**What You'll Do:** * Contribute to design, development, coding, testing, debugging, and deploying of software in an Azure cloud environment * Modify and enhance existing applications as well as assist the team on product delivery by writing code and reviewing pull requests * Independently define, prioritize goals and tasks in a fast\-paced agile product environment with small, focused teams * Communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders to ensure project success * On call by rotation and after\-hours support driven by business needs * Derive optimal solutions and implement best coding practices * Work with Solution Architect and strategize design plans * Propose solutions to tough problems, build consensus among team \& mentor junior developers **What You'll Bring:** * 5\+ years of experience in cloud\-native applications (Azure strongly preferred, AWS is also ok) using Python * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent combination of education and experience * Thorough understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) design and practices * Strong RDBMS experience (PostgreSQL, MS SQL etc.) designing tables \& writing queries * SQL experience is a strong plus * Proven ability to identify, explain, and implement common design patterns * Demonstrated experience and design of systems or pipelines from scratch * Ability to assess and clearly articulate design trade\-offs, scalability options, and performance implications * Conduct code reviews to ensure best coding practices are utilized * Strong knowledge of professional software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps * Fluency with multi\-platform software utilizing various programming environments and tools * Excellent communication and written skills * Eager to learn new languages and technologies * Knowledge of Python, Ruby, Azure, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST API, Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL etc.), NoSQL Databases (MongoDB etc.) preferred * Experience with Docker, Linux, Windows, Azure, GIT, NPM Package Management preferred Pay Range: $129,300\.00 \- $172,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.
