jobs.title: Engineer Sr Lead, Software
jobs.description: **Position Type :** Full time**Type Of Hire :** Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Job Description** We are FIS. Our technology powers the world’s economy and our teams bring innovation to life. We champion diversity to deliver the best products and solutions for our colleagues, clients and communities. If you’re ready to start learning, growing and making an impact with a career in fintech, we’d like to know: Are you FIS? **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer Senior Lead to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-grade, cloud\-native solutions within a modern Azure ecosystem. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role focused primarily on backend engineering; scalable microservices, enterprise APIs, distributed systems, and data engineering with secondary contributions to modern front\-end applications (React, Vue.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS). You will set engineering standards, mentor teams, and influence architectural decisions across application development, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and modernization initiatives. Success is measured by platform reliability, scalability, security, cost efficiency, engineering velocity, and business impact in highly regulated environments. **What you will be doing** Application Development \& Architecture * Design and build cloud\-native applications and scalable microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Python, and FastAPI. * Develop secure REST APIs and event\-driven services for internal and external consumers. * Lead technical design and architectural guidance for large\-scale enterprise platforms. * Create reusable frameworks, libraries, and engineering standards. * Design multi\-region, highly available architectures with disaster recovery and business continuity. * Translate business requirements into technical solutions with product, security, and architecture teams. Cloud \& Platform Engineering * Build and operate solutions using Azure\-native services: AKS, Container Apps, Function Apps, Application Gateway, API Management, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Azure SQL, Cosmos, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. * Design secure network architectures (VNets, Subnets, Private DNS, Private Endpoints). * Implement Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Terraform Enterprise (TFE). * Establish cloud governance, security baselines, and operational best practices. * Lead cloud modernization and application migration efforts. API \& Integration Engineering * Design, secure, monitor, and manage enterprise APIs through Azure API Management. * Implement API lifecycle management: versioning, throttling, quotas, rate limiting, caching, and policy enforcement. * Define enterprise API standards and governance frameworks. Microservices, Observability \& Reliability * Apply patterns including service discovery, circuit breakers, distributed caching, event\-driven architecture, and fault tolerance. * Implement observability: centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM, metrics, alerting, and health dashboards. * Define SLOs and SLIs; optimize performance, scalability, and latency. Data Engineering \& Analytics * Build scalable, metadata\-driven data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks. * Develop ingestion and transformation pipelines across ADLS, Databricks, Cosmos DB, and enterprise/third\-party systems. * Optimize Databricks jobs and clusters for performance and cost. * Implement data replication, backup, and retention strategies. Security \& Identity * Design authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, and JWT frameworks. * Implement RBAC, secrets and certificate management, and secure API authentication. * Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements. DevOps \& Engineering Excellence * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. * Manage source control, branching, release management, and deployment automation. * Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates. * Mentor teams and promote best practices in software engineering excellence and DevOps. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. * 10\+ years of enterprise software engineering experience. * Expert\-level Java and Spring Boot, Python and FastAPI. * Proven experience building microservices, REST APIs, and integration services. * Hands\-on expertise with Azure cloud\-native services and architecture patterns. * Experience with Terraform/TFE, AKS, Container Apps, and containerized workloads. * Strong knowledge of Azure API Management and API governance. * Experience with observability, distributed tracing, and monitoring. * Proficiency with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD. * Experience with OAuth2, OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, and identity providers. * Experience with Cosmos DB and cloud\-native storage. * Strong networking knowledge (VNets, Subnets, Private Endpoints, DNS, firewalls). * Experience with disaster recovery, geo\-redundancy, and high availability. * Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills; Agile/Scrum experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. * Experience in Financial Services, Banking, Payments, FinTech, or other regulated industries. * Front\-end experience with React, Vue.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS, and Databricks. * Knowledge of DDD, Event\-Driven Architecture, CQRS, and SRE practices. **What We Offer you** At FIS, you can grow your career as far as you want to take it. Here’s what else we offer: * Opportunities to make an impact in fintech * Personal and professional learning * Inclusive, diverse work environment * Resources to give back to your community * Competitive salary and benefits **Privacy Statement** FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice. **EEOC Statement** FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis. **Sourcing Model** Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company. \#pridepass

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Fluxx is looking for a highly motivated Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Engineering team. As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure and pipelines behind the leading grants management software for philanthropy—the platform that connects Donors and Doers. Collaborating closely with Engineering, you'll build, deploy, and secure our infrastructure while playing a key role in setting technical direction. You'll lead projects across CI/CD, our delivery and orchestration platform, and monitoring and logging. You'll also be responsible for infrastructure resilience and cloud costs as part of the team. We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, intellectually honest, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team—even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. **This is a full\-time, exempt, and remote position. Candidates must be located in the United States.** **Who we are looking for:** * You debug systems and the processes around them. You are capable of resolving an incident and fixing the conditions that allowed it * You work in both software engineering and operations, understanding what runs where and how to configure the infrastructure to smoothly deliver great service to our clients * You're pragmatic. You know the vision, and deliver in steady increments toward that vision rather than waiting for perfect * You teach and guide teams to better practices. You understand Rome wasn't built in a day * You love resolving issues related to latency, scalability, and performance of core infrastructure * The thing that really floats your boat is making systems better, not just building new stuff * You bring a collaborative educational mindset * You want to work with others, learn from them, and teach your experiences * You own outcomes, not just tickets. A task is finished when the system is more reliable, not when the PR merges * You are a curious, proactive learner who explores emerging technologies and evaluates their practical application within our infrastructure **What you'll do:** * Automate our infrastructure and operational processes with infrastructure as code and standard tooling * Own our CI/CD pipelines, image builds, and GitOps deployments with ArgoCD * Keep our fleet patched and current, from OS updates to Kubernetes and managed\-service upgrades * Build monitoring and alerting that catches problems before customers do * Partner with our security team to protect our systems and customer data, support SOC 2 compliance, and work security findings through to their remediation * Build self\-serve tools for Engineering to reduce bottlenecks and dependencies * Work with engineering teams to make our services reliable, secure, and scalable * Take part in our on\-call rotation for production systems as needed **What you will bring to the team:** * 4\+ years of professional software development and infrastructure operations experience * Deep professional experience managing Kubernetes in production, including creating manifest templates for services, deployments, and other application components * Significant experience writing and using Terraform code to deploy production infrastructure on AWS * Significant experience managing the full lifecycle of AWS services such as EKS, RDS, Elasticsearch, and WAF, including version upgrades, scaling, and failover * Familiarity with Azure and cross\-cloud infrastructure * Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) to streamline development workflows and use them as a force multiplier **Salary:** Fluxx is committed to fair, transparent, and equitable compensation practices. We use a market\-based approach that considers cost of labor by geographic region, along with company size and industry benchmarks. This role is categorized into three compensation tiers based on location, with the following expected annual on\-target earnings (base salary \+ commission): **San Francisco Bay Area, New York City** $185,000 \- $200,000 (SF/NY) **All other locations** $165,000 \- $180,000 The successful candidate's starting salary will be determined based on, but not limited to, (a) location; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. Fluxx is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We take a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. Locations are categorized into one of three zones based on a cost\-of\-labor index for that geographic location and our compensation philosophy. **Benefits:** Fluxx offers the following benefits for the position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; Flexible time off; Paid sick leave; 12 weeks of fully\-paid parental leave; Annual learning and development stipend; Internet stipend; One\-time home office set\-up stipend; 401(k) retirement plan with company match. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Fluxx's applicable stock plans. **More About Fluxx:** We are a people\-first and inclusive workplace committed to continuous learning. We pride ourselves on having a diverse workforce, and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. We respect the gender, gender identity, and gender expression of our applicants and employees. It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Facilities Management eXpress** is looking for an **Engineer Manager** to join our team! At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high\-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high\-performing, inclusive engineering culture. This is a player\-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non\-mission\-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI\-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality. **What You’ll Do:** * **Lead and grow your team:** Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth. * **Build a strong culture:** Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work. * **Clear the path:** Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction. * **Stay technical:** Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness. * **Drive AI\-first development:** Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI\-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools. * **Shape the bigger picture:** Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long\-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent. **Requirements** What we're looking for: * 2\-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS. * A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission\-critical. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others. * This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time. * A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication. * Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross\-functional collaboration. * The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day\-to\-day execution. * A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience. * Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity. **Nice to Have:** * Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin) * Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Containerization with Docker * CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance * Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience **Our Tech Stack:** * .NET / C\# * React and TypeScript * React Native * Azure **The Hiring Process:** * **1\. Apply!** Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started. * **2\. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min)** A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX. * **3\. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min)** An in\-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations. * **4\. Final Interview (60 min)** A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit. * **5\. Offer \& Onboarding** Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process. **Benefits** **FMX Benefits** **\& Life at FMX:** * **Make a big impact:** You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement. * **Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close\-knit team:** We're a team of hard\-working, high\-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously. * **Get to hire and work with the best:** We believe in building high\-quality, well\-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly\-talented team. * **Learn and grow in your role and outside it:** At FMX, we’re committed to improving our professional and personal selves. We bring in industry\-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team\-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them. * **Enjoy flexible working hours:** Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible. * **Work from home:** At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all\-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high\-trust relationships with your teammates and co\-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator. **Company:** While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day\-to\-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest\-growing companies in its space. Check us out at: https://www.gofmx.com/ *Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Employee Handbook.* FMX is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. **Senior Data Engineer \- Schaumburg** ====================================== **MISUMI** \| Data Platform **Own the data platform that MISUMI runs on** --------------------------------------------- MISUMI is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to be the go\-to owner of our Snowflake warehouse, dbt project, and data pipelines. You will be the primary data engineer, with real ownership and real influence: the models you build and the pipelines you run are what Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Customer Support rely on to make decisions every day. You will work hands\-on with a modern stack (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Git/GitHub) and with AI coding agents in your daily engineering work. You will also have the autonomy to take requests from intake to production, propose what we should build next, and shape safe team practices for agentic development. If you want a role where your judgment directly determines whether the business can trust its data, this is it. **Impact in this Role** ----------------------- The Senior Data Engineer is the go\-to owner of MISUMI's Snowflake warehouse, dbt project, and data pipelines. This person turns data from business and production systems into trusted, analytics\-ready models that Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, and Customer Support use to make decisions. Because this is the primary data engineering role, the accuracy, security, and reliability of the data platform, including regulated data such as CUI, depend on this person's judgment and execution. **Essential Functions** ----------------------- * Administer Snowflake: manage users, roles, grants, warehouses, resource monitors and security policies, and keep the environment secure, fast and cost\-efficient. * Design, build, and own dbt models (staging, intermediate, marts, and the semantic layer) that turn replicated source data into trusted, analytics\-ready tables with tests and documentation. * Build, operate, and monitor ELT pipelines from production and business systems into Snowflake, using Fivetran and related tools. Resolve connector failures, schema changes, backfills, and data\-quality issues. * Act as the team's primary technical resource for modeling and pipeline work. Take requests from intake to production independently, including scoping, estimating, and reporting status. * Translate business requirements into technical requirements and data models, and bridge the gap between business teams and technology. Ask clarifying questions, agree on metric definitions and acceptance criteria with stakeholders, and turn them into specifications the team can build and test. * Proactively identify opportunities where data, modeling, or automation can help the business get closer to its goals, and propose and prioritize them with stakeholders instead of waiting for requests. * Run an impact analysis before changing, deprecating, or removing any shared table, model, or connector. Use dbt lineage, Snowflake dependency and access metadata, and stakeholder review, and document a rollback plan. * Own the Git and GitHub workflow for the dbt project: branching standards, pull\-request review, automated tests, and deployment. * Use AI assistants and agentic workflows in daily engineering work to speed up SQL and dbt development, testing, documentation, code review, and debugging, and help set safe team practices for using them. * Find the root cause of data\-quality, performance, and pipeline problems and fix them at the source. * Tune queries, models, and warehouse usage, and advise engineers and analysts on efficient query patterns and table design. * Maintain data dictionaries, data\-flow diagrams, and schema documentation. * Lead data design sessions and technical reviews, and explain design trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Evaluate new Snowflake and dbt features and tools, and recommend improvements to the data platform. * Mentor analysts and engineers on SQL and dbt best practices. * Work with remote, cross\-functional teams across time zones. * Maintain and contribute to the Quality Management System (QMS). **Desired Traits** ------------------ **Five core skills. Candidates must show direct, hands\-on production experience in each:** * Snowflake administration and engineering: access control, warehouse sizing and cost control, query tuning, clustering, security controls, cloning, time travel, and data sharing. * dbt expert model and CI/CD. * 5\+ years working with ETL/ELT tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Stitch, Matillion, Informatica, or Talend, plus experience with pipeline orchestration. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience using agentic coding tools that work directly in the codebase (not chat\-only AI use) in daily data engineering work. This includes building agentic workflows or tool integrations for data work, such as MCP servers, custom agents, or automated dbt and pipeline checks, with concrete examples of the workflows and results. * Expert SQL, including CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning. * Daily use of Git and GitHub pull\-request workflows. * Experience being the primary or sole owner of a data platform, or the technical lead for one. * Experience administering data platforms that hold regulated data (such as CUI under NIST SP 800\-171\), including access control, audit logging, encryption, and data classification. Must be able to pass a background check and complete required CUI and security training. ### **Preferred** * Direct Fivetran experience, including connector management. * Experience with Sigma Computing, or with Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI tool. * Experience modeling ERP and CRM data, such as NetSuite or Salesforce. * Python for data tooling and automation. * Snowflake SnowPro certification or dbt certification. * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience for Snowflake, such as Terraform. * Background in manufacturing, supply chain, or marketplace businesses. ### **Abilities** * Write advanced SQL on large, complex datasets, including semi\-structured data such as JSON in Snowflake VARIANT columns. * Apply data warehousing and dimensional modeling principles to turn business requirements into well\-structured, maintainable models. * Work independently: take an open\-ended problem, define the approach, deliver it, and raise risks early instead of stalling. * Use sound production judgment: verify before changing shared systems, plan for failure, and know how to roll back. * Use AI tools with discipline: give clear context and constraints, review and test every AI\-generated change, and stay accountable for the result. * Solve hard problems methodically: break an unclear problem into testable hypotheses, gather evidence from logs, lineage, and query history, confirm the cause before changing anything, and verify the fix worked. * Communicate clearly in writing and in person, giving business context to engineers and technical context to non\-engineers. **Physical Demands** -------------------- The employee routinely sits, talks, hears, and uses hands and fingers to operate a keyboard. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Travel** ---------- Ability to travel 5% annually in the US for team meetings, offsites, and conferences. **Ready to own the platform?** ------------------------------ If you have run production Snowflake, dbt, and ELT at scale, you work daily with agentic coding tools, and you want to be the person the business trusts with its data, we would like to hear from you. Apply today. **Salary range:** **$167,000 \- $202,300 base salary per year, depending on experience** **Benefits include, but are not limited to:** * **Comprehensive medical and dental coverage** * **401(k) plan** * **Generous PTO and leave programs** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Additional Information: Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer & AI-Native Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award\-winning, data\-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on\-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud. We’re transforming the software industry. We’re Flexera. With **more than 50,000 customers** across the world, we ’ re achieving that goal . But we know we can’t do any of that without our team . Ready to help us re\-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans? Come and see why **we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC** as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at **flexera.com** We are building a new model for software engineering: a small, highly autonomous engineering team that combines experienced technical leadership, talented developers, and AI coding agents to deliver high\-quality software with exceptional speed. We are looking for a hands\-on **Principal Engineer \& AI Technical Lead** to establish and lead this team. You will be responsible for technical direction, architecture, engineering quality, and delivery outcomes while actively developing software alongside two supporting engineers and AI tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. This is not a traditional engineering management position. You will remain deeply involved in design, implementation, code review, debugging, and production delivery. Your leverage will come from making sound technical decisions, decomposing complex problems into manageable work, building effective AI\-assisted workflows, and enabling a small team to operate with significant independence. You will own outcomes rather than simply oversee tasks. ***What You'll Do:*** --------------------- ### **Technical Leadership and Architecture** * Own the technical architecture, design decisions, and implementation strategy for the team's applications, services, and systems * Translate business objectives and product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions * Make sound trade\-offs between delivery speed, reliability, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability * Establish lightweight engineering standards, architectural patterns, coding conventions, and documentation practices * Identify opportunities to simplify systems, eliminate unnecessary complexity, and accelerate delivery * Ensure the team builds software that can be understood, tested, operated, and evolved by engineers beyond its original authors ### **AI\-Native Software Engineering** * Make AI coding agents a first\-class part of the development lifecycle, using tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other appropriate AI engineering tools * Develop effective workflows for AI\-assisted requirements analysis, code generation, test creation, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation * Decompose work into clear, bounded tasks that AI agents can execute independently, in parallel, and with measurable results * Establish project context, repository instructions, reusable prompts, agent skills, automated checks, and other mechanisms that improve the consistency of AI\-generated work * Evaluate AI\-generated code critically, recognizing when to accept, modify, or reject its output * Continuously improve the team's engineering workflow based on actual delivery results rather than AI usage or code\-generation volume ### **End\-to\-End Delivery and Ownership** * Take responsibility for delivering production\-ready capabilities from problem definition through deployment and operational support * Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, users, and other engineering teams to clarify requirements and prioritize work * Break larger initiatives into small, independently testable increments that can be delivered frequently * Identify and resolve technical blockers without introducing unnecessary meetings, dependencies, or handoffs * Establish appropriate observability, deployment automation, rollback procedures, and operational safeguards * Monitor production outcomes and use feedback to improve the product and engineering process ### **Quality, Security, and Reliability** * Define a practical quality strategy covering automated testing, code review, integration testing, and production validation * Ensure AI\-generated changes are verified through appropriate tests, static analysis, security checks, and human review * Establish guardrails for AI access to source code, credentials, production systems, customer data, and other sensitive resources * Prevent shortcuts that create unacceptable security, reliability, compliance, or maintainability risks * Make quality controls increasingly automated so that a small team can move quickly without relying on manual inspection for every routine check ### **Team Development and Enablement** * Lead by example through hands\-on engineering, thoughtful technical decisions, and disciplined execution * Mentor two supporting engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and progressively more challenging assignments * Build a culture of ownership, experimentation, direct communication, accountability, and continuous learning * Help engineers develop the judgment to direct AI agents, validate their work, and solve problems independently * Avoid becoming a bottleneck by delegating meaningful ownership and creating reusable patterns and automated guardrails Share successful AI engineering practices with the broader engineering organization * ***Required Qualifications:*** ------------------------------ * Significant professional software engineering experience, typically 8\+ years, with demonstrated technical leadership appropriate to a Principal or Staff\+ engineer * Strong software design and architecture skills, with the ability to balance simplicity, delivery speed, maintainability, and operational needs * Demonstrated experience delivering and operating production software end to end * Strong jobs.title: PLM Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We are seeking an experienced PLM Engineering Manager to lead 3DEXPERIENCE customization, development, and high level escalation support. This pivotal leadership role will guide a team of 3DX developers, platform engineers, and release engineers. It will also connect Ford's business and engineering stakeholders with the hosting and infrastructure teams and with Dassault Systèmes. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who understands the full 3DX architecture, from 3DPassport and 3DSpace through 3DSearch and FCS down to the database. You are equally comfortable reviewing a developer's trigger logic, analyzing a JVM thread dump during an outage, pushing a Dassault Systèmes Service Request up to R\&D, and explaining the root cause to senior leadership in plain business terms. You set the engineering standards that keep Ford's heavily customized platform stable and upgrade\-ready. A natural collaborator, you build trust across development, hosting, and business teams, and you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where both delivery and accountability matter. This role is a people leader position but also highly technical. **Platform Customization \& Development** * **Customization Ownership:** Lead the design, development, and delivery of all 3DX customizations, including data model extensions (type and attribute specialization, Unified Typing, policies, lifecycles), triggers, JPOs, MQL/TCL scripts, and EKL logic, using Dassault\-supported methods. * **UI \& Widget Development:** Guide the development of 3DDashboard widgets (JavaScript/UWA), web forms, tables, commands, and menus that improve the engineering user experience. * **Integrations \& Web Services:** Own the technical design and support of integrations between 3DX and Ford enterprise systems, using 3DSpace REST APIs, custom web services, and middleware. * **Security Model:** Oversee People \& Organization (P\&O) configuration, including collaborative spaces, organizations, roles, security contexts, and access rules. * **Engineering Standards:** Define and enforce coding standards, code review practices, and source control for all 3DX development, so customizations stay upgrade\-safe and technical debt stays low. * **Requirements Intake:** Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and program teams to turn business requirements into sound technical designs. Advise on "out\-of\-the\-box vs. customize" decisions. **Level 3 Escalation \& Incident Resolution** * **Final Escalation Point:** Serve as the highest internal escalation point for critical (P1/P2\) and complex incidents across the 3DX suite, including 3DSpace, 3DPassport, 3DDashboard, 3DSearch/3DIndex, FCS, 3DSwym, and native app (CATIA/DELMIA) platform interactions. * **Root Cause Analysis:** Lead deep diagnostics using application logs, MQL traces, JVM thread and heap dumps, database query analysis, and HTTP/network tracing to find the true root cause of failures across components. * **Vendor Escalation:** Own the relationship with Dassault Systèmes Support and R\&D. Drive Service Requests to resolution, make sure reproducible test cases are provided, and validate the hotfixes Dassault delivers. * **Incident Leadership:** Serve as technical lead on incident bridges during 3DX platform outages. Coordinate rapid response across hosting, development, and supplier teams, and give clear, timely status to business stakeholders. * **Problem Management:** Own root cause reports and problem records, and drive permanent corrective actions so the same issues do not come back. * **Shift\-Left Enablement:** Turn recurring L3 issues into knowledge articles, runbooks, and automated fixes so L1/L2 can resolve more issues and fewer reach L3\. **Platform Stability \& Lifecycle Management** * **Performance Optimization:** Oversee platform performance tuning across JVM/TomEE configuration, database (Oracle/SQL Server), indexing, caching, and FCS file throughput. * **Upgrade Readiness:** Own the technical impact analysis of customizations for full upgrades, Functional Deliveries (FDs), and hotfixes. Lead regression testing and support cutover execution. * **Change Management:** Make sure all customizations and platform changes follow ITIL\-aligned change management processes, are properly documented, and carry appropriate approvals before promotion through Dev, Test, QA, and Prod. * **Automation:** Drive the adoption of automation for deployments, bulk data operations, and platform health checks, fitting into the team's Ansible and CI/CD pipelines. **Capacity Planning \& Team Leadership** * **People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 3DX developers and escalation engineers, including hiring, performance manage hread and heap dump analysis, and SQL performance analysis (Oracle and/or SQL Server). * **Infrastructure Proficiency:** Strong understanding of server operations (Linux/Windows), OS patching cycles, and network security (SSL/Firewalls). * **Project Management Tools:** Expert\-level proficiency in Jira for backlog management, capacity planning, and reporting. Working knowledge of ServiceNow for incident, problem, and change management. * **Preferred:** CAA (C\+\+/Java) development, SSO/SAML identity integration, and knowledge of automotive product development processes (BOM, engineering change, variant/configuration management). **Leadership Skills:** * **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to set engineering standards, guide design decisions, and raise the technical capability of a development and support team. * **Strategic Communication:** Proven ability to translate technical root causes and constraints into business impacts for senior leadership. * **Process Rigor:** Deep understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management principles and audit compliance (GRC/SOX). * **Problem Solving:** Excellent troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and preventative measures. * **Composure Under Pressure:** Demonstrated ability to lead calmly and decisively during production outages and high\-visibility escalations. * **Collaboration:** Demonstrated success building relationships across Development, Infrastructure, Hosting, Business, and vendor teams to deliver under aggressive timelines. **Licenses and Certifications:** * Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE Certification (Preferred) * ITIL Certification (Preferred) * SAFe / Agile Certification (Preferred) You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! * As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is leadership level 6 and ranges from $132,800\-$250,800\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/LL6 Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. \#LI\-OnSite \#LI\-DS2

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description: Do you want to change how the world creates? At Formlabs, we're building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting\-edge products to life\-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we're helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. We're a team of hands\-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you're ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. As a **Manufacturing Test Engineer**, you'll lead the design and development of manufacturing test systems that bring electromechanical products from prototype to high\-volume production. You'll work at the intersection of hardware and software, building test and calibration hardware and infrastructure, integrating tightly with our manufacturing and operations teams, and making production data visible and actionable across our global supply chain. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive in fast\-paced environments, care deeply about system reliability and product quality, and want to own software that powers physical manufacturing at scale. If you are passionate about manufacturing and eager to develop tests and software services used to build thousands of printers and related products worldwide, we want to speak with you! ### **The Job:** * Design, build and validate hardware and software solutions for electromechanical factory test systems. These systems will facilitate product calibration and testing from the prototype stage through to mass production. * Develop Python\-based test scripts and integrate hardware interfaces (sensors, actuators, motion systems) * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering teams to define test strategies and deploy robust, scalable tools across multiple production sites to ensure projects are delivered successfully and on time * Build and support internal tools and services for collecting, storing, and analyzing manufacturing data (e.g., calibration results, EMS logs, configuration and test data) * Apply data science tools to extract meaningful insights from manufacturing performance data and feed that back into design, quality, and operational decision\-making * Continuously improve our development, testing and deployment processes to streamline software releases across our global factories ### **You:** * BS in Robotics, Mechatronics, or other Engineering discipline with professional experience combining hardware design and software integration * Experience developing and implementing computer vision and machine learning algorithms * Have strong proficiency in Python, including experience designing or supporting test jigs, fixtures, or automation tools that are deployed in manufacturing environments * Good understanding of software integration with embedded systems, electrical, and mechanical engineering and comfortable working cross functionally * Take pride in building robust, maintainable systems—and you're not afraid to dive into a prototype setup to debug issues on the line * Communicate clearly, proactively manage projects and multiple priorities, and thrive in environments where quick decision\-making and knowledge sharing are key ### **Bonus Skills** * Experience working with manufacturing teams on complex products including collaborating with 3rd party contract manufacturers and new product introduction (NPI) build cycles * Experience developing for and maintaining production\-grade code that is shared across teams * Proficient in 3D CAD (OnShape preferred) and mechanical design * Full stack web development, including React/JS, DevOps, Docker, and microservices * Experience with C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers **Our Benefits \& Perks:** * Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs * Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) * 401K matching and access to financial advisors * Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) * Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) * Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it * Ample on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats * Regular sponsored professional development opportunities * Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community * And of course… unlimited 3D prints *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* **Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.** Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available **here**. Please give them a read.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron\-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That's what we do. At Formlabs, we're building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they're building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. If you're energized by the idea of making the impossible happen, come join us as a Mechanical Engineer. **Include a portfolio with your application to show us what you can do.** **The Job:** The job is to ship the best desktop 3D printers on the market: * Prototype new mechanisms, from precision latches to revolutionary pumps and valves to surfaces measured in microns * Test materials that push the boundaries of what 3D printing can do * Research 3D printing challenges and rethink every subprocess to push technology forward * Analyze, validate, and iterate on electro\-mechanical systems * Model everything from brackets to hinges to complex parts in CAD, creating well\-specified, accurate drawings * Partner with Global Sourcing and Manufacturing Teams to bring designs from prototype to mass production * Flex your global savvy by working with teams around the world, virtually and in\-person * Apply your knowledge of manufacturing techniques like injection molding and sheet metal fabrication to the world of 3D printing * Solve customer problems by using your engineering skills to eliminate friction at every stage of their workflow **You:** * You can't wait to build a precision jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US** We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered. #### **About Foundant** At Foundant, we build mission\-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics. We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of \~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve. #### **Where You’ll Work:** * As a remote\-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive. * With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world. ##### ***What******You’ll******Do:*** * You'll be part of Foundant’s product engineering team responsible for development activities along with their ongoing production environments care and feeding to take on their hardest technical problems, and you’ll deliver high\-quality working code — not just direction. This is a hands\-on role at every level of seniority it carries. * You'll own architectural decisions at both the application and service level, making calls that hold up under real production load and remain understandable to the engineers who inherit them. * You'll diagnose systemic and architectural issues that cross component and service boundaries, including the ambiguous ones where the cause isn't in any single team code. * You’ll see the big picture and work proactively to resolve integration issues or coordinate across team boundaries. * You’ll put AI\-assisted development and agentic tooling to work in your daily engineering, shortening the path from idea to production\-ready code and getting valuable improvements into clients’ hands sooner. * Other duties as assigned. ##### ***What******You’ll******Need:*** * 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time at a principal, staff, or equivalent senior individual contributor level as a hands\-on developer. * Demonstrated mastery of architectural patterns and the judgment to know which apply in a given context, at both the application and service level. * Proven expertise in Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with a track record of building and shipping production software. * Extensive full\-stack development experience building scalable RESTful applications with React and Java/Spring Boot backend. * Advanced proficiency working with large scale relational database management systems (RDBMS). * Experience working with analytical systems and databases processing large volume of data. * Proficient with AI assisted development practices and tooling. * Proven experience developing cloud\-based SaaS applications; experience working with AWS is highly desirable. * Proven experience owning production services, including reliability, performance, and incident response. * Professional experience using AI\-assisted development tools in production work. Foundant uses Claude Code; deep expertise with a comparable tool is acceptable. * Extensive experience diagnosing and debugging complex technical issues across multiple components and services, including the use of debugging and profiling tools. * Must be legally eligible to work in the United States. ##### ***What******You’ll******Bring to our Team Dynamics:*** * **Adaptive Achievement:** Moves between unfamiliar codebases, domains, and problem spaces without losing momentum, and delivers high\-quality solutions under shifting priorities and incomplete context. * **Productive Collaboration:** Leads engineers through complex initiatives by influence rather than authority — entering a team as a guest, earning trust quickly, and articulating direction clearly enough that the team can carry it forward without you. * **Service Orientation:** Treats internal engineering teams as clients, and understands that the reliability of a shared service is ultimately felt by the foundations and nonprofits depending on our software to do their work. * **Business Insight:** Weighs the blast radius of shared\-service decisions across every product and client, balancing technical elegance against what actually advances the business and the communities we serve. * **Active Learning:** Builds working depth in unfamiliar stacks quickly, and applies rigorous judgment to AI\-generated code — knowing when to lean on it, when to scrutinize it, and how to help colleagues do the same. ##### ***Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:*** * At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not\-for\-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real\-world change. * We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives. * With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well\-being and professional success. * We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries. * As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals * You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought. * Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it! Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation. Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact hr@smartsimple.com.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Systems Engineer is responsible for the analysis, design, security, and long\-term operation of the systems that support UDHG’s corporate and manufacturing locations. The position works with business users, IT, cybersecurity, and plant personnel to understand system requirements and develop technical solutions that meet those needs. This position serves as the technical owner for assigned infrastructure platforms. The Systems Engineer evaluates technical options, develops system specifications, establishes standards, and makes recommendations concerning architecture, security, capacity, availability, and disaster recovery. The primary focus of the position is infrastructure engineering and systems analysis. Routine help desk tickets, basic end\-user support, printer maintenance, and equipment installation are handled by Level 1 and Level 2 support resources. The Systems Engineer becomes involved when an issue requires advanced analysis, a system change, or a permanent technical solution. **Key Responsibilities****Systems Analysis and Design*** Meet with business, IT, cybersecurity, and personnel to understand operational needs and translate them into system requirements. * Analyze existing systems and identify changes needed to improve security, availability, capacity, performance, or supportability. * Design and document infrastructure solutions involving servers, virtualization, storage, cloud services, identity, networking, backups, and disaster recovery. * Develop system specifications, architecture diagrams, configuration standards, testing plans, implementation plans, and rollback procedures. * Evaluate technical alternatives and recommend solutions based on business need, security risk, cost, system compatibility, and long\-term support requirements. * Test and modify infrastructure systems before changes are placed into production. * Determine the technical approach for assigned infrastructure projects within established IT and security policies. **Infrastructure Engineering*** Design, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments and related infrastructure services. * Serve as the technical owner for Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, and other assigned Windows services. * Design and maintain VMware ESXi and Proxmox virtualization environments, including virtual machines, clusters, storage, replication, and capacity planning. * Plan and lead server, operating\-system, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure upgrades. * Review system performance, capacity, backup results, security events, and availability trends to identify risks before they interrupt operations. * Develop and maintain technical standards for server configuration, virtualization, patching, backups, access, monitoring, and recovery. * Design and test backup, restoration, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity procedures. * Lead the technical work associated with infrastructure migrations, system replacements, new\-location deployments, and company integrations. **Microsoft Cloud and Identity*** Design and maintain Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity services. * Establish standards for user access, authentication, role\-based permissions, multifactor authentication, and conditional access. * Review access and identity configurations for security, consistency, and business need. * Design and maintain endpoint\-management solutions using Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, or similar platforms. * Develop automation using PowerShell or other appropriate tools to reduce manual administration and improve consistency. * Evaluate changes to Microsoft cloud services and determine their effect on UDHG systems and users. **Network and Security Engineering*** Analyze network requirements involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, and remote access. * Design or recommend changes to corporate LAN, WAN, wireless, and remote\-access environments. * Establish technical requirements for network segmentation, access controls, monitoring, and secure remote connectivity. * Review network performance and security data to identify capacity concerns, recurring problems, and potential risks. * Work with cybersecurity personnel to evaluate vulnerabilities, determine remediation methods, and plan infrastructure security improvements. * Perform root\-cause analysis following significant or recurring infrastructure incidents and develop permanent corrective actions. **IT and OT Infrastructure*** Serve as the infrastructure engineering resource for systems that connect corporate IT services with manufacturing OT environments. * Work with the OT Systems Engineer to define ownership, access, security, connectivity, backup, and recovery requirements for shared systems. * Design infrastructure supporting OT\-related servers, virtual machines, storage, identity services, backups, and network connectivity. * Develop and ma tform. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, and network segmentation. * Experience with enterprise backup, recovery, replication, monitoring, patch management, and endpoint\-security systems. * Experience planning and leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, integrations, or system replacements. * Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and systems\-administration automation. * Ability to evaluate technical options, identify risks, and explain recommendations to both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Ability to manage infrastructure incidents where decisions may affect production, security, or business continuity. **Preferred Qualifications*** Systems\-engineering experience in a manufacturing, distribution, or industrial environment. * Experience working with IT and OT systems in the same operating environment. * Knowledge of industrial network segmentation, production availability, manufacturing cybersecurity, and secure remote access. * Familiarity with MES, ERP, SCADA, HMIs, industrial computers, barcode systems, and other plant technology. * Experience designing highly available infrastructure and disaster\-recovery solutions. * Experience supporting storage systems, clustering, replication, and multi\-site environments. * VMware, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, or comparable certifications. **Work Environment*** This is an on\-site or primarily on\-site position supporting corporate and manufacturing operations. * Work may occasionally be performed in production areas where plant safety requirements apply. * Occasional after\-hours, weekend, maintenance\-window, or emergency support is required. * The position participates in an on\-call escalation rotation. * Limited travel to other company locations may be required. * The employee may occasionally need to move or connect technology equipment during infrastructure projects. Equipment installation and repair are not primary responsibilities of the position. **Success Measures*** Infrastructure designs meet documented business, security, and technical requirements. * Systems remain available, secure, supportable, and adequately sized for business needs. * Infrastructure changes are properly tested, documented, approved, and completed with limited disruption. * Recurring incidents are reduced through root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective action. * Backup and recovery procedures are documented, tested, and capable of meeting business recovery requirements. * IT and OT systems maintain appropriate separation, access controls, and ownership. * Infrastructure projects are completed within the approved scope, schedule, and budget. * Technical documentation and support procedures are accurate and current. * Level 1 and Level 2 support teams can resolve routine issues without unnecessary engineering escalation. **Reports To** Director Enterprise Cloud Technology \& Security **Compensation** The listed pay range reflects the expected base rate for this position; actual compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and cost of living in the assigned market. This is a full\-time position with competitive pay and benefits.* **Base:** $128,000 \- $150,000 per year * **Bonus:** 10% Target Bonus * **Total Compensation (Base \+ Bonus):** The successful candidate could reasonably expect a Total Compensation Package in the range of $134,000 \- $173,000 **Benefits** At UDHG, we’re committed to supporting our employees both personally and professionally. We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to help you thrive inside and outside of work. Our excellent package includes:* Medical * Dental * Vision * HSA/ FSA plans * Voluntary Life and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) Insurance * Critical illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Coverage * Legal Insurance Plan * Paid Time Off \& Paid Holidays * Generous 401(k) plan with company match

The Maintenance Engineer I plays a critical role in ensuring the operational efficiency and safety of real estate properties. The Maintenance Engineer I will also contribute to maintaining compliance with safety regulations and industry standards, ensuring a safe environment for occupants and staff. Ultimately, this position supports the long\-term value and functionality of the properties under management through diligent maintenance practices. **Minimum Qualifications:** * High school diploma or equivalent. * Basic knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical equipment. * Experience in maintenance or repair work, preferably in a commercial property setting. * Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, blueprints, and safety regulations. * Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Associate degree or certification in facilities management, electrical, HVAC, or a related technical field. * Familiarity with local building codes and OSHA safety standards. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Basic welding or carpentry skills. **Responsibilities:** * Conduct regular inspections of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems to identify and resolve issues proactively. * Perform routine preventive maintenance tasks and repairs on building infrastructure and equipment to prevent service interruptions. * Replace or repair fixtures and/or equipment as needed including replacing light bulbs/tubes and servicing rest room toilets/sinks * Perform snow removal and grounds maintenance, including policing grounds, as required. * Maintain all key systems, codes, regulations, and company policies during maintenance operations. * Assist in managing maintenance budgets by tracking expenses and recommending cost\-effective solutions. * Participate in rotating on\-call schedule and respond to after\-hours calls, as required. **Skills:** The Maintenance Engineer I utilizes technical skills daily to diagnose and repair issues across various building systems, ensuring continuous operation and safety. Effective communication skills are essential for coordinating with property managers, tenants, and external vendors to address maintenance needs efficiently. Organizational skills are applied to maintain detailed records and manage maintenance schedules, which helps in prioritizing tasks and managing time effectively. Problem\-solving abilities enable the engineer to identify root causes of equipment failures and implement long\-term solutions. Additionally, knowledge of safety protocols and regulatory compliance is critical to performing maintenance work responsibly and minimizing risks.
