This role delivers secure, scalable, and user\-centered solutions across Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Power Platform, enterprise content management, workflow automation, and supporting application platforms. The position may be filled at Level III, IV, or V depending on demonstrated technical depth, leadership impact, solution complexity, and scope of ownership. This opportunity is ideal for a technology professional who enjoys delivering high\-value collaboration and productivity solutions that improve the employee experience and business operations. **This is an onsite position and it is not eligible for visa sponsorship** **What You'll Do** You will: * Engineer, administer, and support Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and related collaboration platforms. * Design secure and scalable collaboration sites, intranets, content structures, metadata, permissions, and information architecture. * Develop and support solutions using SharePoint Framework, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Teams, and related technologies. * Modernize legacy forms, workflows, and applications including InfoPath and Nintex solutions. * Develop reusable automation using PowerShell and approved tools. * Build and support integrations among Microsoft 365, enterprise applications, SQL databases, Azure services, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and third\-party platforms. * Evaluate and implement Copilot, Copilot Studio, agents, bots, and AI\-enabled productivity capabilities. * Administer records management, document management, scanning, imaging, OCR, retention, search, routing, and content lifecycle controls. * Provide advanced troubleshooting for application, authentication, integration, workflow, and performance issues. * Support Windows Server and IIS\-hosted applications, upgrades, patching, recovery readiness, and vendor support. * Develop technical designs, operating procedures, knowledge articles, and support documentation. * Consult with stakeholders to translate business needs into secure and maintainable digital solutions. At advanced levels, this role may also: * Lead complex platform initiatives and modernization efforts. * Provide architecture guidance and establish digital workplace standards. * Mentor engineers and influence platform strategy and roadmap priorities. * Serve as a technical authority for Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and enterprise collaboration technologies. **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * **Level III:** Typically 5\+ years in application development, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or digital workplace engineering. * **Level IV:** Typically 8\+ years including leadership of complex platform initiatives and solution delivery. * **Level V:** Typically 12\+ years including enterprise architecture, platform strategy, standards, and roadmap leadership. * Strong customer service, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills. **Preferred Qualifications** **Microsoft 365 \& Collaboration Platforms** * Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Teams, Power Platform, governance, and information architecture. * Experience supporting enterprise collaboration, content management, and productivity platforms. **Integrations, Automation \& AI** * Experience with Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, PowerShell, and automation tooling. * Experience implementing Copilot, Copilot Studio, agents, bots, and AI\-enabled productivity solutions. **Content, Records \& Operational Support** * Experience with records management, content lifecycle, OCR, imaging, enterprise content management, and search. * Experience supporting Agile delivery, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, GitHub, testing, and solution lifecycle management. **Certifications** * Relevant Microsoft, Power Platform, SharePoint, Azure, AIIM, ITIL, or comparable certifications are preferred. **Leveling Overview** * **Engineer III** – Independently delivers, administers, supports, and modernizes digital workplace solutions while resolving moderately complex issues and improving processes. * **Engineer IV** – Provides technical ownership, leads complex initiatives, architects scalable solutions, and resolves advanced integration, governance, and operational challenges. * **Engineer V** – Establishes enterprise technical direction, defines architecture principles and standards, leads platform strategy, and influences long\-term solution evolution. **Advantages of Working at GSOC** Working at GSOC means more than just a job\-it is an opportunity to contribute to work that truly matters. **Mission\-Driven Impact** Your work directly improves how employees collaborate, communicate, automate work, and access information across the organization. **Modern Workplace Innovation** Lead initiatives involving Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, AI\-enabled solutions, automation, and enterprise collaboration platforms. **Strong Values and Professional Standards** Work in an environment grounded in accountability, collaboration, integrity, security, and continuous improvement. **Work Environment \& Benefits** GSOC offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, educational assistance, retirement benefits, and opportunities for professional growth. **Apply Today** If you are ready to design and deliver modern digital workplace solutions that improve productivity and user experience, we encourage you to apply. ***GSOC does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from staffing agencies, search firms, or third\-party recruiters. Candidates submitted without an active, signed recruiting agreement will not be eligible for placement fees or commissions.***

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, GC Events
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. GC Events is our answer to the question *"Can I run my homecoming, reunion, gala, or auction on GiveCampus, too?"* The product is revenue\-generating, well on its way to product\-market fit, and serving a real, repeat need across our 1,500\+ Partner schools. It's also one of the biggest growth levers in front of us. We're hiring a **Senior Product Manager** to own GC Events end\-to\-end—not just the roadmap, but the commercial outcome. You'll be accountable for whether the number moves, and you'll drive everything required to move it on the product side: strategy, discovery, execution, shipping quality and velocity, launch readiness, adoption, operations, and any third\-party vendors and integrations that sit in the flow. Engineering is one big input, and a critical one—but it isn't the whole job. The whole job is making GC Events the undisputed first choice for schools looking for best\-in\-class software to power event registration, ticketing, and auctions, and delivering 10x revenue growth by the end of 2027 while we do it. You won't do that alone. GC Events has a dedicated GTM Lead who is your commercial counterpart—co\-accountable for the number and responsible for messaging, positioning, pricing and packaging, launches, campaigns, sales enablement, demos, and RFPs. The two of you are joined at the hip. They bring the market and the buyer; you bring the product and the build. Together you make sure GC Events is built, shipped, positioned, sold, adopted, loved, and driving commercial results. This is a PM role for someone who wants to operate like a GM of the product, ship like a builder, and go deeper with users than anyone else at the company, including in person at their events! It's also a PM role for the AI\-native era. You reach for AI across your entire workflow—research synthesis, data analysis, drafting, prototyping, experimentation, shipping—and you think about AI as a core capability of the product itself, not a feature you bolt on. You'll report to the Head of Product and work in close partnership with your GTM Lead counterpart, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partner Operations, Partner Success, Marketing, Business Development, and Business Operations. **Successful Outcomes** * **Commercial results, co\-owned—whatever it takes:** You and your GTM Lead co\-own the GC Events commercial KR. Not a backlog. Not a velocity number. Not a feature list. If we ship the right thing but the number doesn't move, that's on both of you. If we ship nametag printing but the printers never arrived on time, it doesn't matter that we shipped it. You're accountable for the product half of the equation and whatever else it takes across functions, vendors, and external partners to actually move the number. * **Insanely close to users:** You know GC Events better than anyone else on the planet, and you know our Partners the same way. You're on a text\-message basis with the fundraisers running events at our schools—swapping voice notes with them on a Tuesday morning, showing up in person to watch them run regis  own analyses and don't wait on someone else to pull the query. * **AI\-native operator.** You've integrated AI across your full PM workflow—research synthesis, data analysis, drafting, prototyping, experimentation. You've used AI\-powered tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, v0, Figma Make, or similar) to go from idea to working prototype—and, ideally, to a shipped fix, experiment, or companion app that solved a real problem. Just as importantly, you have a point of view on how AI shows up as a capability of the product itself: which problems it's best suited to solve, where it earns a spot in the core flow, and how human\-in\-the\-loop should work. You're actively exploring what's possible and excited about this shift in what a PM can do. You don't confuse "I can build it" with "I should build everything"—you have judgment about where your hands\-on contribution multiplies the team versus where it distracts. * **Technical fluency with engineers.** You hold your own in discussions on software architecture, security, data modeling, and integrations. You participate in technical decisions because you understand the tradeoffs, not because you're performing depth. * **Execution and cross\-functional leadership.** You've led and continuously improved the full execution loop—sprint planning, standups, refinement, retrospectives, resource allocation, roadmap execution—and you treat velocity as a first\-class metric. You've partnered closely with GTM, sales, customer success, and marketing counterparts to move a commercial outcome, and you know the difference between driving their work yourself and amplifying the person whose job it is. **Cultural Characteristics** * Dynamic, emerging leader who is better at listening than speaking * Thrives in ambiguity, creates order in chaos, and consistently thinks two steps ahead * Hands\-on builder excited to go deep into technical requirements, user flows, and data—and to reach for AI or open a PR when that's the fastest path * Operates AI\-first by default—AI is in the flow across research, drafting, analysis, prototyping, and shipping; not bolted on as an afterthought * Strong collaborator who will naturally work cross\-functionally but is also comfortable operating independently * Intensely curious, always pushing to understand why things are the way they are and how they got that way * Operates with a sense of urgency, maintains a fast pace, always pushing for faster * Holds themself and others to high standards; always pursues excellence * Deep sense of ownership and accountability; low maintenance, low drama * Comfortable with strong opinions, loosely held—advocates passionately, then commits fully once a decision is made * Runs towards big, ambitious goals rather than away from them * Passionate about advancing the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education * Radical empathy for our Partner schools, the fundraisers doing the hard work, and the donors who want to make a difference **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Data and Evals
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** The bottleneck in building reliable, useful AI is no longer writing code. It's defining what good looks like and measuring how well our products deliver it. That takes high\-quality data and evals that teams can trust. Our team owns data and evaluation science for Glean's AI products. We build evalsets, agentic LLM\-judges, and benchmarks that capture what good looks like, along with the platform and infrastructure that run evals reliably at scale, and enterprise simulation environments where we test how our assistants and agents actually perform. Starting from real production usage, you'll turn what we learn into evals that guide improvements across the entire stack, from agent harnesses to tool use, skill iteration, model routing, and post\-training of task specific models. You'll bring new research into production and partner with R\&D, product, and GTM to turn findings from evals into better products and customer outcomes. If you care about quality and want to build the systems that measure it, this role is for you. **You will:** * Build evalsets and benchmarks from expert\-curated examples, production data, synthetic data, and past failures, covering edge cases and key user slices. * Build and scale the eval platform and agent observability: experiment pipelines, trace capture and replay, and dashboards, with reproducible, affordable runs. * Build agentic LLM verifiers for correctness, groundedness, citation quality, and task success, and calibrate them against human labels using clear rubrics. * Run evals at every stage, from CI and pre\-release suites to sampled production traffic, and report results with confidence intervals. * Build enterprise simulation environments with simulated users and realistic company data to test multi\-step agent tasks. * Diagnose failures by slice and trace, and turn eval results into concrete fixes, weighing quality against latency and cost. **About you:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong Go and/or Python and backend fundamentals: APIs, data modeling, testing, and distributed pipelines. TypeScript is a plus. * Experience building datasets and benchmarks for LLM use\-cases, RAG, or agents, including evalset curation and synthetic data generation. * Familiarity with eval methodologies and their tradeoffs: deterministic metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, pointwise vs pairwise grading, human labeling, and judge calibration. * Experience building eval or experiment infrastructure that runs reliably at scale, including CI/CD integrations and observability tooling like OpenTelemetry. * Strong analytical skills: you dig into traces and failure cases, write SQL, and use data and metrics to explain why quality moved. * Nice to have: experience with simulation environments and/or model post\-training techniques. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst - AI & Firewalls
jobs.description: . **Title:** Cybersecurity Analyst **Company:** Global Power Components – www.globalpowercomponents.com **Location:** Milwaukee, WI (onsite 5\-days/week) **Hire Type:** Direct Hire **Position Summary** GPC is seeking a hands\-on Cybersecurity Analyst whose primary focus is AI and firewall security. You will secure and govern the AI tools the business adopts including Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI agents, and third\-party generative AI services while owning the day\-to\-day administration of our Ubiquiti UniFi firewall and network security controls across our sites. The focus is securing AI, not building it; however, hands\-on experience implementing AI solutions is required so you understand how these tools are deployed and where their risks lie. You will also support security operations, incident response, and governance, working closely with the IT team, engineering, and operations to keep a modern manufacturing environment secure, resilient, and productive. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **AI Security \& Governance (\~40%)** * Review proposed AI tools, agents, and use cases for security, privacy, and data\-protection risk; define the security requirements they must meet; and verify those controls are in place before go\-live. * Help develop and enforce GPC’s AI acceptable\-use policy and standards, and maintain an inventory of approved AI tools, agents, and integrations. * Secure Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI assistants by reviewing data permissions and oversharing and applying sensitivity labels, data loss prevention (DLP), and audit controls (e.g., Microsoft Purview), so AI tools surface only data users are authorized to see, and engineering drawings, designs, and customer information stay protected. * Detect and manage unsanctioned “shadow AI” use through firewall application control and content filtering, cloud app discovery (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps), and endpoint and browser policies. * Assess AI agents, plugins, connectors, API integrations (e.g., Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for excessive permissions, credential and secrets exposure, logging gaps, and supply\-chain risk, and enforce least privilege for agent identities. * Threat\-model and test AI\-enabled applications against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, and MITRE ATLAS including prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data poisoning, and excessive agency. * Evaluate AI vendors’ data handling, retention, use of customer data for model training, and security controls as part of third\-party risk reviews. * Monitor AI usage and AI\-related security events and investigate misuse or data exposure. * Create user guidance and training on safe AI use, including how to recognize AI\-generated phishing and deepfake voice or video impersonation. **Firewall \& Network Security (\~35%)** * Administer, configure, and maintain GPC’s Ubiquiti UniFi firewall platform, including zone\-based firewall policies, application\-aware (Layer 7\) rules, NAT, intrusion detection and prevention (IDS/IPS), content and URL filtering, SSL/TLS inspection, region and domain blocking, and threat\-signature subscriptions (e.g., UniFi CyberSecure). * Design and enforce least\-privilege segmentation between GPC’s separate network environments including corporate, guest, production/shop\-floor (OT), and IoT across multiple sites and buildings, using VLANs, firewall zones, and identity\-aware policies (e.g., Microsoft Entra integration). * Configure and secure site\-to\-site connectivity (IPsec VPN, Site Magic SD\-WAN) and remote access (e.g., WireGuard, Teleport), including hybrid connectivity to Microsoft Azure. * Maintain firewall high availability and resilience (e.g., Shadow Mode failover, multi\-WAN), firmware and UniFi OS updates, and configuration backups through UniFi Site Manager. * Own firewall change management: evaluate rule and exception requests for business justification, implement approved changes, and keep rule and exception documentation current. * Conduct scheduled firewall rule\-base reviews to remove unused, shadowed, or overly permissive rules. * Forward firewall, IDS/IPS, and network logs to the SIEM, and investigate anomalous traffic and threat alerts. * Manage host\-based firewall policies for servers and workstations (e.g., Windows Firewall through Microsoft Intune) to complement network controls. * Support network security projects — such as new buildings, gateway deployments and upgrades, and network redesigns including testing, cutover, and documentation. **Security Operations \& Incident Response (\~15%)** * Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across endpoints, identities, email, and cloud using SIEM/XDR tools (e.g., Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel), including threat hunting informed by MITRE ATT\&CK. * Use AI\-assisted security tools (e.g., Microsoft Security Copilot) to accelerate investigat ologies for example, applying data\-protection and access controls for generative AI tools, governing AI usage, or assessing LLM\-based applications for security risks. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience administering firewalls and network security, ideally on Ubiquiti UniFi gateways; experience with other enterprise platforms (e.g., Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, or Sophos) also applies. * Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing and switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and VPN (IPsec, WireGuard, SSL). * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Azure security, including Entra ID, Intune, Defender, and Purview. * Familiarity with security and AI frameworks: NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST AI RMF, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT\&CK, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and MITRE ATLAS. * Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management tools. * Scripting or query skills in PowerShell, Python, and/or KQL, including working with REST APIs. * At least one recognized security certification (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA CySA\+, or ISC2 SSCP), or the ability to obtain one within six months of hire. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical risk to non\-technical audiences. * Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and discretion. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to after\-hours incidents. * Ability to pass a pre\-employment background check. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building AI solutions with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, or Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), including grounding AI in business data (e.g., retrieval\-augmented generation). * Experience governing AI agents with Microsoft Agent 365 and Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Purview AI data\-security capabilities, or Microsoft Security Copilot. * AI certifications such as CompTIA SecAI\+, IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP), a GIAC AI security certification, or Microsoft exam AI\-103 (Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure). * Hands\-on experience with the UniFi Network application, UniFi Site Manager, CyberSecure, and Site Magic SD\-WAN. * Ubiquiti certifications such as UniFi Routing, Switching \& Cybersecurity Admin (URSCA) or UniFi Network Professional, or other networking and firewall certifications (e.g., CompTIA Network\+, Cisco CCNA, Fortinet NSE 4 or higher, or Palo Alto Networks Next\-Generation Firewall Engineer). * Advanced security certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate (SC\-500\), Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\), GIAC GCIH or GCIA, or ISC2 CISSP. * Experience with AI red\-teaming tools such as Microsoft PyRIT or NVIDIA garak. * Experience securing manufacturing or operational technology (OT) environments, including shop\-floor equipment, and familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443\. * Experience protecting engineering/CAD environments and intellectual property. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks common to manufacturers and their customers (e.g., NIST SP 800\-171/CMMC, ISO/IEC 27001\) and with AI management standards such as ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience designing or deploying segmented, multi\-site networks, including firewall deployments and migrations. **What Success Looks Like in the First Year** * Approved AI tools and agents are inventoried, governed by policy, and protected by data\-loss and access controls. * New AI tools and integrations receive a security review before approval, with required controls verified before go\-live. * Firewall policies are documented, reviewed on a regular schedule, and aligned to least privilege across all sites and network environments. * Security alerts are triaged within defined service levels, and critical and known\-exploited vulnerabilities are remediated within target timeframes. * Employees recognize and report AI\-enabled phishing and impersonation attempts.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to shape next\-generation AI solutions that directly power insurance workflows, support our Agentic AI product vision, and help deliver measurable outcomes for customers globally. **Job Description** ### **What you’ll do** * Lead the design, implementation, and evolution of Guidewire’s GenAI and LLM products, including data ingestion, feature pipelines, model training, fine\-tuning, deployment, and monitoring on AWS (e.g., S3, EC2, RDS, SageMaker). * Architect and build robust ML/LLM pipelines that power high\-impact use cases such as claim summarization, underwriting assistance, pricing and rating intelligence, and developer productivity tools across our product portfolio. * Develop and optimize LLM solutions using techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and fine\-tuning to deliver reliable, safe, and high\-performing experiences for insurance users. * Collaborate with Product Strategy, PDO, and Professional Services teams to align GenAI capabilities with the broader Product VPMOM, Agentic AI product roadmap, and customer adoption goals (including Claims Summary, Underwriting Assistant, Codelift, and other GenAI “lifts”). * Establish and apply ML Ops best practices for CI/CD, experimentation, evaluation, observability, and responsible AI, ensuring models are auditable, secure, and production\-ready at scale. * Mentor and coach engineers and data scientists, conduct code and design reviews, and champion technical excellence, including performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of AI workloads. * Partner with cross\-functional teams (Security, Finance, BizTech, GTM) to ensure AI solutions adhere to data governance and security controls, and contribute to Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers do business through cloud, analytics, and AI. * At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes. ### **What you’ll bring** ### **Required** * Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data\-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement. * 5\+ years of professional experience in Machine Learning and/or Data Science, including end\-to\-end delivery of production ML systems. * Deep expertise in Python and experience building scalable ML/LLM services and pipelines, ideally on AWS using services such as S3, EC2, RDS, and SageMaker. * Strong understanding of ML Ops practices for model development, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management (including CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model registries, and drift detection). * Hands\-on experience with classical and gradient\-boosting models (such as GLM, Random Forest, and XGBoost) and their application to real\-world business problems. * Deep understanding of neural networks and transformer\-based architectures for LLMs and chat models, including familiarity with open\-source foundation models and their fine\-tuning and inference. * Experience with prompt engineering, RAG and related LLM architecture patterns, and vector databases for semantic search and retrieval. * Solid knowledge of evaluating and monitoring LLM performance using NLP and LLM\-assisted metrics, with a focus on safety, robustness, and user experience. * Demonstrated technical leadership: driving design decisions, leading complex engineering efforts, mentoring peers, and conducting thoughtful code and architecture reviews. * **\*\*\*\*\*MUST HAVE GUIDEWIRE EXPERIENCE\*\*\*\*\*\*\*** ### **Preferred** * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience building data pipelines and features using SQL, Spark, or AWS Glue. * Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and creating backend APIs to expose ML/LLM services. * Famili up for success. In your first months, you’ll immerse yourself in Guidewire’s Product Strategy and GenAI roadmap, learn our cloud and data platform, and take ownership of one or more core components of the GenAI platform such as data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, or a flagship LLM\-powered feature. Within six months, you’ll be leading the design and rollout of new GenAI use cases across products like Claims Summary, Underwriting Assistant, and developer tooling, delivering measurable “GenAI lifts” that improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience for our customers. Your work will directly advance Guidewire’s mission to transform how P\&C insurers operate with cloud and AI, enabling secure, scalable, and impactful AI solutions that support billions of dollars in insurance transactions and help shape the future of the industry worldwide. ### **What’s in it for you** The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as: * Flexible work environment. * Health and wellness benefits. * Paid time off programs including volunteer time off. * Market\-competitive pay and incentive programs. * Continual development and internal career growth opportunities. You will also participate in our in\-person orientation process, which is part of how we build connection, collaboration, and a d understanding of Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to transform how P\&C insurers do business. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $162,000 \- $258,000\. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full\-time positions or part\-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well\-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance. Interested in this position? **About Guidewire** Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC. Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Construction
jobs.description: *Every day, our team members do amazing things in pursuit of our shared purpose to build trust with our clients, partners, subcontractors, and teammates. No matter your background, education, or career path, if you share our vision to create extraordinary experiences, you belong* ***at HITT****.* Robotics Software Engineer \- Construction**Job Description:** ==================== The Robotics Software Engineer is responsible for developing and deploying autonomous robotics solutions that must operate in some of the most challenging real\-world environments. This role will own work across the development lifecycle: creating proof\-of\-concept prototypes, maturing promising concepts into feature\-complete systems, and hardening those systems for reliable deployment on jobsites. This team member reports to the Robotics Software Lead and is part of HITT’s Robotics Team, which leads research and development, pilot programs, and full\-time field deployments. The Robotics Team’s mission is to support our project teams, transform our industry, and bring robots to every jobsite. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer who has a deep system\-level understanding of what it takes for robots to operate in unstructured environments, handle dynamic obstacles, safely work around people, and work reliably with limited networking and power infrastructure. Although they may specialize in autonomy, perception, or manipulation, they are comfortable contributing across the robotics stack and addressing issues that span software, sensors, compute, networking, and mechanical hardware. They can move quickly when building an early proof\-of\-concept while applying the engineering discipline needed to mature it into a field\-ready solution. We encourage strong candidates excited by this role to apply even if they do not match every technical qualification listed. **RESPONSIBILITIES** Robotics Software \& Systems Integration * Design, develop, integrate, and test software for complex field robotics applications. * Support the development and maturation of the HITT robotics software stack. * Integrate robot platforms, sensors, actuators, embedded computers, networks, and operator interfaces into cohesive systems. * Develop field\-ready autonomy capabilities, including localization, mapping, navigation, state estimation, and mission planning. * Integrate perception pipelines using cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, inertial sensors, and other sensing modalities. * Develop manipulation applications involving motion planning, controls, end effectors, calibration, and task execution. * Use simulation, synthetic data, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and repeatable test environments to accelerate development and reduce field risk. * Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity on robots, sensors, operator interfaces, and cloud services using wired and wireless networks. * Serve as a strong technical contributor across the stack while bringing depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in every discipline is not expected. Collaboration \& Partnerships * Collaborate with software engineers, hardware engineers, field testing engineers, vendors, partners, end users, and other stakeholders. * Integrate and extend third\-party technologies using APIs, SDKs, middleware, and other software interfaces. * Contribute to co\-development efforts with vendors and technology partners to establish technical requirements, resolve integration challenges, and evaluate solutions. Field Testing \& Deployment * Plan and execute structured testing in the lab, at test sites, and on active construction projects. * Deploy alongside field teams, observe real workflows, collect data, diagnose issues, and convert field feedback into engineering priorities. * Design for difficult real\-world conditions, including dust, changing lighting, uneven terrain, vibration, intermittent connectivity, dynamic obstacles, and frequent environmental change. * Support deployed systems through remote and on\-site troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Document architectures, interfaces, test results, deployment procedures, and lessons learned so solutions can be supported and scaled. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in robotics, computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field. * Master’s degree or 2\+ years of experience in developing, integrating, and testing field robotics systems. * Proficiency in C\+\+, Python, and Linux\-based robotics development. * Proficiency in modern software\-engineering practices, including version control (e.g., Git), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker). * Experience working with APIs/SDKs, open\-source software packages, and technical standards to bring together disparate technology components into a reliable solution. * Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic software development (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor). * Strong system\-level troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, networking, and field operations. * Ability to work effectively in uncertain, fast\-moving environments and take ownership of open\-ended technical problems. * Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics in written and verbal formats to various audiences. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize tasks across multiple projects. * Willingness to travel to active construction sites and participate directly in testing and deployment. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience developing robotic systems for construction, manufacturing, logistics, agriculture, mining, defense, or other demanding real\-world environments. * Experience developing robotic systems using Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2\) or comparable robotics middleware. * Experience in mobile robot perception, SLAM, and navigation for ground and/or aerial robots. * Experience developing or integrating mobile manipulation systems, including perception, motion planning, controls, end\-effector integration, and task execution. * Experience integrating robotic sensing and compute such as cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, IMUs, embedded computers, and GPU\-accelerated perception. * Experience writing and working with software drivers to interface with sensors, actuators, and embedded systems, including familiarity with communications protocols and peripherals (e.g., RS232/422/485, CAN, TCP/IP). * Experience developing low\-latency teleoperation systems for real\-time video, command, and telemetry streams, with graceful degradation amid intermittent connectivity. * Experience developing cloud\-connected robotics software workflows (e.g., Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS), web\-based operator interfaces (e.g., React, JavaScript/TypeScript), and real\-time video\-streaming pipelines (e.g., GStreamer). * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unity) and/or developing software for NVIDIA Jetson devices. * Familiarity with IP networking (e.g., subnetting, routing, DNS, DHCP) and mesh\-network radios, including diagnosing latency, packet loss, and connectivity issues in RF\-constrained field environments. In accordance with Virginia Senate Bill 215 (SB 215\), the base salary range for this position is: $82,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 Compensation in other cities and states may vary. HITT Contracting offers a competitive total benefits and compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, premium health care coverage including vision and dental, employer\-matched 401(k), wellness reimbursement program, paid holidays and time\-off, and other voluntary benefits and leave types. The determination of salary is based on the candidate’s individual professional experience, qualifications, education, skills, and training. ***HITT Contracting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring and developing the most qualified individuals based on job\-related experience, skills, and merit. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We value a respectful, inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. HITT Contracting maintains a drug\-free workplace, consistent with applicable local, state, and federal laws.***

jobs.title: Presales Solution Engineer - Edge AI
jobs.description: Presales Solution Engineer \- Edge AI **Description \-** **Role Summary** ---------------- The Presales Solution Engineer – Edge AI is a customer\-facing technical leader responsible for transforming Edge AI opportunities into measurable business outcomes and production\-ready solutions. This role works across the complete customer journey—from discovery and solution architecture through Proof of Concept (POC), validation, deployment, and production scale. The Solution Engineer serves as the technical bridge between customer requirements, HP's Edge AI capabilities, Advanced Compute platforms, partners, and delivery organizations. Success is measured not simply by successful demonstrations or POCs, but by the ability to move customers from concept to production and deliver measurable business value. **Customer Discovery \& Technical Strategy** -------------------------------------------- Partner with customers, account teams, Enterprise Architects, and business stakeholders to understand business challenges, technical requirements, workloads, infrastructure, data environments, and desired outcomes. Translate customer requirements into actionable Edge AI and Advanced Compute architectures and implementation strategies. Identify opportunities where AI inference, computer vision, intelligent edge workloads, advanced compute, and related technologies can improve customer operations or create new business capabilities. Connect near\-term opportunities with the customer's broader technology and AI strategy. **Solution Architecture \& Design** ----------------------------------- Design end\-to\-end Edge AI solutions incorporating the appropriate combination of: * Edge computing platforms and advanced compute * CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, and AI accelerators * AI inference and model deployment * Computer vision and intelligent edge workloads * Data ingestion and processing * Containers and orchestration * Edge management and observability * Networking, security, and device management * Cloud and hybrid\-cloud integration * ISV and ecosystem technologies Develop solution architectures that account for performance, scalability, manageability, security, reliability, cost, and operational requirements. **Proof of Concept Leadership** ------------------------------- Own the technical execution of customer POCs, pilots, and solution validations. Define clear POC objectives, technical success criteria, business outcomes, architecture, timelines, responsibilities, and exit criteria before execution begins. Configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and optimize Edge AI solutions in customer and lab environments. Ensure POCs demonstrate more than technical feasibility by connecting technical results to measurable customer outcomes. **POC\-to\-Production Ownership** --------------------------------- Serve as the technical owner for moving successful POCs into production deployments. Develop a clear productionization plan covering architecture, infrastructure, security, integration, operational readiness, support, monitoring, deployment, and scaling requirements. Identify technical and organizational barriers that could prevent a successful POC from reaching production and proactively develop mitigation plans. Partner with HP Services, engineering, partners, ISVs, Enterprise Architecture, and customer teams to create a smooth transition from presales validation into implementation. **Maintain technical continuity throughout the lifecycle: Discover Architect Validate POC Production Scale** **Edge AI Technical Leadership** -------------------------------- Serve as a subject matter expert within HP's Edge AI and Advanced Compute Practice. Maintain deep knowledge of emerging Edge AI technologies, architectures, AI models, inference frameworks, accelerators, compute platforms, and industry use cases. Build reusable architectures, technical patterns, reference designs, demos, POC frameworks, and deployment methodologies that accelerate future customer engagements. Capture lessons learned from customer engagements and feed those insights back into HP product, engineering, services, and practice development teams. **Sales \& Business Development Support** ----------------------------------------- Partner with sales and technical account teams to identify, qualify, and advance Edge AI opportunities. jobs.title: Manufacturing Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY** The Manufacturing Industrial Engineer will play a key role in redesigning HARLO’s manufacturing plant and developing the systems, layouts, and processes needed to support continued business growth. This is a new, hands\-on, on\-site position requiring someone who is comfortable spending significant time on the production floor, learning how work is currently performed, and turning observations into practical, sustainable refinements, and developing a robust process for continuous improvement plant\-wide through Kaizen events and other methods process enhancements. The successful candidate will independently assess operations, identify opportunities, establish priorities, and lead improvements from concept through implementation. This position will help develop a phased plant\-growth and operational\-improvement roadmap and will evaluate people, equipment, materials, methods, information, and facility constraints to create a scalable manufacturing operation that safely increases capacity, improves throughput, controls costs, and maintains product quality. The Manufacturing Industrial Engineer will partner with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and Management to translate business growth objectives into practical facility, equipment, labor, and process plans. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.** * Evaluate HARLO’s current plant configuration and recommend practical layouts, capacity plans, equipment strategies, material\-flow methods, and operating systems to support increased production volume and product complexity. Coordinate and implement approved changes. * Create and maintain an operational\-improvement roadmap that identifies and prioritizes opportunities based on impact, effort, cost, and implementation timing. * Spend 50\-70% of the time on the production floor observing how HARLO products and major subassemblies are built, engaging with employees, identifying constraints, and translating and turning front\-line knowledge into practical improvements into tangible implementations. * Design and implement approved assembly\-line concepts, subassembly cells, workstations, and material\-flow routes for HARLO product families, with emphasis on safety, ergonomics, quality, line balance, visual management, production continuity, and effective use of floor space. * Incorporate new product launch processes and procedures as defined between Engineering and Production to ensure seamless transition of new products coming into manufacturing flow are not disruptors to current product and gain production efficiencies expeditiously. * Ensure the 4M principles — Man, Machine, Material, and Method — are implemented across HARLO’s production / assembly plant to analyze, improve, and troubleshoot all processes. * Establish and maintain reliable production standards through process flows, value\-stream maps, time studies, takt and cycle\-time data, labor standards, workstation layouts, standard work, digital work instructions, and process\-control documentation. * Evaluate fixtures, tooling, equipment, and automation alternatives based on labor requirements, capacity, quality, implementation risk, and cost. * Lead approved manufacturing and process\-improvement projects from planning through implementation, working with appropriate departments to support successful adoption and sustained results. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This position does not initially have direct reports. During onboarding, the employee will develop an understanding of how production leadership manages labor, material flow, and daily operations. Where future opportunities for leadership develop, the candidate may have the opportunity to manage and lead employees upon alignment with management. The Manufacturing Industrial Engineer is expected to lead cross\-functional projects and improvement initiatives through collaboration, communication, and influence. **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** **To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and demonstrate the following:** * Self\-directed and comfortable helping build a new function, identifying opportunities, prioritizing work based on operational impact, and driving projects to completion with limited supervision. * Hands\-on approach with a willingness to work directly on the production floor, engage employees, observe processes, test solutions, and support implementation until improvements are successfully adopted. * Proficiency with CAD or facility\-layout software, process\-mapping tools, and Microsoft Excel. * Experience with ERP/MRP systems and data visualization tools. * Ability to analyze manufacturing processes, identify root causes of inefficiencies, and develop practical solutions. * Working knowledge of lean manufacturing methods, including 5S, standard work, value\-stream mapping, line balancing, visual management, root\-cause analysis, and mistake\-proofing. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across production and support functions. * Six Sigma training or certification is preferred. **EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE** **Qualified candidates must possess:** * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related field. * At least three (3\) years of relevant professional engineering experience, including demonstrated experience independently implementing manufacturing or process improvements. * Approximately five (5\) years of relevant experience is preferred for candidates whose background includes significant responsibility for plant\-layout changes, production expansion, or operational transformation. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This position requires regular interaction with manufacturing operations and time spent on the production floor. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is an on\-site position based in Grandville, Michigan or wherever the HARLO assembly plant activities may be. The work environment includes both office and manufacturing settings. The employee is required to follow all applicable safety (PPE) requirements while working in production areas. Pay: $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote**Little more about the team:** You'll be the product manager for our Canvas and Agentic AI teams \- the teams building Honeycomb's AI\-powered investigation experience. Canvas lets engineers use natural language to query, visualize, and understand their production systems. We're pushing well past chat: we're building Skills (pre\-configured workflows that encode domain expertise into repeatable, executable actions), Auto\-Investigations (agent\-driven investigations that kick off before a human gets paged), and a rearchitected Canvas that's both interactive and collaborative. You'll work in a tight triad with engineering and design leads, owning the roadmap for how AI shows up in Honeycomb, from the product UI to our MCP server. You'll partner with our Director of AI Strategy, Research \& Development teams, and our customer\-facing teams to stay grounded in what customers actually need while pushing toward something meaningfully different from what exists today. This is a role for someone who can hold both execution and ambiguity: shipping production features while navigating a product space where the right answers are still emerging. **What you’ll do in the role:** **Define AI product strategy in service of Honeycomb's vision** * Synthesize AI trends, customer needs, and technical capabilities into clear strategic recommendations * Help the product organization understand where and how AI creates genuine customer value vs. where it's hype * Identify emerging observability challenges created by AI adoption (e.g., LLM drift, prompt regression, low\-context generated code) * Make informed bets about which AI technologies and approaches warrant investment **Conduct research that bridges technology and customer reality** * Build deep understanding of how customers are adopting AI in their engineering workflows * Identify patterns across customer conversations that signal future market needs * Stay current with AI/ML developments (RAG, fine\-tuning, agentic systems, etc.) and translate implications for observability * Engage with technical communities, researchers, and early adopters to spot trends before they go mainstream **Enable AI innovation across the product portfolio** * Partner with product teams to identify high\-value opportunities to leverage AI capabilities * Provide guidance on AI approaches, trade\-offs, and best practices without centralizing all decisions * Help teams understand how their work fits into our broader AI strategy and how to leverage shared capabilities * Synthesize cross\-portfolio learnings and socialize what's working (and what isn't) **Evangelize the AI\-observability connection** * + Articulate Honeycomb's point of view on AI observability both internally and externally + Help customers understand how observability needs evolve as they adopt AI + Contribute to thought leadership through writing, speaking, and community engagement + Build credibility with technical audiences who care deeply about how we use AI, not just that we use it **What you’ll bring to the role:** **Proven AI product experience** * 5\+ years in product management with at least 1\+ year shipping AI/ML\-powered products * Track record of taking AI features from concept to customer impact, including things that didn't work * Deep understanding of how engineering teams actually build, deploy, and operate AI systems (not just theoretical knowledge) * Familiarity with current AI/ML techniques and the judgment to know when they're applicable vs. overhyped **Strategic thinking with customer empathy** * Ability to synthesize disparate signals (research, customer feedback, technical trends) into coherent strategy * Comfort operating with ambiguity and making decisions without perfect information * Pattern recognition acros n—can explain complex ideas clearly to varied audiences * Ability to influence without authority across product, engineering, and go\-to\-market teams * Comfort presenting to customers, executives, and technical audiences * Collaborative mindset that elevates others' work rather than centralizing control **Curiosity and learning orientation** * Demonstrated ability to stay current in fast\-moving domains (AI is evolving weekly, not yearly) * Intellectual humility—you're more interested in learning than being right * Excitement about the intersection of AI technology and real customer problems * Energized rather than exhausted by the pace of change in AI Base Salary based on level of experience $198,500 \- $233,500 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer (Manager / Architect)
jobs.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to provide technical leadership for our engineering team and take on one of our most strategically important challenges: unifying a diverse ecosystem of analytics applications under a coherent, scalable technology platform. Our analytics landscape has grown organically across multiple teams and products. The result is a collection of powerful but siloed tools, each with its own technology stack, data contracts, and deployment patterns. You'll join a team that acts as the connective tissue bringing these applications together, making pragmatic decisions about when to consolidate and when to preserve the right tool for the right job. This role is for an engineer who is energized by ambiguity, skilled at reading distributed systems, and opinionated (but flexible) about platform design. You will work directly with engineering leads and data teams. As the team's technical lead, you will guide and mentor other engineers while remaining a hands\-on contributor.**What You'll Do** **Technical Leadership** * Set technical direction for a small team of platform engineers, translating requirements and architecture guidance into well\-scoped, sequenced work * Mentor engineers through pairing, code review, and design feedback, raising the team's standards for quality, testing, and documentation * Coordinate delivery across contributors, including distributed team members, surfacing risks and dependencies early * Remain a primary hands\-on contributor to the team's most complex integration and platform work **Platform Unification \& Integration** * Audit existing analytics applications to understand their underlying technology choices, data flows, and integration points * Design and implement integration patterns (APIs, event streams, shared data contracts) that allow siloed applications to interoperate without unnecessary rewrites * Build and maintain shared platform services (authentication, observability, configuration management, logging) that reduce duplication across applications **Data Pipeline \& ETL Engineering** * Develop a deep understanding of existing data pipelines owned by distributed teams, including their data sources, transformation logic, and dependencies * Partner with domain teams who have the deepest knowledge of their own data, acting as an integration architect and collaborator rather than a centralized pipeline owner; identify unification opportunities but defer to domain expertise on data semantics and processing logic **Cloud Infrastructure** * Deploy and manage platform services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP experience a plus) * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices using tools such as Terraform or CDK * Collaborate with the IT platform team to define deployment pipelines and reliability standards for integration services * Construct evidence\-based business cases for cloud feature adoption, translating technical requirements into business value, risk reduction, and compliance language that resonates with IT governance and procurement stakeholders **What We're Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on data engineering, integration, platform, or infrastructure work * 2\+ years in a technical lead role: setting direction for shared work, mentoring engineers, and reviewing code and designs * Proficiency in Python; comfortable reading and writing production\-quality code, not just scripts * Strong SQL skills, including working with large or complex datasets * Hands\-on experience with AWS (compute, storage, and at least one managed data service) * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools or coding agents in a professional context, and a genuine curiosity about how AI is changing engineering work * Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly: you can walk into an existing pipeline, tool, or codebase you didn't build and figure out how it works * Strong written communication skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with dbt and Snowflake * Experience with Apache Iceberg * Additional language proficiency, especially Spark or Java * Experience leading or coordinating engineering work across distributed or multi\-location teams * Experience with data pipelines (ETL/ELT), including schema management or data quality monitoring * Exposure to structured (SQL) and semi\-structured (JSON, Parquet, Avro) data at scale * Familiarity with analytics or ML platform tooling (Airflow, MLflow, or SaaS equivalents) **How You Work** We care as much about how you think as what you've built. The ideal candidate for this role: * Is pragmatic over dogmatic: comfortable making a clear recommendation and defending it, but changes course when someone presents a genuinely better argument, not just a louder one * Treats AI\-assisted tools as a normal part of how you work, not a novelty, and stays curious about how they change what's possible * Communicates tradeoffs clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Moves quickly from “I don't know this system” to “here's how it works,” and can produce a clear map of an unfamiliar codebase or pipeline * Understands that “don't touch what works” and “build it right” are often both correct answers, depending on context * Takes ownership of quality and reliability: you care about what happens after you ship * Multiplies the team's impact: shares context, unblocks others, and delegates real ownership rather than becoming the bottleneck **The estimated base salary for this job is $140,000 \- $190,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $168,000 \- $228,000 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.** **\#LI\-CL1** **\#LI\-REMOTE** **Position Level** ------------------ Manager**Country** ----------- United States of America

jobs.title: Cybersecurity, Architect

principles, reference architectures, technical standards, and security\-by\-default patterns, then build the capabilities needed to apply them consistently. * Translate cybersecurity strategy, risk priorities, and business requirements into executable architecture decisions and implementation roadmaps. * Lead security architecture reviews for new platforms, applications, integrations, cloud services, infrastructure changes, AI/compute workloads, and operational technology environments. * Design defense\-in\-depth architectures across identity and access management, privileged access, network segmentation, endpoint security, cloud, SaaS, application security, data security, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and OT or industrial control environments. * Define practical security requirements for systems and services, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, resiliency, secrets management, vulnerability management, and incident response readiness. * Partner with engineering and technology teams to secure integrations, APIs, production platforms, data pipelines, and software delivery processes throughout the technology lifecycle. * Develop reusable security patterns and guardrails that enable teams to deliver securely and consistently at scale. * Identify material technology risks, evaluate alternatives, document decisions, and recommend risk\-based treatment options to technology and business leaders. * Guide the design and evolution of security capabilities such as SIEM and security monitoring, EDR, vulnerability management, IAM, privileged access, cloud security, and security testing. * Review third\-party products, vendors, and managed services for architectural fit, security risk, control coverage, and operational accountability. * Support threat modeling, attack\-surface analysis, technical risk assessments, incident preparedness, and post\-incident architectural remediation. * Establish architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, decision records, and operating procedures that make the security program repeatable and auditable. * Partner with GRC and audit stakeholders to ensure that security architecture and control decisions are documented, testable, and supported by evidence. * Mentor cybersecurity engineers and technical stakeholders on secure design, risk\-based decision\-making, operational discipline, and incident readiness. * Provide clear technical recommendations, tradeoffs, and status updates to the Cybersecurity Partner and technology leadership. **ABOUT YOU** * 5\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security architecture, security engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. * Bachelor's degree in endpoint, cloud, SaaS, application, data, and infrastructure environments. * Experience designing security controls and reference patterns for cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, production systems, and data environments. * Familiarity with OT, industrial control, data center, or other operational technology environments, with the ability to adapt enterprise security principles to operational realities. * Experience with security architecture methods, threat modeling, risk assessments, zero trust principles, defense\-in\-depth design, and secure systems development practices. * Working knowledge of security frameworks and control environments, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX ITGC, PCI, or comparable standards. * Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical architecture decisions and drive adoption through implementation. * Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security decisions to engineers, operators, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience working with security vendors, MSSPs, auditors, and third parties, with the judgment to hold partners accountable for measurable outcomes. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, GIAC, or cloud security certifications are preferred. * Pragmatic, collaborative, and comfortable operating hands\-on in a fast\-moving environment where the security program is continuing to mature. **ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT** This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida.
