This position could participate in an on\-call rotation supporting critical systems and operations outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Participation, availability during assigned periods, and timely response to urgent incidents are essential functions of the role. The Systems Administrator is expected to provide exceptional customer service through phone, email, remote, and onsite support. This position also plays a critical role in assisting clients, sharing knowledge, mentoring Systems Technicians, and contributing to documentation and process improvement efforts. **Job disruption to customer operations. * Serve as the primary escalation resource for the Systems Technician technical team, providing guidance and expertise to resolve complex issues efficiently. * appropriate. * Provide consultations as needed with internal and external stakeholders by providing technical expertise and knowledge of client environments. * Provide consultations with the Systems Technician technical team regarding escalations, aiming to coordinate directly where possible, empower them to solve issues, and act as a mentor. * Follow up with Systems Technician escalations, providing insight regarding resolutions. * Develop and contribute to processes and knowledge base articles to enhance service desk and shared team efficiency and effectiveness. * Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, communication, follow\-through, and problem\-solving. *Technical Support \& Documentation* * Provide advanced end\-user, server, networking, points, virtualization platforms, and cloud technologies. * Support Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Troubleshoot advanced jobs.title: Strategic / Development Industrial Engineer (Senior Individual Contributor)
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO) and Strategic Planning organization is seeking a visionary, high\-impact Grade 10 Strategic / Development Industrial Engineer to lead the next era of operational transformation across our planning and capacity ecosystems. As a senior individual contributor reporting directly to the VP/GM of Foundry Capacity Optimization, you will partner closely with Staff Area Managers (AMs), Principal Engineers, and senior FCSP stakeholders to architect and execute a multi\-year digital and operational transformation roadmap. Your charter is clear: radically increase the strategic impact, velocity, and analytical depth of the organization without expanding headcount. You will eliminate manual data manipulation, disparate spreadsheet modeling, and repetitive reconciliation, enabling FCO engineers to focus on solving high\-value, complex semiconductor capacity and customer delivery challenges. **Core Responsibilities** **1\. Transformation Roadmap and Systems Architecture** * Define, architect, and deliver the end\-to\-end Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO) Digital Transformation Roadmap, aligning long\-range planning (LRP), capacity modeling, tool allocation, and operational execution systems. * Translate complex foundry operational workflows into automated, scalable, and resilient enterprise system requirements. * Establish quantifiable efficiency and productivity metrics to track manual labor reduction, cycle\-time compression, and decision\-velocity improvements across planning cycles. **2\. AI, Machine Learning, and Automation Implementation** * Spearhead the adoption of modern Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies to automate complex decision\-support pipelines, including automated tool mismatch identification, capacity balancing, and yield/mix scenario modeling. * Partner directly with Foundry Automation, Enterprise IT, software development groups, and specialized third\-party technology consultants to rapidly prototype, validate, and deploy production\-grade solutions. * Drive the transition from fragmented desktop spreadsheets and static databases to unified, low\-latency, automated enterprise planning engines. **3\. Data Integration and Elimination of Manual Reconciliation** * Eliminate the time engineers spend manually mapping, transforming, stitching, and reconciling disparate fab, demand, and tool datasets. * Partner with data engineering and business intelligence teams to establish a robust single source of truth for fab capacity, equipment lines, capital planning, and customer allocations. * Institutionalize automated exception handling, data anomaly detection, and self\-healing data pipelines across critical planning feeds. **4\. Industry Benchmarking and External Innovation** * Actively benchmark peer semiconductor foundries and adjacent hyper\-capital\-intensive industries, including advanced aerospace, automotive, display, and energy, for state\-of\-the\-art planning systems, algorithmic optimization, and operational efficiency methodologies. * Evaluate commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) platforms versus proprietary internal builds and develop disciplined business cases, ROI models, and technology roadmaps for executive review. * Bring external best practices into Foundry Capacity Optimization (FCO), fostering a culture of continuous modernization, technological curiosity, and systems thinking. **5\. Stakeholder Alignment and Change Leadership** * Function as a trusted technical advisor and thought partner to Staff AMs, Principal Engineers, and executive management. * Drive operational change management across diverse engineering disciplines, ensuring seamless adoption of new digital tools, automated interfaces, and standardized workflows. * Mentor and upskill the broader engineering cohort in modern analytical tools, automation scripts, and systems\-level problem solving. **Required Skills and Experience** * Proficiency with data analysis and automation tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, business intelligence platforms, or similar technologies. * Experience developing capacity models, facility layouts, or manufacturing systems. * Knowledge of supply chain processes, production systems, or factory operations. * Familiarity with forecasting methodologies and statistical techniques. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Experience within high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing, semiconductor foundry operations, or complex wafer fab supply chains, including familiarity with fab toolsets, lithography/etch/thin\-film constraints, cycle\-time dynamics, and capacity models. * Familiarity with commercial supply chain/capacity planning suites such as Kinaxis, Anaplan, SAP IBP, and Blue Yonder, as well as modern business intelligence architectures. * Experience engaging with and directing external technology vendors, systems integrators, and management consultants to execute technology pilots and full\-scale rollouts. * Demonstrated expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, Design for Excellence, or formal Business Process Re\-engineering (BPR). **Qualifications:** ------------------- * Bachelor's/BS degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field. * 12\+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree, 8\+ years with a Master's degree, or 6\+ years with a PhD in a relevant domain. We invite you to bring your expertise, vision, and creativity to make a meaningful impact on Intel's manufacturing future. Join us in shaping the next generation of technology solutions. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- US, Arizona, Phoenix, US, California, Santa Clara **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- This role is a Position of Trust. Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass an extended Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, SEC sanctions, and additional criminal and civil checks. For internals, this investigation may or may not be completed prior to starting the position. For additional questions, please contact your Recruiter. **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $191,220\.00\-269,950\.00 USD The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on\-site at their assigned Intel site and off\-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** The AI Data Engineer is a hands\-on technical expert who builds the data foundation and AI\-driven applications that help InterMed automate work and make better decisions. The role develops custom applications and AI agents that automate business and clinical workflows end to end, creatively leverages EMR and other healthcare data, and helps the Business Intelligence (BI) team grow its Python and AI\-assisted development skills. It also builds and optimizes InterMed’s cloud data platform on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, including the semantic models that power AI\-assisted reporting and self\-service, while supporting the existing SQL environment as workloads move to Fabric. The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in LLM and AI tooling and is excited to leverage AI capabilities to reshape data strategy **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Data Platform** + Assist with the migration of BI workloads from the on\-premises SQL and SSIS environment to Microsoft Fabric; assess which legacy packages to retire, rebuild, or re\-architect, and maintain existing SQL Server, SSMS\-based workflows, and SSIS packages to ensure continuity of reporting during the transition + Design and build data pipelines into Fabric OneLake from source systems (for example, eClinicalWorks, payer and ACO files etc.), including orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, alerting, and failure recovery + Complete the data warehouse build\-out across priority subject areas, applying a SQL\-based transformation framework (for example, dbt) for modular, tested, version\-controlled, and documented data models + Build and publish certified Power BI semantic models with governed measures, definitions, and business\-friendly descriptions that power Copilot report building and self\-service data agents, and support the transition of reporting from Tableau to Power BI + Build and maintain Python automation scripts and APIs that support data pipelines, applications, and agents + Ensure strong data quality, integrity, and security controls across the platform, including HIPAA and PHI safeguards and automated monitoring and alerting on key data quality metrics * **AI Use \& Development** + Evaluate and integrate LLM\-powered tooling (for example, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to accelerate data workflows and enable natural\-language data access + Establish team standards for responsible AI\-assisted development, including use of AI tools to write, review, test, and document code and queries, with human review of generated output + Use AI to optimize dashboard builds and capabilities for end user agents and self\-service analytics + Design, build, and deploy purpose\-built applications and AI agents that automate BI, IT, other administrative and clinical workflows end to end, from data intake through action and audit trail + Develop custom apps and agents using low\-code tools within the Microsoft ecosystem (for example, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Fabric data agents) and Python\- and LLM\-based custom agents for multi\-step workflows where low\-code tools fall short + Creatively leverage EMR and other data sources, including structured fields, clinical documentation, and other unstructured sources, to support new analytics, automation, and clinical and operational use cases, in compliance with HIPAA and PHI safeguards + Partner with IT on the integration, deployment, and ongoing operation of applications and agents + Serve as an advisor to IT and business partners on AI vendor point solutions: assessing fit, overlap with in\-house capabilities, data access and integration requirements, and build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs + Develop analyst capability in Python, flexible coding, unstructured data techniques, and AI\-assisted development through coaching, code review, and shared patterns and templates + Maintains strict confidentiality in alignment with HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability) guidelines and InterMed policies. + Perform other duties to support the mission, vision and values of InterMed. **MISSION AND VALUES:** * Follows InterMed’s mission to provide patient\-centered primary care, putting the patient first to deliver high quality, high value care. * Provide the highest quality care to our patients with a level of service that exceeds their expectations. * Maintain a positive attitude and always treat our patients and each other with dignity and respect. * Insist on honesty and integrity from each other and our business partners. * Make teamwork a core component of our relationships between physicians, colleagues, and patients. * Embrace change to better serve our patients. * Use business practices that feature individual accountability and group responsibility to ensure delivery of high value healthcare. * Have fun as we carry out our mission to serve. **SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES:** * Python or equivalent for data engineering: writing modular, testable pipeline code, custom operators, and data quality scripts * Proficient SQL and strong data modeling expertise, including dimensional modeling, star schema design, and performance optimization — with hands\-on experience in SQL Server environments * Uses AI coding assistants and LLM\-powered tools as part of everyday work to accelerate data engineering, analysis, and documentation; applies judgment, reviews AI\-generated output, and understands AI’s limitations * Experience designing Power BI semantic models, including relationships, governed measures, and descriptions that support accurate AI\-generated reports and answers * Deep knowledge of modern data architecture patterns (for example, lakehouse, medallion, or cloud ELT) and the ability to map a path from legacy on\-premises environments to those patterns * Hands\-on experience with a SQL\-based transformation framework (for example, dbt) and a pipeline orchestration tool * Experience building applications or AI agents that automate multi\-step workflows, using low\-code platforms (for example, Power Apps and Power Automate) and/or Python with LLM APIs and agent frameworks * Ability to work with unstructured and semi\-structured data (for example, clinical notes, documents, and JSON) in addition to relational data * Ability to coach analysts with varied technical backgrounds and raise team coding standards * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI and how they fit within a broader Microsoft environment (Azure, M365, Microsoft Entra ID) preferred * Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated environments; HIPAA/PHI familiarity a plus * Strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills; able to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and lead through uncertainty * Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, architecture tradeoffs, and migration plans to non\-technical audiences and leadership **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * **Education:** + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience * **Experience**: + 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience with AI, data engineering, BI development, or data architecture, with demonstrated ownership of production pipelines and infrastructure + Proficiency in Python for data engineering: transformation, automation, pipeline development and data quality scripts + Advanced SQL skills with hands\-on experience in SQL Server and SSMS\-based environments preferred + Hands\-on, daily experience using AI coding assistants and AI tools (for example, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to write, test, debug, and document code and queries + Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and how it integrates within a broader Microsoft technology environment + Deep understanding of data engineering, analytics, and end\-to\-end data workflows from source system to consumption layer + Demonstrated experience delivering at least one production application, automation, or AI agent that replaced a manual business process + Experience with version control, CI/CD workflows, and code review practices for data assets + Demonstrated ability to design, document, and govern enterprise data models and architecture Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

In this role, you will develop robust reliability analysis to assess the health of assets, components, and processes in line with JLL's enhanced Reliability \& Asset Management program, drawing on data from connected systems to continually refine maintenance strategies and meet outcomes\-based performance goals. You will also oversee root cause failure analysis (RCFA) of equipment issues, determining corrective actions that balance cost avoidance, return on investment, and client priorities to maximize asset reliability and efficiency. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and this role offers genuine opportunities for growth, including support toward globally recognized qualifications in Reliability and Asset Management (RAM) as your career develops with us. **What your day\-to\-day will look like:** * Prepare detailed work packages for planned maintenance activities, incorporating safety requirements, required permits, work sequencing, labor estimates, and associated costs * Develop and maintain standard work routines, task lists, and job plans within the CMMS, ensuring instructions include relevant parts, labor, craft, vendor, regulatory, and safety details * Update and maintain asset records in the CMMS, including new equipment entries, retirements, and field labeling, while keeping a library of drawings, manuals, and supporting documentation current * Support reliability activities such as root cause analysis, failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA), and preventive maintenance optimization (PMO), while helping implement precision and predictive maintenance routines * Rank asset criticality using Reliability Centered Maintenance approaches and help define proactive, cost\-beneficial maintenance strategies and risk mitigation plans * Facilitate operational event and equipment failure investigations, ensuring root causes are identified, corrective actions are prescribed, and follow\-up monitoring confirms effectiveness * Apply predictive maintenance technologies, including vibration analysis, oil analysis, infrared thermography, ultrasound, and motor current analysis, to assess rotating and moving equipment * Maintain accurate CMMS records and develop key performance indicators for equipment reliability, including planned/unplanned work ratios, cost metrics, and mean time between failures (MTBF) * Collaborate closely with Maintenance and Planning teams, reflecting the culture of collaboration that sets JLL apart, locally and across the globe **Required qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline, mechanical or electrical preferred * Formal maintenance planning and scheduling training * 1\-2 years of experience implementing RCM, CbM/PdM methods, and operating building automation and energy management systems * Solid understanding of asset management, data analytics, and capital planning approaches * Extensive knowledge of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire suppression systems * Familiarity with commercial, critical, manufacturing, laboratory, or distribution facility types * Proficiency with CMMS software and strong computer skills, including advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior client representatives * Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and interpret incomplete data sets to make informed recommendations **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in critical or regulated environments such as data centers, laboratories, manufacturing facilities, automotive, petrochemical, or pharmaceutical settings * Certified Reliability Leader (CRL) designation * Certified Maintenance Reliability Professional (CMRP) designation * Level 1 jobs.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer / Architect
jobs.description: Overview: CSG AI is building advanced AI systems for Keysight CSG that bring together agentic reasoning, machine learning, reinforcement learning, engineering software, simulation, emulation, measurement, and product integration to transform how complex engineering designs are explored, evaluated, and improved. Our ambition is to move beyond isolated AI assistants and point solutions. We are building systems that can understand engineering intent, reason across tools and data, coordinate specialized capabilities, act on virtual and physical engineering environments, and learn from the results. The goal is a foundation for AI\-driven engineering at scale, where intelligent systems can connect design intent to simulation, emulation, instruments, measurements, and product workflows, helping engineers explore larger design spaces and turn complex workflows into repeatable, adaptive, and increasingly autonomous capabilities. Responsibilities: **Role Overview** ================= As a Senior AI Systems Engineer / Architect, you will define and build the architectural backbone that connects AI reasoning with Keysight engineering tools, data, models, services, and products. You will design how agents represent state and context, coordinate work, invoke tools, exchange structured information, and interact with engineering environments. Your systems will span the full fidelity spectrum, from software simulators and digital models, through real\-time and hardware\-in\-the\-loop emulators, to instruments, measurement systems, lab automation, and physical test workflows. You will create the integration patterns that allow AI capabilities to operate coherently across these environments rather than as isolated prototypes. This is a hands\-on architecture and systems engineering role. You will shape core agentic abstractions while also building production\-quality software, APIs, orchestration services, tool interfaces, and backend integrations. You will work closely with ML, RL, Agentic DevSecOps, product, and domain teams to turn advanced AI capabilities into engineering systems that are powerful, extensible, reliable, and ready to become part of Keysight products and workflows. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Architect and implement the core agentic systems that connect LLMs and other reasoning models with engineering tools, APIs, data services, learned models, policies, and product workflows. * Design orchestration and multi\-agent reasoning flows using graph\-based, tool\-calling, or equivalent architectures, including clear semantics for state, context, memory, coordination, and execution. * Build backend services, APIs, SDKs, and integration layers that allow intelligent systems to invoke engineering capabilities, retrieve context, execute multi\-step workflows, and return structured, verifiable results. * Integrate AI systems with Keysight CSG engineering environments across design, simulation, emulation, physical measurement, test automation, laboratory systems, and product software. * Define robust agent and tool contracts, structured schemas, validation interfaces, state models, and error handling patterns that support predictable and extensible execution. * Design context, retrieval, memory, and persistence mechanisms that allow AI systems to reason over engineering intent, product knowledge, design artifacts, simulation and emulation results, measurement data, and workflow history. * Build production\-quality orchestration services with modular architecture, versioning, observability, tracing, auditability, and clear failure and recovery behavior. * Create reusable integration patterns for connecting AI systems with existing engineering platforms, enterprise services, data pipelines, compute environments, and product software. * Collaborate with product, UX, and application teams to turn agentic capabilities into compelling engineering experiences through product features, operator workflows, APIs, and intelligent assistants. * Partner with Agentic DevSecOps and runtime teams so agent workflows can be validated, monitored, governed, replayed, and operated reliably in production environments. * Work with ML and RL engineers to integrate learned models, representations, policies, evaluations, and feedback loops into larger agentic systems. * Prototype new agentic concepts rapidly, then harden the successful ones into maintainable, testable, documented, and production\-quality software components. * Define technical standards and architectural patterns for agent interfaces, tool integration, orchestration, APIs, context management, and product quality across CSG AI. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** =========================== * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience. * Typically 5\+ years of relevant experience building production software systems, AI platforms, distributed applications, engineering tools, or intelligent systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture or complex integrations. * Strong software engineering skills in Python and C\+\+ or another production systems language, with the ability to move between high\-level AI frameworks and lower\-level engineering integrations. * Experience architecting and building backend services, REST or gRPC APIs, SDKs, service integrations, and production software components. * Hands\-on experience with LLM application development, tool\-calling, agentic workflows, RAG, context management, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent systems. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, state management, concurrency, reliability patterns, and integration architecture. * Experience integrating software systems with external engineering tools, data sources, compute systems, workflow engines, or enterprise platforms. * Ability to design clean, structured interfaces for agents, tools, data exchange, validation, authorization, and error recovery. * Experience building maintainable production software with automated testing, version control, CI/CD practices, observability, profiling, and clear technical documentation. * Ability to translate emerging AI techniques into practical system architectures and collaborate across AI research, systems engineering, product engineering, and technical domain teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience integrating AI systems with engineering design, simulation, emulation, measurement, test automation, lab instrumentation, or other physical engineering workflows. * Experience with Keysight or similar electronic design, validation, measurement, test, lab automation, wireless, semiconductor, or telecom engineering environments. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent communication, structured tool protocols, or custom agent runtime interfaces and interoperability standards. * Experience with vector databases, knowledge graphs, semantic retrieval, multimodal context, document processing, or engineering knowledge systems. * Experience designing product\-facing AI features, copilots, autonomous engineering workflows, operator experiences, or AI\-enabled engineering applications. * Experience with GPU\-backed inference, model serving, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and performance optimization for AI workloads. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud\-native or on\-premises distributed services, observability tools, and production deployment patterns. * Familiarity with hardware\-in\-the\-loop systems, digital twins, emulator control, instrument control, SCPI, VISA, measurement automation, or real\-time engineering systems. * Experience with security, authorization, policy enforcement, audit trails, validation, or governance mechanisms for AI\-enabled workflows. * Background in high\-performance computing, scientific computing, EDA, wireless systems, semiconductor workflows, electronic measurement, or other complex engineering domains. Santa Rosa, CA Pay Range: MIN $156,740\.00 \- MAX $261,230\.00 Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest. About the role: **Vacancy Status** This is an existing job vacancy.**What you will do** * Own customer solutions end\-to\-end. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy solutions in live operational environments where the stakes are real and the timeline is short. * Deliver relentless customer value. Build trusted relationships from the IC level to the executive sponsor and become the technical face of our company in the room. * Run multiple threads. Carry several customer engagements in parallel based on customer priorities and pod capacity. Set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when reality shifts, operate without close supervision, and own the outcome. * Operate as a SEAL team. A small, tight, multi\-disciplinary unit with focus and urgency tasks are traded seamlessly to whoever is closest to the skills needed. * Make the product better. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings into durable platform capabilities not one\-off scripts. * Drive adoption and lead the change. Mentor customer operators and guide their teams through solution transitions, so the new way of working actually sticks. **What we are looking for** * **AI \& Agentic Development** * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering. * Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty. * Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state. * **Software Engineering** * Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts. * Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase. * Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems. * **Data Engineering \& Platforms** * Ability to build and maintain data pipelines ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents. * Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals. * Strong   forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats is a strong signal, though not a requirement. **How to succeed in this role*** You measure your own success in business outcomes efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements not lines of code shipped. * You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities. * You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision. * You are curious and pragmatic you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new. * You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders written, verbal, and in the room. * You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours no waiting for perfect clarity. * You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver without being told. * Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not. * You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed. * Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric and you still ship. * You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working. * Ability to travel as required up to 50% **\#****Intermediate** **\#LI\-CS1** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more. **Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs, training, and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com. jobs.description: IBC Special Inspections/Construction Field Technician and Materials Tester L.E. Gregg Associates is a Kentucky\-based multi\-disciplinary science and engineering firm that provides geotechnical, environmental, special inspection, and construction materials testing services to commercial, industrial, governmental and institutional clients throughout the state of Kentucky. Special inspections technicians requires a self\-reliant individual that is capable of reading and interpreting plans and specifications to ensure that what is being built matches the plans and building codes. While we are a professional service company, what we ultimately provide is a public service. We are the last line in structural safety. A Special Inspector is responsible for performing Construction Materials Testing (CMT) as well as Special Inspections in accordance with the Kentucky Building Code and/or International Building Code. The goal for this testing and inspection is to ensure that the client and owner are receiving a quality product. The engineering technician represents L.E. Gregg engineers in the field on a daily basis. Activities include but are not limited to: observing the placement of engineered fill materials, observing concrete placement including sampling and testing the concrete being placed, review of reinforcing steel in footings and slabs, review of plans and specifications. Additionally, the position will include assisting in the L.E. Gregg Laboratory. Key Characteristics Beyond the basic ability to read and understand plans and specifications perform required tests and observations, and provide well written and timely daily inspection reports, an L.E. Gregg Special Inspection Technician is expected to: Aggressively pursue the mandate given to us by the building code and our client to ensure that the project is being executed appropriately. There is no reason to ever only look at one item on a job site. Act at all times in the best interest of L.E. Gregg, its engineers, the public and the project owner. Present yourself as a professional at all times, this includes conduct, punctuality, personal appearance, and equipment state. Seek to maintain and improve personal levels of competence and knowledge with regard to special inspections. Work as a team which would include effective internal communications and a willingness to pitch in on the task at hand. The position is closely tied to the construction industry and will require a flexible schedule, outdoor work and occasional overnights (very seldom). The position does not have to be based in Lexington, Kentucky; however, travel to Lexington will be required. Company truck, laptop and phone will be provided. The applicant shall have at a minimum: * A high school GED or diploma * A clean and valid driver's license * Be able to lift 80 pounds on a regular basis * Computer literate (will train in programs if needed) * Be self\-reliant and self\-motivating * Neatly and accurately complete all required paperwork, including daily reports, test reports and time sheets in a timely manner * Communicate orally and in writing with engineers and staff members, agency representatives, contractors and business and property owners * Perform maintenance/cleaning of equipment and calibration and adjustments as needed * Ability to perform tasks required of this position, such as, climb ladders and scaffolding, and negotiate uneven and irregular ground surfaces. The following are desired qualifications: Experience in the construction industry Knowledge of construction practices, materials and techniques. Ability to read plans and specifications Knowledge of the Kentucky or International Building Code ACI or ICC Certifications (will be trained if not already certified): ACI \- Concrete Field Testing Technician ICC \- Structural Masonry Certification ICC \- Pre\-Stressed Concrete Certification ICC \- Structural Steel / Welding Certification ICC \- Structural Steel Bolting Certification ICC \- Spray\-Applied Fireproofing Certification AWS \- Certified Welding Inspector Pay is based upon experience and current certifications. jobs.title: AI Automation & Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI\-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end\-to\-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100\+ customers across 80\+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White \& Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M\+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world\-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. * We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. * We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego\-free feedback. * We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. **About the role** ------------------ We want every employee at Legora to get more from AI. As an AI Automation \& Enablement Engineer, your mission is to raise the baseline of AI fluency across the company and help colleagues have their own aha moments with AI and automation. You’ll work as an embedded engineering partner to internal teams: understand how people work, build useful solutions alongside them and help them develop the confidence and skills to use AI independently. You’ll combine hands\-on building with practical teaching, turning promising experiments into reliable workflows that people use every day. You’ll work with tools such as Claude and Claude Code, OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Codex, Cursor, and other AI and automation platforms. You’ll choose the right approach for the problem, from a better way to use an existing tool to an integration or internal application. **What you’ll be doing** ------------------------ * **Find work worth improving:** Spend time with employees across functions to understand their tasks and identify opportunities to improve quality, reduce manual effort or remove delays. * **Create practical "aha" moments:** Work alongside colleagues on their real tasks. Help them provide useful context, break down problems, evaluate outputs and see where AI can meaningfully improve their work. * **Build automations and internal tools:** Use AI coding tools, scripts, APIs, agents and workflow platforms to take useful ideas through testing, rollout and ongoing use. * **Raise AI fluency:** Run hands\-on sessions and office hours, create clear examples and reusable workflows, and help employees build skills they can apply independently. * **Turn individual wins into shared practice:** Identify approaches that work, make them easy to reuse and help teams develop their own confident AI practitioners. * **Choose tools thoughtfully:** Evaluate new capabilities and explain the tradeoffs in usefulness, reliability, cost and ease of adoption. Simplify the process before automating it. * **Optimize model selection and spend:** Match models to the task, comparing quality, speed and cost to improve employee productivity and reduce unnecessary AI spend. Help teams understand when a faster, lower\-cost model is sufficient and when a more capable model justifies the additional cost. * **Make workflows dependable:** Test outputs and verify actions in connected systems. Work with IT, Security and system owners on appropriate permissions, human review, monitoring and recovery steps. * **Own adoption and improvement:** Follow up after launch, resolve failures and improve what you build based on how people actually use it. * **Measure the results:** Track changes in manual effort, turnaround time, errors, output quality and sustained adoption. Success means better work and more capable employees. **Who you are** --------------- * **A practical builder:** You’ve built automations, integrations or internal tools that other people use. You can explain the problem, your decisions and the resulting impact. * **An active AI power\-user:** You use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor for substantive work. You understand their limitations and can judge when AI, conventional automation or a simpler process is appropriate. You can match models to the task, balancing quality, speed and cost to improve productivity and reduce unnecessary spend. * **A clear, patient teacher:** You enjoy working with people at different levels of confidence, explain technical ideas simply and help others solve problems themselves. * **Curious about how work gets done:** You ask useful questions, find the underlying problem and translate a vague request into a practical next step. * **Thoughtful about reliability and access:** You verify results, handle sensitive information carefully and know when an action needs human review or a system owner’s input. * **Accountable after launch:** You follow through on documentation, maintenance and adoption, and stay focused on whether the work is delivering value. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building internal AI tools or delivering practical AI enablement programs. * Experience connecting agents to business applications, APIs and knowledge sources. * Experience evaluating AI outputs, testing workflows or monitoring integrations. * Examples of tools, guides or workshops that helped colleagues adopt a better way of working. **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ * **Visible impact:** Help employees across Legora do better work and build lasting confidence with AI. * **Room to build:** Work directly with the people using your solutions and see their feedback shape what you deliver. * **Global collaboration:** Partner with colleagues across Europe, APAC and North America. * **Competitive package:** Comprehensive salary, benefits and tools for success. * **In\-person environment:** Union Square office and company provided lunch daily. ### **Benefits \& perks** We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: **Medical, dental \& vision** * Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente * HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) * Dental plans via MetLife * Vision plans via Vision Care **Family support** * Generous parental leave * Free access to Maven Clinic * Dependent Care FSA * Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents **Additional perks** * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * Life Insurance \+ STD/LTD * 401(K) with generous company match * Unlimited PTO * Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer** At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Compensation Range: $172,550 \- $233,450

jobs.title: Agentic AI Developer-IVR Modernization
jobs.description: **Description** **Leidos** is seeking an experienced **Agentic AI Developer** to support the Enterprise Health Sector in modernizing and enhancing its customer service and Interactive Voice Response (IVR) capabilities through innovative artificial intelligence technologies. The successful candidate will design, develop, integrate, and deploy intelligent, AI\-driven conversational solutions that improve customer interactions, automate complex workflows, and enhance the overall user experience. This position will focus on leveraging **Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and cloud\-based technologies** to develop scalable, secure, and reliable voice\-enabled applications supporting the mission. The ideal candidate will have strong software development experience, hands\-on knowledge of AI agent frameworks, and experience integrating conversational AI solutions with enterprise applications and existing IVR platforms. **Primary Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement Agentic AI solutions to enhance and modernize enterprise IVR and contact center applications. * Develop intelligent conversational AI agents capable of understanding user intent, maintaining conversational context, and executing multistep workflows. * Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Natural Language Processing technologies into voice\-enabled applications. * Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and backend integrations connecting AI agents with enterprise systems, databases, and business applications. * Develop AI\-powered voice interactions using speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, and conversational AI technologies. * Design and implement agent orchestration workflows, tool integrations, and automated decision\-making capabilities. * Integrate AI solutions with existing IVR and contact center technologies, including platforms such as Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Genesys Cloud, or comparable technologies. * Develop and optimize prompt engineering strategies, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and AI agent workflows. * Collaborate with software engineers, solution architects, business analysts, and customer stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Implement security controls, authentication, authorization, privacy safeguards, and human escalation mechanisms for AI\-enabled applications. * Evaluate and improve AI solution performance, including response accuracy, latency, reliability, and overall customer experience. * Conduct unit testing, integration testing, performance testing, and troubleshooting of AI\-enabled applications. * Support Agile software development practices, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and technical documentation. * Ensure AI solutions align with applicable federal security, accessibility, and compliance requirements. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of relevant experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree, subject to contract requirements. * Hands\-on software development experience using Python, JavaScript, Java, or similar programming languages. * Experience developing or integrating AI/ML solutions, conversational AI applications, or LLM\-powered systems. * Experience with REST APIs, microservices, and enterprise application integration. * Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agent orchestration, tool calling, context management, and automated workflows. * Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with Natural Language Processing, speech recognition, and conversational AI technologies. * Experience working within Agile software development environments. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to meet customer\-specific suitability and background investigation requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience developing Agentic AI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar technologies. * Experience developing and integrating IVR or contact center applications using Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, Genesys Cloud, Twilio, or comparable platforms. * Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, OpenAI APIs, or other enterprise LLM platforms. * Experience developing voice\-enabled AI agents and integrating speech\-to\-text and text\-to\-speech technologies. * Experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and semantic search capabilities. * Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless architectures. * Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, AI guardrails, and responsible AI development practices. * Experience integrating AI applications with legacy enterprise y civilian agencies. * Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements. **About the Role** This position provides an opportunity to contribute to the modernization of the customer\-facing technologies by developing intelligent, secure, and scalable AI\-driven solutions. The Agentic AI Developer will play a key role in improving automated customer interactions, reducing reliance on traditional menu\-driven IVR systems, and enabling more natural, efficient, and accessible communication experiences. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. **Original Posting:** --------------------- October 22, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. **Pay Range:** -------------- Pay Range $131,300\.00 \- $237,350\.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. **About Leidos** Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. **Pay and Benefits** Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits. **Securing Your Data** Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. **Commitment to Non\-Discrimination** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. The GeoAI team is building next\-generation AI\-powered data automation platforms for ADAS and autonomous driving. We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to develop scalable auto\-labeling technologies that transform fleet\-collected sensor data into high\-quality training datasets with minimal human intervention. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision, spatial AI, and large\-scale data infrastructure. You will work on perception models, 3D scene reconstruction, foundation models, and automated data\-generation systems that accelerate autonomous\-driving development. **The Role:** **Build Next\-Generation Auto\-Labeling Systems** * Design and deploy production\-scale auto\-labeling solutions for 2D and 3D object detection, semantic and panoptic segmentation, lane and road\-structure extraction, multi\-object tracking, occupancy, scene understanding, and traffic\-participant behavior. * Develop automated label validation, confidence scoring, consistency checks, and quality\-monitoring frameworks. * Build active\-learning and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that improve label quality while reducing manual annotation effort and turnaround time. * Create teacher\-student and model\-assisted labeling workflows for large\-scale camera and LiDAR datasets. **Develop Advanced Perception and Fusion Models** * Research, train, and evaluate camera\-based and LiDAR\-based detection, segmentation, tracking, depth\-estimation, and occupancy models. * Develop multimodal fusion models combining camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS/IMU, and map context. * Improve temporal consistency, calibration robustness, and long\-tail performance across diverse driving environments and edge cases. * Build end\-to\-end ML workflows from raw sensor ingestion and preprocessing through annotation, quality control, and dataset delivery. **Leverage Spatial AI and 3DGS** * Develop 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and related reconstruction pipelines for large\-scale driving scenes collected from fleet vehicles. * Use reconstructed scenes for label propagation, synthetic annotation generation, annotation validation, rare\-case augmentation, and simulation. * Create scene\-centric representations that improve geometric accuracy and consistency across sensors, viewpoints, and time. **Apply Foundation Models to Data Automation** * Apply Vision\-Language jobs.title: AI & I Data Analytics Research Fellow – Radiation Oncology
jobs.description: **Why Mayo Clinic** Mayo Clinic is top\-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News \& World Report. As we work together to put the needs of the patient first, we are also dedicated to our employees, investing in competitive compensation and comprehensive benefit plans – to take care of you and your family, now and in the future. And with continuing education and advancement opportunities at every turn, you can build a long, successful career with Mayo Clinic. **Benefits Highlights** * Medical: Multiple plan options. * Dental: Delta Dental or reimbursement account for flexible coverage. * Vision: Affordable plan with national network. * Pre\-Tax Savings: HSA and FSAs for eligible expenses. * Retirement: Competitive retirement package to secure your future. **Responsibilities** The AI and Data Analytics (AIDA) team within the Department of Radiation Oncology at Mayo Clinic is hiring a Research Fellow to help advance the next generation of AI in cancer care: https://radonc\-aida.github.io ). We’re looking for an exceptional researcher that is technically strong, intellectually curious, and motivated by real\-world impact. You’ll join a uniquely positioned institution. Mayo Clinic treats over 1\.4 million patients annually and is consistently ranked among the most trusted names in medicine. Within this environment, AIDA operates as a fast\-moving, high\-impact team building and deploying AI tools directly into clinical workflows. Over the past year, our tools have moved beyond prototypes into active clinical use, supporting hundreds of clinicians across multiple specialties. Several have been recognized at institutional and national forums, reflecting both their technical innovation and measurable impact on care delivery. This is a rare opportunity to work on AI systems that are not only published, but used, evaluated, and iterated on in real clinical environments. Whether it’s building models to personalize cancer treatment, extracting insights from longitudinal clinical data, or deploying tools that streamline physician workflows, your work will span both foundational research and real\-world translation. We are looking for someone who could thrive in top\-tier tech companies or academia but chooses to work here because you want your work to matter to patients, to clinicians, and to the future of healthcare. **What You’ll Do** *Deploy impactful AI*: Develop, implement, and evaluate machine learning models in real clinical settings. Success is measured not just by publications, but by adoption, usability, and clinical impact. *Work on end\-to\-end systems*: Contribute to AI tools that integrate into clinical workflows ranging from predictive modeling to automation of documentation and decision support. *Lead ambitious research*: Design and execute novel research projects in collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of physicians, physicists, data scientists, and engineers. *Translate research into practice*: Help move ideas from concept to prototype to deployment to real\-world use, learning what actually works in healthcare. **Qualifications** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Biomedical Informatics, Engineering, Physics, Applied Math, Statistics, or a related field. * Strong background in modern machine learning (e.g., deep learning, transformers, or related methods). * Strong experience with Python and ML ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, scikit\-learn). * Strong communication skills: able to write and present complex ideas clearly. * Self\-motivated, execution\-focused, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems. **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $71,992\.20 \- $84,220\.50 / year; Education, experience and tenure may be considered along with internal equity when job offers are extended. **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** Monday \- Friday **Weekend Schedule** as needed **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview: We are looking for a strong Data Engineer with an analytical and Data Science mindset to help transform large\-scale product, customer, telemetry, behavioral, and operational data into trusted datasets, actionable insights, and predictive intelligence. This role will initially focus on Data Engineering, including building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets. With our core data pipelines and datasets increasingly established, the role is expected to quickly expand into Data Science, statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modeling. This is a Hybrid position based in Frisco, TX. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to the Frisco office. You will be required to be onsite on an as\-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work from your home office. We are not offering relocation assistance. Position Details: **About the Role** ------------------ * Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical datasets supporting analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. * Build reliable data ingestion, transformation, and feature pipelines across large\-scale product telemetry, customer, behavioral, feedback, and operational datasets. * Establish strong practices around data quality, observability, reliability, performance, and governance to ensure datasets are trusted and ready for analysis and modeling. * Use Python, SQL, Spark, and modern cloud data technologies to process, transform, analyze, and derive insights from large\-scale datasets. * Analyze product telemetry, usage, behavioral, customer feedback, support, and operational datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, friction points, and opportunities. * Develop meaningful features, metrics, cohorts, and customer segments that enable deeper understanding of customer behavior and product performance. * Progressively develop statistical and machine learning models to understand customer behavior, product usage, engagement, friction, and customer outcomes. * Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, segmentation, anomaly detection, time\-series analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling based on the problem being solved. * Develop and test hypotheses using statistical analysis and experimentation to understand the factors driving customer and product outcomes. * Build predictive approaches that help identify emerging customer issues, behavioral changes, product friction, performance issues, and other signals before they become broader problems. * Apply NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and Generative AI where appropriate to extract insights from unstructured customer signals such as feedback, surveys, reviews, and support interactions. * Evaluate analytical and machine learning models using appropriate statistical and ML techniques and ensure conclusions are supported by the underlying data. * Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate ambiguous customer and product questions into measurable data problems, analytical hypotheses, and actionable recommendations. * Move beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting by translating data into insights, predictions, recommendations, and measurable product outcomes. * Develop scalable approaches for operationalizing successful models against production datasets, including model monitoring and retraining where appropriate. * Measure whether insights and resulting product or engineering changes produce the expected impact, creating a continuous learning loop between data, insights, actions, and customer outcomes. **About You** * 5\+ years hands\-on experience in Data Engineering, with experience building and supporting scalable data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL with experience working with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets. * Experience with data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and modern ETL/ELT frameworks. * Experience working with cloud data platforms and services in environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, data transformations, performance optimization, and building reliable analytical datasets. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a demonstrated interest in moving beyond data engineering into Data Science, Machine Learning, and advanced analytics. * Working knowledge of statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, and predictive modeling. * Hands\-on exposure to Data Science and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Ability to move from raw data hypothesis analysis/model conclusion recommendation* measurable outcome. * Exposure to behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, segmentation, forecasting, predictive analytics, or other applied Data Science techniques is highly desirable. * Familiarity with NLP, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and Generative AI for extracting insights from structured and unstructured datasets is beneficial. * Coursework, certification, specialization, or a degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred. * Demonstrated ability and motivation to rapidly develop deeper Data Science and Machine Learning expertise while continuing to apply strong Data Engineering fundamentals. * Ability to convert loosely defined product or customer questions into measurable analytical problems and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. \#LI\-Hybrid Company Overview: McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. needs. * Proficiency with modern design, prototyping, research, and collaboration tools such as Figma, Claude Code, Cursor, Miro, Jira, and related platforms. * Strong command of UX methods and Analyze usage metrics, resolution rates, and user feedback to optimize automation logic, natural language processing (NLP) accuracy, virtual agents, and robotic process automation (RPA), while collaborating with HR and IT teams through agile delivery. * **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field and 4\+ years of experience in AI solution development, automation engineering, or platform configuration. * Experience with at least one agentic AI platform, such as Moveworks, ServiceNow Virtual Agent, or Workday Extend, OR an RPA platform such as UiPath. * Experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, or prompt engineering. * Programming experience using Python, JavaScript, or PowerShell. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer FDE
jobs.description: Engineering, Platform Full\-time **About Meeru AI** Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems, including ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, and HRIS, and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms: SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises, across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. **The Role** The **Staff Backend Engineer** owns the application and API services layer: the services through which everything the platform computes actually reaches a person. Multi\-tenant APIs, authentication and authorization, and the review and approval workflows where a controller accepts a result, challenges it, or sends it back. The computation layer produces the numbers. This layer is where a finance team sees them, interrogates them, approves them, and acts on them. That means your services carry the same correctness and auditability requirements as the computation beneath them, plus the access control and tenancy guarantees that let a Fortune 500 finance organization trust the platform with their close cycle. Every action taken through your services is part of an audit trail that sits next to externally reported financials. Who approved what, when, on the basis of which underlying result, and what changed afterward. That is not logging you add later. It is a product requirement, and it shapes how the services are designed from the first commit. This is hands\-on and high\-ownership. You own major services end to end, set backend patterns alongside the Senior Staff engineers, and partner with data, AI, and product on the contracts between layers. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. **Own the multi\-tenant APIs through which the platform's results are consumed.** Design the service contracts between the application layer and the computation, data, and AI layers, and own the versioning discipline that lets those contracts evolve without breaking consumers who cannot all move at once. 2\. **Build the review, approval, and exception\-handling workflows finance teams operate in.** This is where the product either earns trust or loses it. A controller who cannot see why a number is what it is will not approve it, and will not use the platform twice. 3\. **Build and maintain multi\-tenant isolation at the service layer.** Own authentication, authorization, and role\-based access across the application surface. Cross\-tenant leakage should be impossible by construction rather than prevented by convention. 4\. **Build the audit trail.** Who saw what, who approved what, on the basis of which result. Guarantee that every user\-facing figure links back to its computation and its source, and support the enterprise security and compliance reviews Fortune 500 finance customers run before they buy. 5\. **Build for a multi\-cloud\-ready, multi\-tenant\-ready, customer\-hosted deployment model.** Services that run inside a customer's environment with strong isolation and no data egress. 6\. **Own performance, reliability, and cost of the services you build,** including observability and operational health. You should be able to answer why a request is slow rather than guessing. 7\. **Set backend patterns, review designs, and mentor mid and senior engineers.** Partner with data, AI, and product on cross\-layer service design. **A note on accountability:** this role owns the application and API services, tenancy and access control, and the audit trail. It does not own the core computation layer, the data foundation, the AI layer, or product prioritization. **Requirements** Seven or more years in backend forward deployment engineering, with significant Staff\-level time owning complex production services. Owning them, including what happens when they fail. * Demonstrated ownership of services in a multi\-cloud SaaS environment, and a clear account of how you guaranteed isolation rather than assumed it. * An obsession with correctness and traceability. You treat "who did what, when, and on what basis" as a first\-class requirement rather than an audit checkbox. * Strong API and service design, including versioning, contracts, and backward compatibility. You have evolved an interface other teams depended on without breaking them. * Practical security engineering: authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. Not theory. * Python * FastAPI, Django, or Flask; PostgreSQL and Redis; * REST API design; Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform * SQL against Snowflake or PostgreSQL. **Nice to Have** * Finance, accounting, or fintech domain, or a genuine willingness to learn how financial statements are built and reconciled. * Multi\-tenant, customer\-hosted deployment at scale. * Supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 review. * Building auditable systems in a regulated environment. * Exposure to ML or LLM application patterns, enough to integrate them well. **Benefits** * Health and wellbeing. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with MeeruAI covering 50 % of employee premiums * Flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts with a company contribution * Unlimited PTO and 12 paid holidays. * 401(k) with company matching
