jobs.description: In 1965, an engineer in Scotland was given a mundane task with a tricky problem to it \- banks wanted to close on Saturdays and still serve customers, but they didn’t know how to solve authentication of the right user. James Goodfellow, working at Smiths Industries, uncovered the insight that you needed something you have (a card) and something you know (a PIN). Because someone told him they could only remember 4 digits instead of his proposed 6, today over 3 million ATMs use a card\+4 digit PIN over 60 years later. Like the ATM, Mercury is building technology that pushes forward financial interfaces for the long term. Command is Mercury's LLM\-powered financial assistant, launched to all customers in June 2026\. It lets users understand their finances and take action in plain language, from asking about cash flow to sending payments, issuing cards, and managing invoices. With the product now in customers' hands, the work is to evolve it, extend its capabilities, and find new ways to leverage LLMs to give Mercury customers a more powerful banking\* experience. ### **What You'll Do:** * Ship new capabilities users love * Feel a strong sense of product ownership and actively seek responsibility – help design and ship new Command skills * Partner with product and compliance teams to define what "working correctly" means for each new capability, then build the tests that prove it * Join a small but mighty team of experienced product and AI engineers building the future of Mercury * This list is illustrative. Command is a product in motion and priorities will shift as we learn. The right person should be comfortable working in ambiguity, in a scrappy startup environment ### **The Ideal Candidate:** * Has 1\-4 years of backend or full\-stack development experience, with knowledge of or excitement to learn Haskell, React, TypeScript, and Redux * Experience building LLM powered products * A builder who is passionately product\-minded and has experience building and shipping new products * Empathizes with users and can channel their perspective to build lovable products * Can balance tradeoffs and find creative solutions to accomplish goals * Actively incorporates AI tools into their workflow and is excited about leveraging them to amplify their impact — whether that's accelerating development, improving code quality, or finding creative solutions to hard problems If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com. Mercury values diversity \& belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. \#LI\-RA1 **Total Rewards** The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager, AI Experiences
jobs.description: **Overview** Microsoft Monetize powers an open, transparent advertising marketplace, connecting advertisers and publishers across thousands of websites and applications. Its buy\-side and sell\-side technology enables customers to access and trade premium advertising inventory efficiently and at global scale. The Monetize Real\-time Platform executes dynamic advertising auctions in less than 100 milliseconds, handles more than 8 million queries per second and approximately 100 billion requests per day, and generates more than 150 TB of new data daily. Its distributed systems support auction execution, ad delivery, and marketplace accounting under demanding performance and reliability constraints. We are seeking a **Principal Software Engineering Manager** to lead the Infrastructure, Operations and Shared Tech team. The team’s scope spans foundational infrastructure, production operations, and selected shared software services and libraries that power the real\-time platform. These capabilities include distributed caching, model and configuration distribution, low\-latency decision\-service integration, traffic management, and high\-volume logging and streaming pipelines. You will combine people leadership with deep technical judgment to advance platform architecture, operational excellence, and engineering productivity across hybrid on\-premises and Azure environments. You will guide engineers working on performance\-sensitive C/C\+\+ services, shared\-runtime modernization, distributed\-cache migrations, and the integration of model\-backed capabilities into real\-time serving. This role requires a leader who can connect infrastructure decisions to application behavior and business outcomes. You will own the team’s roadmap and delivery, develop engineers, and partner across platform, product, machine learning, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable shared capabilities that make the broader engineering organization more effective. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Transformation Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ Mosaic Health is seeking a hands\-on engineer with strong applied AI experience and deep knowledge of technology infrastructure and data pipelines. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role, not a people\-management position. You will build applications, integrations and automated workflows across apree, CareMore and Millennium Physician Group. Your work will connect operational needs with dependable technical solutions that improve service, reduce manual effort and support the business. You will take initiative and personally carry solutions from discovery through rapid prototyping, pilot deployment and value validation, then partner with IT, data and security teams to industrialize solutions approved to scale. You will spend a substantial portion of your time designing, writing, testing and troubleshooting code, including the data pipelines that support your applications. Success requires independent execution and close collaboration: you will seek input early, work constructively with operational, IT, data and security partners, and keep stakeholders informed. You will focus on a prioritized set of initiatives, understand differences in workflows and systems across the businesses, and build reusable capabilities that can be adapted to local needs. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Work with operational teams to understand workflows, handoffs, exceptions and sources of data. Turn an agreed business objective into a practical technical plan, identify missing information, and drive the next steps without waiting for fully specified requirements. * Build, collaborate on, and maintain AI\-enabled applications, backend services and integrations. Apply language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling where they solve a defined operational problem. * Design and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, validating and delivering structured and unstructured data. Handle data quality, schema changes, retries, duplicate records and backfills, and make data lineage and failures traceable. * Prototype and evaluate models, frameworks and software tools. Compare AI\-based approaches with conventional software and existing products, and recommend solutions based on measured quality, latency, cost, maintainability and operational fit. * Build evaluation datasets and automated tests for model outputs, retrieval quality and complete workflows. * Partner with IT, data and security teams across Mosaic Health on approved architecture, access, integrations and deployment. Build pilots within approved environments and, for solutions approved to scale, work with Technology to transition and industrialize them with appropriate identity and access controls, networking, secrets management, auditability and protection of sensitive information. * Collaborate with consultants and vendors while retaining hands\-on ownership of your deliverables. Review designs and code, contribute directly to implementation, and ensure documentation and knowledge transfer allow you to maintain and extend the work. * Work with business owners and Finance partners on pilot rollout, user feedback and value validation. Establish the baseline and track adoption, cycle time, manual effort, error rates, and realized operational and financial value to determine whether the solution should scale. **WHAT YOU BRING** * Typically, 5\-7 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on experience building and deploying AI\-enabled applications. Demonstrated ownership of production systems and the ability to explain technical decisions, failures and improvements. * Evidence of personally taking a product or workflow from an initial idea through pilot deployment and value validation, with demonstrated ability to partner on industrialization and ongoing improvement, including integrating language models into real applications. Able to explain what you built, how you resolved obstacles, and how you supported the solution after launch. * Strong backend development skills in Python and/or TypeScript, proficiency in SQL, and experience designing APIs, services and database schemas. * Practical understanding of language model APIs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs and tool calling. Able to design workflows around model limitations and select the appropriate approach for the task. * Experience evaluating AI systems with representative datasets and measurable quality criteria, including retrieval accuracy, unsupported outputs, edge cases and regression testing. Able to balance quality, latency and cost. * Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed applications, including compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, containers, queues, observability and CI/CD. Experience diagnosing production issues and making reliability, security and cost tradeoffs. * A record of taking initiative and delivering with limited day\-to\-day direction. Able to break ambiguous problems into manageable steps, make sound technical decisions, learn unfamiliar tools, and follow through on implementation and support. Recognizes when to seek input or escalate a dependency, bringing clear options and a recommended next step. * A collaborative working style: listens to frontline users, seeks and incorporates feedback, shares knowledge, and works respectfully across disciplines. Communicates progress and tradeoffs clearly, follows through on commitments, and helps partners resolve shared problems. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating data pipelines, including ETL/ELT, batch and event\-driven processing, orchestration, data validation and monitoring. Understands how source\-system behavior, data freshness, lineage and schema changes affect downstream applications and AI outputs. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred. * 5\-7 years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience serving as a technical lead, software architect, or principal engineer responsible for enterprise\-scale software platforms. * Expert\-level knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, cloud\-native application development, microservices, API design, engineering automation, CI/CD, secure software development, and enterprise application design. * Demonstrated expertise establishing engineering standards for AI\-assisted software development, including responsible AI adoption, code provenance, data privacy, software quality, and engineering governance. * Deep experience implementing and advancing full\-stack observability capabilities, including application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, telemetry, logging, cloud monitoring, and operational analytics across complex production environments. * Proven ability to influence enterprise technology strategy, lead cross\-functional engineering initiatives, establish technical standards, and build alignment across Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Information Security, and executive technology leadership. * Exceptional analytical, communication, mentoring, and technical leadership skills with demonstrated technical adaptability and experience evaluating, introducing, and operationalizing emerging software engineering technologies and industry best practices. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Digital Measurement
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Platform Engineer I – Digital Measurement** **WE CREATE EMPOWERED LEADERS!** At Milwaukee Tool, our most valued resource is our dedicated team of employees \- employees who work with a passion to be the best and have an unparalleled pride in their work and in the Milwaukee brand. We know that the only way to sustain growth and success is to value the growth and success of each person within the organization that's why we invest in an individual's growth and development from day one. Behind our doors you'll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you'll have the support and resources of the fastest\-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We're just getting started. **Build your career at the intersection of technology, digital commerce, and business.** **Your Role on Our Team:** At Milwaukee Tool, we believe our people and culture are the foundation of our success. As a **Platform Engineer I** , you'll join our Digital Platform team and help power the digital experiences used by Milwaukee Tool customers. You'll build expertise in digital analytics implementation by administering and helping own our Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) technical implementations across digital applications and experiences. You'll partner with engineers, architects, product managers, analysts, and business teams to translate measurement needs into reliable technical solutions and collaborate on closely aligned RudderStack event tracking. This is an early\-career role for someone with foundational familiarity and a strong interest in digital measurement, technical problem\-solving, and growing into long\-term ownership of our analytics implementation. **You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Administer, maintain, and improve Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 implementations across websites and mobile applications. * Translate business, product, and measurement requirements into tags, triggers, variables, events, and analytics configurations. * Take ongoing ownership of platform administration, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting, including resolving tracking issues, implementation defects, and production support needs. * Test and validate technical analytics implementations to support accurate, reliable data collection. * Use browser development tools, analytics platforms, and data to identify root causes and resolve measurement issues. * Support analytics projects through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing production support. * Collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts on RudderStack event tracking and shared measurement standards across digital experiences. * Use analytics data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve measurement quality and implementation effectiveness. * Document platform configurations, measurement standards, implementation decisions, and support processes. Develop toward independent ownership of our technical analytics implementation and become a trusted subject matter expert. * **The TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business or Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Digital Marketing, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of relevant experience, including internships, coursework, personal projects, or professional experience. * Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, digital measurement, or similar technologies; prior RudderStack experience is not required. * Basic familiarity with SQL or a willingness to learn. * Ability to break down ambiguous problems, ask thoughtful questions, and find practical solutions. * Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. * Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Systems thinking and an interest in understanding how technologies, platforms, and business processes work together. * Ability to collaborate with diverse teams across departments and geographies. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities. Basic familiarity with JavaScript, JSON, browser development tools, or web technologies; hands\-on coding experience is helpful but not required. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental, and vision insurance plans * Generous 401(k) savings plan * Education assistance * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service * And many more — check out our benefits site HERE *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Internal Systems
jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end\-to\-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting. Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis. We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **OUR STACK** ------------- * Agents: Claude across the company (in Slack, through the API, with skills and MCP), plus Mastra for the agents we build ourselves and Temporal for long\-running work. * Code: Python and TypeScript, scheduled jobs and webhooks. * The systems your agents work across: Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and the CRM, recruiting, HR, finance and compliance tools a growing company runs on. **THE ROLE** ------------ We build agents for marketers. This seat builds them for us. Every company our size runs on work nobody sees. Someone copies a new hire's details into six tools. Someone remembers which contract renews next month. Someone answers the same security questionnaire for the fourth time. Most companies hire a coordinator for that work. We're hiring an engineer. You're a forward\-deployed engineer for Minerva itself. Other companies call this an AI operations engineer or an internal AI engineer. Your customers are every team here: operations, finance, people, recruiting, sales and the founders. You sit with them, find the work they'd most like to stop doing, and replace it with a system that runs without them and leaves an audit trail. You report to our COO and work closely with engineering, which owns anything that touches production. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Own the company's knowledge agent.** One agent over our docs, Slack, calls and tickets, with Slack as the front end. It answers with sources, and people trust it. * **Automate the processes that run the company.** Hiring, onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, vendor reviews, customer security questionnaires, contract renewals and billing. Start where the hours or the risk are highest. * **Run the skill library.** Every team gets Claude connected to the tools it uses and a set of skills, each with a named owner on that team, an eval and the right permissions. What one person figures out, everyone gets. * **Own the source of truth.** Decide where each kind of information lives, move it there and keep it findable by people and by agents. When an agent spots something out of date, it proposes the fix and a person approves it. * **Build the plumbing under our operating dashboards:** the metrics, controls and board reporting that today get stitched together by hand from five systems. * **Put the guardrails in first.** Least\-privilege access, a human approval before any agent writes to a system of record, and audit trails that double as compliance evidence. * **Sit with your users.** Watch how a recruiter, a seller or our finance lead actually works, then automate the part they hate. * **Measure adoption.** Which systems get used, by whom and at what cost, including what we spend on models and which agents can touch what. Retire what nobody opens, and write the runbook for what stays. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * You've shipped agents or automations that coworkers use every week, and you can show the usage: who stopped doing what, and how many hours came back. * Production Python or TypeScript, with LLMs wired into real APIs. You're comfortable with OAuth scopes, webhooks and scheduled jobs, and with the ways each of them fails. * You know how a company runs. You can talk to a recruiter, a controller and a security auditor in their own terms, and you fix the process before you automate it. * A controls instinct. Before you ship, you've decided who approves what and what happens when the agent is wrong. * You're current. You know what shipped in AI tooling this month, and you can show us your own setup. * You write clearly. People follow your runbooks without asking you. * You're in New York City or willing to relocate. **YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…** ---------------------------------- * A founder or founding engineer who automated your own company's back office because someone had to. * A chief of staff or bus pped writing specs for engineers. * A solutions or forward deployed engineer who wants the whole company as your customer. * A GTM or internal tools engineer who automated a sales team and wants scope beyond the sales stack. * Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've automated your own job at least once. Apply. **NICE TO HAVES** ----------------- * You've rolled out Claude or another model platform to a whole company: access, permissions, usage and cost. * You've been through a SOC 2 or similar audit on the side that produces the evidence. * Hands\-on time with the systems a startup runs on: HRIS, ATS, CRM, billing and spend tools. **WHAT THIS ISN'T** ------------------- * An IT helpdesk. You'll automate the tickets away, not answer them. * Product engineering. Our customer\-facing agents and production infrastructure belong to the engineering team. * An AI strategy role. You ship systems people use. Nobody here needs a deck about transformation. * The owner of the work you automate. Our compliance lead still owns the security answers, and whoever runs sales ops owns the CRM. You build the systems that do the work for them. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** the knowledge agent is live in Slack and used daily. A new hire gets set up in every tool in under an hour, and the access record writes itself. At least three workflows run without a person in the loop and are still in use four weeks later. * **First 6 months:** security questionnaires go out the same day without a founder writing them. Contract renewals, notice windows and price increases surface before they cost us money. Every team has a system it would fight to keep. * **The number you own:** hours of manual work retired each month, measured against a baseline you set in your first month. **COMPENSATION** ---------------- $186,000–$236,000 base salary, depending on experience. Meaningful equity. Medical, dental and vision. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- Skip the cover letter. Show us one thing you built that other people used: a demo, a repo, or a few paragraphs on what the process looked like before, what you built, how many people used it and what broke. Applications without one won't be reviewed. **WHERE WE WORK** ----------------- We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. **BENEFITS** ------------ Every full\-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses. **PAY TRANSPARENCY** -------------------- The salary range in this posting is our good\-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process. **APPLYING** ------------ Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** ---------------------- You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** --------------------- Minerva is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State or New York City law. **RECRUITMENT FRAUD** --------------------- Our hiring runs through Ashby and @minerva.io email addresses. We will never ask you for money, bank details or other financial information during the process. If a message claiming to be from Minerva looks wrong, forward it to hiring@minerva.io. Compensation Range: $186K \- $236K

jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end\-to\-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting. Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **THE ROLE** ------------ A warehouse full of consumer data does nothing for a marketer until they can sort, filter and chart it in the time it takes to ask the question. Our data team builds the consumer graph and each brand's first\-party models, and our data scientists train scores on top. This seat makes all of it usable in the product: first\-party fields that respond instantly, scores on the pages marketers already use, segments that stay current, and an agent that turns a plain\-English question into the right query against a brand's own data. This is an IC or senior IC seat on product engineering, working day to day with data engineering and data science. Your counterpart on the warehouse side is our Staff Data Engineer, who owns the golden model and publishes the semantic views you build on. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * **Own how first\-party data performs in the app.** Any field a brand connects can be sorted, filtered and charted without a live warehouse query. You decide what gets precomputed, where it lives and how it stays fresh. * **Own how our models reach marketers.** Propensity, LTV, churn and product\-fit scores on the person, segment and product pages, with full distributions instead of a single number. * **Own dynamic segments.** Segments that update as new data lands, with stats ready for activation. * **Own the in\-app agent's query tool,** built on the semantic views our data platform team publishes. You own the path from a marketer's question to the right rows. * **Own the product side of the sync.** What gets precomputed, and the path from Postgres to the synced client. Each hop costs money and time, and you choose on purpose. * **Extend the pipelines.** You mostly build on what the data team produces. When a feature needs a table that doesn't exist, you write the model or pipeline step yourself. * **Ship end to end.** One feature can mean a Python Lambda, a Zero schema change and a TanStack Start page. You ship all three. **OUR STACK** ------------- * **App:** TypeScript, TanStack Start, React 19, Tailwind and Base UI, on Vite and Bun. * **Sync:** Zero on Postgres, schema in Drizzle. The app reads from a live\-synced local copy of the data instead of request\-response endpoints. * **AI:** Mastra for agents, Temporal for long\-running work. * **Backend:** Python on AWS Lambda. * **Data:** Snowflake, including semantic views and Cortex. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * Production experience with a cloud data warehouse. Snowflake preferred. * Production TypeScript, and backend services shipped on AWS: Lambda or similar. * You're current. You know what shipped in AI tooling this month and what changed in the latest release of the packages you depend on. * You build things on your own time, and you can show us. * You're in New York City or willing to relocate. **YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…** ---------------------------------- * A **full\-stack engineer at a data\-heavy SaaS company** who ended up owning the warehouse because someone had to, and liked it. * A **product engineer at a warehouse\-native analytics or activation company** who has spent years making Snowflake feel fast inside an app. * A **backend engineer who has shipped on a sync engine** like Zero, Replicache or ElectricSQL, and wants a dataset big enough to stress it. We'd be especially impressed by this one. * A **data engineer tired of handing tables to other teams** who wants to own the feature the table ends up in. * Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you built something this year that changed how you think data should reach a user. Apply. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** new scores and first\-party tables reach the app through a repeatable system you built. * **First 6 months:** any first\-party field can be sorted, filtered and charted without a live warehouse query, and the in\-app agent's query tool runs on your layer. * No single number. When product engineering has a data question, it comes to you. **COMPENSATION** ---------------- $150,000–$236,000 base salary, depending on level. Meaningful equity. Medical, dental and vision. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- Skip the cover letter. jobs.title: Staff AI Solutions Engineer - Nuclear & Safety
jobs.description: As a global leader in radiation safety, detection and measurement, Mirion Technologies is advancing radiation safety through innovative technologies and solutions. Mirion's Nuclear \& Safety business group builds the hardware, software, and services that keep nuclear power plants, laboratories and research facilities, defense operations, and radiation\-hazard workplaces safe and effective. We're investing in a small, high\-impact team of embedded AI Solutions Engineers who will sit inside our Nuclear \& Safety business units and turn everyday operational friction across manufacturing, quality, service, and back\-office workflows, into measurable efficiency gains using modern AI. This is not a research role and not a central\-platform role. You will spend most of your time with the people who run the business (i.e. plant managers, quality engineers, field service leaders, product managers), finding the highest\-leverage problems and then personally designing, building, and shipping the solution. Your toolkit spans the full range of applied AI: computer vision for visual inspection and image\-based QA, spectral and sensor\-data analytics, basic software development, and agentic AI / LLM\-based automation for decision support and workflow orchestration. You'll report directly to the Chief AI and Digital Officer, giving you a direct line to enterprise AI strategy while you operate with the autonomy of a startup engineer inside a public, nuclear\-regulated industrial company. What You'll Do Find and frame the opportunity * Embed within the Nuclear \& Safety business unit, attending their staff meetings, walking their production floor, shadowing their field service and quality teams to fully understand the business and landscape of problems * Build a first\-hand map of where manual, error\-prone, or slow processes are costing time and money. * Translate ambiguous, non\-technical pain points ("our detector inspection and QA review takes too long," "we can't keep up with service tickets") into scoped, buildable AI solutions, and build the business case for prioritizing them. Build and ship * Design and deploy solutions for use cases such as automated visual inspection of detectors and assemblies, defect and anomaly detection, spectral and sensor\-data analysis, and image\-based quality verification. * Design and deploy agentic AI systems (LLM\-based agents, workflow orchestration, and automation) to reduce manual effort in manufacturing, service, quality and compliance documentation, and other back\-office functions. * Own the full lifecycle: rapid prototyping, pilot with real users, hardening for production, and handoff or ongoing support, leveraging shared enterprise services and without waiting for a large team to do it for you. Communicate and drive adoption * Present progress, trade\-offs, and results in plain business language to business counterparts (plant managers, quality leaders, and executives who don't have an AI background) and adjust your approach based on their feedback. * Define and track the metrics (cycle time, error rate, cost, throughput) that prove a solution is actually working, and course\-correct quickly when it isn't. * Lead change management and light training so solutions get adopted, not shelved. Operate within the broader AI function * Partner with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and central AI/Digital team to stay aligned on architecture, security, data governance, and tooling standards, and to bring reusable patterns back to the center. * Apply appropriate rigor for a regulated nuclear environment (nuclear quality assurance, validation, documentation, export controls, cybersecurity) in partnership with Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance colleagues. What Success Looks Like in Year One * At least 2–3 AI\-driven solutions in production, each tied to a measurable operational KPI (time saved, defect reduction, cost avoidance, throughput gained). * A trusted, self\-sustaining relationship with business unit leadership. They should come to you with problems rather than reaching out to the CAIDO, directly. * A reusable playbook or pattern (for computer vision, for agentic workflows, or both) that can be extended to other Nuclear \& Safety business units or replicated by peer AI solutions engineers. What You Bring Required * 5\+ years shipping production software or applied ML/AI systems, with real users depending on what you built. * Experience in software engineering and cloud\-based application development and deployment * Hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or a comparable custom agent framework), including prompt design and retrieval\-augmented approaches. * Strong core software engineering: Python, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), APIs, and enough MLOps/DevOps fluency to get something into production and keep it running. * A demonstrated track record of high agency. Ideally a history of projects you identified, scoped, and delivered with minimal direction, not just tickets you executed that were assigned in JIRA. * Excellent communication skills with non\-technical audiences. Strong ability to clearly explain what a model does and doesn't do without jargon, and knowledge of how to build trust with non\-technical operators. * Comfort with ambiguity and autonomy. You will often be the only AI/software person in the room and working daily with those with little\-to\-no AI skills. You will be part of a team of centralized peers with strong skills but will operate independently to deliver business\-unit\-specific results. Strongly Preferred * Hands\-on experience building computer vision solutions (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow, image classification/detection/segmentation pipelines), or ML on spectra, waveforms, and sensor time\-series data. * Experience in Azure or AWS, Databricks, and Claude/OpenAI integration via AWS Bedrock or Azure Foundry * Experience in a regulated industry — nuclear power, defense, medical devices, or industrial manufacturing under a formal quality system (e.g., ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, NQA\-1\). * Prior experience as an embedded, business\-facing, or "forward\-deployed" engineer, solutions engineer, or applied AI generalist, rather than a purely research\-facing ML role. * Domain exposure to nuclear power plant instrumentation and controls, radiation detection and measurement, gamma spectroscopy, health physics, or radiation safety and monitoring workflows. Why This Role * Direct visibility with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and a real hand in shaping how AI gets built and scaled across Mirion Nuclear \& Safety. * The rare combination of startup\-style autonomy and ownership with the stability, resources, and mission of a global public company protecting workers, communities, and the environment. * A builder's role. You will ship things that change how people work, not produce slide decks about how AI might someday help. **Mirion Technologies (NYSE:** MIR) is a global leader in radiation safety, science, and medicine, protecting people and the planet from the harmful effects of ionizing radiation. Mirion Nuclear \& Safety powers Nuclear Power Plants, Laboratory \& Research (including spectroscopy and scientific analysis), Radiation Safety \& Monitoring, and Defense. Mirion offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes Vacation \& PTO Time, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching, HSA and FSA options, life and disability insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness resources, and several voluntary benefits including legal assistance, identity protection, and pet insurance.

jobs.description: NTT DATA's Client is seeking an experienced Data Modeler to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise data models supporting analytics, reporting, operational applications, data warehousing, and data integration initiatives. * The Data Modeler will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Data Architects, Data Engineers, analysts, application teams, and governance teams to translate complex business requirements into well\-defined conceptual, logical, and physical data models. * The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in enterprise data modeling, relational and dimensional modeling, data warehousing, cloud data platforms, metadata management, and data governance. Design models that appropriately support transactional, analytical, historical, and reporting requirements. Perform model normalization and denormalization based on application, integration, analytics, and performance requirements. **Data Warehousing \& Analytics Modeling** Design dimensional models for enterprise data warehouses, data marts, and modern analytics platforms. Define facts, dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and grain based on business and analytical requirements. Design appropriate approaches for maintaining historical information, including Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCDs). Participate in architecture and model design reviews to ensure proposed solutions comply with enterprise architecture and governance standards. Metadata, Lineage \& Documentation **Maintain comprehensive documentation for conceptual, logical, and physical data models.** **Document:** Business definitions Data entities and attributes Source\-to\-target relationships Data lineage Business rules Data ownership Transformation requirements Maintain model metadata using enterprise modeling and/or data\-cataloging platforms. Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into structured data models. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data consistency and quality. Ability to communicate data concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills across business, architecture, engineering, governance, and analytics teams. Ability to independently lead data\-modeling discussions and design reviews. **Ideal Candidate Profile** * The ideal candidate is a hands\-on enterprise Data Modeler, rather than primarily a Data Engineer or BI Developer, who can demonstrate substantial experience creating and governing conceptual, logical, and physical models. * Candidates should be able to provide concrete examples of enterprise data models they have designed, explain their approach to relational versus dimensional modeling, and demonstrate strong knowledge of data warehousing, SCDs, metadata, lineage, governance, and modern cloud data architectures. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Join NVIDIA’s Modular Diagnostics team and lead AI\-powered innovation. Our team develops key diagnostic applications and infrastructure to test every NVIDIA GPU. This ensures flawless performance before launch. As part of the Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure Solutions team you will build intelligent automation. This automation speeds up critical engineering workflows and improves GPU validation speed and quality. **What you'll be doing:** ------------------------- * Build and deliver agentic AI solutions—autonomous systems that reason, plan, and take actions. These automate silicon bring\-up, test and validation frameworks, debugging, and engineering workflows to speed up GPU launches. * Build scalable AI infrastructure, services, APIs, and reusable platforms that enable teams across NVIDIA to develop and deploy AI\-powered applications. * Integrate AI agents with engineering tools, knowledge bases, data platforms, and existing business processes to build end\-to\-end intelligent workflows. * Partner with multi\-functional teams across Modular Diagnostics and adjacent organizations to identify high\-impact use cases, define requirements, develop prototypes, and deploy production\-ready solutions. * Establish evaluation, observability, security, and reliability practices for AI systems to ensure solutions perform at scale and meet enterprise standards. Drive projects from concept through adoption, measure their impact against clear success criteria, and continuously improve their efficiency. * **What we need to see:** ------------------------ * BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years delivering production software, infrastructure, platform, or AI solutions. * Strong programming skills in Python and C/C\+\+. * Track record of building applications with large language models, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, or workflow orchestration. * Demonstrated ability to build scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and production software infrastructure. * Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and system\-design skills with a history of shipping reliable systems. Effective collaboration across technical and business teams, with clear communication and the ability to drive solutions from idea to production. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** ------------------------------------- * Background in GPU computing, CUDA, GPU architecture, or silicon bring\-up processes. * Familiarity with engineering diagnostics, hardware development workflows, or systems software. * Hands\-on work with MLOps, model evaluation frameworks, AI observability tools, or production AI monitoring. * Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or developer tools. * Prior work building internal developer platforms or engineering efficiency tooling. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD \- 241,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 26, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AV Analysis Platform
jobs.description: NVIDIA is seeking a senior software engineer to help build and scale evaluation and analysis infrastructure for Autonomous Vehicle development. This role sits at the intersection of AV tooling, distributed systems, data platforms, and developer efficiency. You will develop and enhance systems that allow AV engineers to run AV log data analysis, assess model behavior, debug regressions, and produce critical metrics and insights at scale. This engineer should be able to operate independently, partner deeply with senior technical leads, and bring clarity to complex platform decisions spanning evaluator execution at high\-scale, performance tunings, structured outputs and output schema evolution, observability, and production readiness. This role directly improves how AV engineers examine autonomous driving performance, analyze regressions, validate analyzers, and trust the results produced by NVIDIA’s AV infrastructure. The ideal candidate will help make evaluation workflows faster, safer, more observable, and easier for teams to adopt. **What you'll be doing:** * Design and build evaluation and analysis tooling used by AV and ML engineers. * Improve analyzer workflows, including onboarding, execution, qualification, and production observability. * Build reliable services, APIs, CI pipelines, and UI\-facing workflows across the stack. * Define and evolve data contracts for analyzer outputs, including structured schemas, tabular data, time\-series data, and metadata. * Improve system stability, performance, traceability, alerting, and operational debuggability for high\-scale workloads. * Partner with AV engineering, data platform, infrastructure, and product teams to deliver end\-to\-end user workflows. Establish guardrails for analyzer rollout, including pre\-merge validation, output\-size controls, runtime/memory metrics, and production monitoring. * **What we need to see:** * BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems, developer tools, data platforms, or evaluation infrastructure. * Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages. * Experience designing distributed systems, workflow orchestration, APIs, backend services, or data pipelines. * Ability to reason across systems software, data schemas, backend services, and user\-facing tooling. * Experience collaborating across teams and driving ambiguous technical work to completion. * Ability to balance new feature development with production stability, maintainability, and user support, while demonstrating agility and adaptability in a fast paced environment. Experience with Protobuf, Parquet, schema evolution, data contracts, and large\-scale analytical storage. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Background with self\-driving car development, simulation, evaluation, or analysis workflows. * Experience with observability, performance profiling, resource usage analysis, and production reliability. Experience improving legacy systems through incremental migration, deprecation, and architecture cleanup. * \#LI\_Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 26, 2026\. jobs.title: Software Engineer 6 - Ads Signals & Targeting
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We launched a new ad\-supported tier in November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. **Our Team** The Ads Signals \& Targeting team for Netflix Ads is responsible for improving ad supply eligibility through advancements in audience and contextual targeting, which is essential for ensuring a great member experience where members see the right ad at the right time. This involves managing the fundamental Signals and Target systems, and continuously evolving these systems to support outcome\-based optimizations and probabilistic modeled audience targeting. **The Role** As a Software Engineer on the Ads Signals \& Targeting team, you will be instrumental in developing and enhancing our ads targeting and audience capabilities, which leverage various signal sources to enable precise ad delivery and maximize advertiser value . In this dynamic and innovative environment, your contributions will have a significant impact on how we protect member data and privacy. You will collaborate with a team of talented professionals who are deeply passionate about ads technology and privacy, fostering a culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning. **Skills \& experience we’re seeking:** * 8\+ years of experience building distributed systems, core backend infrastructure, or high\-throughput platforms. * Proven leadership at an L6/Staff/Principal level, collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, design, and business, and delivering complex features with critical business impact. * Experience simplifying or consolidating privacy systems across teams, including sunsetting solutions that no longer serve the business. * Professional experience in designing and building user and contextual signals and audience targeting features for ad platforms. * Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, C\+\+, or similar, with a strong grasp of software development principles and design patterns. * Experience in developing distributed cloud\-based applications and proficiency in modern programming languages, preferably object\-oriented. * Proven experience in handling data at extremely large volumes with big data tools like Spark, and building high throughput low latency distributed systems that utilized the big data. * Track record of mentoring engineers within and beyond your immediate team and influencing technical roadmaps across adjacent teams through clear articulation of business impact. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and effectively manage multiple priorities. * Knowledge of the ad tech and advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising and digital marketing trends. Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams. * **Nice to haves:** * Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and security concepts, including Privacy by Design principles. * Experience with ads targeting using machine learning models. * Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $499,000\.00 \- $900,000\.00\. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

jobs.title: Sr Lead, Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **Job ID:** 18910 **Alternate Locations:** Remote **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high\-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day. **Reports To** Director, Global Reliability **Department** Engineering, Reliability \& Automation (ERA) **Organization** Global Supply Chain and Procurement (GPSN) **POSITION SUMMARY** The Sr. Manager, Reliability is a senior technical contributor and program manager within the ERA Global Reliability team, responsible for executing reliability improvement programs across a portfolio of Newell Brands manufacturing sites and distribution centers within the global network of 40\+ manufacturing facilities, 60 DCs, and markets in 140 countries. Reporting to the Director, Global Reliability, this role is a field\-level executor of the Newell Brands Strategic Equipment Management Policy (SEMP) — the company's governing framework for how assets are planned, acquired, operated, maintained, and retired across the global supply chain network. The Sr. Manager translates SEMP requirements into site\-level programs, assessments, and improvement plans, ensuring policy intent is operationalized consistently across assigned sites. This role owns hands\-on reliability engineering deliverables: asset criticality assessments, fleet management analysis, condition monitoring program builds, PM optimization, failure mode investigations, and reliability KPI reporting. The Sr. Manager acts as a working technical lead, supporting the fleet management strategy by executing site\-level programs that feed network\-wide asset intelligence — guiding site\-level reliability engineers and maintenance teams through structured improvement initiatives while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and site engagements. This role is a key execution engine for the Global Reliability Program within the ERA Strategic Master Plan. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Reliability Program Execution * Execute site\-level reliability assessments using the ERA reliability framework: asset registry validation, criticality ranking (FMECA\-based), PM plan audit, and condition monitoring gap analysis across manufacturing sites and DC facilities. * Develop and implement PM optimization plans using RCM principles, condition\-based triggers, and failure mode data; establish PM intervals grounded in equipment OEM data and operational history. * Lead condition monitoring program deployment at assigned sites, including vibration analysis routes, oil sampling schedules, thermographic inspection programs, and ultrasound surveys. * Execute the Tribo Program at assigned sites: conduct Tribo Scorecard assessments, develop site\-level lubrication improvement plans, support development of on\-site tribology SMEs, and track progress against network Tribo standards defined by the Director, Global Reliability. * Conduct and lead root cause failure analysis (RCFA) investigations for chronic failures and high\-impact asset events; own corrective action tracking through closure. * Build and maintain failure mode libraries and asset\-specific maintenance task lists within MicroMain CMMS. Fleet Management Execution * Execute fleet management assessments within assigned site portfolios: document asset populations by class (motors, drives, compressors, conveyors, automation equipment, etc.), validate fleet criticality ratings, and identify fleet\-level PM standardization gaps. * Contribute fleet performance data to network\-level benchmarking; identify poor\-performing assets within a fleet class and recommend lifecycle interventions (condition\-based replacement, refurbishment, or standardization). * Support the Director in developing capital replacement schedules for critical fleet segments; provide site\-level asset condition inputs to long\-range capital planning. * Implement fleet\-based spare parts strategies at assigned sites, including kitting standards and critical spare identification aligned to fleet criticality tiers. CMMS \& Data Management * Drive asset data quality within MicroMain: asset hierarchy integrity, PM plan completeness, labor hour capture, and work order classification accuracy. * Generate reliability KPI reports including PMR, MTBF, MTTR, planned vs. unplanned maintenance ratio, and backlog analysis at site and regional levels. * Support development of reliability analytics dashboards in coordination with the ERA AI \& Digital Enablement team. * Identify data gaps in CMMS cost fields and labor actuals; develop site\-specific data governance improvement plans. Site Engagement \& Coaching * Partner with site Engineering Managers and M d local reliability ownership and PM discipline at the front line. * Execute PEAK EFO pillar assessments at assigned sites, evaluating AM and PM pillar maturity against global standards; document gaps, develop site\-level improvement plans, and track progression through defined maturity stages in alignment with the Director's network\-wide EFO program. * Facilitate reliability\-focused kaizen events, PM standardization workshops, and condition monitoring training at assigned sites. * Support development of site Reliability Engineers through on\-site coaching, structured work plans, and technical mentorship. * Travel to assigned manufacturing sites (domestic and international) on a regular cadence to assess program execution and drive improvement. Program Management \& Reporting * Manage concurrent reliability improvement projects across a portfolio of 4\-8 manufacturing sites; maintain project plans, milestone tracking, and risk logs. * Report site\-level PMR, OEE, and condition monitoring adoption metrics to the Director, Global Reliability on a regular cadence. * Participate in PEAK operating reviews, contributing reliability KPIs and site action plans to the monthly/quarterly cadence. * Support development of reliability investment business cases, cost avoidance analyses, and capital justification documentation. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Coordinate with ERA Automation and OT teams to integrate condition monitoring sensors and edge devices into the site OT network architecture. * Partner with Operations to align reliability program priorities with production scheduling, planned outage windows, and capital projects. **QUALIFICATIONS** Required * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 7\+ years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering, or asset management in a manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with condition monitoring technologies: vibration analysis, oil analysis, thermography, or equivalent. * Experience with CMMS platforms for asset management, PM planning, and work order execution. * Working knowledge of RCM, FMECA, PM optimization, and root cause failure analysis methodologies. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and site engagements simultaneously. Preferred * CMRP, CRL, or Category I/II vibration analyst certification (ISO 18436 or equivalent). * Experience with MicroMain or similar CMMS platforms. * Familiarity with PEAK, Lean, or Six Sigma methodologies. * International manufacturing site experience; LATAM or EMEA exposure preferred. * Experience integrating condition monitoring data with industrial analytics or AI platforms. **COMPETENCIES** * Strong hands\-on technical capability in reliability engineering disciplines * Structured problem solver with a data\-driven approach to failure analysis * Effective communicator with site\-level teams and program leadership * The Remote base pay range for this position is from {MIN AMOUNT} to {MAX AMOUNT}. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this positionSelf\-directed with the ability to manage multiple priorities across a distributed portfolio * Collaborative team member with a continuous improvement mindset The Remote base pay range for this position is from $123,000 to $169,400\. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this position Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well\-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Director Engineering - Automation, Performance and AI Quality
jobs.description: At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. **So, what's the role all about?** We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to architect and lead our quality engineering discipline into the AI era. You will own automation infrastructure, performance engineering, and all AI\-driven quality initiatives — building and mentoring high\-performing teams of engineers and architects who set the standard for how modern software is validated at scale. This is not a maintenance role. You will disrupt legacy testing paradigms, champion agentic test generation, and embed AI\-quality thinking into every stage of the SDLC — from the first commit to production monitoring. You will be the organizational bridge between engineering velocity and product reliability. **How will you make an impact?** **AI Quality Strategy** * Define and lead all AI\-augmented quality initiatives across the organization * Deploy LLM\-powered test generation, triage, and root\-cause analysis tooling * Build frameworks for validating AI/ML model outputs and non\-deterministic behaviors * Evaluate and integrate emerging AI quality toolchains (GitHub Copilot, Claude, agents) * Champion responsible AI testing practices, coverage standards, and governance models **Automation Engineering** * Own the full automation strategy across UI, API, and integration layers * Architect scalable, maintainable test frameworks * Drive shift\-left testing embedded in CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) * Establish coverage KPIs, flakiness SLAs, and automation ROI metrics * Lead adoption of self\-healing and AI\-assisted test maintenance **Performance Engineering** * Lead performance and load testing strategy at enterprise scale * Define SLOs/SLAs and partner with SRE on reliability thresholds * Design continuous performance validation integrated into delivery pipelines * Drive root\-cause analysis for regressions, bottlenecks, and latency spikes * Oversee toolchain including k6, JMeter, Gatling, and APM integrations **People \& Org Leadership** * Lead and grow teams of automation engineers, performance engineers, and architects * Set technical direction, OKRs, and career ladders for the quality engineering org * Hire senior ICs and architect\-level talent; build succession depth * Foster a culture of ownership, engineering craft, and continuous learning * Partner cross\-functionally with Product, DevOps, and R\&D leadership **Have you got what it takes?** * 12\+ years in software engineering or QA, with 5\+ years in engineering leadership at the Director level or senior Staff\+ with direct reports * Deep hands\-on background in test automation architecture — you've built frameworks from scratch, not just inherited them * Proven track record leading performance engineering at scale (10,000\+ concurrent users, distributed systems, cloud\-native environments) * Experience shipping or operating AI/ML systems and understanding the unique quality challenges they introduce * Prior success managing multi\-team orgs with both IC engineers and architects (10–40\+ total headcount) * Enterprise software domain experience strongly preferred (SaaS, CCaaS, fintech, or similar high\-uptime/regulated environments) **AI \& Technical Acumen** * Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations relevant to software testing (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows) * Experience evaluating or integrating AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalents) in engineering workflows * Comfort with statistical testing concepts: model drift detection, data validation, behavioral testing for non\-deterministic outputs * Proficient in at least one scripting/programming language (Python, TypeScript, Java) and modern CI/CD tooling * Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Datadog, Grafana, Dynatrace, New Relic) **Leadership** * Exceptional communicator — able to translate deep technical concepts into executive\-level strategy and roadmaps * Strong organizational influencer who shapes culture and engineering standards beyond your direct org * Data\-driven decision maker: you measure quality outcomes, not just activity * Bias for hiring and developing senior talent; you build teams that outlast you * Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in fast\-moving environments ***About NiCE*** *NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.* *Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30\+ countries.* *NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

jobs.title: SWE Test
jobs.description: **About North Cloud** The public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. As AI accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them. At North, we’re building the next\-generation cloud, AI, and data spend management platform. We give companies real\-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money. Backed by top\-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, North is building the financial operating system for the public cloud. **About the role** Customers make financial decisions from the numbers North shows them, so our software has to work correctly and our numbers have to be accurate. You'll join the Experience team and own the test strategy and frameworks every engineer at North uses. You'll set the patterns, build the tooling, and keep the test suite fast and balanced. For now, the role is a mix, and hands\-on manual verification is still part of it. Engineers still test their own work. Your job is to make the right way to test the easy way, so testing well is part of how every team ships. We're hiring for this role without a fixed level. When a forecast is off, customers feel it, either in missed savings or in commitments that go unused. You'll join the Services team and own the models behind North's internal forecasting service, working with your teammates on the service that delivers forecasts across North's features. You'll shape how the service evolves, from how models are trained and evaluated to how forecast quality is monitored in production. interfaces. * Shape the forecasting service's architecture, including how models are trained, versioned, evaluated, and served. * Improve how we evaluate, backtest, and monitor forecast accuracy over with the Commitments, Visibility, and Data teams on what each feature needs from a forecast. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of software or machine learning engineering experience, including shipping time series models to production and owning them after launch. * Deep experience with time series forecasting across classical statistical methods and machine learning approaches, and judgment about when each fits. * Experience with time\-aware validation, backtesting, and forecast accuracy metrics, and an understanding of their tradeoffs. * Experience monitoring production models, including drift, anomaly detection, and retraining. * Fluency in Python and SQL, and experience with large datasets. * Experience collaborating with data scientists, and explaining model behavior and uncertainty to people outside engineering. * Pragmatic, informed use of AI coding tools. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience working as a data scientist, or doing analysis work alongside ML engineering. * Experience with probabilistic forecasting. * Experience forecasting usage, demand, or spend across many accounts with different patterns. * Experience with cloud usage, billing, or pricing data. * Experience with AWS ML services. * Familiarity with FinOps concepts. **Work Setup** Hybrid role based in New York City, with an office in Dumbo, Brooklyn Team members typically work in the office 2–3 days per week OR Remote US **Benefits*** Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks
