jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for an outstanding engineer with a real passion for design. Nubank's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI\-assisted solutions and 30\+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other. The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it. This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nubank scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- **NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30\+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful. **New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nubank scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally. **Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds. **Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Architect and build the systems design at Nubank runs on — increasingly agentic ones. * Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable. * Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function. * Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow\-up. * Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you. * Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade\-offs legible to people who don't read code. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **An outstanding, deeply experienced engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on. **A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front\-end infrastructure used by many teams. **A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them. **Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role. **A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260\-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project. **Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio. ### **Backgrounds that tend to fit** * Design systems and UI platform engineers at design\-led product companies. * Engineers at design tooling companies. * Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public. * Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design\-led product. ### **What this role is not** * Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar. * Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core. * Not customer\-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function. * Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.) Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world. We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire. **Job Summary** =============== Own the agentic systems at the center of Orbis AI — the orchestration, planning, retrieval, and tool\-use machinery behind the Agent Catalog and the OSINT Agent Harness. You will build agents that hold up under real mission workloads and set the evaluation bar the rest of the organization writes against. This is senior engineering on AI systems: the hard problems are correctness, explainability, cost, and behavior at scale. **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Architect and ship agents across the portfolio — knowledge agents over customer data, tool agents that wrap external operations, and goal\-driven agents that plan and execute multi\-step analysis. * Own the orchestration layer: planning, tool selection, state and memory, retries, partial failure, and termination behavior. * Design and own retrieval end to end — chunking, embedding, indexing, ranking, and the query\-time behavior that decides answer quality. * Build the provenance and citation paths that let a user see how a conclusion was reached, and treat unexplainable output as a defect rather than a limitation. * Own the evaluation infrastructure for agent quality — accuracy, groundedness, explainability, latency, and cost — and set the standard other engineers write cases against. * Integrate model providers and third\-party tools behind stable internal interfaces, and instrument agents so quality regressions and cost anomalies surface before a customer finds them. * Partner with research engineers to productionize validated results, and mentor engineers moving into AI work from a conventional software background. * Travel up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building LLM\-backed or agentic systems in production * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience * Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, with substantial production code in at least one * Deep practical experience with retrieval\-augmented generation — embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each * Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi\-step, tool\-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives * Proven rigor about evaluation, including harnesses that measured whether an AI change actually improved anything * Willingness to travel up to 15% **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution, or information extraction * Experience running open\-weight models in constrained or disconnected environments where a hosted API is not an option * Experience with production observability and cost control for model\-backed workloads * Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or research workflows and the accuracy and provenance expectations that come with them * Experience mentoring engineers into AI work from a conventional software background * Open\-source contributions, publications, or academic collaboration in applied AI **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,* *qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.* *Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non\-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.*

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: #### **Our mission:** Are you an experienced DevOps Engineer who wants to make a real impact on cloud infrastructure serving millions of users worldwide? You'll work with Kubernetes, automate infrastructure and deployments, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our cloud platform. At Open\-Xchange (OX), we develop open\-source communication and collaboration software used by public sector organizations, telcos, and hosting providers to keep data secure and under their control. Our products cover email, collaboration, DNS security, and related services, and are used by millions of people worldwide.#### **Discover what OX offers you:** * We work in a non\-hierarchical organization that empowers everyone to take responsibility, stay focused, and contribute directly to the company’s success and customer value. * We value expertise and continuous professional development. Our professionals work closely with experienced colleagues, take ownership of their work, and continuously expand their skills. * Openness and diversity are core to OX. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking strengthen our collaboration and help us see the bigger picture. #### **Your team:** The OX Cloud team operates the cloud infrastructure behind our open\-source products, serving millions of users worldwide. We work closely with engineering teams to automate deployments, improve scalability and ensure our platforms remain reliable, secure and observable. We're cloud\-native and Kubernetes\-first, running our platform on our own infrastructure and increasingly on hyperscalers. Our goal is fully automated, declarative and hands\-off operations. We're also evolving our DevOps approach and engineering culture, and you'll play an important role in shaping that journey.#### **Your new job:** * Automate the provisioning of infrastructure, products and configuration with Terraform, Helm and GitOps (Argo CD) in collaboration with other engineering teams. * Run our production environments on Kubernetes, both on our own infrastructure and on hyperscalers. * Develop and maintain Helm charts, support other teams with Helm\-based deployments, and extend the platform with Kubernetes operators where needed. * Contribute to the management and optimization of storage and database infrastructure. * Join our on\-call rotation to handle incidents, troubleshoot issues and improve overall system reliability. * Collaborate with developers and other engineering teams across the product lifecycle, sharing your expertise and helping us continuously improve our engineering practices and culture. #### **This is the tech stack you'll be working with:** * Platform: Kubernetes, on Linux * Automation: Terraform, Helm, GitOps with Argo CD * CI/CD: GitLab CI * Observability: Prometheus, Grafana * Languages: Go, Python, Shell * Databases \& storage: MariaDB/MySQL, Cassandra, S3 #### **Your background:** * Several years of experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and declarative tooling such as Terraform, Helm or GitOps (e.g. Argo CD). A background in software development is a strong plus. * Practical experience operating Kubernetes clusters and workloads, including Helm charts, troubleshooting distributed systems and working with Kubernetes operators. * Solid Linux fundamentals and an understanding of orchestration, automation and declarative, hands\-off operations. * Programming skills in Go, Python or Shell, along with experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab or Jenkins. Go is a plus. * Familiarity with databases and storage solutions. Experience with hyperscalers is a bonus. * Strong English communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with an interest in Open Source technologies and working in remote\-first, multicultural teams. * Ability and willingness to work primarily within East Coast US business hours to effectively engage with customers and internal stakeholders. * Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The company is not able to provide employment visa sponsorship at this time. #### **This is what you get at OX:** * The flexibility to work 100% remotely ensures a work environment that suits you best. * Flexible working hours that allow you to successfully combine your home and family responsibilities with work. * Getting together in\-person for workshops and fun team events. * Time off to volunteer – and mental health support when you need it. * We provide financial relief through corporate benefits and a subsidy for ergonomic chairs and desks. * We can discuss further location\-related benefits together in an initial talk. #### **Join the team:** Join us in our fight for an open internet and deliver added value! Click “Apply now” to submit your application.#### **Your contact person:** Reach out to Justin (recruiting@ox.io) from the People Team. He will be able to discuss current opportunities and tell you more about our exciting vision and mission @OX.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)
jobs.description: **Creative Technologist (AI Design Engineer)** ============================================== *Also known as: Creative Workflow Specialist · AI Workflow Designer* **About OpenArt** ================= OpenArt is a leading AI Creative Platform for visual storytelling, used by millions worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination. We're bringing those tools together into one agentic creative environment: it understands what you mean, orchestrates the right capabilities, and still leaves you in full control of the work. We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we're shaping that future. **About the Role** ================== We're building tools that expand what's creatively possible — and, increasingly, an agent that does the work: it understands what a creator wants, picks the right models and tools, runs the job, and hands back something they can see, adjust, and finish. For that to hold up in professional production, the agent has to know the work from the inside. That's where you come in. We need someone who sits between creators and product to turn real pain points in professional workflows into solutions that run and can be proven. If you know professional creative production from the inside and you're used to building your own ideas into interactive prototypes with AI, this might be your seat. We're not just looking for someone who makes demos. We're looking for someone who finds the problem, researches the workflow, delivers the prototype end to end, makes the case for it, and then hands it to engineering to ship. **Why Join OpenArt** ==================== * **Your prototypes become products.** What you build won't stop at a demo. Validated prototypes go straight onto the product roadmap and are taken to launch by engineering. * **Work at the frontier of AI and creativity.** You'll be among the first to get hands\-on with new models and capabilities, and as a practitioner, you'll decide what shape they take inside creators' workflows — and what the agent should do with them on a creator's behalf. * **Direct impact on product direction.** Your judgment won't sit in a review queue. From identifying problems to validating prototypes, you'll directly shape what OpenArt builds next. * **Hyper\-growth and huge market opportunity.** OpenArt is one of the largest AI video generation platforms globally, with millions of monthly active users and partnerships with top model players including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, BytePlus, and Kling. * **Define where creative tools go next.** Generation gets cheaper every month; what creators and clients pay for is finished work. An agent that does the whole job is where the category is heading, and the person who knows production from the inside is the one who decides what it does. **Requirements** ================ * **Fluency in professional creative pipelines.** Hands\-on experience in professional creative production such as advertising, film, or content. You understand every stage from brief to delivery and can pinpoint where the real bottlenecks are. * **Moves fluidly between design and engineering.** AI is your core tool for building. You're proficient with AI coding tools, model APIs, agent frameworks, and lightweight code, and can independently turn concepts into working prototypes fast. * **End\-to\-end delivery.** You can independently take work from problem definition and workflow research through interaction design, visual design, and a usable prototype, delivered to a standard professional users can work with directly. * **Strong product taste.** You hold a high bar for craft, polish, and interaction quality, and you know the difference between something that works and something that works well. * **A body of work that proves it.** A portfolio or GitHub showing the tools, prototypes, products, or experiments you've built. After, assess what was learned and make a clear call: scale, iterate, or stop. * **Drive from concept to launch.** Work closely with product, model, and engineering teams to turn validated prototypes into shipped features, and build up reusable components and interaction patterns along the way, so the next workflow reaches creators faster. **Compensation** ================ * Competitive TC including base salary, bonus, and equity (based on experience). * Meaningful equity ownership in what you build. **Work Setup** ============== * San Carlos, CA (full\-time, on\-site or hybrid) * Visa sponsorship available Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each * Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi\-step, tool\-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives * AI **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobs.title: AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description: At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state\-of\-the\-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands \- we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. You will be the strategic and technical owner of transformation engagements on a defined set of accounts. The most informed voice on what Pencil should do for each client and how the work gets done. You set the thesis, structure the engagement from first principles, co\-design the recommendations and timelines with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads, lead the client through the enterprise\-wide change required to make it stick, and stand behind quality and performance once the work ships. You own the recommendations and the narrative we tell our clients. ***Candidates must be based in North America and have consulting and/or agency experience to be considered for this role.*** **Key responsibilities:** * Implementation Leadership: Own the narrative told to the client and the strategic and tactical plan that drives the engagement, setting the transformation thesis, co\-designing the recommendations with Forward Deployed Engineers and Creative Leads * Structured Problem\-Solving: Take ambiguous client problems and structure them from first principles into a clear set of hypotheses, workstreams, and sequenced decisions everyone can act on. * Change Management Leadership: Lead clients through enterprise\-wide transformation, moving them beyond siloed pilots into integrated, AI\-driven workflows \- navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, identifying blockers and champions, and engineering the buy\-in that scaled AI adoption requires. * AI Process Design: Translate abstract GenAI concepts into clear, repeatable operating processes that client teams can execute confidently day\-to\-day. * Product Feedback Loop: Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding insights back to Product and Engineering \- what's missing, what's broken, what's worth doubling down on \- so Pencil's roadmap stays enterprise\-ready. * Transformation Blueprints: Codify what works on your accounts into repeatable Blueprints the rest of the team can run, so every successful engagement leaves behind a sharper playbook than the one before it. **Your background:** * Minimum of 5 years’ experience in consulting or an agency setting, in\-house transformation, programme management, or enterprise technology implementation, with exposure to technology, digital strategy, and/or operations. A strong academic record in a quantitative or analytical discipline is preferred. * AI\-native in your day\-to\-day. You already use Claude Cowork; experience with Claude Code or other agentic tooling is a strong plus. You don't wait to be told to automate something. * Tech\-fluent and hands\-on. You're in the Pencil platform yourself \- configuring agents, prototyping, stress\-testing recommendations \- and you can hold your own in a technical conversation with a client's engineers about their stack. Lightweight engineering \- SQL, scripts, reading code \- is a strong plus. * Confident with senior stakeholders. You can carry a client meeting on your own, give direct feedback, and stay composed when scope shifts. * A track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional, often ambiguous work to a high standard and on time. * Marketing, advertising, or agency experience is essential for this role. **You’ll Thrive Here If You…** * Are Provocative and Brave: You aren't afraid to challenge a customer’s existing way of working if it means helping them avoid long\-term implementation challenges. * Are an Ally to Change: You are comfortable with ambiguity and change, and you take pride in being a trustworthy partner who helps others navigate the "new and unknown." * Believe in Enterprise Adoption: You are obsessed with seeing technology move away from “pilot purgatory" and towards an embedded, value\-driving part of a company’s culture and success. * Embody Pencil Values: You lead with transparency, agility, and a focus on measurable impact, ensuring our values are mirrored in the customer’s own transformation journey. **KPIs \& Success Measures** * Enterprise Adoption: Depth and breadth of Pencil usage across a customer's teams, departments, and use cases once the rollout is live. * Time\-to\-Value: Speed at which your accounts reach their first defined success metric or ROI milestone after engagement kickoff. * Quality of Transformation Narrative: How well your transformation thesis and the strategic and tactical planning survive delivery without major rework, and the performance the recommendation drives for the client post\-launch. * Product Feedback Impact: Quality and reach of insights fed back to Product and Engineering that keep Pencil's roadmap enterprise\-ready. * Blueprint Contribution: Successful documentation and internal adoption of repeatable "Transformation Blueprints" based on customer wins. **Benefits:** * 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme * Health insurance / private medical cover * Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development * Remote \- work from anywhere in your home country * Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy * Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees * Flexible working hours

jobs.title: Civil and Structural Engineer (Power Generation)
jobs.description: Pacifico Energy develops, finances, builds, and operates energy infrastructure that powers businesses and communities. Joining Pacifico means helping turn ambitious energy projects into operating infrastructure, with work that connects directly to the people and businesses building the future of AI. We are hiring a Civil and Structural Engineer to join our team. The Civil and Structural Engineer supports power generation projects including gas turbines combined with solar and BESS renewable energy systems. This role is responsible for coordinating and supervising civil and structural engineering design activities, including site development, grading, drainage, foundations, and plant structures, to ensure effective integration of site, civil, and structural requirements throughout project development, engineering, construction, and commissioning. The position acts as the technical representative, providing oversight of EPC contractors and engineering consultants while managing civil, structural, and geotechnical risks that could impact project cost, schedule, or constructability. **What you get to do:** **Civil Engineering Design** * Coordinate and supervise civil engineering design activities performed by EPC contractors or engineering consultants, including site layout, grading, earthwork, roads, drainage, and underground utilities. * Review civil design deliverables for consistency with project requirements, constructability, and integration with overall plant design. * Ensure civil designs incorporate requirements related to flood protection, stormwater management, erosion control, and site access. * Support optimization of site layout, grading, and earthwork quantities to reduce construction cost, schedule, and risk. * Participate in civil design reviews, value engineering exercises, and constructability assessments. **Structural Engineering Design** * Coordinate and supervise structural engineering design activities for power generation facilities, including foundations for gas turbines, generators, transformers, and balance\-of\-plant equipment, as well as steel structures, pipe racks, buildings, and support structures for solar and BESS installations. * Review structural design deliverables, including calculations, drawings, and specifications, for technical accuracy, code compliance, and consistency with project requirements. * Review geotechnical investigations and ensure geotechnical recommendations are appropriately incorporated into foundation and structural designs. * Coordinate structural interfaces with equipment vendors (equipment loads, anchor bolts, and embedments) and with mechanical, electrical, and civil design disciplines. * Verify structural designs comply with applicable codes and standards (e.g., ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC 360\) and site\-specific wind, seismic, and soil conditions. * Participate in structural design reviews, value engineering exercises, and constructability assessments. **EPC \& Consultant Supervision** * Serve as the civil and structural engineering coordination lead in interactions with EPC contractors. * Define scopes of work, review proposals, and manage performance of civil, structural, and geotechnical consultants. * Supervise quality, schedule, and budget of EPC and consultant deliverables related to civil and structural engineering. * Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and risk assessments to ensure civil and structural requirements are fully integrated. * Support resolution of civil, structural, and geotechnical issues during engineering, procurement, and construction. **Regulatory \& Stakeholder Interface** * Support and coordinate communications with regulatory authorities and other stakeholders related to civil and structural design approvals. * Assist in responding to regulatory comments, information requests, and stakeholder inquiries. * Support public consultation or disclosure processes as required. **Documentation, Reporting \& Risk Management** * Maintain organized records of technical studies, design documentation, calculations, drawings, and correspondence. * Provide regular reporting on civil and structural design progress, technical risks. * Support civil and structural inputs to project schedules, budgets, and risk registers. * Assist with civil and structural sections of development reports, internal approvals, and financing or due diligence materials. **What you bring to the role:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * 7–10 years of experience supporting civil and structural engineering for power generation or large industrial infrastructure projects. * Experience supervising EPC contractors and engineering consultants. * Working knowledge of civil site design, foundation and structural steel design for gas turbine facilities. * Strong technical review, coordination, and communication skills. **Preferred**: * Experience with gas turbine simple or combined cycle power generation projects. * Experience reviewing civil and structural design packages during EPC execution. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification. * Familiarity with structural analysis and civil design tools (e.g., STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, AutoCAD Civil 3D). **Key Competencies**: * Project owner/developer\-side EPC and consultant supervision * Civil, structural, and geotechnical risk management * Integrated site and plant design coordination * Design code and quality compliance oversight * Schedule\- and cost\-aware decision\-making

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: **A World\-Changing Company** Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. **The Role** **The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer**At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head\-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world\-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most. FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business\-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well\-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in\-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade\-off for their personal productivity. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. jobs.description: Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest\-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60\+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com. Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best\-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®. As a Product Manager focusing on Transportation at Pattern, you will play a critical role in enhancing, optimizing, and automating logistics workflows into scalable software solutions. You will lead a dedicated engineering team through two\-week sprints to build directed warehouse tools, manage yard operations, and optimize global inventory distribution. This role sits at the intersection of complex supply chain challenges and rapid technology expansion, driving massive cost savings and high\-impact operational efficiency across our expanding global footprint. ### **What is a day in the life of a Product Manager \- Transportation?** * Connect daily with the offshore engineering team (8:00 AM–9:00 AM MT) to facilitate standups and align on technical execution. * Conduct sprint planning, define user stories/tasks, assign sprint points, and run retrospectives every two weeks. * Partner closely with UX designers to design and refine directed internal tools for warehouse associates. * Engage with internal stakeholders to identify logistics pain points, gather product requirements, and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT). * Analyze operational data to identify opportunities for optimizing freight execution, carrier ordering, and yard management processes. * Deep dive independently into complex supply chain and transportation problem sets to define scalable solution architectures. ### **What will I need to thrive in this role?** * 2\+ years of product management experience, preferably within logistics, transportation, warehousing, or supply chain environments. * Proven experience leading software engineering teams through full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and two\-week sprint cycles. * Background working with major retailers, e\-commerce giants (e.g., Amazon, Walmart), global logistics providers, or freight/trucking companies. * Strong ability to work independently with minimal oversight, taking full ownership of problem spaces. * Proficiency with analytical and product tools such as Snowflake, Excel, AI development assistants (e.g., Claude, Cursor), and the Google Workspace suite. * Exceptional cross\-functional communication skills to build trust and align distributed engineering, design, and executive stakeholders. ### **What does high performance look like?** * Successfully transition legacy spreadsheets and email workflows into automated, in\-house software products. * Execute two\-week sprint deliverables on time while maintaining team alignment and sprint velocity. * Build strong trust, cohesion, and a unified direction across cross\-functional US and overseas engineering/design teams. * Proactively solve complex operational problems and drive measurable financial impact through reduced shipping and chargeback costs. ### **What is my potential for career growth?** * Opportunity to lead greenfield product initiatives within a fast\-growing tech business expanding 30–40% annually. * Direct exposure to enterprise\-level supply chain scaling, double\-digit facility network expansion, and global logistics automation. * Path to take complete ownership over multi\-year product roadmaps across complex fulfillment and transportation verticals. * Professional network development through collaboration with senior leadership and global operations experts. ### **What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?** * **30 Days:** Build relationships across engineering and operational teams, gain a complete understanding of internal systems, and master the existing multi\-year transportation product roadmap. * **60 Days:** Take active ownership of two\-week sprint planning cycles, partner with UX to refine warehouse tool designs, and begin delive  mentored by the VP of Product / Director of Product Management. ### **Sounds great! What’s the company culture?** We are looking for individuals who are: * **Game Changers** \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes. * **Data Fanatics** \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data. * **Partner Obsessed** \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern. * **Team of Doers** \- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners. ### **What is the hiring process?** * Phone Interview * Video Interview * Top\-Grading Interview / Panel Interview * On\-Site Visit / Final Interview * Reference Checks * Executive Review * Offer ### **How can I stand out as an applicant?** **Strong Nice\-to\-Haves:** * Experience in global supply chain logistics, cross\-border freight distribution, or yard management software. * Prior background at high\-scale e\-commerce platforms (Amazon, Walmart) or global logistics providers (e.g., Flexport). * Hands\-on experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) to accelerate product workflow and problem\-solving. **Interview Standout Tips:** * Demonstrate your ability to take an ambiguous problem space and break it down into structured software requirements. * Highlight specific examples where you independently owned a product space with minimal daily oversight. * Show a clear track record of successfully managing distributed offshore engineering and design teams across multiple time zones. **Why should I work at Pattern?** Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include: * Unlimited PTO * Paid Holidays * Onsite Fitness Center * Company Paid Life Insurance * Casual Dress Code * Competitive Pay * Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance * 401(k) match. jobs.title: Infrastructure Security Engineer (Senior/Principal)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** ===================== Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ================= As Positron scales, our engineering environment is evolving from a primarily on\-prem footprint to a hybrid\-cloud model. We are looking for a Senior or Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure and manage that transition. You will own identity and access management, cloud infrastructure for our developers, infrastructure as code, and the core developer tooling our hardware and software teams depend on every day. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role where you will define the foundations: how engineers authenticate, how infrastructure is provisioned and segmented, how secrets and artifacts are stored, and how we detect and respond to threats against our most critical systems. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Identity and Access Management*** Define, implement, and operate our identity platform, including Auth0 and role\-based access control (RBAC) across internal systems and cloud environments. * Establish least\-privilege access policies and lifecycle processes for users, service accounts, and machine identities. * Design and manage public key infrastructure (PKI), including certificate issuance, rotation, and revocation. **Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure*** Lead the migration of on\-prem workloads to a secure hybrid\-cloud environment on GCP. * Build and maintain cloud infrastructure for developers using infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible. * Design and enforce network segmentation between on\-prem, cloud, and critical infrastructure environments. **Developer Tooling and Platform Security*** Deploy and maintain artifact storage and other core developer tooling with security built in from the start. * Own secrets management across environments, ensuring credentials and keys are stored, accessed, and rotated safely. **Detection and Response*** Select, deploy, and operate a SIEM solution covering our critical infrastructure. * Build and lead incident response processes, from detection and triage through remediation and post\-incident review. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Expertise in identity and access management, including SSO, RBAC, and identity platforms such as Auth0, Okta, or similar. * Experience with Kubernetes, including managed or proprietary Kubernetes distributions. * Hands\-on experience building and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible. * Production experience with GCP, or with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work in GCP. * Proven experience deploying, tuning, and operating a SIEM solution. * Experience with PKI, including certificate management and lifecycle automation. * Demonstrated incident response experience, including leading investigations and remediation. * Experience deploying and maintaining artifact storage and secrets management systems. * Understanding of network segmentation and secure network design across on\-prem and cloud environments. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Broader security engineering experience beyond infrastructure, such as application or product security. * Experience designing security architecture for organizations moving from on\-prem to hybrid cloud. * Familiarity with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tooling and deployment. ### **Leveling and Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first three to six months, you will have defined and stood up our identity foundation, with Auth0 and RBAC in place across key systems. Developers will be provisioning cloud infrastructure through infrastructure as code, and the migration from on\-prem to hybrid cloud will be well underway on a secure, segmented footing. A SIEM solution will be live and monitoring our critical infrastructure, giving the team real visibility and a clear path to detect and respond to threats. **Why Join Us?** * Build the security and infrastructure foundations of a well\-funded AI hardware company from the ground up, with the ownership to make lasting architectural decisions. * Protect the systems behind next\-generation inference silicon, working alongside hardware and software engineers on some of the most important infrastructure in AI. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is Senior: $170,000 – $250,000, Principal: $250,000 \- $325,000\.. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future. **Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: As one of the first engineers on PowerPlan’s Applied AI team, you’ll build the data foundation behind the AI solutions our own teams use every week, across finance, sales, professional services, and product. Most of the work is finding, cleaning, and defining the data each build needs, then picking the simplest structure that will hold it, and pairing with the team’s AI engineer to put larger solutions into the business’s hands. PowerPlan builds the financial software behind the companies that keep the lights on, and nine in ten U.S. investor\-owned utilities use our platform. The Applied AI team sits inside Strategic Initiatives, works closely with the executive leadership team, and brings that same standard of getting the numbers right to how the company itself runs. The standards you help set early will shape how every build after yours gets done. Responsibilities: Success will be measured by whether the AI solutions you build data for are in weekly use and run by the business, and by whether new builds start from trusted, shared data instead of fresh exports. * Learn how the company runs through its data in your first 30 days, deliver an owner\-checked first catalog of critical data by the end of your first quarter, and keep it current enough by month 12 that business and technology leaders plan AI work from it. * Help set the team’s standards for data, connections, and code review from your first 30 days, including how AI tools connect to business systems: read\-only by default, no more complex than the job requires, and reviewed by IT and security. * Pair with the team’s AI engineer on a first build in your first quarter, lead the data on the first larger build into pilot by six months, and by month 12 deliver the data behind at least two larger AI solutions in weekly use and run by the business. * Agree on the first shared data sets in your first quarter, publish the first one by six months, and have at least two shared, governed data sets in use by more than one team or AI solution by month 12\. * Within your first 12 months, retire hand\-built recurring reports by defining the numbers once, so an AI tool can draft the commentary, answer questions, and flag what needs a person’s attention. Qualifications: * You have two to four years of professional experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or in a similar role where writing code to clean and model data was central to the job, or a master’s degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience. * You’ve turned messy, real data from a business system, a spreadsheet, or a set of documents into something people or an AI tool used, and you can walk us through what broke and how you fixed it. * Before you build on a number, you trace it through the systems and processes that produce it and find out from the people who own it what it means, and you can tell us about a time a business owner’s explanation changed what you built. * Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode are your default way of working, and you know how to plan the work, direct the tool, and check what it produces. The team builds with Claude Code, and we provide the tools. * You write working Python and SQL and can read and change code someone else wrote. * You’ve pulled data from an API end to end, including authentication, secrets, paging, and errors. * You work in Git by habit, treat data access and documentation as part of the build, and write notes a business owner can follow. * You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, information systems, or a closely related quantitative field; a business analytics or other quantitative business degree also qualifies if it included substantial programming coursework. * You can work from Atlanta in the office at least three days a week and are authorized to work in the United States (this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future). **Even Better If…** * You’ve built an MCP server, an agent skill, or a connector someone else used. * You have experience with a modern data platform, retrieval over documents (RAG), or data quality checks. * You’ve worked with CRM, finance, or project data, ideally in or alongside finance, professional services, sales operations, or support. * You’ve applied continuous improvement methods, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or value stream mapping. * You hold a master’s degree in a related field, such as computer science, information systems, data science, or business analytics. **PowerPlan is an EOE** Applicant Privacy Notice Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: As an AI Engineer at PowerPlan, you'll be one of the first engineers on our Applied AI team: an in\-house forward\-deployed engineer who works like a product owner and owns AI solutions end to end, from the first conversation with a department to a tool its people use every week. You'll embed with teams across the company, from customer support and professional services to finance and sales, learn how the work really gets done, and build with real autonomy. You'll report to the VP of Strategic Initiatives, the group that works closely with PowerPlan's executive leadership team on the company's top priorities, and you'll help shape how a brand\-new team works from the ground up. Nine in ten U.S. investor\-owned utilities trust PowerPlan's software to get their numbers right. Your job is to bring that same standard to how PowerPlan itself runs. Responsibilities: Success will be measured by how many solutions you get into weekly use, the measurable change each one delivers, and whether the departments you work with can run and change their tools without you. * In your first 30 days, embed with your first department, learn the work from the people who do it, and agree on a one\-page problem statement, a measured baseline, and real examples before you build. * Help write the playbook for a new team: standards for building with AI tools, keeping shared work current, and testing for quality and robustness, all shaped by what you learn on real builds. * By the end of your first quarter, get your first solution into weekly pilot use, tested against real examples, with time saved measured against your baseline. * Grow from one pilot to one or two solutions in weekly use by month six, and three across at least two departments by year end, including two larger cross\-department builds with the team's AI data engineer. * Redesign clumsy workflows with the people who run them instead of just speeding them up, with agentic coding tools as your default way of building. * Leave every department with runbooks, training, and people who can run and change what you built without you. * Publish your first reusable agent skills and workflow patterns by month six, grow them into a library the company reuses, and help set the standard for when AI output can be trusted and when a person should check it. Qualifications: * You have two to four years of professional experience building or shipping software products (as an engineer, product manager, or similar), or a master's degree in a related field and at least one year of that experience. * You've shipped software or a product other people rely on, at work or on your own, and can walk us through what you built, why, and what changed once people used it. * You think in systems and reason from first principles. You ask why a step exists before you automate it, and you can show us a process you changed rather than just sped up. * You can turn a conversation with an expert into a clear problem statement and a way to measure success. * Agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode are your default way of working, and you know how to plan the work, direct the tool, and check what it produces. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: Software Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Agentic SDLC

A Network Engineer performs a wide variety of evaluation, maintenance, installation and training tasks to ensure the computer network performance meets company and user satisfaction. A Network Engineer also provides direction, information, and recommendations regarding network configurations and installations. **Qualified candidates will possess the following Minimum Requirements:** * 4 Year college degree in a computer\-related field with a minimum of five(5\) years IT industry experience required * Global WAN infrastructure knowledge and Cisco networking experience required * Microsoft Exchange and/or SQL experience required * Knowledge of VoIP implementation and support required * Knowledge of Virtual Machine/Thin Client implementation(s) required. * Knowledge of network security through proper configuration of VPN and Firewalls required * Ability to communicate both written and verbal required * Must have demonstrated good problem solving and jobs.title: Enterprise Automation Developer
jobs.description: **About Prime Controls** Established in 2004, Prime Controls, L.P. is a family\-owned Systems Integration and I\&C Construction firm dedicated to meeting clients’ industrial automation and control requirements. As a Main Automation Contractor, we offer comprehensive solutions, supported by our size, expertise, and extensive experience. With a professional team of 1000\+ employees, Prime Controls serves customers nationwide from our Dallas, Texas headquarters and offices throughout the United States. Our mission is to deliver the highest quality professional services while prioritizing our employees’ well\-being and fostering an exceptional workplace environment. **Position Summary** Prime Controls is hiring an Associate Developer to build the APIs, integrations, automations, and AI agents that connect our business and engineering systems. This role is designed for an early\-career developer, including a recent computer science or software engineering graduate, who is genuinely fast with modern AI development tooling and uses it to produce working, supportable software rather than one\-off scripts. The work is real and immediate. Prime is standing up API endpoints against internal engineering data, moving field\-facing tools off spreadsheets and manual handoffs, and building AI agents that take repetitive work out of estimating, project controls, purchasing, and document handling. The Associate Developer will write that code, test it, document it, and hand it off in a state someone else can maintain. This is not a help desk role and it is not an infrastructure role. Day\-to\-day support, identity, endpoint management, and network operations stay with Information Technology. This role sits in the Business Technology Group and partners closely with Engineering, IT, platform owners, and the business groups whose processes the work is meant to improve. We expect the person in this role to grow. The intent is to add senior development leadership over time and build a small development function around it, so appetite for mentorship, code review, and rising standards matters more than a polished resume. **Key Responsibilities** **API and Integration Development** * Build and maintain REST API endpoints that expose project and asset data from internal engineering systems to the tools that need it, including project asset lists consumed by field\-facing applications. * Implement authentication and authorization for internal and externally reachable applications using approved patterns such as JWT, Microsoft Entra ID, or issued API keys, following the standard selected with IT and BTG rather than inventing a new one per project. * Develop integrations between enterprise platforms including ERP/MRP, engineering data systems, construction tracking platforms, Microsoft 365, and internal tools, using vendor APIs, file exchanges, and scheduled data movement. * Write integration code that fails visibly and recoverably, including logging, error handling, retries, and alerting that tells someone when data stopped moving. * Document endpoints, payloads, dependencies, and support expectations so integrations are transferable and not owner dependent. **AI Agent and Automation Development** * Build AI agents and assisted workflows against approved platforms, including Claude and the Microsoft AI stack, for defined business processes such as document review, data extraction, exception handling, and routine reporting. * Turn manual and repetitive business processes into automations using Power Automate, Python, PowerShell, scripted jobs, and platform\-native capability, selecting the lightest tool that will hold up. * Define and test guardrails on any agent that touches business data: what it can access, what it can write, what it must escalate to a person, and how its output is verified. * Measure what the automation actually changed. Every agent or automation is expected to carry a before\-and\-after number such as time per transaction, keying error rate, or cycle time. * Evaluate native platform capability before building custom, consistent with BTG governance. **Internal Application Development and Support** * Contribute to internal applications, including JavaScript\-based field and project tools, with a focus on refinement, integration, and stability rather than rebuilds. * Take ownership of assigned components: fix defects, improve usability, and keep the application deployable. * Improve user experience on internal tools, working from real user feedback captured from the field and office. * Support version control discipline, code review, branching, and release practices as the development function matures. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Practice** * Use AI development tooling as a primary part of the daily workflow, including code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation, and debugging. * Review and verify AI\-generated output. Understanding why the code works is a requirement of the role, not an optional step. * Share working patterns, prompts, and reusable approaches with BTG and Engineering so productivity gains spread beyond one person. * Operate within Prime's AI governance policy, including approved tools, data handling rules, and review expectations. **Collaboration, Security, and Documentation** * Work with IT on infrastructure, security review, licensing, identity, and hosting before anything is exposed outside the network. * Translate business requests into a scoped technical approach, and say clearly when a request should be a configuration change, a small automation, an internal application, or a vendor platform decision. * Participate in testing and validation, including writing test cases and supporting user acceptance testing for changes that affect business workflows. * Maintain documentation, handoff notes, and decision records for everything built. * Route material changes through the Change Control Board and support the Change Management Coalition on adoption and rollout for tools that reach the field. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated ability. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Working proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, or C\#. * Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and basic authentication concepts, demonstrated through coursework, internships, personal projects, or prior work. * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL sufficient to read a schema, write queries, and reason about data relationships. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of AI development tools to produce working software, with the ability to explain what the tool produced and why it is correct. * Evidence of initiative: projects started and finished without being assigned, problems pursued past the first obstacle, and work shipped rather than shelved. * Ability to communicate clearly with people who are not developers, including field and office staff describing a problem in their own terms. * Willingness to work onsite at the Lewisville headquarters, with occasional travel to regional offices or project sites. **Preferred** * Internship, co\-op, or project experience building or consuming production APIs. * Experience with Git\-based version control and collaborative code review. * Exposure to the Microsoft stack, including Power Platform, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Entra ID. * Exposure to cloud services, containerization, or CI/CD pipelines. * Coursework or project work in machine learning, natural language processing, or agent frameworks. * Interest in construction, industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing environments. * Any experience turning a manual process into an automated one, at any scale. **Initial 90\-Day Priorities** * Complete onboarding to Prime's development environment, source control, AI tooling, and AI governance policy, and understand what data may be used where. * Learn the current system landscape: ERP/MRP, engineering data platforms, internal tools, construction tracking pilots, and the integration points already in place. * Deliver one production API endpoint end to end, including authentication, documentation, and testing, under the direction of the assigned technical owner. * Take ownership of one existing internal application component and close a defined backlog of defects and usability items. * Build one AI agent or automation against a real business process with a measured before\-and\-after result. * Produce documentation for everything touched in the first ninety days, to the standard that lets another developer pick it up. * Identify two additional automation candidates from direct observation of how the business works, with an estimate of effort and expected benefit.
