jobs.description: ### **About the company** **What’s Promptly in a nutshell** Promptly is building the first patient\-centered global evidence network, offering real world data sharing and monetization capabilities. Together with a selected network of Partners, we generate new knowledge from harmonized datasets, augmented with the collection of longitudinal patient\-reported data and patient\-generated digital biomarkers within a secure and privacy\-preserving environment. We answer the question – is this patient treatment the best it could possibly be? **What’s our purpose** We exist to empower every patient and every health organization on the planet with evidence on the outcomes of care! Why do we get up in the morning? Well, most healthcare professionals have chosen to work in healthcare driven by their desire to make a difference in patients’ lives. And so have we! We have chosen to follow this calling by addressing the biggest problem in healthcare: the lack of real\-world evidence on the outcomes of care. For us, society denying patients better care due to lack of access to data is unethical, in a world where technology improved so many aspects of our world. Making the right evidence available to healthcare organizations to help prevent one lost life, one care complication, one failed treatment is the moral obligation that big tech companies have – it’s our Hippocratic Oath. At Promptly, everything we do is driven by our core purpose: to promote better healthcare at lower costs for patients every day, by making health outcomes available. ### **About the role** Promptly runs real\-world evidence (RWE) studies for pharmaceutical sponsors on routinely collected hospital data: electronic health records, laboratory results and clinical documentation from a federated network of partner hospitals. Some of these data are harmonised to a common data model such as the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model; others arrive in the hospital's own format. Patient\-level data never leave a hospital. Analysis code runs inside each hospital's trusted research environment (TRE), and only aggregate results leave after statistical disclosure control (small\-number suppression). You are the statistician on these studies. You decide what a dataset can and cannot estimate, choose the design and the methods, quantify the uncertainty, and defend those choices to sponsors and clinicians. Everything we deliver has to stand up to methodological scrutiny, and you make sure it does. You do not work alone. Clinicians at the partner hospitals and medical experts are your closest collaborators. Together you define outcomes and exposures that are clinically meaningful and measurable in routine data, and interpret what the results mean for patients. A Clinical Data Engineer builds the data pipelines and the analysis datasets you specify. Depending on your background, you may also derive cohorts and variables yourself from prepared extracts. The team works in English. If you are early in your career, you will co\-author your first protocols and statistical analysis plans (SAPs) with support from the RWE lead. You will grow into owning the statistical design and analysis of whole studies. If you are more experienced, you will own that from the start. The bar on statistical rigour is the same for both. ### **What you'll be expected to do** * Turn clinical questions into study designs: estimand, target population and index date, comparator, confounding strategy, bias assessment, sample size and power. * Work with clinicians and the sponsor's medical team to define outcomes, exposures and covariates. Check that what you measure in the data matches what they mean in practice. * Specify the analysis dataset with the Clinical Data Engineer, or derive cohorts and variables yourself from prepared extracts in SQL and Python. Check data quality before analysis. * Co\-author protocols and SAPs with the RWE lead and clinical experts. The statistical parts are yours: estimands, analysis methods, sample size and how uncertainty is reported. * Run the analysis in Python (or R): survival analysis (Kaplan\-Meier, Cox, competing risks), propensity scores and multiple imputation, handling immortal\-time bias and informative censoring. Derive inputs for health\-economic models, such as transition probabilities. * Prepare outputs that pass statistical disclosure control, then pool estimates across hospitals. * Write the methods, statistical analysis and limitations sections of study reports, and present results to sponsors and clinical partners. * Review sponsor protocols and concept sheets (short early study outlines), and say plainly what a proposed design can and cannot answer. ### **What we're looking for (qualifications \& skills)** You do not need to match every point. If you have a strong statistical foundation and want to learn the rest, please apply. * An MSc or PhD in biostatistics, statistics, epidemiology or a related quantitative field, or equiva sessment (HTA) submissions. * Experience of discussing methods with pharmaceutical sponsors, clinicians or other external partners. ### **Position** * Remote\-first * Full time ### **What we offer** **Financial Benefits** * Competitive salary * Annual performance bonus * Equity compensation via our ESOP (open to all team members) * Annual training allowance * Home\-office equipment allowance **Non\-Financial Benefits** * Equal opportunity and inclusive environment * Flexible work schedule and vacation policy * Corporate events and international team gatherings ### **What is the recruiting process like** * There is a first interview with your future manager and/ or seasoned team members to get to know you and to give you an overview of Promptly and of the job you are applying to * Afterwards, you will undergo a technical assessment stage, in which you will work on a test task or solve a business case. * In same exceptional cases, a third interview might take place. Don’t worry if this happens. It’s because we have a good opinion on you, but there might be something we still need to get clear * Finally, you will get your offer, and hopefully you’ll accept it! * Also, we would like to notify you that during the final phases os the interview process, we may perform reference checks to validate the information provided in your application, resume, and discussed during the interview. ### **Our Culture \& Values** Empathy — Ownership — Responsibility — Teamwork — Excellence If you embrace these values, you will thrive at Promptly. We are a purpose\-driven company where everyone acts as an owner, committed to improving healthcare through data, technology, and collaboration. **Privacy notice for applicants** --------------------------------- Promptly \- Software Solutions for Health Measures, S.A. (“Promptly”) is the controller of the personal data contained in your application. We process that data to manage our recruitment activities: reviewing applications, organising and conducting interviews, tests and assessments, evaluating candidates, communicating with you throughout the process and, where an offer is made, preparing your hiring. We do so on the basis of the steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract, and of our legitimate interest in selecting suitable candidates for the role. Your data is accessible only to the members of the Promptly team involved in the selection process and to service providers that support the tools we use to manage it, acting on our instructions and bound by confidentiality and data protection obligations. We do not use your data for purposes unrelated to recruitment, we do not share it with third parties for their own purposes, and we do not take decisions about you based solely on automated processing. If you are not selected, we keep your application for up to 12 months so that we may contact you about future openings that match your profile. You may ask us to delete it at any time, and we will do so. You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your personal data, and to object to its processing. To exercise these rights, or to ask any question about how we handle your data, write to dpo@promptlyhealth.com. You may also lodge a complaint with the Portuguese supervisory authority (Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados \- CNPD). **Applicant declaration** ------------------------- By submitting this application, I confirm that the information provided by me, and in any documents attached to it, is true and complete to the best of my knowledge, and that I have not omitted any material fact. I confirm that I have disclosed any previous employment or engagement with Promptly. I accept that if any of the information provided is false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn and, where employment has already begun, this may constitute grounds for disciplinary action, including termination, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer I-1854
jobs.description: An Electrical Engineer II at a PSM manufacturing company will design, develop, and maintain electrical systems while ensuring compliance with safety regulations. This mid\-level engineering role requires balancing technical design with the rigorous safety standards of Process Safety Management (PSM), which is essential in industries that handle highly hazardous chemicals. **Typical responsibilities** * **Systems design and development:** Design, simulate, and test electrical systems, components, and circuits for new and existing manufacturing equipment. Create and revise electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and layouts using CAD software like AutoCAD or EPLAN. * **Process Safety Management (PSM) and compliance:** Actively participate in PSM activities, including Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs) and Pre\-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSRs), to ensure that electrical designs meet all applicable safety standards, such as those from OSHA and NFPA. * **Automation and controls:** Design and program control systems using Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), with specific experience in platforms like Allen\-Bradley or Siemens often required. Optimize control systems for efficiency and reliability. * **Manufacturing support:** Provide technical support to manufacturing and maintenance teams to troubleshoot electrical issues and resolve equipment failures. Develop maintenance and testing procedures for electrical equipment. * **Project management:** Plan and execute small to medium capital projects related to equipment upgrades and process improvements, including creating budgets, timelines, and procurement specifications. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** Work with mechanical, software, and other engineering disciplines, as well as production and management, to ensure projects meet all requirements. * **Documentation and reporting:** Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, engineering reports, and records throughout the project lifecycle. **Required qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * **Experience:** Typically 2–5 years of related electrical engineering experience, often with a background in manufacturing or industrial settings. Experience in a PSM\-regulated environment is essential for this specific role. * **Technical skills:** * Proficiency in electrical CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN). * Experience with industrial automation, including PLCs, HMIs, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). * Knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, instrumentation, and control networks. * Familiarity with industry codes and standards, such as NEC, NFPA, and IEEE. * **Soft skills:** * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent communication skills for collaborating with technical and non\-technical teams. * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Observability/Site Reliability
jobs.description: PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million\-qubit, fault\-tolerant quantum systems. Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high\-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber\-optic infrastructure. In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government\-funded projects to support the build\-out of our first utility\-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes\-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real\-world impact. Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. Come join us. **Job Summary:** The OS Core Team at PsiQuantum works closely alongside engineers and scientists in the electronics, system architecture, and validation teams and is responsible for building the scalable, distributed, fault\-tolerant control plane and operating system for utility scale photonic quantum computers. Our team is responsible for orchestration, scheduling, kernel architecture, co\-design, calibration, validation, providing abstractions, systems, and operating software for the immense heterogenous fabric of co\-processors, networks, and photonics that are critical to the success of our company's goal of building the world's first useful quantum computer. As a Senior Software Engineer, Calibration \& Control you will design and implement algorithms, controls, and software that keep our quantum processors in spec 24×7x365\. **Responsibilities:** The core of our system revolves around a high performance, scalable graph database which contains critical information to control and manage PsiQuantum computing systems. Your role is to scale and extend the current core database systems to support the massive increase in size complexity of our systems. **Daily functions:** Data systems design and implementation. Participate in design and code reviews. Collaborate across software, hardware, and research teams at PsiQuantum. Testing and maintenance of database software. Champion and serve as an exemplar of good software development practices at PsiQuantum. **Experience/Qualifications:** 15\+ years experience with Python or C\+\+ in a system software context. Design and implementation of large scale distributed storage systems, emphasis on graph databases. Proven track record of developing and shipping reliable, performant software in a high scale or mission critical context. Bachelors degree in a technical discipline preferred, or equivalent experience. **Ways to stand out:** Experience in graph database systems such as Nebula, neo4j, Gravlax. Experience in high performance computing and data design. Experience in computer architecture. Experience in high performance networking. Experience with highly scalable distributed systems in a reliability and up\-time critical environment. PhD in a related technical discipline is a plus but not required. *\[We are open to adjusting the compensation to experience level]* **Note: PsiQuantum will only reach out to you using an official PsiQuantum email address and will never ask you for bank account information as part of the interview process. Please report any suspicious activity to** **recruiting@psiquantum.com****.** We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.

jobs.title: Director, AI Transformation
jobs.description: ### About Us: Rare Beauty Brands is a prestige skincare company with a portfolio that includes Kate Somerville, Patchology, and Good Day. We are growing fast, and our strategy is clear: acquire and build mid\-sized premium skincare brands that serve discerning consumers, and run them better than anyone else could. AI is now central to how we plan to do that. Rare Beauty Brands is an equal opportunity employer. The Role -------- Rare Beauty Brands is hiring a Director, AI Transformation to move the company from using AI tools to running on them. The role reports directly to the President \& CEO and works across every function: brand, digital and ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, finance, and people. Most companies, RBB included, have adopted AI at the individual level: people use it to write faster, summarize, and draft. The next stage is different. It means redesigning how work gets done, building agents and automations into real processes, and measuring the return. Getting there takes a dedicated owner with the technical range to build it and the business judgment to know what is worth building. That is this job. You will sit with each department head, find the friction in how their teams operate today, and then design, build, and ship solutions that remove it. Some of that work you will do yourself. Some you will do with vendors, agencies, and the people already on the team. All of it has to show up in scalability, efficiency, profitability, or growth. ### Responsibilities: **Find the work worth transforming** * Partner with each member of the executive leadership team to map current workflows, pain points, and sources of friction in their functions * Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of AI and automation opportunities, ranked by business impact, effort, and risk * Say no to shiny projects with no ROI, and be able to explain why **Build and ship** * Design, prototype, and deploy AI agents, automations, and integrations across our systems (ERP, ecommerce platforms, Amazon, CRM and email marketing, data and reporting tools, and the tools we have not bought yet) * Do hands\-on work yourself where it is faster, and direct vendors, agencies, or internal builders where it is not * Own the technical architecture: how our tools connect, where data lives, how agents get access, and what guardrails are in place **Make it stick** * Lead the change management side: training, documentation, adoption tracking, and partnering with teams to redesign processes in ways that ensure adoption * Build internal capability so the company gets more self\-sufficient over time, not more dependent on you **Govern it** * Own AI governance at RBB and chair a small AI governance group (CEO, select members of the Executive Leadership Team, HR) that approves policy and signs off on higher\-risk deployments * Update and maintain RBB’s AI policy: acceptable use, approved tools, what data can go into which systems, brand safety for anything customer\-facing, and where a human has to review before anything ships * Run an agent and tool registry. Every agent, automation, and AI tool in use has a named business owner, a documented purpose, the systems and data it can touch, its cost, and a review date. Nothing goes live unregistered * Set guardrails for agents that take action: least\-privilege access, limits on what they can spend or change, logging, and a fast way to shut them off, especially when they touch customers, money, or inventory * Protect company and customer data: classify what is sensitive, control who and what can access it, and run a security and privacy review on every AI vendor before we sign (how they store, retain, and train on our data) * Get ahead of shadow AI: know which tools people are actually using, bring the useful ones into approved channels, and retire the risky ones * Own the response when an agent gets something wrong, exposes data, or behaves unexpectedly: how it is caught, fixed, and reported * Track the privacy and AI regulations that apply to RBB and keep us compliant without slowing the work down **Measure and report** * Define the metrics for every major initiative before it starts (hours saved, cost avoided, revenue lifted, cycle time cut) and report against them * Give the CEO and ELT a clear, regular read on what is working, what is not, and what is next, including where AI risk stands: what is in the registry, what has been reviewed, and any incidents * Stay ahead of the AI curve, continually and rapidly identifying disruption opportunities and translating complex breakthroughs into lean, high\-velocity execution plans for our company. ### Requirements: **Must have** * **7\+ years of experience spanning operations, technology, consulting, or product, with at least 2 years leading hands\-on AI, automation, or digital transformation work that you built yourself, with specific, measurable results you can point to, such as hours saved, costs reduced, or revenue gaine**d * Hands\-on fluency with c rrent AI tools and the ability to build with them: LLM APIs and agent frameworks, automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n or similar), and enough scripting (Python or JavaScript) to connect systems and move data * Working knowledge of AI governance and data security: access controls, data privacy, vendor security review, and how to put guardrails on an agent that can take real actions in real systems. You have written an AI or data policy that people actually followed * A track record of changing how a team actually works, not just recommending it. You have redesigned a process, lived through the rollout, and can talk about what went wrong. You have experience bringing non\-technical teams through a process change, with adoption you tracked after launch * Business judgment. You can read a P\&L, size an opportunity, and tell the difference between a demo and a solution * You have the communication range to explain a technical architecture to an engineer and a business case to a CEO in the same afternoon * You are comfortable operating in a lean, fast\-moving company where you own outcomes end to end and there is no team under you on day one **Nice to have** * Experience in consumer products, beauty, or ecommerce, and familiarity with the systems that run them (Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite or similar ERP, Klaviyo or similar) * Experience evaluating and managing vendors, agencies, or freelance developers * Background in data: building reporting, defining metrics, cleaning up messy sources What success looks like in year one ----------------------------------- By the end of your first 90 days, you have met with every department, documented the top friction points across the company, and brought the ELT a ranked roadmap with your first two or three builds already underway. You have also refined and published RBB’s AI use policy, stood up the AI governance group, and logged every AI tool and agent already in use in a central registry. By six months, at least one process in each major function has been redesigned around an agent or automation, with a before\-and\-after measure the function head would vouch for. The company is tracking value creation across all projects using standardized metrics and a universally accessible dashboard. Every agent and automation in production is in the registry, has a named owner, and has passed a security and data review. By twelve months, the company can point to transformational gains in cost, speed, and/or revenue tied to this work, the ELT treats you as the first call when a process problem comes up, and RBB has a repeatable way to evaluate, build, govern, and roll out AI solutions that does not depend on any one person. How this role works ------------------- * Reports to the President \& CEO and works day\-to\-day with the full executive leadership team * Individual contributor to start. The role is expected to prove value with the tools we already have and build internal capability, rather than a large team or expense base * Full\-time and fully remote. RBB is a work\-from\-home company, and this role can be based in states where we are already registered: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, New Jersey, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Washington * $130,000\-$150,000 annual salary plus bonus potential * 401(k) plus employer match, medical, dental, and vision benefits, paid time off, including company\-wide self\-care days * Ownership over a growing function at a fast\-moving, founder\-led beauty brand incubator * Salary Range Disclaimer \- The salary range for this role reflects the minimum and maximum compensation for the role. jobs.title: Vice President | Enterprise Security Architecture
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** Note: This position follows our hybrid\-friendly schedule, so you get the best of both worlds – flexibility and collaboration. In office days are 3 days per week (including a Monday or Friday), in our St Petersburg, FL Corporate Office. This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future. **Job Description** This senior technology leader will own the security architecture of the firm's technology estate: the reference architectures, standards and patterns that decide whether the secure path is also the easy path for every team building at Raymond James. The role sets the target state for zero trust, identity, data protection and cloud security. It builds security into the firm's modernization programs at the first design decision, not at the last review gate. The role is built for an AI\-forward practitioner. Agentic AI is changing both how the firm builds software and what it must secure. The leader in this seat uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code every day in their own work. They also own the architecture that lets the firm adopt agents safely: agent and workload identity, least\-privilege tool access, controls against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and audit evidence that holds up with examiners. Success means engineers seek this leader out because security made them faster. The role sits in Enterprise Architecture and leads the Lead Security Architect. It partners closely with the Information Security organization, which keeps ownership of security operations, risk acceptance and policy. This role owns the architecture, the standards and the patterns teams build on. It demands strong executive presence, and the credibility to hold a deep technical conversation with senior engineers and a risk conversation with the CISO, auditors and regulators in the same day. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Define and maintain the enterprise security target architecture and the roadmap from current state to target. This covers zero trust; identity and access management for workforce, client and non\-human identities; network segmentation; encryption and key management; and data protection. * Own the security architecture standard for AI and agentic systems: agent and workload identity, scoped tool permissions and human approval gates, prompt\-injection and data\-exfiltration controls, model and data provenance, logging that makes every agent action auditable * Use AI coding agents and agentic tooling hands\-on to speed up security architecture work, including threat modeling, policy\-as\-code, control mapping, architecture review and reference implementations. Set the pattern for how architecture and engineering teams use these tools safely. * Build security into delivery: threat modeling at design time, secure\-by\-default golden paths, and pipeline security controls, built so the compliant path is the fastest path. The pipeline controls include static, dynamic and dependency scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA), secrets management, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and supply\-chain provenance, and policy\-as\-code. * Set cloud security architecture for AWS and Azure with Enterprise \& Cloud Architecture. This covers landing\-zone guardrails, identity federation, network and data\-perimeter controls, and continuous compliance. * Lead security architecture review for major initiatives and for third\-party, SaaS and vendor platforms. Use consistent, published criteria, record decisions, and make exceptions time\-bound and tracked to closure. * Translate regulatory and examination expectations (SEC, FINRA, GLBA, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF) into architecture standards and reusable controls, and supply the architecture evidence for audits and exams. * Measure the practice and report on it: pattern adoption, exception aging, and the share of findings caught at design time rather than in production. * Lead and develop the Lead Security Architect, and grow a security architecture community of practice across the technology organization. * Collaborate with senior executives on security strategy, investment cases, and executive\-level communications and presentations. Keep a strong external view of the threat landscape and emerging AI\-security research and frameworks, such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS. * **What We're Looking For:** * A recognized subject\-matter expert, with deep, hands\-on mastery of security architecture built over 15\+ years and the judgment to know which controls matter and which are theater. * Proven where the stakes are highest. Experience at a large technology company or hyperscaler, or at a major financial institution such as a Wall Street bank, exchange, broker\-dealer or asset manager, where the architecture was tested by real adversaries, regulators and scale. * AI\-forward by habit, not by title. Uses Claude Code or similar agentic tools daily, and has evidence of securing AI or agentic systems in production rather than only writing policy about them. Builder credibility. Can still read the code, write the policy\-as\-code and sketch the reference implementation. * **Certifications:** * CISSP, CCSP or equivalent strongly preferred. **Education** Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, High School (HS) (Required) **Work Experience** General Experience \- More than 15 years, Manager Experience \- 10 to 15 years **Certifications** **Travel** Less than 25% **Workstyle** Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com. At Raymond James our associates use five guiding behaviors (Develop, Collaborate, Decide, Deliver, Improve) to deliver on the firm's core values of client\-first, integrity, independence and a conservative, long\-term view. We expect our associates at all levels to: * Grow professionally and inspire others to do the same * Work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes * Make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind * Take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter * Contribute to the continuous evolution of the firm At Raymond James – as part of our people\-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our Associates. When associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About RealSelf** For two decades, RealSelf has been the trusted authority in the aesthetics space. Now, we're evolving into a dynamic digital ecosystem that puts consumers at the center of their aesthetic journey. As the only destination combining verified patient experiences, board\-certified doctor insights, and cutting\-edge technology, RealSelf empowers millions to make confident, informed decisions. **Role Overview** Our NYC\-based engineering team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to lead a small but mighty engineering squad, with an initial focus on RealSelf's new booking and finance products. You will work across the stack, designing and building the backend services that power booking flows, payments, and financial tooling, while setting the technical direction for a team you will help build and grow. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role where you will write code, own architecture, and mentor engineers while collaborating with product, design, operations, and finance stakeholders. You'll directly shape how consumers finance and book care, while contributing to the foundation of our next\-generation technology platform. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design and lead the architecture for RealSelf's booking and finance products infrastructure, including booking and scheduling flows, financing application integrations, and financial collection and reporting pipelines. * Build and scale backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and SQL that power a high\-traffic consumer marketplace used by millions of people researching and booking care. * Ensure security and compliance across everything that touches money or personal data, including PCI DSS scope reduction, data privacy (GDPR, CCPA), and audit\-ready logging. * Collaborate across engineering, product, and finance to design APIs, data contracts, and reporting feeds used for revenue operations and business decision\-making. * Mentor and guide engineers through code review, architectural reviews, and technical direction. ### **Requirements** * 7\+ years of backend or infrastructure engineering experience, with at least 1\+ year in leading a team * Proven experience designing high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems in Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar. * Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks for financial data (PCI DSS) and privacy (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA). * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), infrastructure\-as\-code tools (CloudFormation, Terraform, or similar), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD best practices. * Demonstrated ability to lead technically — setting direction, unblocking engineers, and raising the bar through reviews and mentorship. * Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate code delivery and improve quality. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross\-functionally with product, operations, and finance teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * Experience with experimentation and growth engineering (A/B testing, funnel optimization, conversion instrumentation). * Previous work in consumer marketplaces, Martech or healthcare tech. ### **Bonus Qualities** * Hands\-on experience with consumer financing providers (Cherry, PatientFi, CareCredit). * Experience building booking, scheduling, or marketplace systems at scale. Evaluated based on experience; opportunity for performance\-based bonus. **Why RealSelf?** ----------------- * RealSelf exists to help people make confident, informed decisions about procedures that can change how they see themselves, and how the world sees them. * Our reviews are raw and honest. Our Q\&A connects people directly with verified experts. We care deeply about trust, safety, and transparency in an industry where those things matter. * On the heels of a major rebrand, RealSelf is entering a new era of rebuilding and reinvention. This role is an opportunity to help shape the future of a culturally relevant, deeply useful product — and leave a lasting mark on a platform that genuinely matters. **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * You'll work alongside our inspiring world\-class team to create content and build products that connect and empower millions of people around the world, wherever they may be on their aesthetics journey. * Health benefits: We offer comprehensive benefits for medical, dental and vision — 100% paid for by RealSelf at the employee level. * Work\-life balance: Enjoy paid time off, including no work on your birthday and Summer Fridays, as well as generous leave options for life events such as becoming a parent. * 401(k) matching: Plan for the future and take advantage of our 401(k) plan with a company match. * Treatment reimbursement: At RealSelf, we encourage our team to walk in our audience's shoes. Enjoy time off during our 12 company\-wide holidays \+ no work on your birthday! * Hybrid NYC office: We recognize that there's no one size fits all with office culture. That's why we believe in a flexible hybrid schedule for our New York City employees, who can enjoy the benefits of in\-person collaboration in our office as well as deep work time while remote at home. * *Compensation will be evaluated based on experience.* RealSelf is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. **More About RealSelf** ----------------------- * Beautymatter: RealSelf's New “Omnichannel Content Flywheel” Is Quickly Paying Off * Forbes: Inside RealSelf’s Rebrand * Adweek: Cosmetic Surgery Platform RealSelf Appoints New CEO to Spur Editorial Expansion * Tech Crunch: RealSelf, a community for cosmetic treatments, raises $40 million We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Thirty Madison is now part of** **Remedy****! You can read more about the acquisition** **here****. We are excited to join forces and continue to revolutionize healthcare accessibility!** **About the role** We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer within our centralized data team to own a core area of our data, such as financial performance, operations, or growth and retention, from raw sources through to the metrics leadership uses to make decisions. You'll build the dbt models and semantic layer behind those metrics. You'll also act as the analytical partner to the teams that rely on them. This is a high\-ownership role on a lean team that moves fast. Requirements often start ambiguous, and you'll be expected to find the highest\-value problems before they reach anyone's roadmap. **Our stack:** Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Hex **Comp \| Perks \| Benefits** * The base pay range for this role is $160,000\-$180,000 * Potential to earn equity * Robust and affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options * Flexible time off policy *\*\*Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.* **What you get to do every day** * **Own a functional data area.** Be the lead analyst for a domain like finance or growth and retention, the first person stakeholders turn to for answers and insight. You'll own its models, metrics, analysis and roadmap. * **Architect core data models.** Design and maintain silver and gold layer models in dbt using Kimball dimensional modeling (facts and dimensions). These power segmentation, targeting, automation and analytics for your area. * **Define and operationalize metrics.** Turn company\-wide metrics into governed, consistent definitions. Examples include retention, funnel conversion, LTV/CAC/ROAS and revenue. * **Steward the semantic layer.** Treat our BI tooling (Hex) as a product. Own semantic layer health, cross\-team modeling standards and self\-serve data products, beyond building dashboards on request. * **Make the numbers trustworthy.** Set standards for testing, documentation and freshness. Lead root\-cause analysis on data discrepancies, then fix the underlying architecture so they don't recur. * **Partner with the business.** Turn ambiguous questions from Marketing, Growth, Finance and Product into clear requirements and scalable solutions. Work without dedicated PM support and use data to influence decisions. * **Communicate clearly.** Explain technical decisions, trade\-offs and results to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. Set and manage expectations along the way. * **Improve upstream data.** Work with product and engineering on event taxonomy, instrumentation quality and consistency across app, web and backend. **What you bring to the role** * 5\+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, data engineering or a closely related role. * Deep SQL in a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake. You use it to validate data quality, investigate anomalies and back your own analysis. * Production experience with dbt: modeling, testing, documentation and project structure. * Strong data modeling skills, including Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) and layered medallion architectures. You know when to break the rules. * Business and analytical judgment. You can tell which question matters and how to answer it, not just how to model it. * A track record of leading cross\-team data initiatives, including gathering requirements yourself from technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Clear, confident communication with senior leadership, including pushing back and resetting expectations when needed. * Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. You prioritize well and ship without waiting for perfect specs. * Hustle and a bias for action. You roll up your sleeves, do what the moment needs, whether that's a quick ad\-hoc pull or a weekend fire drill on a broken pipeline, and follow through until it's done. **Bonus Points** * Experience supporting Marketing, Growth, Sales or Product teams, such as attribution, paid media, funnels or retention. * Experience owning a BI platform or semantic layer (Hex, Looker, dbt Semantic Layer or similar) as a product. * Experience building semantic layers and documentation designed for AI and agentic workflows. * Familiarity with product analytics instrumentation and event tracking. * Background in consumer health, subscription or e\-commerce businesses. **U.S. Applicants Only** **Don't meet every single requirement?** Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Remedy we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Contact us at recruiting@thirtymadison.com to request accommodation. \*This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I\-9 Form information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.\* * **Please be aware that there are fraudulent entities who are falsely claiming to be or represent Remedy in order to solicit sensitive personal information or payment. Remedy is not in any way associated with these entities or practices. The safety and integrity of those seeking employment with us is of the utmost importance and we actively work with our legal and security teams to prevent future incidents.** **Remedy will never ask for sensitive information or payment when engaging with job seekers. The entities use many methods to perpetuate these scams, including but not limited to: participating in a text\-only interview, using Remedy's trademarks on their correspondence, or providing you with a seemingly legitimate offer letter. If you suspect you are a victim of this scamming, we encourage you to cease further contact and report the crime to** **The Federal Trade Commission****.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Platform
jobs.description: **ABOUT RETOOL** Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. But most companies don't have the resources to properly invest in these tools, leading to a lot of old, clunky internal software, or worse, teams still stuck in manual and spreadsheet workflows. AI has changed who gets to build software. The definition of "developer" now includes analysts, operators, and domain experts creating solutions directly—and the tools they reach for are multiplying by the week. That's both an opportunity and a challenge: as more people build with more AI tools, the risk of shipping ungoverned software into production grows just as fast. At Retool, we're building the platform that makes all of it safe to ship. Build with any AI tool you want, then deploy into one place that connects to your real business data, enforces enterprise policies automatically, and lets teams create once and reuse everywhere with shared, trusted components. The cost of building software has collapsed. The cost of governing it hasn't—and that's the problem we solve. Developers and domain experts have already automated over 100 million hours of work on our platform, freeing them to focus on creative problem\-solving and strategic work that drives real business value. The people closest to the problem can now build the software to solve it, safely, and within enterprise guardrails. Let's build the future together. **WHY WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU** We’re building AI\-native products where model behavior is part of the product, not just an implementation detail. As LLMs become more capable, the bottleneck is no longer access to models—it’s making non\-deterministic systems reliable, evaluable, and trustworthy in production. We’re hiring AI Engineers to own that problem end to end. This is not a role for someone who simply integrates AI APIs into features. It’s for engineers who take responsibility for how probabilistic systems behave over time, how quality is measured in the presence of variance, and how capabilities improve without regressing. If model regressions, subtle behavior drift, or edge\-case failures keep you up at night—and you enjoy that kind of ownership—we want to talk. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As an AI Engineer, you’ll own model\-driven behavior in production systems, working across product, infrastructure, and evaluation layers. Your work will directly shape what users experience—and how confidently the team can ship. You might: * Own the behavior of AI\-powered features across multiple product surfaces, including quality, safety, variance, and failure modes * Design and evolve prompting, retrieval, routing, and tool\-use strategies that embrace non\-determinism while bounding its downside * Build and maintain evaluation systems that measure model performance using statistical signals, distributions, and trends—not just pass/fail tests * Detect, diagnose, and resolve non\-deterministic failures such as hallucinations, partial correctness, instruction drift, or sensitivity to context changes * Define and implement guardrails, fallbacks, and degradation paths that keep systems useful even when models behave unexpectedly * Partner with product and infra teams to decide when probabilistic behavior is “good enough” to ship—and when it isn’t * Influence model selection, model behavior, and tool design to balance quality, cost, latency, and robustness for real user workflows You’ll work across the stack (e.g., TypeScript, Node.js, React), but your leverage won’t come from code volume alone—it will come from shaping runtime behavior with precision, measurement, and intent. **WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)** This role is: * Accountable for AI behavior, not just system correctness * Grounded in evaluation, iteration, and regression prevention under non\-determinism * Comfortable designing systems where outputs vary, confidence is probabilistic, and correctness is contextual * Focused on shipping dependable products on top of imperfect components This role is not: * Adding LLM calls to Your work will set standards that others build on. If you enjoy being the person teams rely on when AI behavior matters most—and certainty is never guaranteed—you’ll thrive here. **READY TO BUILD RELIABLE AI SYSTEMS?** If you’re excited to move beyond demos and take real ownership of non\-deterministic behavior in production—defining quality, preventing regressions, and turning variability into a strength—we’d love to meet you. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **About Greenlight Rent** Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino \+ Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market\-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence. Our technology removes friction from the move\-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more. We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss\-of\-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works. **The role** As a Staff Engineer on our data team, you'll be a senior software engineer who builds the systems that produce, move and serve our data, not just the pipelines and queries on top of them. You'll set technical direction for how data flows through Greenlight Rent, from the application services and APIs that generate it to the warehouse, models and tools the business runs on. You'll partner with product, finance and operations to turn rental\-housing problems into reliable software and trustworthy data. Our teams are small, about three engineers each, and AI tools let every one of them cover a lot of ground. Staff Engineers here stay hands\-on: most of the week goes to building, and the rest to leading the team and growing the people on it. **What you'll do** * Design and build the data foundations of Greenlight Rent: event and data models, ingestion from our application databases and partner integrations (property management systems, payment providers), and the warehouse and transformation layer * Write production application code too: the services, APIs and jobs that generate and use data, not only what happens downstream of them * Own measurable outcomes with your product and business partners, and make the scope and sequencing calls that get you there * Own the reliability and correctness of the data the business depends on, including monthly close, reporting and partner data * Write high\-quality code and set standards for testing, code review, observability and data quality, including when AI\-generated code needs a closer look * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and tradeoff decisions, and document them clearly * Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and lead a few direct reports * Keep sensitive financial and personal data secure and compliant **What you bring** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including technical leadership at the senior or staff level * A software engineer first: deep expertise in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript or Java), and a record of building and shipping application systems, not only data pipelines * Strong data engineering: SQL, data modeling, warehouses (e.g., Snowflake or BigQuery), transformation (e.g., dbt) and orchestration (e.g., Prefect or Airflow) * Experience designing and scaling APIs, distributed systems and relational databases * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and CI/CD * Product sense: you care about why something gets built and whether it worked, not just how it's built * Fluency with AI coding tools, and the judgment to know when their output isn't good enough * A track record of leading ambiguous, high\-impact projects to completion * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical partners **Nice to have** * Experience in fintech, insurtech, payments or proptech * Familiarity with regulated environments (e.g., SOC 2, PCI, consumer\-finance rules) * Experience building 0\-to\-1 products or data platforms at a startup or growth\-stage company * Experience managing engineers, or a wish to grow into it **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Salary Range:** $195,000 \- $235,000 Greenlight Rent has partnered with a number of compensation benchmarking tools to determine competitive and fair market pay bands for our size and stage. Our goal is to ensure each employee is paid equitably and competitively while also maintaining a consistent and standardized methodology. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level and balancing internal equity relative to other teammates. Base salary is just one part of our Total Rewards Package here at Greenlight Rent. In connection with this position, we also offer: * Competitive cash compensation package including base salary, milestone based bonus, and other financial perks * Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (up to 90% employer contribution) \- eligible from your start date * 401(k), HSA, Life \& Disability Insurance Coverage ($0 employee contribution for additional insurances) * Unlimited PTO Policy * Generous Paid Parental Leave * Stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Greenlight’s success * Remote\-first work culture with opportunities to collaborate as a team in person * Monthly lifestyle stipend to fit your needs (meals, wellness, co\-working)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Financial AI Product
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ### **About the Financial AI Product Team** Rippling’s Financial Product team builds the systems that power some of the most critical financial workflows for modern businesses — including payroll, payments, reconciliation, compliance, and operational finance. These products sit at the intersection of money movement, employee trust, customer operations, and regulatory complexity. The work is high stakes: financial systems must be accurate, reliable, auditable, and resilient, even as they handle messy real\-world data and complex business rules across customers, countries, and use cases. We are using AI to make these workflows dramatically simpler. That means building systems that can interpret inconsistent data, automate manual review, surface exceptions, explain outcomes, and accelerate implementation — while preserving the deterministic controls financial products require. The goal is not AI for its own sake; it is practical, production\-grade AI that helps customers run financial workflows with more speed, confidence, and accuracy. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will help define how AI becomes a core part of financial product and infrastructure at Rippling.### **What you will do** * Build AI\-powered product capabilities for complex financial workflows such as onboarding, data ingestion, reconciliation, validation, exception handling, and operational review. * Design systems that combine model\-driven reasoning with deterministic financial execution. * Build workflows that trace financial values back to source evidence, surface unresolved gaps, and prevent downstream execution when validation fails. * Create ingestion and normalization systems that can handle messy exports, historical records, customer\-provided files, and inconsistent provider formats. * Develop evals, testing harnesses, observability, and feedback loops to measure AI quality in workflows where “almost always right” is not good enough. * Partner closely with product, design, operations, compliance, and platform teams to identify high\-impact AI opportunities and turn them into reliable product capabilities. * Work through ambiguous product areas, prototype quickly, and scale successful solutions into reusable product and platform primitives. * Help set the engineering bar for correctness, auditability, security, reliability, and production safety in AI\-enabled and new AI native financial products. ### **What you will need** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems at meaningful scale. * Experience designing backend systems, data models, APIs, workflows, or platform infrastructure for complex business domains. * Strong judgment around reliability, correctness, edge cases, and operational risk. * Interest in applied AI, LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, structured extraction, or AI\-assisted workflows. * Ability to reason clearly about where AI should be used, where deterministic systems should take over, and how to build guardrails around model\-driven workflows. * Product sense and comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces where the right answer is not obvious upfront. * Ability to partner with product managers, domain experts, operations teams, and engineers to turn messy real\-world workflows into simple, scalable software. * A high\-ownership mindset: you can take a problem from vague customer pain through architecture, implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. ### **Additional Information** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), **Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy**, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: IT Specialist
jobs.description: The IT Specialist provides skilled technical support to end users across a unique BYOD (bring\-your\-own\-device) research environment, and supports the endpoint, identity, and collaboration services that environment depends on. The position independently identifies, researches, and resolves technical problems across endpoints, accounts, collaboration services, connectivity, and workplace technology. It documents, tracks, and monitors work to ensure timely resolution, and works to the account provisioning, security, and endpoint configuration standards owned by the Senior and Lead IT Specialists. Because the Institute is a research organization, the role extends beyond conventional corporate end\-user support. It includes supporting specialized scientific workstations and laboratory computers, access to high\-capacity research storage, research and scientific applications, instrument\-attached systems, and conference\-room and collaboration technology. **Who We Are** The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all (https://www.salk.edu/about/our\-community/) members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research. Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders (https://www.salk.edu/about/management\-team/) to dedicated administrators (https://www.salk.edu/administration/) and brilliant faculty members (https://www.salk.edu/science/directory/faculty/), the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation. **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be** * **End\-User Technical Support — Tier 1 and Tier 2** + Serves as first point of contact for end\-user requests received by telephone, email, ticket, remote tools and in person, and provides second\-line resolution for issues requiring deeper diagnosis. + Troubleshoots hardware, software, operating system, application and network connectivity issues across macOS, Windows, Linux and mobile platforms. + Troubleshoots Microsoft 365, business and scientific applications, printers, peripherals, VPN, Wi\-Fi and mobile\-device issues. + Installs, configures and maintains desktops, laptops, mobile devices and peripheral equipment. + Supports specialized scientific workstations, laboratory computers and instrument\-attached systems; provides access to high\-capacity research storage; installs and troubleshoots research and scientific applications. + Provides support across the main campus and remote Institute sites, including scheduled site visits. + Provides user training and guidance in supported technologies and applications, and communicates technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users. * **Endpoint, Identity, Collaboration and Workplace Technology Administration** + Configures and deploys laptops, desktops, mobile devices and peripherals to the Institute’s standard configurations, and applies operating system and application updates. + Supports endpoint\-management platforms such as Intune, Jamf or SCCM/MECM under established configuration standards. + Supports existing user accounts, including passwords, lockouts, multi\-factor authentication, group membership, and permissions in Active Directory and Entra ID, working to the provisioning standards owned by the Senior and Lead IT Specialists. + Supports Exchange Online and Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Office applications and collaboration services, including mailboxes, calendars, room calendars and distribution lists. + Supports mapped drives, shared folders, OneDrive, Box, SharePoint and external storage, and assists with user data migrations. + Supports telephony extensions, voicemail and call routing, printers, scanners, conference\-room systems, displays and AV equipment. + Verifies that endpoints carry required security controls and remain compliant with institutional configuration standards. * **Diagnosis, Root Cause and Tier 3 Escalation** + Diagnoses unfamiliar and intermittent faults, and determines whether an issue originates in the endpoint, application, account, network or upstream infrastructure. + Recognizes and reports suspected phishing, malware, and compromised\-account activity, and follows the defined escalation procedure to the Cybersecurity Engineer. + Diagnoses wired and wireless connectivity, DNS, DHCP, VPN and basic network pro  and peripheral support experience in a multi\-platform environment. * Minimum two years supporting macOS and Windows operating systems and business applications; working familiarity with Linux. * Minimum two years providing IT support services using a ticketing system, with demonstrated ownership of a personal queue. * Demonstrated experience administering user accounts, group membership and permissions in Active Directory or a comparable directory service. * Demonstrated experience with endpoint deployment, imaging or provisioning, and secure device disposal. **What We Can Offer** **The expected pay range for this position is $31\.25\-$34\.60 hourly.** Salk Institute provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the institute reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. **Benefits** Salk Institute offers competitive benefits (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/benefits/), including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, patient advocacy services, and transit/parking program. **Salk Values** The Salk Community, both scientists and administrators, worked together to define values that we believe support Salk’s pursuit of excellence. To be truly the best scientific institution requires not only incredible discoveries, but a common understanding of how we should work together to enable those discoveries. The acronym “I CARE” (https://www.salk.edu/about/careers/values/) provides a simple way to remember each of the values and reminds each of us of the importance of what we do each day. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** The Salk Institute for Biological Studies is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal access to opportunities for students, employees, applicants for employment and other visitors. Salk has also adopted and maintains a policy to encourage professional and respectful workplace behavior and prevent discriminatory and harassing conduct in our workplace. jobs.title: Principal Engineer ( AI + Dev Tooling)
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **About the team** ------------------ The Developer Tooling team empowers Scribd engineers across the entire software development lifecycle. We build and evolve the tools, frameworks, and platforms that power engineering workflows — from modernizing infrastructure and optimizing build and deployment processes to pioneering agentic engineering capabilities that let AI agents execute alongside our developers. Our work delivers broad, measurable impact by boosting productivity and elevating the developer experience company\-wide. **About the role** ------------------ This is a Principal Engineer role, and it comes with a clear mandate: define how Scribd builds software as AI changes the work. You'll own the technical vision for agentic engineering at Scribd: how hundreds of engineers work alongside coding agents to write, review, and ship code across our stack. The roadmap here isn't handed to you. You decide where we invest, set the direction, and carry it through to what engineers actually use every day. You'll work directly with the CTO and engineering leadership to make agentic engineering a lasting advantage for the company, and the standards you set will shape how every team works. **About you** You care about developer experience, and you get real satisfaction from taking friction out of how engineers work. You think in platforms and systems, and you know when to protect stability and when to move fast. You've used coding agents seriously enough to have strong opinions about where they work, where they struggle, and what that means for how codebases and workflows need to change to get the most out of them. You're comfortable with a wide remit and a lot of ambiguity. Hand you a hard, loosely defined problem and the room to solve it, and that's a good day. **What you will do** * Decide the architecture, patterns, and guardrails that let engineers and coding agents work together across our codebase, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure, and set the direction for where it goes next. * Set the direction for Scribd's internal tools, libraries, and platforms, setting standards that engineers across the company rely on. * Partner with engineering leaders to turn ambiguous, cross\-org problems into initiatives, and own them from framing through delivery. * Raise the bar across the org.
