jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Rust
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! **About The Team** The Hub Applications team builds core functionality of the software that runs on SmartThings hubs and keeps them connected to the cloud. Written primarily in Rust, our software is responsible for letting millions of connected homes reliably control their devices, stay in sync, and receive improvements over time. Some of our core responsibilities are:* **Local device execution:** Building and maintaining the runtime that lets hubs run device integrations directly on the hub. * **Hub and cloud data flow:** Ensuring device state, events, and commands move reliably between hubs and the cloud, that cloud and hub data records stay synchronized, and that hubs recover gracefully after losing connectivity. * **Core hub software architecture:** Reshaping the hub’s core services so they’re easier to maintain, faster, and ready for new hardware.. * **Configuration and system management:** Designing how hubs receive, validate, and safely roll back configuration, and keeping core system behavior such as timekeeping consistent and resilient. * **Release quality and observability:** Monitoring software releases across the hub population and building the metrics and tooling that surface problems early. **About The Role** We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Applications team. This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone with expert\-level Rust skills. You’ll write, review, and set the standard for the Rust code that runs on millions of SmartThings hubs, where performance, memory use, and reliability on resource\-constrained devices matter. Comfort with Rust’s ownership model, concurrency, and error handling is essential, as is experience working across the boundary between Rust and existing C code. You’ll help drive long\-term technical strategy for our core areas, including evolving the hub’s foundational software toward a more modular, maintainable design. Operating with autonomy, you’ll bring clarity to complex, cross\-functional challenges and act as a go\-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives. Close partnership with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams will shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. Mentoring engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and guiding how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational practices are also part of the role. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown, with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is $139,000 to $198,000, with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Own the long\-term technical direction for one or more Hub Applications domains. * **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Lead large, cross\-team projects as the technical owner, from design through rollout. * **Architect for Reliability \& Scale:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems such as local device execution, hub\-to\-cloud data synchronization, and hub configuration and software asset management, with stability, resilience to unreliable connectivity, and operational excellence as first\-class concerns. * **Rust Technical Leadership:** Serve as a deep Rust expert for the team. Set the standard for how we write, review, and test Rust that runs on resource\-constrained devices, with performance, memory efficiency, and safe concurrency as everyday concerns. Guide the evolution of existing code, including where Rust meets legacy C. * **AI Practices \& Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward\-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs. * **Mentor \& Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, in p capacity * Expert\-level proficiency in Rust, with deep knowledge of ownership and lifetimes, async and multithreaded concurrency, error handling, and writing performant, memory\-efficient code for resource\-constrained devices * Strong systems programming experience on embedded Linux or similar constrained environments, including debugging crashes, memory issues, and performance problems in production * Experience designing for unreliable networks: offline operation, state reconciliation, retry and backoff behavior, and graceful recovery * Strong knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Proven ability to lead architecture and design reviews, set technical direction across teams, and bring about simple solutions to complex problems * Strong track record of cross\-functional collaboration with firmware, cloud, and product teams * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience translating technical strategy for both technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Experience interoperating Rust with C or C\+\+ codebases, including incremental migration of legacy code * Experience with IoT connectivity protocols and standards (Matter, Zigbee, Thread, MQTT) * Experience with embedded scripting runtimes or sandboxed code execution (e.g. Lua, WebAssembly) * Experience with IoT fleet management: staged rollouts, feature flags, monitoring, and lifecycle management at scale * Experience with observability tooling and release monitoring for large deployed device populations * Experience with CI/CD and automated validation for embedded software ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches once a week. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is **$139,000 to $198,000\.** Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. So if you’re innovative, not afraid to challenge status quo, collaborative and have a passion for technology, then you’ve found your next home with SmartThings!

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description: ### **About SnapLogic** SnapLogic powers the agentic enterprise. The company's Agentic Integration and Applied AI Platform serves as the AI operational layer for the enterprise, securely connecting applications, data, APIs and AI agents across cloud, on\-premise and hybrid environments. With trusted orchestration, governance and enterprise\-grade control, SnapLogic helps organizations accelerate business value and scale AI with confidence. Unlike legacy tools, SnapLogic is built for the AI era and trusted by global enterprises, including AstraZeneca, Adobe, Verizon, and Sony, to modernize operations and power the next generation of enterprise AI. **Join the Agentic Integration movement at** **snaplogic.com****.** The Role: As the Director of Software Engineering, you are a hands\-on, "rock star" Java developer and visionary leader responsible for driving the development of enterprise\-grade cloud SaaS/PaaS distributed applications. You will orchestrate the broader engineering ecosystem by deriving a roadmap that balances commitments, tech debt, and product innovation to mitigate risk. By balancing technical excellence with business ROI, you will spearhead SRE and agile process improvements, mentor team leads, and foster a high\-performing culture. You will also act as the eyes and ears to customer needs, collaborating closely with customers, field teams, and company leadership to continually innovate the product experience. ### **The Role:** As Director of Platform Engineering, you own the platform that every SnapLogic service runs on: the control plane, the data layer behind it, and the operational tooling that keeps it healthy in production. You are a hands\-on technical leader and a people leader. You set the architectural direction, you build and grow the team that executes it, and you stay close enough to the systems to make real decisions about them. This is a role for a leader with real depth in distributed systems and the data layer that backs them. You will hold your team to end\-to\-end understanding of the systems they operate, and you will be expected to have that understanding yourself. SnapLogic runs roughly 50 MongoDB clusters across production and test, holding more than 60TB of data, and that footprint is a core part of the charter. You will derive a roadmap that balances customer commitments, technical debt, and platform innovation, and you will be judged on reliability and scale as much as on delivery. You are also the eyes and ears on platform health for the wider engineering organization, working with SRE, application teams, support, and company leadership. This is a hybrid role based at our HQ in San Mateo, CA, with the requirement to work in the office two days per week### **What You'll Do:** * **Platform Ownership \& Architecture** You own the services that make up SnapLogic's control plane. You set the architectural direction for reliability, performance, and scalability across services, the data layer, and upstream dependencies. You review designs for criticalcomponents, you make the call on build versus buy, and you keep a clear view of risk versus reward on every production change. You decide how much of your own time goes to coding and code review, and you keep enough hands\-on depth to lead the work credibly. * **Engineering Leadership \& Team Building** You have led and managed engineering teams, and you think constantly about team productivity, quality, and health. You own hiring for the team, including the forecast and budget, recruiting strong engineers, and promoting and growing the people already here. You organize the team to make impactful changes, you delegate technical ownership over subject matter areas, you establish leads and empower them to mentor their own reports, and you give direct, constructive feedback. You run regular one\-on\-ones, advocate for career growth, and resolve conflict early. * **Reliability, SRE, \& Production Support** You are accountable for the zero\-downtime SLA. You drive root cause analysis, own SRE process improvements, and make sure those processes are actually followed. You keep your eyes on production at all times and pull in resources before widespread impact is felt. You turn every incident into a durable improvement: better tests, observability, automation, or a design change. You manage support escalations, stay in close contact with the support manager, and join customer escalation calls when needed. * **Cloud\-Native Infrastructure \& GitOps** You understand Kubernetes well beyond deploying workloads: operators and custom resources, policy enforcement, networking, IAM integration, and capacity. You lead the ongoing move of legacy EC2\-based services onto Kubernetes without putting availability at risk. You treat developer self\-service, environments on demand and an internal developer portal as a product your team owns. * **Data Layer at Scale** You own the strategy for a MongoDB footprint of roughly 50 clusters and more than 60 va and/or Python, with the comfort to pick up new languages and stacks * Deep experience operating distributed systems in production: debugging, profiling, capacity planning, and incident response * Track record of taking systems from design through production rollout and owning them after launch * Solid grasp of databases, relational or NoSQL, including query performance, indexing, and schema design trade\-offs * Deep understanding of distributed systems, including HTTP protocols, distributed caching strategies, and observability * Experience being accountable for an availability SLA on a customer\-facing platform * Hands\-on experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS, including troubleshooting cluster, networking and workload issues * Experience with GitOps delivery (ArgoCD) and infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with cloud infrastructure, AWS preferred, containers, and CI/CD * Familiarity with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, structured logs) and SRE practices * Experience implementing continuous delivery and cloud deployment solutions * Multi\-tenant public and private cloud experience * Hands\-on experience operating MongoDB, or another NoSQL database, at scale: sharding, replica sets, query profiling, and index tuning * Agile project and release management * A record of accurate, fast decision making under production pressure The above range is the approximate annual U.S. base pay range for this position. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the range listed. In addition to base salaries, certain roles are also eligible for annual cash bonuses or commissions. All of our full time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package.### **Why Join:** There's never been a better time to join our **SnapSquad**! At SnapLogic, we believe in empowering people \- customers and employees alike \- to connect what matters and build what’s next. From competitive salaries to global wellness benefits, we’re committed to your success and well\-being. ### **A Few Reasons You’ll Love it Here:** #### **We’re Innovators** SnapLogic pioneered the first AI integration assistant, SnapGPT, and continues to lead with a full suite of AI\-powered tools across our agentic integration platform \- making integration faster, smarter, and accessible to more people. #### **We’re Recognized Leaders** From being named a Visionary in multiple Gartner Magic Quadrants, leading the market in innovative AI reports from Aragon Research, or being recognized for our AI developments in the SaaS Awards, we’re setting the pace in a rapidly evolving market. #### **We’re Growing Fast** SnapLogic’s revenue growth earned us a place on the 2026 Inc. 5000, recognizing America's fastest growing companies. As we scale globally, we’re creating opportunities for ambitious builders and operators to make a bigger impact, take deeper ownership, and accelerate their careers. #### **We’re Agentic** Our platform empowers everyone across the enterprise to create automated, AI\-connected workflows. That means more impact, less friction, and a bigger role for YOU in driving transformation. **Are you ready to help build what’s next for the enterprise? Let’s talk.** Apply now and help us power the agentic enterprise. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking an AI Specialist who can provide hands\-on expertise and support while working with technical decision makers and data scientists to design and architect AI solutions built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. This is a strategic role that works closely with cross\-functional teams, including product, engineering, and the broader field organization to ensure successful execution and customer adoption of Snowflake’s AI \& ML solutions. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:** --------------------------------- * Be the technical expert in the room that positions Snowflake’s AI and ML features and value to technical stakeholders at Snowflake’s customers across the Americas. * Partner with Snowflake account team teams and customer champions to scope and drive POCs to success and technical wins that prove the value of Snowflake’s capabilities, including executive readouts and business value cases. * Collaborate with Snowflake’s product and engineering teams to influence Snowflake’s AI and ML roadmaps based on customer feedback. * Publish content that helps the team and company scale beyond your individual efforts, like blog posts, presentations at conferences, or technical collateral like notebooks and demos. * Influence, tailor and maintain Sales Engineering AI and ML selling assets, including customer presentations, demonstrations, and customer stories. **ON DAY ONE, WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:** ------------------------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud. * Familiarity and associated knowledge of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, or fine\-tuning that are used to operationalize enterprise AI use cases like interactive chat applications or text processing. * Deep knowledge of Python and common ML packages (such as LangChain, pandas, sklearn, and PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies like dbt, Airflow, and Spark. * Strong presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos. * Bachelor’s Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred. **BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:** --------------------------------------------------- * Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, **or other OSS packages.** * Experience and understanding of large\-scale infrastructure\-as\-a\-service platforms (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, etc.) * 1\+ years of practical Snowflake experience. * Knowledge of and experience with large\-scale database technology (e.g. Snowflake, Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, etc.) Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on\-target earnings of $220,000 \- $288,750\. The estimated base salary for this role is $165,000 \- $216,562\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Developer **Company:** SMRTR **Location:** United States or Canada, Remote **Employment Type :** Full\-time **About SMRTR** SMRTR builds software that helps businesses run more efficiently. Together with our sister companies Shea, a SYSPRO ERP partner, and DTEC, a distribution ERP provider, we are part of Solen Software Group. Our customers rely on us every day, and our Subscriptions, Renewals, Collections \& Accounting team keeps that relationship healthy, making sure software subscriptions, renewals and services are billed on time and accurately, and that outstanding balances are resolved quickly and professionally. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a software developer with 3–5 years of experience to build product features and integrations for NG and SMRTR TRAC. Our stack is Vue, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, with services on the JVM (Scala). Working with our Director of Software Engineering, you will help deliver our 2027 roadmap: connecting our products to the ERP systems our customers run (starting with SYSPRO), AI\-powered document capture, and new NG and TRAC features. You will join a small, experienced team where what you build reaches customers quickly. **Key Responsibilities** **Product development** * Build features across the front end (Vue, TypeScript) and back end (Node.js, Scala/JVM) for NG and SMRTR TRAC. * Design and work with PostgreSQL data models and queries (and some MongoDB), with attention to performance. * Fix defects and improve the reliability of the products you work on. **Integrations and APIs** * Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations between NG / SMRTR TRAC and ERP systems such as SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI and NCR, following the team's integration patterns. * Contribute to AI document capture (classification and data extraction) and the print\-to\-NG driver. **Delivery and collaboration** * Turn requirements from Professional Services, Sales and customers into working software, with guidance from engineering leadership. * Estimate your own tasks and deliver to agreed dates. * Support go\-lives and help troubleshoot production issues. **Engineering practices** * Write tested, reviewed and secure code in our GitHub\-based workflow with CI/CD. * Write clear technical documentation and release notes. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to work faster, safely. **What You Bring** **Required** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Production experience with Vue.js, TypeScript and Node.js. * PostgreSQL: schema design, SQL and query performance. * JVM experience, preferably Scala. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating with third\-party systems. * Git\-based workflows, code review and automated testing. * Clear communication with colleagues and, when needed, customers. * Authorized to work in the United States or Canada; set up for remote work. **Nice to Have** * MongoDB. * Android or Xamarin. * ERP integration experience (e.g., SYSPRO, Microsoft Dynamics 365, VAI, NCR). * Document management, OCR or AI document capture. * Experience with manufacturing, distribution or food \& beverage software. **How Success Is Measured** * Features and integrations delivered on schedule * Quality: defects and production incidents in your code * Accuracy of estimates on your own work * Growing ownership of product areas over the year **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary of USD 65,000–85,000 (United States) or CAD 95,000–110,000 (Canada), depending on experience and location * Benefits according to country of employment (in the US: health, dental and vision insurance and a 401(k) with company match) * Paid time off and company holidays * Fully remote work with a collaborative, experienced team **Recruitment Disclaimer** Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels. ***We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.***

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Data & Machine Learning
jobs.description: Position Type: Location(s): United States, San Mateo, CA Date Posted: Job ID: R\-125392 **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. ### **Sr. Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning** **San Mateo, CA** ### **Why PlayStation Data \& Intelligence** PlayStation reaches more than 100\+ million people. Behind those experiences is one of the largest consumer data estates in entertainment: tens of petabytes under management and trillions of telemetry events a year, powering personalization, experimentation, partner analytics and enterprise decisions across the company. We are in the middle of a multi\-year shift in how that data creates value. Today intelligence often arrives after the moment has passed. Our goal is a connected intelligence layer where trusted context about players, content, partners and the business is built once, reused everywhere, activated at the point of decision, and improved by evidence about what happened next. That includes serving AI models and agents with the same governed meaning, quality and permissions we give to people. This role helps shape how that is built across PlayStation. **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Principal Engineer, Data \& Machine Learning to serve as chief architect for our Data \& Intelligence organization and as the senior technical authority for how SIE builds, reuses and activates trusted data and intelligence. This is one of SIE’s most senior individual\-contributor roles. You will report directly to the Vice President of the organization, sit on the leadership team alongside the Sr. Directors who run our two delivery portfolios, chair our architecture review forum, and lead a community of Principal Engineers anchored to the major architectural seams. You will have no direct reports by design; your leverage comes from the architecture, the standards and the decisions the whole organization builds against. This is a hands\-on role. You will author architectures and reference implementations, prototype uncertain approaches, review the designs and code that matter most, and step in directly when a technical problem puts an important outcome at risk. **What You’ll Own** You will set the architecture for, and drive reuse across, the initiatives that define the next three years of data and intelligence at PlayStation: * **A single, reusable understanding of the player.** The context, lifecycle and lifetime\-value intelligence that powers experiences and decisions across PlayStation, built once and reused rather than rebuilt per use case. * **Content and game understanding.** Intelligence about titles, experiences and how players engage with them, connected through engagement and content graphs to improve discovery, personalization and new AI experiences. * **Creator and partner intelligence.** Reusable title, launch and lifecycle intelligence available to partners at the point of decision, before launch, while live and after. * **Unified measurement.** Experimentation, attribution and causal measurement so the company knows what changed an outcome, by how much, and what to do next. * **Activation.** Real\-time signals, activation data products and APIs that deliver trusted context into the systems that personalize and act. * **Semantic and conversational intelligence.** A shared layer of business meaning and metrics that people, analytical tools and AI agents can query and trust. * **Enterprise decision data.** Decision\-grade finance and supply\-chain data that accelerates transformation programs across SIE. * **Trusted foundations and golden paths.** Data contracts, certification, lineage, unified events and standard publish\-to\-consume paths, with trust designed into the lifecycle; and launch data readiness so priority launches have their signals and measures from day one. **What You’ll Do** * Translate our multi\-year Data \& Intelligence strategy into a coherent technical strategy and target architecture, with clear principles for trusted data products, ML systems, shared intelligence, evaluation, activation and lifecycle management. * Chair the architecture review forum: set its charter and cadence, publish decisions, track adoption and hold the line on non\-conforming designs. * Own the boundary decisions between platform capabilities built for reuse and domain delivery, and keep th Deep expertise in at least two of: reusable data products, semantic and metadata layers and data contracts; ML platforms, lifecycle management, evaluation and decisioning; real\-time signals, distributed inference and activation platforms; experimentation and causal measurement; generative AI, retrieval and agentic systems; responsible AI, privacy and technical governance. * Strong command of distributed systems, cloud, data architecture, APIs, security, reliability, observability and performance engineering. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, engineering and product leaders, and cross\-functional partners without direct authority. * Outstanding written communication. This role leads through documents. * Experience mentoring Staff, Principal or similarly senior technical professionals. * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Data and ML applied in gaming, entertainment, media, digital commerce or another large\-scale consumer ecosystem. * Personalization, recommendations, customer intelligence, content intelligence, experimentation or predictive decisioning at scale. * Shared data or ML platforms serving multiple products and organizational domains. * Feature, vector, graph, semantic or knowledge platforms; AI gateways and LLMOps. * Experience translating research or emerging technology into production capabilities. * Contributions to the field through open source, patents, publications, standards or conference talks. **Why You’ll Love This Role** * Set the technical direction for data and intelligence across PlayStation. * Own the architecture behind experiences reaching more than 100 million people. * Report directly to the VP and sit on the organization’s leadership team. * Build once, reuse everywhere: the mandate is to end duplicated work, not add to it. * Work with strong Principal and Staff engineers, data scientists and product leaders across the company. * Stay hands\-on at the most senior IC level. \#LI\-KS1 At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location. Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top\-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below. $304,200—$456,200 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As a Project Engineer, you’ll help move civil infrastructure projects from planning and design through permitting and construction. You’ll coordinate schedules, support project management, and turn engineering analysis into clear plans and reports. Your work may span pipelines, stormwater systems, and water treatment projects, with opportunities to collaborate with clients, field teams, and technical specialists. **Responsibilities** * Support project scheduling, construction estimating, design engineering, and construction management across project phases. * Prepare and review schematics, technical engineering reports, and technical writing; contribute to permitting phase involvement and client communication. * Apply hydrologic analysis tools and hydrological modeling to stormwater management and stormwater systems. * Support construction inspection, land surveying, and coordination of project teams; provide team leadership as assigned. * Your impact: By coordinating sound designs with field execution, you help clients and communities receive reliable civil infrastructure. **Qualifications** * Experience managing projects in an engineering role, with civil engineering, civil infrastructure, and construction experience. * Project management skills and technical proficiency with CAD (computer\-aided design) software; relevant tools may include AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, MicroStation, Bluebeam, GIS (geographic information systems), and ArcGIS. * Familiarity with Mathcad, HEC (Hydrologic Engineering Center) tools, and SWMM (Storm Water Management Model) is useful for engineering analysis. * Knowledge of pipeline projects, water treatment, construction inspection, permitting, and stormwater management is valued. * Strong communication, technical writing, and collaboration skills; experience with design engineering, construction management, or hydrologic analysis tools is preferred. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $240,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Flexible schedule * Health savings account * Paid time off * Parental leave * Referral program * Relocation assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Diego, CA 92110

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** The Principal Data Scientist for Enterprise Data \& Customer Analytics provides senior technical leadership in the design, development, deployment, and responsible use of advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions. This role transforms complex enterprise and customer data into actionable intelligence, production\-ready models, and reusable analytical capabilities that improve customer experiences, business decisions, and operational outcomes. The position combines deep data science and software engineering expertise with business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and enterprise influence. The Principal Data Scientist works across business and technology teams to identify high\-value opportunities, establish technical standards, guide model development, and communicate complex findings in a clear and decision\-oriented manner. **JOB REQUIREMENTS** **Education and Experience** * Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a closely related quantitative field is required. * Must have a minimum of 6 years of experience working with large, diverse, and sensitive datasets and translating analytical results into measurable business value. * Extensive progressive experience applying data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or artificial intelligence to complex business problems, including experience serving as a senior technical lead or principal\-level individual contributor. * Demonstrated experience developing, validating, deploying, monitoring, and improving analytical and machine learning models in enterprise environments. Experience in the energy, utility, customer analytics, or other highly regulated industry is preferred. * **Technical Knowledge and Skills** * Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark for data preparation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical analysis, machine learning, and production\-scale model development. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of Databricks, including collaborative development, distributed computing with Apache Spark, ML lifecycle practices, model tracking, governed data access, and deployment patterns. * Advanced knowledge of statistical methods, experimental design, causal reasoning, predictive modeling, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, and model evaluation. * Demonstrated knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, natural language processing, neural networks, ensemble methods, recommendation techniques, and other modern machine learning approaches. * Strong knowledge of large language models, including prompt design, model interaction patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, evaluation, grounding, guardrails, and responsible AI considerations. * Experience developing or adapting models through techniques such as fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient tuning, feature engineering, hyperparameter optimization, and systematic experimentation. * Ability to design reliable model evaluation approaches for predictive and generative AI solutions, including quality, accuracy, bias, explainability, safety, drift, performance, and business\-impact measures. * Strong SQL and data engineering skills, including experience integrating structured and unstructured data across enterprise platforms and building repeatable analytical pipelines. * Knowledge of cloud\-based data and AI platforms, software development practices, version control, automated testing, APIs, CI/CD, and MLOps or LLMOps practices. * Ability to debug and troubleshoot complex data, code, model, and performance issues across the analytical lifecycle. Working knowledge of data governance, data privacy, security, model risk, ethical AI, and the appropriate handling of customer and enterprise data. * **Leadership and Business Skills** * Ability to identify and shape high\-value data science and AI opportunities in partnership with customer, operational, product, and technology stakeholders. * Strong consulting, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into meaningful business insight for audiences at all levels of the organization. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction, establish standards, influence without direct authority, and mentor data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business partners. * Ability to balance innovation with production reliability, governance, customer impact, cost, and long\-term maintainability. * Self\-directed, results\-oriented, and able to manage multiple complex assignments with limited technical guidance. Commitment to continuous learning and awareness of emerging data science, machine learning, and generative AI trends. * **MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Partner with Enterprise Data \& Customer Analytics leaders and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and refine use cases that improve customer experienc ery quality. Unless separately assigned, the role does not have direct authority for hiring, termination, performance appraisal, or discipline. **CORE BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES** The successful candidate will demonstrate understanding and application of the Southern Company behaviors: Unquestionable Trust, Superior Performance, and Total Commitment. * Acts ethically and protects customer, employee, and company data. * Delivers results with accountability, sound judgment, and attention to quality. * Thinks strategically and maintains an enterprise perspective when designing sustainable solutions. * Innovates responsibly and tests assumptions with evidence. * Builds constructive partnerships and works effectively across business and technology teams. * Communicates candidly, clearly, and respectfully. * Develops others through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical mentorship. * Adapts to changing priorities and acts with appropriate speed and decisiveness. Demonstrates commitment to continuous learning, inclusion, and safe work practices. * **PREFERRED DIFFERENTIATORS** * Experience delivering customer analytics use cases such as segmentation, propensity, personalization, forecasting, customer journey analysis, service optimization, or next\-best\-action recommendations. * Experience combining enterprise data products with advanced analytics and generative AI capabilities. * Published research, patents, conference presentations, open\-source contributions, or recognized thought leadership in data science, machine learning, or artificial intelligence. * Experience establishing reusable analytical frameworks, technical standards, or enterprise communities of practice. **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Systems (Go)
jobs.description: Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi\-stage work reliably and at scale. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on a challenging class of problems: long\-running AI workflows that call models, tools, and external APIs; maintain state across extended executions; produce structured content and generated media; interact with human reviewers; recover from partial failures; and consistently deliver accurate results to users. The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non\-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress. The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed\-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM\-backed applications, AI agents, or agent\-based systems in production**. You will join at a stage where significant architecture remains to be designed and built. Engineers in this role will have substantial ownership over the patterns, services, infrastructure, and engineering standards that shape the University's AI systems. **Remote Work Eligibility** This position is eligible for remote work for candidates residing in states where Stanbridge University is currently authorized to employ remote employees. Eligible states currently include: **Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas, and Wisconsin.** Candidates must reside in an eligible state at the time of employment. Remote\-work eligibility is subject to University employment requirements and may change based on applicable state requirements. ### **Engineering Environment** The engineering problems addressed by this team include: * **Durable workflow orchestration:** Long\-running, multi\-stage pipelines using persistent state, job queues, checkpoints, resumability, idempotent execution, and recovery from interrupted or orphaned work. * **Multi\-provider model infrastructure:** Routing across commercial model providers with model registries, token and cost controls, rate\-limit handling, retries, circuit breakers, health monitoring, and provider failover. * **Agent and tool orchestration:** Systems in which AI agents interact with tools, APIs, data sources, application services, and deterministic business logic to complete multi\-step work. * **Prompt engineering infrastructure:** Treating prompts as version\-controlled production artifacts with review, testing, regression protection, and measurable behavior. * **Testing non\-deterministic systems:** Recorded and replayable provider interactions, deterministic fixtures, evaluation harnesses, baselines, and regression testing for AI behavior. * **Correctness and quality controls:** Structured\-output validation, automated evaluation, domain\-specific requirements, evidence checking, and safeguards against confident but incorrect model output. * **Human\-in\-the\-loop workflows:** Review and approval stages within automated processes, including systems capable of safely responding when users modify state or inputs during execution. * **Generated media pipelines:** Systems capable of producing and managing documents, audio, imagery, video, and other generated assets. * **Production service architecture:** Go\-based APIs and backend services, relational data stores, job infrastructure, observability, and integrations supporting user\-facing applications. * **Secure ingestion:** Processing user\-supplied and potentially untrusted documents while maintaining appropriate security and authorization boundaries. ### **Two Engineering Emphases** Engineers will meet the same overall technical bar but may bring deeper expertise in one of two areas: ### **Platform and Pipeline** Focused on distributed systems, workflow orchestration, durable state, job queues, recovery, provider infrastructure, latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. This emphasis is particularly well suited for experienced systems engineers who view AI models as powerful components that introduce a new set of distributed\-systems and reliability challenges. ### **Agents and Quality** Focused on agent and tool architecture, prompt systems, context management, evaluation frameworks, regression testing, judge models, evidence validation, and end\-to\-end output quality. This emphasis is particularly well suited for engineers who approach AI behavior through experimentation, measurement, testing, and systematic improvement. Candidates may indicate an area of preference; however, specialization in one area is not required. ### **Essential Functions** * Design, develop, test, deploy, an cation, experience, and qualifications and internal equity ### **Conditions of Employment:** * A job\-related assessment may be required during the interview process. * Must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily and be physically present in the office (unless otherwise noted). * **Employment Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Stanbridge University does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship or participate in employer\-sponsored or employer\-dependent work authorization programs. * **Sponsorship:** Sponsorship now or in the future could include having Stanbridge University sponsor, complete employer documentation, provide attestations or training plans, or otherwise participate in a work\-authorization or employment\-based immigration program in order for an individual to begin or continue employment. Stanbridge University does not provide any such sponsorship. * Employment verification will be conducted to validate work experience per accreditation standards. * Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. * Official transcripts are required prior to hire. Degrees earned outside the United States must be evaluated by a recognized credential evaluation service to determine U.S. degree equivalency and applicable subject\-area coursework. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. ### **Work Environment** * Standard professional and technology\-focused work environment. * Duties are typically performed while sitting at a desk or computer workstation. * Position requires extensive interaction with computers, software development environments, cloud services, AI systems, and technical infrastructure. * Subject to collaboration with cross\-functional teams, changing technical requirements, and demanding project timelines. ### **Physical Demands** * Regularly sits for extended periods. * Physical ability to perform department\-related duties. * Proficient in using electronic keyboards and office equipment. * Effective verbal communication via phone, video conferencing, and in person. * Ability to read fine print, operate computers, and understand voices clearly. * Able to lift, carry, and/or move objects weighing 10–25 pounds as needed. ### **Employee Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Exciting university events * Seasonal motivational health and wellness challenges * Work/Life Balance initiatives * Onsite wellness program / Staff Chiropractor * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) ### **Institutional Values** **Diversity and Inclusion** Stanbridge University’s motto, “Strength through Diversity,” reflects our deep commitment to honoring the diverse backgrounds of our students, faculty, staff, and surrounding communities. We strive to build an inclusive learning environment and uphold anti\-discrimination practices in all aspects of university life. **Innovation and Technology** We embrace cutting\-edge technology to enhance student learning through interactive, hands\-on experiences, including virtual reality and simulation labs—ensuring students are prepared for the demands of modern healthcare practice. **Community Engagement** Through initiatives such as Stanbridge outREACH, students are empowered to give back to local and global communities, cultivating compassion, civic responsibility, and social awareness. ### **Equal Opportunity Employer** Stanbridge University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Controls Programmer – C#/.NET
jobs.description: Description: **Bring Your Software Expertise to Steven Douglas Corp. (SDC)** At **SDC**, we design, engineer, and build custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges for customers across medical, consumer products, industrial, automotive, and other industries. As a family\-owned and growing business, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions by blending proven engineering principles with creative approaches to automation. We are looking for a Controls Programmer who combines strong C\#/.NET development skills with a hands\-on understanding of industrial hardware. In this role, you will work primarily on advanced test and process equipment we build for one of our key customers in the solar manufacturing industry. Most of these systems are PC\-controlled, meaning the application you build is the sole controller, directly driving sensors, motors, drives, and data acquisition hardware in real time. We are looking for team players who enjoy working side by side with our controls engineers and technicians to design, build, and deploy software that keeps this equipment running reliably. **Why Join SDC?** * **Software That Runs Real Machines:** Your applications won’t sit on top of the equipment; they’ll be the controller, running machines on the plant floor and through months\-long tests. * **Collaborative Environment:** Work closely with our controls engineers, technicians, and project managers from design through debug, runoff, and customer startup. * **Family\-Owned Culture:** Experience a supportive and agile environment that values technical excellence and personal growth. **What You’ll Do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy C\# Windows applications that run on industrial machinery and interface directly with sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, and other controls hardware. * Build and support applications where the PC serves as the primary controller in the system, managing real\-time I/O and device communication. * Work directly with controls engineers to understand machine behavior, hardware interfaces, and operator workflows, and translate them into clean, maintainable software. * Support deployment and troubleshooting of your applications during machine debug, runoff, and customer Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). * Maintain and improve existing software tools and code libraries, applying good source control and documentation practices. * Collaborate with the controls team to identify where custom software can improve machine reliability, data visibility, or troubleshooting speed. * Travel approximately 10% to support customer startups and project implementation. Requirements: **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying C\# Windows applications in a .NET environment. * Hands\-on experience developing applications that interface directly with industrial hardware, such as sensors, motors, drives, data acquisition devices, or instrumentation, on machinery or manufacturing/test equipment. * Experience building applications where the PC is the primary controller in the system, handling real\-time I/O, device communication, and control logic. * Solid understanding of software fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, application architecture, debugging, and version control workflows. * Comfortable working on the plant floor alongside engineers and technicians to understand machine behavior and translate it into usable software. * Ability to use AI tools and code generation to work more efficiently while maintaining full responsibility for all output. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with SQL or other databases for storing and retrieving machine or process data. * Experience with GitHub or other source control platforms. * Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data processing, or test automation. * Experience with other industrial controls platforms, such as Allen\-Bradley PLCs, HMIs, Ignition, robotics, or machine vision systems. * Ability to read and understand electrical schematics. **What Success Looks Like** * Successful Electrical Controls Programmers at SDC: * Deliver reliable, well\-structured Windows applications that operators and engineers can use every day. * Build software that communicates cleanly and reliably with the sensors, motors, and hardware it controls. * Develop software capable of running months\-long tests without interruption. * Communicate clearly with engineers, technicians, and project teams about what the software does and why. * Continuously improve our code libraries, tools, and development practices. * Help make every machine's software as solid as the hardware it runs on. **What We Expect From Everyone at SDC** * Every role at SDC is built on a shared set of expectations that define how we work together. * Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and accountability in everything you do. * Treat coworkers, customers, suppliers, and partners with respect. * Communicate openly and collaboratively across all departments. * Take ownership by identifying issues early, proposing solutions, and following through. * Adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a positive, team\-first attitude. * Produce high\-quality, detail\-oriented work that supports safety, quality, and continuous improvement. * Be dependable, willing to learn, and ready to support teammates whenever needed. * Contribute to a workplace built on trust, teamwork, and shared success. **Why Join Steven Douglas Corp.?** * Work on challenging, custom automation projects—not repetitive production support. * Collaborate with an experienced team of engineers, machinists, electricians, assemblers, and project managers. * See your designs come to life from concept through customer startup. * Help shape engineering standards and influence how future machines are built. * Grow your technical skills while working with robotics, vision systems, servo motion, AI\-enabled inspection, and advanced automation technologies. * Join a stable, family\-owned company committed to long\-term growth, innovation, and investing in its people. **Benefits** * Competitive salary based on experience. * Performance\-based incentive opportunities. * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, with supplemental coverage options. * Company\-sponsored Health Savings Account (HSA). * Employee Assistance Program (EAP). * 401(k) with a 4% employer match per pay period. * Paid vacation, sick leave, and 10 company\-paid holidays. * Ongoing opportunities for professional development and career growth.

jobs.title: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer
jobs.description: The Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Controls Engineer is responsible for designing, improving, and supporting control systems for RNG production facilities, with a practical focus on reliable plant operation. This role combines home\-office engineering, field troubleshooting, commissioning support, and ongoing optimization of instrumentation, PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems. The Controls Engineer works closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, OEM suppliers, and environmental teams to improve gas quality, plant uptime, process safety, and regulatory compliance across operating anaerobic digestion facilities. **This is a Remote position with** **travel required****25\-50%** **to our on operations facilities as needed.** **Responsibilities** **Controls \& Automation** * Design, program, and maintain PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems for RNG plant operations. * Develop and optimize control strategies for feedstock receiving systems, gas upgrading systems, compression systems, flare systems, digesters, and utility systems. * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols including Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Profibus, and OPC. * Develop and maintain controls standards, preferred hardware configurations, programming practices, network architecture, and documentation templates that can be applied consistently across multiple RNG facilities while still allowing site\-specific adaptation. * Support design, procurement, installation, commissioning and startup of new equipment and plant expansions. * Implement alarm management and process interlocks to improve plant safety and reliability. * Review control system deliverables from OEMs, system integrators, and engineering contractors, including control narratives, cause\-and\-effect logic, loop diagrams, I/O lists, network drawings, panel drawings, factory acceptance test procedures, and commissioning documentation. **Instrumentation \& Electrical Systems** * Specify, install, calibrate, and maintain process instrumentation including pressure, flow, temperature, methane analyzers, H₂S analyzers, and moisture analyzers. * Troubleshoot control valves, VFDs, motors, analyzers, and field devices. * Review and maintain P\&IDs, control narratives, electrical one\-lines, and instrument loop drawings. * Support electrical systems up to medium voltage where applicable. **Process Optimization** * Analyze plant performance data to improve methane recovery, gas quality, and system efficiency. * Develop and monitor KPIs and performance dashboards for operational improvement. * Optimize digester gas handling, upgrading systems, and pipeline injection controls. * Support root cause analysis for process upsets and downtime events. **Compliance \& Safety** * Ensure plant control systems are designed, configured, documented, and maintained in accordance with applicable OSHA, NEC, NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, ISA, EPA, and local regulatory requirements. * Support environmental reporting and emissions compliance through data collection systems. * Participate in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA), Management of Change (MOC), and HAZOP reviews. * Prepare or review controls\-related Management of Change documentation for software revisions, setpoint changes, interlock modifications, alarm changes, instrument replacements, and control strategy updates that affect plant operation or safety. * Maintain appropriate industrial control system cybersecurity practices, including user access control, network segmentation, backup and recovery practices, vendor remote access controls, and coordination with corporate information technology standards. **Maintenance \& Reliability** * Develop preventative maintenance plans for controls and instrumentation systems. * Lead troubleshooting efforts during unplanned outages. * Provide remote and on\-site troubleshooting support for operating facilities, including review of trend data, alarm history, equipment status, analyzer readings, and operator feedback to diagnose controls\-related causes of downtime or unstable operation. * Support spare parts inventory management for critical controls components. * Coordinate with OEM $145,000 \- $160,000 annually (dependent on experience and geographical location) Why join the Suburban Propane team? Because we care about the physical, mental, and financial wellbeing of our employees and provide them with competitive pay plus incentive potential and an outstanding benefits package including: Medical, dental, and vision (eligibility after just 30 days of employment) Paid time off that increases with tenure A 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting A new employee training program and many opportunities for continued learning and career development Disability and life insurance Employee recognition program Generous tuition assistance program Propane discounts, and more! Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack web applications. * Build responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks. * Develop server\-side logic, application services, and RESTful APIs. * Design and maintain databases to support application functionality. * Integrate third\-party APIs and external software services. * Troubleshoot defects and optimize application stakeholders. * Perform software testing and support application deployments. * Maintain technical documentation and recommend improvements to existing systems. * Apply security best practices to PHP. * Understanding of REST APIs, database design, SQL, and application architecture. * Familiarity with Git or another version control system. * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective communication and collaboration abilities. * Ability to manage development tasks and meet project deadlines. **Preferred Skills** * Experience building and maintaining production web applications. * Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment workflows. * Knowledge of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. * Understanding of application security, web accessibility, and performance optimization. * Experience working in an Agile software development environment. **About the Company** Succinct Solutions is the employer named for this proposed Full Stack Developer jobs.title: Data Engineer, Business Units - Go
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco; Hub \- Seattle **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineeringDataData/Analytics Engineer **Compensation** ---------------- * Zone 1Base Pay: $135K – $205K * Zone 2Base Pay: $117K – $180\.5K *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* *Preferred locations for team members for our Data Platform roles are our San Francisco or Seattle hubs.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** As a Data Engineer on the **Business Unit (BU) Pod supporting Go**, you’ll build the pipelines and data models that help us understand how people use Superhuman’s proactive AI assistant. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to give teams the data they need to improve the product and measure its impact. Go helps people where they already work, through conversations, inline suggestions, and built\-in and custom agents. Understanding how people use these experiences takes more than counting clicks. Your work will help teams see where users get stuck, which capabilities they find useful, and what brings them back. It will also help connect Go’s usage to customer adoption and business growth. You’ll own projects and datasets with a clear scope, supported by experienced engineers. Most of your work will focus on production pipelines and reusable data models that teams can use to answer their own questions. You’ll also contribute analysis and dashboards when they help move a decision forward. As you learn the product and our systems, you’ll have opportunities to take on more complex work. **What you’ll do** * Build and maintain production data pipelines in Databricks that process product events, user activity, and agent interactions across Go. * Develop datasets for onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion so teams can work from consistent metrics. * Work with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to define what needs to be measured, improve event logging, and check that new features are represented correctly in downstream data. * Make data models easy to understand and use, with clear definitions and documentation that support self\-service through analytics and AI tools. Build focused analyses and dashboards when they help partners use the data or make a decision. * Connect Go usage with customer and account data to help teams understand adoption, customer value, and Go’s contribution to growth and revenue. * Keep the datasets you own accurate, up\-to\-date, and reliable. Add tests and monitoring, investigate discrepancies, and fix the underlying causes. * Improve pipeline and query performance, manage compute costs, and make the code you work on easier to maintain. You’ll work alongside engineers and partners across Data Platform and Go. We care about understanding the problem, questioning assumptions, and following through when the answer takes some digging. You’ll contribute to design decisions and have teammates to turn to as you build your expertise. **Qualifications** ------------------ * You have 2\+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines, ideally for product analytics or other critical business use cases. * You’re highly proficient in SQL and have experience writing, debugging, and optimizing transformations in a modern lakehouse or cloud data warehouse such as Databricks or Snowflake. * You understand data modeling and warehouse design, and can turn complex source data into tables that others can understand and reuse. * You test your work carefully, investigate unexpected results, and trace data issues back to their source. * You have experience with workflow orchestration, version control, and deployment practices for data pipelines, using tools such as Databricks Workflows, Airflow, and Git. * You use AI\-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor, and take responsibility for testing and validating the code they produce. * You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners. You can turn a product question into data requirements and explain the assumptions and limitations behind an answer. * You’re curious about how people use products and how your work can help teams make better decisions. * You follow your work through to production, break problems into manageable steps, raise risks and dependencies early, and ask for help when you need it. ### **Nice to have** * Experience using Python and/or Spark for data transformations, pipelines, or automation. * Experience with product or growth analytics, including adoption funnels, retention, conversion, or A/B experiments. * Experience working with event logging and behavioral data from web, desktop, or mobile products. * Experience supporting AI products or agents, including measuring adoption, interaction quality, reliability, latency, or usage costs. * Experience building dashboards or other data tools that product, analytics, and business teams use to answer their own questions. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) and RRSP matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E\-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada). Compensation Range: $117K \- $205K

jobs.description: **Key Responsibilities:*** Define the target architecture and roadmap for machine learning on AWS and Databricks. * Design and implement scalable, secure, and production\-ready ML solutions. * Assess the current Databricks implementation and recommend improvements, integrations, and platform capabilities. * Establish end\-to\-end ML workflows covering data preparation, feature engineering, experimentation, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. * Implement MLOps practices using Databricks and MLflow, including experiment tracking, model management, automated deployment, governance, and monitoring. * Design batch and real\-time model\-inference solutions based on business and technical requirements. * Advise teams on the effective use of Databricks capabilities, including Unity Catalog, Feature Engineering, Model Serving, Lakehouse Monitoring, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow, and Databricks Workflows. * Integrate Databricks with relevant AWS services, such as Amazon S3, IAM, KMS, SageMaker, Lambda, ECR, CloudWatch, and streaming services. * Define reusable architecture patterns, development standards, and platform guardrails. * Establish appropriate security, access\-control, data\-governance, model\-governance, and compliance practices. * Optimize workloads for scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. * Partner with data scientists, data engineers, platform teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to move ML use cases from concept into production. * Provide technical leadership, mentoring, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams. **Required Qualifications:*** Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise machine learning platforms and solutions. * Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks in a production environment. * Deep knowledge of the Databricks Lakehouse architecture and its machine learning capabilities. * Strong experience with MLflow, including experiment tracking, model lifecycle management, deployment, and governance. * Extensive AWS architecture and implementation experience. * Strong understanding of MLOps, CI/CD,
