using Apache Spark/PySpark. * Experience with feature engineering, model evaluation, drift detection, explainability, retraining, and responsible AI practices. * Strong knowledge of data security, IAM, encryption, networking, governance, and regulatory considerations in cloud environments. * Ability to translate business requirements into practical architecture and implementation plans. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Technical Control Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** The Technical Control Engineer ensures the smooth operation and reliability of Symbotic’s automated systems at client sites. This role balances reactive support with proactive monitoring, incident ownership, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, act as a technical lead during high priority incidents, and contribute to scalable processes and knowledge management initiatives. This position partners closely with Engineering, R\&D, Implementation, and Customer Operations to transition new sites from “Hypercare” to steady\-state support, ensuring operational excellence and long\-term system reliability. **What we do** The Technical Support Team is part of Symbotic’s Service Operations Organization and is responsible for the successful stand\-up, performance, and continuous operation of Symbotic systems inside customer sites. Our team supports all production\-impacting aspects of the system—including controls, electrical, software, networking, and infrastructure—and serves as the primary escalation point for real\-time system issues. Working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Implementation, and Customer Operations, Technical Support delivers timely troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and sustainable solutions to ensure system reliability and operational excellence. Through rapid response and strong technical ownership, we strengthen customer relationships and keep automated operations running at peak performance. **What you’ll do** * Manage and resolve complex technical support requests from end users via ticketing systems, phone, email, and chat. * Provide advanced remote support for electro\-mechanical, software, networking, and controls\-related issues using remote access tools. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to: * Automation and robotic systems * PLCs, motors, VFDs, and motion control systems * Software applications, networking, and scripting * Serve as a technical escalation point and act as the focal lead during major incidents. * Coordinate cross\-functional resources (Software, Controls, Hardware, R\&D, Customer Operations) to restore service efficiently. * Prioritize incoming issues based on customer impact, system criticality, and contractual SLAs. * Provide clear, timely updates to internal and external stakeholders during incidents. * Respond to equipment downtime events and coordinate with external vendors or resources as needed. * Proactively monitor system performance metrics, logs, and trends to identify potential failures before they impact operations. * Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical and recurring incidents to reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) and prevent recurrence. * Identify systemic issues and recurring failure patterns, translating insights into preventative actions and process improvements. * Participate in post\-incident reviews and lead follow\-up actions to ensure sustained resolution * Act as a technical owner during critical events, ensuring accountability from incident intake through full resolution. * Collaborate with R\&D, Implementation, and Customer Operations to transition new sites from “Hypercare” to steady\-state support. * Leverage metrics from high\-impact downtime events to create and improve knowledge base content with measurable value to issue resolution and recurrence prevention.. * Contribute to a scalable KB to enable “shift\-left” resolution, improving self\-sufficiency for customers and on\-site Tier 1 teams. * Support ongoing system maintenance activities, including data backups, trend analysis, and I/O checks. * Interpret electrical schematics, OEM manuals, and system documentation to diagnose integrated system issues. * Stay current on supported software, hardware, tools, and platform updates relevant to Symbotic systems. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering or related technical field preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience in industrial automation, robotics, or controls may be considered. * Minimum 2 years of experience in technical support, controls, or engineering role supporting complex systems. * Prior field or industry experience in automation, robotics, warehouse, or supply chain environments preferred. * Demonstrated experience providing remote system support (Remote Desktop, SSH). * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, protocols, and troubleshooting; familiarity with packet sniffers, network probes, and command\-line diagnostic tools. * Proficiency with Linux shell environments and scripting; working knowledge of SQL scripting and application support. * Familiarity with ISC DHCP, BIND, and server configuration. * Experience with motion control systems (servos, VFDs), Allen Bradley ControlLogix, and programming languages such as Ladder Logic, C, and scripting languages. * Experience with server management, Active Directory, and Windows/Linux patching. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills. * Ability to prioritize and perform effectively in high\-pressure, customer\-facing environments. **Our Environment** * Up to 15% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. * The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed bi\-weekly. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $69,000\.00 \- $101,200\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: GIS Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: The Geospatial (GIS) Solution Engineer serves as a technical lead within T\&M’s Applied Technology Practice reporting to the practice leader. This role’s primary focus will be on geospatial technology projects within the Applied Technology practice as well as supporting projects across the engineering market sectors focusing on: data collection and development, application/solution development, GIS enterprise system implementations and maintenance, data visualization, asset management, Esri solution implementation, indoor mapping, and other related technologies, tools and software. **Responsibilities:** * Serve as a technical GIS lead for the organization working with the Director of Applied Technology to identify growth areas in the geospatial technology space. * Support strategic pursuits through stakeholder outreach, proposal development and project management execution. * Create technical applications and demonstration to support business development activities, conferences and other marketing initiatives. * Guide and direct clients on the use of geospatial technology identifying areas to leverage and better utilize its capabilities helping to move them forward. * Work with the Practice Leaders and other company leadership to identify new technologies, software, business lines, and solutions to keep the organization ahead of the industry and our clients. * Guide and mentor junior technical staff to help foster a collaborative environment across the organization. **Professional Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Computer Science, Civil Engineering, Planning or related field is required. * 5\+ years of related experience designing and architecting technology solutions and workflows from concept through implementation with federal, state, county, and local agencies across multiple industries. * Experience with the install, configuration, maintenance, and administration of ArcGIS Enterprise including patching, license renewals, and detail\-oriented troubleshooting. * Experience with RDBM systems such as SQL Server, Oracle, or PostgreSQL and the integration of spatial and non\-spatial databases. * Cloud platform experience such as Azure or AWS for application development and environment hosting as well as utilizing their ML and AI capabilities. * Management and support of field data collection activities including the configuration and maintenance of GPS units and iPads. * Effective communication skills with the ability to convey technical details and information to both technical and non\-technical staff. * GIS Professional (GISP) certification is desired but not required. **Technical Skills:** * Knowledge and experience will the full Esri technology stack from desktop, server, and cloud based technologies to Esri Solutions, software extensions, and development tools. * ArcGIS Indoors and Network Management (Utility Network) solutions * Programming, scripting and automation experience with Python 3\.0 or higher, Arcade, JavaScript, SQL, Command line, ESRI and third party API’s, etc.. * Microsoft PowerBI, Tableau or other business intelligence and visualization tools. * Asset Management software: Maximo, Hexagon, Cartegraph, Cityworks, etc.. * Additional IT, cloud, programming, and database skills related to working with the above. jobs.title: Sr. Director, AI & Data Engineering
jobs.description: T\-Mobile is in pursuit of exceptional talent to join our executive team. We’re committed to excellence and innovation, and we are on the lookout for a leader who can steer our company towards new heights of success. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving strategic initiatives and leading a talented team of professionals. The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success, demonstrating a keen ability to navigate complex challenges and capitalize on emerging opportunities. As a key member of our executive team, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing our organizational strategy and contributing to our continued growth and market leadership. Join us in our commitment to driving innovation, inspiring collaboration, fostering a positive company culture, and achieving unparalleled success. The Sr. Director of AI \& Data Engineering leads the architecture, design, development, and implementation of end\-to\-end data and AI products across the Finance, Procurement and Supply Chain organization and will establish excellence strategically and operationally as we deliver on the following – * Establishing scalable patterns aligned with T\-Mobile northstar architecture * Data Ingest / Egress (pipeline development and system integrations) * Data Product Development (against a data model reflecting FP\&SC business process) * Data Platform Development (enhancing FP\&SC COE’s Lakehouse to continue to follow best practices) In this capacity, the Sr. Director is focused on supporting business decisions through the sustainment of existing platforms and the development and deployment of intelligent data products, platforms, capabilities, architectures, information products and AI products that drive business outcomes.**Un\-carrier® Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of production ready solutions, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure in the cloud using defined enterprise design patterns. * Establish and drive the strategic direction for end\-to\-end information solutions in alignment with strategic priorities and enterprise direction; and lead a leadership team in solving enterprise issues concerning information management to improve information quality, reliability, and scalability. * Promote the development of innovative products, such as AI, in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders. * Support investigation of new software packages/vendors, platforms, and capabilities to deliver quality, reliable, and scalable information, and AI products. * Lead and support other business initiatives across the team with flexibility and a willingness to pitch and bring added value. **The Experience You’ll Bring** * Activate vision \& strategy: Demonstrated success building and leading vision, strategy, and execution of foundational data and information product initiatives, including experience with driving successful platform adoption programs, with the ability to demonstrate the business impact of such initiatives. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** TSi is hiring an AI Automation Engineer: an early\-career, hands\-on developer who has built AI agents and wants to grow in building them securely. This person helps design, build, and maintain AI agents and integrations for TSi's internal operations and for TSi clients. **This is a builder role, not an AI user role.** Technology direction and cybersecurity are owned by the CTO and Senior Director of Technology. This developer builds within that framework and, with guidance from senior staff, writes agents that are secure and privacy\-protective by design — least privilege, controlled data access, human approval where it matters, and full auditability. Applicants must have personally built and deployed at least one AI agent using APIs, tool/function calling, or agent frameworks. During the interview process, you will be expected to demonstrate your work, discuss architectural decisions, and explain how you addressed security and privacy considerations. Applicants who cannot provide a portfolio, repository, demo, or walkthrough of an AI agent they personally built will not be considered. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **AI Agent Development** * Build, test, and deploy AI agents that automate multi\-step business workflows using tool calling, function calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Integrate agents with TSi business systems (e.g., NetSuite, ServiceNow, CPQ, Smartsheet) through APIs and secure connectors. * Support the deployment of AI agents and applications to cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), including configuring services, managing secrets, and monitoring performance. * Maintain code in source control, participate in code review, write automated tests, and document deployments. This position requires hands\-on software development. Daily work includes writing Python and/or TypeScript code, integrating APIs, debugging issues, reviewing code, and deploying solutions. This is not a no\-code or low\-code AI role. **Secure Agent Engineering** * Scope every agent to least privilege: only the tools, data, and permissions the task requires. * Build defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, insecure output handling, and excessive agent autonomy (per the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications). * Require human\-in\-the\-loop approval for high\-impact actions (financial transactions, record changes, external communications). * Manage API keys and credentials through approved secrets management; never hard\-code secrets. * Log agent actions, tool calls, and decisions to support auditing and incident investigation. * Test agents for security issues before release, including basic red\-teaming with guidance from senior staff; document risks and mitigations for review by the CTO and Senior Director of Technology. **Privacy by Design** * Minimize, mask, or redact employee and client PII before it reaches a model or third\-party service. * Follow TSi data classification policy on which data may be used with which models and vendors. * Build with applicable privacy obligations in mind, including state privacy laws and biometric privacy laws (e.g., BIPA) for video and identity data. **Collaboration \& Compliance** * Follow TSi cybersecurity and IT policies and escalate security concerns. * Assist with AI vendor and tool evaluations by providing technical input. * Write clear documentation and runbooks so agents can be supported and audited. * Train end users on the agents you build. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * **Proof of work:** Has built at least one working AI agent (personal, academic, or professional project). A portfolio, repository, or walkthrough is required. * Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control. Please be prepared to share a repository (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) that shows your commit history on a personal, academic, or open\-source project. * 0–2 years of software development experience, including internships or substantial personal projects. * Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python; solid with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and SQL. * Hands\-on experience (professional or project\-based) with a major model’s APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and tooling such as the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, or equivalent. * Working understanding of secure development practices for AI: prompt injection mitigation, least\-privilege tool design, secrets management, input/output validation, and audit logging. * Ability to explain technical decisions and risks. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience integrating with ServiceNow, NetSuite, or Microsoft 365 / Copilot. * Experience with MCP servers/connectors. * Experience with cloud deployment (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud). This is a growth area we will help you develop. **CORE COMPETENCIES** * **Builder:** Focused on getting working agents into use, and learns quickly from feedback. * **Security mindset:** Treats security and privacy as design requirements, not afterthoughts. * **Accountability:** Works independently on well\-scoped tasks in a remote environment, takes ownership of assigned work, and asks for help early. * **Communication:** Explains complex topics in plain language; documents thoroughly.

jobs.title: Wireless Algorithms Engineer (MAC Layer Scheduling)
jobs.description: **Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology** At **Tarana**, we're more than just a fast\-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering **fiber\-class internet speeds** worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible. We are looking for engineers we can grow into this role. You do not need wireless experience. What matters is that you learn quickly, think deeply, and are excited by problems where the answer is not already known. You will be working on the MAC scheduler, the software that decides, thousands of times per second, how spectrum and antenna resources are allocated among users on a sector. It is a hard problem, and it's still evolving. You will work with engineers designing the algorithms running in our product today. You will start by fixing real bugs in production code, which is the fastest way to learn a system of this scale, and you will own a sub\-component. Later, we expect you to propose algorithmic changes that directly affect the performance of our deployed network. This is an opportunity to go from learning an unfamiliar system to shaping the algorithms at its core. **What You’ll Do:** * Learn wireless from the ground up: how signals propagate, why interference happens, what a scheduler is actually optimizing * Read a lot of code written by people who thought hard about it, and get your own code reviewed by them * Debug problems on real hardware, where the answer is often not in the software * Work with field telemetry from a live network and learn to find signal in it * Build simulations to test whether an idea works before anyone commits to building it **What You'll Need:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and the mathematics underneath them: probability, linear algebra, and enough comfort with proofs to reason about why something works * You can already program well. C\+\+ or C preferred, but if you are strong in another language and have written performance\-sensitive code, we will take that seriously * Evidence that you build things because you want to, not because they were assigned. A project you took further than the class required, something you wrote to solve your own problem, a system you built and kept improving * The ability to explain your reasoning clearly, including the parts you are unsure about **What Would Make You Stand Out** * Wireless or communications coursework, including signal processing or information theory. * Optimization, control theory, or applied machine learning. * Embedded or systems programming, or experience where performance and memory constraints mattered. **What we offer:** **We don’t just build next\-gen wireless technology — we build people.** The salary range for this position is: $90,000 to $120,000 Compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Tarana provides competitive benefits to employees in this role, including medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401K match, flexible time off, and stock options. **Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity.** **About Us** Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R\&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next\-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game\-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com. P7cUsmpBPr

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, Cell Assembly
jobs.description: **What to Expect** Gigafactory Texas is seeking a strategic, highly motivated Manufacturing Engineer to help define and scale Tesla’s next\-generation 4680 cell assembly. You will lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced manufacturing equipment and systems, driving long\-term architecture for scalability, flexibility, reliability, quality, speed, and cost. The Manufacturing Engineer will work with cross\-functional teams throughout the entire lifecycle of the product and process, partnering closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Process teams to resolve production equipment issues and support new products from initial design through prototype development and into full production. **What You'll Do*** You will own end\-to\-end Design For Manufacturing (DFM), leading change control, process qualification, commissioning, and formal handovers for new lines, first\-of\-kind and duplicate equipment, retrofits, and optimization projects. Including Prototyping/FAT/SAT/GR\&R/Cpk sign\-off, and delivering required packages (FMEA, BOM, LOTO, SOPs, build\-as\-print), remain engaged post\-handover for change management, OEE ramps, fleet landing plans, vendor qualification, and escalation through Change Control Boards * Deploy, validate, and continuously optimize automated cell assembly equipment for press\-fit/swaging, ultrasonic welding, laser welding, helium leak testing, hi\-pot testing, Electrolyte filling and X\-ray inspection. Drive process characterization, root\-cause analysis (5 Whys, 8D, DMAIC), DOE, SPC, GD\&T, and statistical validation to achieve process capability, high yield, and low downtime * Partner cross\-functionally with R\&D, Ramp, Quality, Maintenance, Automation, and vendors to introduce new cell designs/materials, standardize handover procedures, and close outliers. Optimize cell handling, vision inspection, and joining systems for speed, precision, and repeatability * Design and integrate advanced automation (PLCs, motion control, real\-time data, error\-proofing), sophisticated vision systems (Keyence/Cognex), and pneumatic/mechanical/electrical systems (Bluebeam/AutoCAD/Eplan). Develop safety solutions and culture aligned with OSHA, ISO, TUV, NFPA\-70E, and IEC standards * Develop and enable data\-driven operational and financial decisions through predictive insights into tool and process performance, including integration of factory data systems and use of software such as MySQL, Python, R, JMP, Tableau, and Ignition * Lead multidisciplinary projects (NPI, CAPA, RCA, OCAP) that integrate automation, predictive analytics, and quality systems (PFMEA/DFMEA, risk assessments). Mentor teams, apply Agile/OKRs, and drive improvements in safety, people, accuracy, rate, and cost * This role sits at the intersection of process development, equipment qualification, and production ramp, giving you direct influence on how new and existing systems come online and stay capable **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience * Proficiency designing mechanical equipment, fixtures, and tooling in CAD (SolidWorks; CATIA a plus). Understanding of design for manufacturability and proficiency in rapid prototyping/modeling to roll out upgrades quickly * Proven skills in DFM, equipment/tooling specification and validation, yield/cost optimization, automation integration, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration. Proficiency with CAD (SolidWorks/AutoCAD/Eplan), GD\&T, fixture/tooling design, statistical tools (DOE, SPC, Cpk/Ppk, Minitab/JMP), PFMEA, control plans, MSA/GR\&R, IQ/OQ/PQ, FAT/SAT, Lean/Six Sigma, safety/EHS, MES/Industry 4\.0 data systems, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement * Deep technical expertise treating joining and inspection as an integrated chain: Metal forming/press\-fit/swaging (interference fits, plastic deformation, force/displacement, springback, tooling/die design, press selection, in\-process monitoring, common failure modes, DFM) * Ultrasonic welding (polymer and/or metal weldability, joint/horn/anvil design, parameter windows, equipment troubleshooting, strength/hermeticity validation) * Laser welding (fiber/disk/pulsed systems, beam delivery, thermal/HAZ control, similar/dissimilar metals and plastics, in\-process monitoring, safety, and inspection) * Chemical Filling (Electrolyte depositing, multiple step pressurized dispensing, High speed rotary filling) * Complementary NDT: helium leak testing (vacuum methods, sensitivity, fixtures, GR\&R), hi\-pot testing (electrical safety standards, automation, failure modes), and X\-ray/CT inspection (radiation safety, defect algorithms, 2D/3D, AI\-assisted analysis). Emphasis on equipment specification, vendor management, automation/robotics, simulation, and closing the loop with DFM/DFR for hermeticity, electrical integrity, and internal quality * Leadership experience guiding mid\-to\-large multidisciplinary teams, mentoring others, and delivering company\-wide impact. Comfort with Agile, OKRs, and high\-performing, fast\-changing environments. Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and ability to manage multiple priorities under shifting requirements #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program * Earned Wage Access: Real\-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels) Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Trajan Wealth** With over $3 billion in assets under management and advisement, Trajan® Wealth is one of the fastest\-growing Registered Investment Advisor firms in the country. What sets us apart is our fully integrated, in\-house model \- combining fee\-only wealth management, estate planning through Trajan Estate, and tax strategy through Trajan Tax. We don't refer out critical components of a client's financial life. We bring them together under one fiduciary standard \- the Family Office. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep API management experience to help build, scale, and secure the digital platforms that power our financial services products. You will work across the stack, from designing customer\-facing web experiences to architecting the API gateway, authentication, and integration layer that connects our internal systems, partner banks, and third\-party data providers. This role sits at the intersection of product velocity and platform reliability. You will partner with product managers, designers, security, compliance, and SRE teams to deliver features that meet the regulatory bar of financial services while still moving at the pace our customers expect. Your work will directly influence how the firm exposes capabilities to internal teams, fintech partners, and end clients. This role would be 100% onsite at our Scottsdale corporate headquarters. **How We Work** * Small, autonomous product squads with clear ownership and meaningful end\-to\-end scope. * Trunk\-based development, CI/CD, and a culture that prefers small, reversible changes over large, risky releases. * Genuine investment in engineering quality: paved roads for common patterns, internal platform teams to lean on, and time set aside for tech debt and learning. * Blameless incident culture, with the expectation that postmortems lead to real change. **Duties and responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate full\-stack features end\-to\-end \- from React/TypeScript front ends, through Node.js / Java / Python (or similar) backend services, to data persistence and event\-driven integrations. * Own the API lifecycle: design RESTful and event\-driven APIs, manage versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility, and curate the developer experience through OpenAPI/Swagger documentation and SDKs. * Configure and tune our API gateway platform (MuleSoft). * Implement and maintain authentication and authorization patterns appropriate for financial services: OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, scoped access tokens, and consent management for open\-banking\-style flows. * Partner with security and compliance to ensure all systems meet relevant standards (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA, GDPR / CCPA, SOX where applicable) and pass internal audits and external regulatory reviews. * Build observability into everything: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, alerting on golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, saturation), and meaningful SLOs for the services you own. * Write production\-quality, well\-tested code, and uphold engineering standards through thoughtful code review, pairing, and mentorship of mid\-level engineers. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for the services you own, drive incident response when issues arise, and lead blameless postmortems that translate into durable system improvements. * Collaborate with product to translate business and regulatory requirements into clean technical designs, and be a credible voice in trade\-off conversations around scope, risk, and timeline. * **Qualifications** **Required:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on both frontend and backend systems. * Strong proficiency in a modern frontend framework (React preferred; Vue or Angular acceptable) with TypeScript, and in at least one backend language commonly used in financial services (Java, Python, Go, Node.js, or C\#). * Working knowledge of Dagster (or a comparable orchestration framework such as Airflow or Prefect) and Snowflake, including building data pipelines, modeling warehouse data, and integrating analytical workloads with operational APIs. * Hands\-on experience designing and operating APIs in production at scale, including REST and ideally one of GraphQL, gRPC, or event\-driven (Kafka, EventBridge, etc.). * Direct experience with a commercial or open\-source API management platform (MuleSoft, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management or similar). * Solid grounding in identity and access standards: OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, mTLS, and API key management. * Cloud experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS). * Working knowledge of relational and at least one non\-relational database, and comfort reasoning about data consistency, transactions, and idempotency in financial workflows. * Demonstrated ability to ship in regulated environments, comfortable with code reviews, change management, audit trails, and the discipline that financial services demands. * Clear written and verbal communication; ability to explain technical concepts to product, business, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to Have:** * Experience integrating with core banking platforms, payment rails (ACH, SWIFT, FedNow, card networks), market data providers, or KYC/AML vendors. * Familiarity with open banking standards (FDX in the US, PSD2 / Open Banking in the UK/EU) and consent\-driven data sharing patterns. * Exposure to financial\-grade API security profiles (FAPI) and mutual TLS in production. * Experience contributing to a developer portal, internal API marketplace, or platform\-as\-a\-product model. * Background working with event sourcing, CQRS, or ledger\-style data models. * Prior experience as an on\-call leader or as the engineering point of contact during incidents impacting regulated services. **Benefits** * $108,000 to $140,000 base salary plus bonus * 401(k) with a matching contribution up to 13%. * United Healthcare PPO medical coverage for employees, paid by the company. * Delta Dental PPO, United Healthcare Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, and many more voluntary options. * Generous holidays and PTO. * Future career growth opportunity. **Come and join a team that is making a difference in their clients and employee's lives!**

jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT Operations**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the design, architecture and support of systems, services and applications required for the collection, storage, processing, and analysis of all forms of data to enable data\-driven decisions and outcomes across the enterprise.**Job Description** **Responsibilities** * Work collaboratively with other engineers, data scientists, analytics teams, and business product owners in an agile environment. * Architect, build, and support the operation of Cloud and On\-Premises enterprise data infrastructure and tools. * Design robust, reusable, and scalable data driven solutions and data pipeline frameworks to automate the ingestion, processing and delivery of both structured and unstructured batch and real\-time streaming data. * Build data APIs and data delivery services to support critical operational processes, analytical models and machine learning applications. * Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities. * Understand and implement best practices in management of enterprise data, including master data, reference data, metadata, data quality and lineage. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, engineering, or relevant technical field * Four years of collective experience in the application of data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, business intelligence, database administration, and data integration concepts and methodologies * Three years of experience architecting, building, and administering big data and real\-time streaming analytics architectures in on\-premises and cloud environments * Two years of experience architecting, building, and administering large\-scale distributed applications * Two years of experience with Linux operations and development, including basic commands and shell scripting * Two years of experience with execution of DevOps methodologies and continuous integration/continuous delivery * Expertise in SQL for data profiling, analysis, and extraction * Familiarity with data science techniques and frameworks * Creative thinker with strong analytical skills * Results oriented with a strong customer focus * Ability to work in a team environment * Strong technical communication skills * Ability to prioritize work to meet tight deadlines * Ability to learn and keep pace with the latest technology advances and quickly grasp new technologies to support the environment and contribute to project deliverables **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in a technical field (e. Experience with data analysis and using data visualization tools to describe data * Relevant technology or platform certification (AWS, Microsoft, etc.) * Software development experience in relevant programming languages (i.e. Java, Python, Scala, Node.js) **Working Conditions** * Office Environment * Occasional Travel \<10% *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

jobs.title: Transformation Engineer
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a Transformation Engineer to join our growing team at TribalScale. In this role, you will be embedded with a client organization of approximately 500 employees, serving as a hands\-on AI platform builder, technical leader, and educator over an extended engagement. You will help establish and continuously improve the organization's AI knowledge foundation—its "company brain"—while building production\-ready agentic systems, advancing Claude Code practices, and enabling teams across the business to adopt AI workflows. Success means not only shipping working systems, but also making them secure, maintainable, useful, and widely adopted. This is a hands\-on engineering and organizational transformation role for someone who can move quickly from ambiguity to production, partner across functions, and own outcomes over time. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **AI Knowledge Systems \& Agentic Memory** * Design, build, and maintain an LLM\-powered company knowledge base ("company brain" or LLM wiki) that captures institutional knowledge and makes it usable by employees and agents. * Architect agentic memory and context strategies: define what agents remember, how knowledge is retrieved and refreshed, and how access permissions are enforced. * Develop practical retrieval, indexing, knowledge\-quality, and lifecycle processes that keep information accurate, relevant, and secure. ### **Production Agentic Engineering \& Claude Code** * Design, build, deploy, and operate agentic applications and production harnesses, including evaluations, observability, guardrails, testing, human oversight, and ongoing iteration. * Serve as the organization's Claude Code expert: establish conventions for CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP integrations, and repeatable team workflows. * Build reusable developer tooling, integrations, APIs, and automation that improve engineering productivity and software delivery. * Deploy and maintain solutions on AWS, applying IAM permissions, security controls, monitoring, reliability practices, and cost management. ### **Organization\-Wide Enablement \& Adoption** * Design and deliver a structured training program for an approximately 500\-person organization, covering agentic memory, harnesses, Claude Code, and practical AI workflows for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Run workshops, hands\-on demonstrations, office hours, and tailored onboarding; create documentation and reusable learning materials. * Develop internal AI champions and support managers and teams as they embed new practices into day\-to\-day work. * Define and monitor adoption and impact measures, such as active usage, workflow uptake, proficiency, productivity, and feedback; improve the program based on results. ### **Long\-Term Transformation \& Delivery** * + Partner with stakeholders across engineering, IT, security, and business functions to prioritize use cases and align technical work with organizational needs. + Own solutions from discovery and rapid prototyping through production deployment, maintenance, and iterative improvement. + Establish practical AI governance covering data access, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible use across hundreds of users. + Balance speed, quality, maintainability, and change management while helping the organization build sustainable internal capabilities. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Strong hands\-on s iver practical solutions in fast\-paced environments. We recognize that strong candidates may not meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you and your experience is adjacent to what we have described, we encourage you to apply. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience leading AI adoption or platform transformation in a mid\-sized organization, particularly one with approximately 200–2,000 employees. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or other agent orchestration and evaluation frameworks. * Claude Certified Architect certification or other relevant AI engineering credentials. * Experience building internal communities of practice, champion networks, or measurable enterprise enablement programs. * Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, infrastructure as code, and operating secure AI systems at organizational scale. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. jobs.title: Mid level Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ You will design, build, and operate production\-grade multi\-agent systems for commercial and federal customers. The work spans the LangChain ecosystem, reliable agent loops, advanced retrieval architectures, and ontologies that ground agent reasoning. You will also connect agents to enterprise tools and to each other through MCP and A2A. This role suits an engineer who thinks in systems: how agents reason, retrieve, act, recover from failure, and get evaluated and observed in production. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ Agent development and orchestration * Build single\- and multi\-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. * Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self\-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets. * Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool\-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably. * Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior. Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent\-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self\-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge\-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache\-Augmented Generation with semantic caching. * Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and query\-rewriting strategies. * Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance. Ontologies, context, and skills * Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property\-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG. * Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window. * Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning. Interoperability protocols * Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely. * Implement Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross\-vendor communication. Engineering and delivery * Write production\-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices. * Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams. * Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM\-powered applications. * Hands\-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. * Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi\-agent orchestration. * Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality. * Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning. * Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows. * Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol. * Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming. * Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations. Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

data needed to support AI models and intelligent workflows. * Work closely with the IT Infrastructure team to ensure AI solutions are deployed in reliable, scalable, and maintainable environments. * protection. * Support requirements gathering and solution alignment with the requirements management team and cross\-functional subject matter experts. * Evaluate and integrate appropriate tools, frameworks, and cloud capabilities to improve AI solution performance, maintainability, and security. * Collaborate with specialized technology partners to accelerate delivery, validate architecture decisions, and implement best practices. * Document solution designs, technical decisions, and operational support guidance for AI implementations. * Stay current on emerging AI technologies, engineering practices, and governance considerations, and recommend practical improvements where appropriate. * Perform other duties as assigned by the Sr. Director of Information Technology \& Systems. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Act as a liaison between IT and business teams to ensure solutions support business needs. * Provide technical guidance and recommendations to business and Data Governance** * Assist in maintaining appropriate system documentation, integration documentation, and technical standards. **REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * Bachelor’s degree developing and supporting API\-based integrations (SOAP and REST). * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced and evolving technology environment. * Demonstrated customer\-focused mindset with strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative approach. **PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * Experience with Microsoft Synapse and/or Fabric analytics platforms. * jobs.description: **WHAT YOU'LL DO** Viant Technology (NASDAQ: DSP) is building the future of AI\-powered, identity\-driven advertising across CTV and the open internet and TVision plays a critical role in that ecosystem by delivering next\-generation audience measurement through real\-world, person\-level viewing insights. Working closely with data science, analytics, and platform engineering teams, you'll help transform billions of seconds of raw viewing data into actionable insights that drive innovation across Viant's CTV and advertising technology platforms. ### **THE DAY\-TO\-DAY** * Build and maintain web services that support configuration, monitoring, and data ingestion for TVision's in\-home measurement devices. * Build and maintain data pipelines to support the recognition and analysis of content captured by our devices. * Work with data science and analytics staff to build clean, well\-designed tools and libraries for our back\-end data processes, making best practices in software engineering and database performance accessible to the entire team. * Ensure the quality, security, and timeliness of our data deliveries by thorough testing, careful code review, and robust operational monitoring. ### **MUST HAVE** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related quantitative field. * 3\+ years of experience building backend services and distributed data systems. * Experience with Python and modern Python engineering best practices. ### ### **GREAT TO HAVE** * Experience building batch and streaming data pipelines at scale. * Experience with AWS infrastructure, DevOps tooling, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with cloud\-hosted, containerized web service architectures and modern deployment patterns. * Knowledge of relational databases, data lake technologies, and performance optimization best practices. * Experience with modern big data processing frameworks such as Spark, Databricks, Flink, or similar technologies. * Comfort collaborating with quantitative and data science teams to optimize computational workflows and data processing efficiency. ### **LIFE AT VIANT** Investing in our employee's professional growth is important to us, but so is investing in their well\-being. That's why Viant was voted one of the best places to work and some of our favorite employee benefits include **fully paid health insurance**, **paid parental leave** and **unlimited PTO** and more. Viant uniquely combines proprietary content intelligence, household\-level identity resolution, and person\-level attention signals to connect advertisers with real customers and drive measurable outcomes across the open internet. Through its award\-winning AI solutions, Viant is building the future of autonomous advertising, where AI doesn't just assist the campaign, it delivers real results. Learn more at viantinc.com. The work is impactful, the environment is collaborative, and our teams are united by a shared commitment to making healthcare work better. **Position Overview****Position Title:** Product Manager II **Organizational Relationship:** Reports to Director of Product Management **Job Family:** Product Management **Managerial Responsibilities:** None **Classification:** Exempt / Full\-Time **Location:** Hybrid **Remote Work Eligibility:** This position is hybrid and is currently available to employees residing in **Utah**. The PM guides features from problem discovery through delivery and launch, partnering with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver measurable customer and revenue outcomes: fewer rejections and denials, less manual work for practice staff, faster reimbursement, and stronger retention. The PM is accountable for requirements and user stories, competitive analysis, and input to pricing and packaging. jobs.title: Control Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Veolia in North America is the top\-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America. **Job Description** **Position Purpose:** We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Control Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, programming, and lifecycle maintenance of our facility’s automated control systems. You will serve as the technical subject matter expert for our ABB 800xA Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial networks. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between operations, maintenance, and IT, driving continuous improvement initiatives and providing rapid troubleshooting support to minimize production downtime. You will play a vital role in ensuring our manufacturing processes run efficiently, safely, and reliably while integrating modern automation standards. **Primary Duties/Responsibilities:** * **System Maintenance \& Troubleshooting:** Provide daily technical support, diagnostics, and troubleshooting for automated production equipment, prioritizing rapid resolution of DCS and PLC faults to minimize manufacturing downtime. * **DCS \& PLC Programming:** Develop, modify, configure, and optimize logic for ABB 800xA DCS systems, as well as facility PLCs and HMIs, to support new equipment installations, process upgrades, and safety improvements. * **Network \& Integration Management:** Oversee and maintain industrial communication networks and data integration architecture, ensuring robust communication between field devices, control systems, and data collection platforms using OPC DA/UA, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and Modbus. * **Documentation \& Design:** Regularly read, interpret, and update electrical schematics, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), loop sheets, and technical manuals to ensure all facility documentation remains accurate and up to standard. * **Preventative Maintenance:** Develop and implement robust preventative maintenance procedures, backup protocols, patch management, and disaster recovery plans for all critical automation infrastructure. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with maintenance technicians, process engineers, and capital project teams to design and execute automation upgrades, ensuring seamless handover and comprehensive operator training. * **Safety \& Compliance:** Ensure all automation and electrical control designs comply with industry safety standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA 70E) and internal company policies. **Work Environment:** * Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, which may include exposure to noise, varying temperatures, and moving machinery. * Willingness to support occasional off\-hours or on\-call emergencies to support critical continuous operations. **Qualifications** **Education/Experience/Background:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and hands\-on industrial experience). **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:** * **DCS Expertise:** Must have demonstrated proficiency and hands\-on experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting **ABB 800xA DCS** systems. * **Automation Platforms:** Strong applied experience working with various PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA platforms in a manufacturing, continuous process, or heavy industrial environment. * **Industrial Networking:** Deep understanding and practical experience with industrial communication protocols, specifically Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC DA/UA. * **Technical Literacy:** Proven ability to read, interpret, and redline electrical schematics, P\&ID drawings, and complex technical manuals. * **Problem Solving:** Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of diagnosing root causes, reducing equipment downtime, and optimizing complex control loops. *Preferred Qualifications:* * **OT Cybersecurity:** Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity concepts, including network segmentation, secure architecture, firewall configurations, and safeguarding industrial control systems against vulnerabilities. * **Additional PLC Experience:** Experience with Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell (Studio 5000\) or Siemens (TIA Portal) environments. * **Project Management:** Experience leading small to medium capital automation projects from scoping and budget approval through FAT, SAT, and final commissioning. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to walk the production floor, climb stairs/ladders, and occasionally lift up to \[Insert Weight, e.g., 30 lbs] when inspecting equipment. **Additional Information** **Benefits:** Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: SimCorp Dimension Lead I SaaS Migration
jobs.description: **Job Title: SimCorp Dimension UAT Test Lead / Senior Business Analyst (SaaS Migration)** **Position Type: Contract / Permanent** **Location: Onsite at Atlanta /Herndon** **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced SimCorp Dimension Specialist to lead and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for our migration from an on\-premises/ self\-hosted environment to the SimCorp SaaS Cloud platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep domain knowledge of SimCorp Dimension workflows, multi\-fund accounting structures, and front\-to\-back asset management operations. You will design, build, and execute comprehensive UAT test cases to ensure seamless data integrity, parallel run validation, and business continuity before go\-live. **Key Responsibilities** * Test Strategy \& Planning: Define the UAT test scope, acceptance criteria, and execution timelines specifically for the SimCorp SaaS migration. * Test Case Development: Design comprehensive UAT test scenarios covering multi\-fund setups, investment operations, accounting, and third\-party integrations. * Data \& Position Reconciliation: Lead the validation of the Security Master, live/historical positions, cash balances, and historical NAV calculations between legacy and SaaS environments. * End\-to\-End Workflow Testing: Execute test cases for trade execution, settlement, corporate actions, compliance rules, and automated batch processing. * Defect \& Triaging Management: Identify, log, and prioritize software configurations, environment issues, or data discrepancies, coordinating directly with SimCorp support and internal IT. * Business Liaison: Act as the core bridge between the technical migration team, external SimCorp engineers, and internal business users (portfolio managers, operations, and accounting teams). Required Skills \& Qualifications * SimCorp Dimension Expertise: Minimum 3–5\+ years of hands\-on configuration or testing experience with SimCorp Dimension (specifically modules like Portfolio Calculation, Asset Manager, Investment Accounting, or Batch/DFS). * Migration Experience: Proven track record participating in a SimCorp upgrade, data migration, or transition to a Cloud/SaaS delivery model. * Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of buy\-side investment operations, asset management, multi\-fund accounting structures, and financial instruments (Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives, or Private Markets). * Reconciliation Expertise: Advanced skills in data validation, ledger matching, and auditing complex financial datasets. * Testing Tooling: Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM) and automated regression testing tools used alongside SimCorp. This role is a hybrid, but it leans heavily toward a Business Analyst (BA) / Operations kind of resource. In the world of SimCorp Dimension, this is commonly referred to as a Functional or Business Consultant, rather than a technical IT developer. **Why It Leans Toward BA / Ops** * They test business outcomes: An IT tester checks if code crashes; a SimCorp BA checks if the NAV (Net Asset Value) calculation is correct down to the penny after migration. * They understand the market: The resource needs to understand financial instruments, trade lifecycles, and corporate actions. * They speak the users' language: They bridge the gap between your portfolio managers/accountants and the underlying system configurations. **What IT/Technical Skills They Do Need** While they aren't writing software code, they still need strong technical data skills, including: * Advanced Excel \& SQL: To extract data from the legacy system and the new SaaS system to run complex match\-and\-reconciliation macros. * System Configuration: Understanding how SimCorp’s internal logic, batch jobs, and Communication Channels (DFS) move data around.

In a startup environment, speed matters, and so does getting it right the first time. **What You'll Do:** * Design mechanical components, housings, assemblies, and development platforms for LiDAR sensors in SolidWorks * Create clear, complete, manufacturing\-ready drawings with proper GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5 * Perform tolerance stack\-up analyses to verify fit, function, and optical alignment budgets * Translate system‑level requirements into robust mechanical architecture and detailed designs * Design fixtures, jigs, and tooling for assembly, alignment, inspection, and test * Support and improve lens alignment stations and related optical assembly processes * Manage engineering change requests and revisions (ECR/ECO), keeping documentation and BOMs accurate * Work with suppliers to resolve manufacturability questions and ensure part quality * Drive design\-to\-cost and value engineering efforts to reduce part cost and complexity without compromising performance * Collaborate with optical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers to turn requirements into robust designs * Iterate quickly through prototypes and builds, then move designs toward production **What We're Looking For** * B.S. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent practical experience * Minimum of 4\+ years of mechanical design experience for precision hardware products * Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including assemblies, detailed part modeling and drawings * Working knowledge of GD\&T and its practical application to functional and inspection requirements * Experience performing tolerance stack\-up analysis (worst\-case and statistical) * Experience with tool and fixture design **Nice to Have** * Experience with precision optomechanical design, such as lens mounting and adhesive bonding. * Experience with thermal analysis and structural FEA, especially for compact electro\-optical packaging * Hands\-on machining, , assembly, or test experience **Life at Voyant** We build frontier hardware \& systems from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. jobs.description: **Job Description** It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us. **Who are we?** Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world\-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital\-rail\-and\-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 30K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! **How will you make a difference?** As an experienced engineer within Wabtec Bus Solutions, you will drive design and development focused on a mix of major initiatives in embedded software development for different products, controls, \& sensors. Reporting to the Engineering Manager or Supervisor, you will design and develop embedded software\-based products, contribute to product development, and ensure compliance with engineering standards. Your role will include collaborating with peers, supporting design decisions, and executing engineering tasks aligned with project goals. **What do we want to know about you?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer or software engineering (master’s preferred; ABET accredited). * 6\+ years of relevant experience. * Basic project management skills and ability to lead engineering based small sized projects or parts of projects. * Working knowledge of embedded software design of systems and components including engineering \& manufacturing principles, practices, and procedures * Deep knowledge in embedded architecture/systems, safety standards, performance optimization, \& system integration. **What will your typical day look like?** * Design and develop embedded software systems, including controllers and sensors, per customer and technical requirements. * Make design decisions to optimize performance, cost, and manufacturability. * Contribute to innovation, patents, or process improvement and support embedded software designs from concept through production launch. * Participate in DFMEA sessions and validation planning and follow APQP/NPD processes to ensure successful product launches * Lead or support root cause analysis and corrective actions for software and electrical issues. * Evaluate specifications and performance needs to deliver cost\-effective solutions and architect scalable, maintainable software for real\-time embedded systems. * Contribute to 8D teams and continuous improvement initiatives. **What about the physical demands of the job?** * The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. * Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception. * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to reach hands and arms and talk or hear. * The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible. **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?** At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. **Who are we?** Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation.
