jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Walker Sands is one of the fastest\-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to help fuel that continued growth. The starting salary for this role is expected to be between $155,000 and $175,000 per year.** Walker Sands is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our DATA practice (Data, Analytics, Technology and AI) and help lead the data infrastructure behind our client reporting, measurement, internal operations, and AI\-driven work. This is a hands\-on role, but not a heads\-down one. Reporting to the SVP, DATA, you'll lead key technical parts of our data stack and be a strategic partner on where it goes next: what to build, what to buy, what to fix, and what actually matters to the business. You don't need a lot of direction and are comfortable working through ambiguity. The role grows as you do. Near term, you'll work alongside our team and external partners to extend and strengthen the platform. Over time, you'll take on more of the technical ownership and help lead what comes next. And as the practice scales, you'll build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage. **What You Will Do (Responsibilities):** **Data Engineering** * Build and maintain pipelines and dbt models in Snowflake that are tested, documented, and trusted * Integrate data from paid media, web analytics, SEO, CRM, and business systems using tools like Fivetran or Airbyte and direct APIs * Find and fix breaks at the root, before an account team or client finds them * Maintain data governance: access controls, privacy, and consent requirements * Structure and document data so AI agents can use it reliable: clear semantic layers, consistent definitions, and metadata that tells an agent what a table or metric actually means * Build governed access patterns for agentic tools (scoped, read\-only, permission aware) so agents only query the data they're allowed to, and their answers can be traced back to the source **Strategy \+ Partnership** * Work with the SVP, DATA on architecture, roadmap, and build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-partner decisions * Translate business and client needs into data designs that hold up, and push back when a request won't * Make data usable for analysts, reporting, and AI\-driven tools through well\-modeled, well\-governed layers **Team Leadership** * Build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage, including the playbooks and escalation paths behind it * Eventually build out the team as needed for various functions to drive better accuracy, performance and data tools for the business **What You Bring (Requirements):** You've spent 7\+ years in data engineering, enough of it in lean environments where you owned real things without much hand\-holding. You can go deep on a broken pipeline in the morning and talk through a roadmap tradeoff in the afternoon, and you're good at both. You are a clear communicator, and work to understand needs beyond the technical with empathy and a 'here's what's possible' mindset. You find problems, fix them, document them, and explain them without making them more complicated than they need to be. * + 7\+ years in data or analytics engineering, including time as the lead or senior technical owner on a production data platform + Deep, hands\-on Snowflake experience + Strong dbt, advanced SQL, and working Python + Experience integrating SaaS and marketing APIs (ad platforms, GA4, Salesforce, HubSpot) through ELT tools and custom pipelines + A track record of shaping technical direction, not just executing tickets + Clear communication with technical and non\-technical people alike**Strong Pluses** + Agency or B2B marketing data background + Data governance and privacy experience (role\-based access, masking, consent data) + Experience making data usable for AI and LLM\-driven tools + Experience leading or mentoring others + Comfortable using AI like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and bringing new ways of working within the data and privacy guardrails of the business **What We Offer (Compensation \+ Benefits):** * **Starting Salary: $155,000 \- $175,000** * + Base salary is only a part of the total rewards package. Placement on the salary scale will be determined by a variety of factors to ensure internal equity. + Starting salaries are not inclusive of a full range of compensation for this role and are instead meant to reflect the expected beginning salary for a new hire. Merit\-based increases can be earned after time in role. * **Bonus Potential:** This role will be eligible for a bonus based on company performance. * **Growth Opportunities:** Clear career paths, mentorship programs, and learning events to help you grow professionally. * **Flexible PTO and Hybrid Work:** Take time as needed for vacations, mental health, or personal days. Includes 8 paid holidays, half\-day summer Fridays, and a week off between Christmas and New Year. * **Health Coverage:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans. Mental health resources, pet insurance, and more. * **Retirement Savings**: Employer\-matched 401(k) and access to financial planning services. * **️ Additional Protection:** Life insurance, disability coverage, and other benefits that provide added financial security. * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Free, confidential support for you and your household, including counseling, mental health resources, and help navigating life's everyday challenges. * **Family Support:** Paid leave for new parents and caregivers, plus policies for fertility treatment, pregnancy loss, adoption challenges, and more. * **Performance \& Coaching:** Regular performance reviews, clear goal\-setting, and ongoing coaching to help you understand expectations, grow your skills, and make progress in your career. * **Milestone Sabbatical:** Celebrate five years with a two\-week sabbatical and a $2,000 gift. * **Community \& Belonging:** Employee resource groups, volunteer opportunities, and programs designed to build connection across the agency. * **Culture:** Our agency offers an award\-winning culture. Read more on our website here! **We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. As an equal opportunity employer Walker Sands is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and welcomes everyone to our team.** **In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example – she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).** **If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.**

jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description: **About WRG** Water Resources Group is a family of self\-performing civil construction companies, including Rice Lake Construction Group and Rice Lake West. For more than 40 years, we have built water and wastewater treatment infrastructure, along with heavy civil and commercial/industrial projects, across the Upper Midwest and Mountain West. Our team of roughly 420 employees delivers more than 45 active projects a year, backed by an award\-winning safety program. **Position Summary** The Application Developer builds, maintains, and improves the internal business applications our employees rely on every day. This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys both writing code and talking with the people who use it: you will sit down with employees and business leaders, understand what they need, and turn it into practical, reliable solutions. Working alongside WRG’s technology leadership, you will keep existing applications running smoothly, enhance them as they move into broader use, and take on growing responsibility for deployment and production support over time. **Essential Responsibilities** **Development** * Develop and enhance internal business applications, features, APIs, reports, and user interfaces. * Meet with employees to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions. * Improve and scale existing applications as they move into broader organizational use. * Integrate applications with company systems, databases, authentication tools, and shared technology. * Write and optimize SQL queries, reports, and database views. * Use modern development tools, including AI\-assisted tools, while reviewing and validating the resulting code. **Maintenance \& Support** * Maintain and support applications currently in use, troubleshooting issues involving code, data, databases, network resources, and authentication. * Participate in release processes, including source control, versioning, testing, Docker image builds, deployment, and rollback. * Support integration with company systems, including Sage 300 CRE and Sage Paperless. * Help keep application dependencies, base images, and supporting infrastructure patched and current. * Assist with consolidating and retiring legacy deployments as applications are replaced. **Standards \& Documentation** * Follow and help improve standards for application development, deployment, security, and support. * Apply sound security practices, including SSO, environment\-based credentials, and least\-privilege database access. * Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, architecture notes, and troubleshooting guides. * Build applications that others can support, so no system depends on the knowledge of a single person. **Qualifications** **Required** * 3–6 years of experience developing and supporting business applications in a production environment. * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building web\-based applications. * Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases. * Experience using Git for source control and version management. * Experience with REST APIs, testing, and application troubleshooting. * Ability to understand, maintain, and improve applications written by others. * Clear communicator who works well with both technical and nontechnical employees. * Strong problem\-solving and documentation skills. **Preferred** * Experience deploying and supporting applications in Docker/Linux environments. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, ODBC connectivity, or SSO. * Experience with ERP/accounting systems, especially Sage 300 CRE or Sage Paperless. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. **Success jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Webull is a leading digital brokerage platform built on next generation global infrastructure. At Webull, we believe that everyone should have an equal opportunity to control their own financial future. Our vision has always been to empower individual investors with the tools and resources they need to succeed financially. This commitment remains at the heart of everything we do. From low\-fee trading and robust market data to advanced analytical tools, we are committed to providing a seamless, top\-tier trading experience.** **About The Role \& Team** Webull is a cloud\-native fintech leader, with our global trading platform powered by AWS. As we continue to expand our trading platform and technology infrastructure, we are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help ensure our cloud environments remain highly available, secure, scalable, and resilient. In this role, you will play a critical part in maintaining the reliability and performance of the infrastructure supporting our 24/7 global trading operations. You will work closely with our Development, Security, and Network teams to optimize AWS production environments, troubleshoot complex infrastructure challenges, strengthen monitoring and incident response capabilities, and drive automation to improve operational efficiency. We are looking for someone with strong technical expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure, a proactive approach to problem\-solving, and a passion for building reliable, high\-performing systems. The ideal candidate takes ownership of technical challenges, thrives in a fast\-paced environment, and is excited to contribute to the continued growth and stability of Webull's global brokerage platform. **In This Role, You Will** * Operate and maintain Webull’s AWS production environments (EC2, VPC, ELB/ALB, Route 53, S3, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, MSK, EKS) across multiple regions, ensuring 99\.99% availability for our 24/7 trading platform. * Build and tune monitoring, logging, and alerting with CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch; define SLIs/SLOs and reduce alert noise so on\-call engineers act on what matters. * Participate in the on\-call rotation, lead L2/L3 incident troubleshooting for cloud and network issues, and drive post\-incident root\-cause analysis and follow\-up actions. * Provision and change infrastructure through Terraform/CloudFormation and GitOps workflows; standardize environment builds and eliminate manual console changes. * Operate EKS/Kubernetes clusters, including upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, and Helm/ArgoCD\-based deployments. * Manage IAM roles and policies, Security Groups, KMS, Secrets Manager, and certificate lifecycles; support SOC 2, FINRA/SEC audit requests and remediate findings from Security Hub, GuardDuty, and AWS Config. * Maintain VPC design, subnets and routing, Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, and Site\-to\-Site VPN connectivity with third\-party vendors. * Design, document, and regularly test backup, cross\-region failover, and DR runbooks to meet RTO/RPO targets. * Track cloud spend with Cost Explorer and tagging, rightsize resources, and manage Savings Plans and Reserved Instances. * Write Python/Shell/Go tooling, Lambda functions, and AI\-assisted runbooks to automate repetitive operational tasks. **The Skills You Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud operations, SRE, or DevOps, including 3\+ years running production workloads on AWS. * Solid knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, ELB, Route 53, RDS, CloudWatch, and EKS. * Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills; good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPN, and TLS. * Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Working experience with Terraform or CloudFormation, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD. * Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting; Go is a plus. * Familiarity with MySQL, Redis, and Kafka in production environments. * Experience in broker\-dealer, electronic trading, or other regulated financial environments. * Willingness to join an on\-call rotation and support global trading sessions outside regular hours when needed. **What Makes You Stand Out** * AWS Certifications: * + AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional + AWS Certified SysOps Administrator + AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or CKA. * Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and landing\-zone design. * AI\-Forward Thinking: Interest in using AI agents or LLMs for operational automation. * Fluency in Mandarin and English to work with our global engineering hubs. **Why Webull?** Webull is more than a fintech company—we’re a global community of innovators, collaborators, and trailblazers. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL, Webull operates in 16 regions worldwide, serving over 20 million users. At Webull, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your work makes a real impact. Investing in our people is a top priority for us, which is why we have a comprehensive benefits package that includes: * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical and dental insurance for employees and dependents, vision insurance, and more! * **Financial Support**: 401(k) match, commuter benefits for NY positions, and short\-term disability coverage. * **Work\-Life Balance**: Generous time off that increases with tenure, paid parental leave, personal days, sick time, volunteer days and company holidays. * **Wellness \& Pet Care**: Fitness and wellness benefits, plus pet insurance for your furry friends. * **Investing in Your Future:** We provide tuition reimbursement to help you pursue relevant degrees, certifications, and training that align with your career goals. * **Dynamic Office Perks**: Catered breakfast (every Monday) \& lunches (every Friday), fully stocked kitchens, and monthly happy hours to connect and collaborate. This role is based in ourSt. Petersburg, FL Global HQ, where in\-person collaboration fuels growth, mentorship, and innovation. At Webull, we’re committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. The base salary range is $90,000\-115,000 annually, plus a discretionary bonus and full benefits. Final offers consider experience, location, and relevant qualifications. **EEOC Statement** Webull is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where all backgrounds, perspectives, and talents are valued.

jobs.title: Product Director - Modelling Portfolio
jobs.description: Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape. For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments. Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected. By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe. This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead. Wood Mackenzie Intelligence Connected **WoodMac.com** **Wood Mackenzie Brand Video** **Wood Mackenzie Values** * Inclusive – we succeed together * Trusting – we choose to trust each other * Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions * Future Focused – we accelerate change * Curious – we turn knowledge into action **About the role** ================== Wood Mackenzie's trading customers act on our forecasts and analytical models every day, across power, gas and oil markets. We are turning that modelling estate into a portfolio of products in its own right: versioned, documented, commercially packaged, and consumable by machines as readily as by analysts. The Director of Modelling Products owns that portfolio. You set the strategy for what we model and why, you own the commercial case for investment across commodities, and you lead the product leads who hold each market. You will not build the models yourself and you will not own the engineers who implement them. You decide what the portfolio should contain, hold the standard it is judged against, and make the case for what we invest in next. **What you will own** ===================== * **The portfolio strategy.** Which models we build, rebuild, retire or acquire across power, gas and oils. You own the investment case and the sequencing, and you defend both. * **Productization of analytical assets.** Moving models and their underlying features from research outputs into products, with versioning, documented methodology, reproducible outputs and a defined release cycle. This is the central program of the role. * **The modelling product leads.** Senior product people holding market specific depth in their commodities. You hire them, develop them, set their objectives, and hold a consistent methodological standard across them. * **Methodology governance.** One standard for validation, change control, backtesting and documentation, so that a colleague or a customer can understand what a model does and how much to trust it. * **Commercial packaging and distribution.** How modelling assets reach customers: in applications, through APIs and data platforms, and as inputs to our own analysts. You work with commercial teams on pricing and packaging. * **The partnership with central engineering and modelling functions.** Development capacity is provided centrally and built to your specification. You set requirements, review implementations and hold the quality bar without managing the developers. **What we are looking for** =========================== * **A quantitative background you can draw on.** A degree in a mathematical, engineering or scientific discipline, and real experience with linear programming, econometric or machine learning modelling. You need to be able to discuss, validate and challenge a methodology on its merits rather than take it on trust. * **Portfolio level product leadership in analytics or data.** Ten years or more in product, including ownership of a multi\-product portfolio and the investment tradeoffs across it. * **Experience leading product managers,** including senior ones. Your leverage in this role comes through other people. * **A track record of productizing analytical or research assets.** Taking work built for internal or bespoke use and turning it into something repeatable, documented and commercially viable. * **Machine consumable delivery.** APIs, streaming, data platforms and workflow integration. Our customers increasingly want the model and the data rather than the report. * **Commodity or energy market context preferred.** Deep subject matter expertise is not a prerequisite, since market specific depth sits with peers or the leads reporting to you. You do need enough market and commercial literacy to prioritize well. * **Comfort operating without direct control.** Development, data engineering and market expertise all sit with teams you do not manage. Clear specifications, credibility and influence are how this role works. **What this role is not** ========================= * Not a modelling role. You will not be building or running models. You direct, prioritize and hold the standard. * Not an engineering or data science management role. Those capabilities are provided by central functions. * Not a research leadership role. Our analyst teams produce market views and commentary. You own the models they and our customers depend on. * Not a finished portfolio. The scope will expand across commodities as the function develops. *The salary range for this position is $160,000\- $190,000, which represents base pay only and does not include short\-term incentive compensation or commission. When determining base pay, as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. This base salary maps to the Boston Location.* **Equal Opportunities** We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership. While our current plug\-ins function as external add\-ons, you will be responsible for re\-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero\-latency DFM feedback and one\-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. **How You'll Contribute** ------------------------- * **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high\-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry\-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs. * **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real\-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI\-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. * **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring\-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure. * **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership. * **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well\-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross\-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams. * **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise\-grade deployments, whether partner\-hosted or Xometry\-hosted, ensuring seamless multi\-tenant management. **What You'll Bring to Xometry** -------------------------------- * **Experience:** 12\+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms. * **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert\-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. * **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. * **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6\-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. * **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long\-term technology investments. * **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. **You Would Be A Great Fit With** --------------------------------- * **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. * **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. * **Security \& Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. * **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large\-scale ML platforms or high\-frequency marketplace engines. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually \+ annual bonus, depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including: * 401(k) match * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Life and disability insurance * Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays * Maternity and bonding leave * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources * A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E\-Verify. \#LI\-Hybrid Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E\-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Principal M&P Engineer, Metallics
jobs.description: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next\-gen aerospace sector building an end\-to\-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation\-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors. Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members. We are seeking an experienced Materials and Processes (M\&P) Engineer to serve as the Metallics Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the airframe of our next\-generation electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, being certified under FAA airworthiness criteria derived from 14 CFR Part 23 eVTOL aircraft and Part 21\.17(b) powered\-lift. In this role, you will be the technical authority for metallic materials and processes across primary and secondary airframe structure, from alloy selection and specification development through qualification, production support, and FAA certification. This is a hands\-on role on a fast\-moving program. The ideal candidate brings deep metallurgical expertise, a strong command of aerospace specifications and certification requirements, and the judgment to make sound, timely decisions with incomplete information. You will thrive here if you bring a flexible mindset, a strong sense of urgency, and the ability to create structure and clarity in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for individuals who are slightly impatient, flexible under changing priorities and perform under pressure. **What you'll do** * Technical authority: Serve as the M\&P Metallics SME; owning metallic material and process decisions for aluminum, titanium, steel, and corrosion\-resistant alloys used in structure, engine, battery components, fittings, and fasteners. * Certification: Develop compliance data and substantiation for M\&P\-related airworthiness requirements, and interface with the FAA, DERs, and internal certification teams to support certification activities. Develop, author, review internal MPE specs, test plans, other specs. * Cross\-functional partnership: Work closely with stress, design, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and certification teams to make timely trade\-offs that keep the program moving. * Build the function: Help build and mature Archer's M\&P metallics capability, including lab test methods, processes, tools, and mentorship of junior engineers. * Qualification and allowables: Plan and execute metallic material and process qualification programs, including test plans, test matrices, conformity, data review, and reports; establish material strength properties and design values using MMPDS and statistically based methods. * Specifications and design guidance: Author and maintain Archer material and process specifications, design guidelines, and standards, including heat treatment, surface treatment, plating, shot peening, welding/joining, machining, and inspection requirements. * Material selection: Lead alloy, temper, and product\-form selection (plate, sheet, extrusion, forging, casting, bar, and additively manufactured parts), balancing strength, fatigue and damage tolerance, corrosion resistance, weight, cost, and manufacturability. * Corrosion control: Define corrosion prevention and control requirements for metallic structure, including galvanic compatibility, dissimilar\-material isolation (including metal\-to\-composite interfaces), sealants, and finish systems. * Production and supplier support: Support manufacturing and suppliers through material review board (MRB) dispositions, nonconformance resolution, first article inspections (FAI), special\-process source approvals, and supplier audits (including NADCAP\-accredited and not accredited processes). * Failure analysis: Lead failure analysis and root cause investigations using fractography, metallography, SEM/EDS, and hardness and conductivity testing, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure. **What you'll need** * Bachelor's degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field; Master's or PhD preferred. * Minimum 8 years of aerospace M\&P experience focused on metallic materials and processes (6 years with an advanced degree), including direct support of metallic structures. * Demonstrated track record leading material and process qualification, specification development, and FAA (or equivalent EASA/military) certification activities. * Aerospace alloys: In\-depth knowledge of aerospace aluminum (2xxx, 6xxx, 7xxx series and tempers), titanium (e.g., Ti\-6Al\-4V), precipitation\-hardening and s corrosion cracking, and hydrogen embrittlement. * Special processes: Working knowledge of heat treatment (e.g., AMS 2770, AMS 2759\), anodizing and conversion coating (e.g., MIL\-PRF\-8625, MIL\-DTL\-5541\), passivation (AMS 2700\), plating, shot peening (AMS 2430/AMS 2432\), and welding/joining (e.g., AWS D17\.1\). * Standards and data: Fluency with MMPDS, SAE AMS, ASTM, MIL, and NAS specifications, as well as galvanic compatibility guidance such as MIL\-STD\-889\. * Inspection and NDT: Experience with nondestructive testing methods, including dye penetrant (ASTM E1417\), magnetic particle (ASTM E1444\), ultrasonic, and eddy current, and with defining acceptance criteria. * Regulatory knowledge: Familiarity with FAA regulations, Advisory Circulars, and M\&P\-related airworthiness requirements, including material and process control, fabrication methods, and material strength properties and design values. * Failure analysis: Hands\-on experience with fractography, metallography, and SEM/EDS for root cause analysis. Define metallic F\&DT methodology (slow crack growth, safe\-life) in coordination with structures team **Preferred qualifications** * Experience on a new aircraft development and type certification program, ideally in eVTOL, general aviation, or rotorcraft. * Experience with forgings and castings, including casting factors and classification (e.g., AMS 2175\). * Experience with metallic–composite hybrid structures, fastener systems, and bonded or sealed joints. * Experience with conducting supplier audits, establishing or approving NADCAP\-accredited special processes, AS9100 quality management system * FAA DER or Designee experience, or experience working directly with Designees and FAA Aircraft Certification Offices. * Please note that this job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and does not include an exhaustive list of responsibilities and qualifications At Archer we aim to attract, retain, and motivate talent that possess the skills and leadership necessary to grow our business. We drive a pay\-for\-performance culture and reward performance that supports the Company's business strategy. For this position we are targeting a base pay between $219,000\- $273,700 . Actual compensation offered will be determined by factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. ##### Archer is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs. Applicants who may require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should provide their name and contact information to Archer's People Team at people@archer.com. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis. ##### Information collected and processed as part of any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Archer's Candidate Privacy Policy. ##### Certain positions may be eligible for visa sponsorship. ##### Archer is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. ##### Archer Aviation does not engage with external recruiting agencies/individual recruiters with whom it does not have a prior written agreement. Archer reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes that it receives and bears no responsibility for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes. If you are a recruiting agency or individual recruiter wishing to do business with Archer, please reach out to People@archer.com. All employment processes are managed by the Archer People Team.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, Services and Tasks
jobs.description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. **State the Business Title** Lead Software Engineer, Services and Tasks **Role Summary** The Lead Software Engineer will lead full\-stack development efforts across clinical workflow solutions, combining hands\-on engineering with technical leadership and design oversight. This hybrid role is based in Boston, MA, and supports the development of scalable, reliable software using React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, APIs, relational databases, and distributed systems. The role also includes evaluating and applying generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools to improve productivity and quality. This position will report to the Senior Engineering Manager. **Team Summary** The Clinicals Services \& Tasks team owns the end\-to\-end arc of clinical work at the point of care \- from the moment an order is created, through the documents that inform and result from it to the tasks that carry that work to completion across the practice. The team supports the systems and workflows that help clinicians and care teams move efficiently through complex work while reducing friction and cognitive load. This includes building and maintaining stable platform capabilities, improving user\-facing workflows, and ensuring the underlying services can support dependable performance at scale. Team members work across application layers, service boundaries, and data models to improve the experience of clinical work from initiation to completion. **Essential Job Responsibilities** * Lead full\-stack engineering efforts across React\-based frontend applications, Java services, and supporting APIs. * Provide technical mentorship, architectural guidance, and design oversight to engineers on the team. * Develop and maintain features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and modern frontend architecture patterns. * Design and support APIs and service integrations across distributed systems, including monolith and microservices environments. * Build and optimize relational data models and database\-backed application functionality. * Collaborate with product, design, and engineering partners to translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions. * Evaluate and apply generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools to improve development workflows, code quality, and delivery efficiency. * Drive technical decisions that strengthen scalability, reliability, maintainability, and system clarity. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and support durable fixes across application layers. * Travel as needed to support team or business needs. **Additional Job Responsibilities** * Contribute to planning and prioritization discussions for team delivery. * Support code reviews and promote consistent engineering practices. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to improve workflow clarity and implementation alignment. * Help refine engineering standards, documentation, and team operating practices. * Assist in evaluating legacy technologies and migration paths in large\-scale production environments. * Explore GraphQL, Unix/Linux, and other tools or technologies that may improve platform capabilities. * Participate in incident response and operational follow\-up when needed. * Recommend improvements to developer productivity, deployment workflows, and testing practices. * Share knowledge across the broader engineering organization through informal mentoring and technical discussions. **Expected Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience in software engineering or full\-stack application development. * Demonstrated experience leading full\-stack development teams, including technical mentoring and design oversight. * Proficiency with React, modern frontend architecture, and core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Strong programming experience in Java. * Experience working with generative AI and AI\-assisted software engineering tools in day\-to\-day development workflows. * Solid experience with relational databases and data modeling. * Experience designing and supporting APIs and working across distributed systems and evolving system architectures, including monolith and microservices environments. * Exposure to GraphQL, Unix/Linux environments, and legacy technologies in large\-scale production systems is a plus. * Strong communication skills, ownership, and accountability, with a demonstrated track record of adopting new technologies. * Ability to work in a hybrid environment in Boston, MA. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and cross\-functional partners in a product\-focused environment ***Expected Compensation*** $143,000 \- $243,000*The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job\-related experience,* *relevant knowledge* *and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package \- depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long\-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.* ***About athenahealth*** ***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.* ***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do\-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission\-driven problem\-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award\-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.* ***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.* ***What we can do for you:*** *Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.* *We also encourage a better work\-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in\-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full\-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.* *In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.* *Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers* *https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal\-opportunity*

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer — Integrations and AI-Driven Development
jobs.description: **About the Role** BOSS is looking for a junior software developer who wants to grow into a senior engineering role while helping build and maintain the integrations behind a production platform supporting payroll, invoicing, onboarding, compliance, and other business\-critical workflows. AI\-assisted development is central to how we work. You'll use modern coding agents and AI development tools to explore the codebase, implement features, review changes, write tests, and investigate problems. You'll learn how to combine the speed of AI\-assisted development with careful engineering judgment, effective validation, and a strong understanding of the underlying systems. You'll work extensively with third\-party APIs and services while gaining experience in code review, testing, debugging, performance, and production operations. You'll help build and maintain reliable integrations, ensure new features fit cleanly into existing workflows, investigate issues when they arise, and strengthen the tools and practices that keep the platform reliable. This is an opportunity to work closely with company leadership, learn a complex business domain, and see the direct operational impact of your work. As your judgment, system knowledge, and production experience grow, you'll take on progressively greater ownership and develop toward a senior engineering role. **Responsibilities** * Review backend and frontend changes for correctness, maintainability, security, and compatibility with existing workflows. * Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations with payroll, banking, document, payment, email, and other third\-party services. * Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data mapping, pagination, rate limits, retries, and error handling. * Design integration workflows to be observable, recoverable, and safe to retry without duplicating financial or operational activity. * Investigate discrepancies between BOSS and external systems and reconcile failed or incomplete transactions. * Use AI coding agents to investigate the application, develop solutions, generate tests, and accelerate routine engineering work. * Review and validate AI\-generated changes for correctness, security, maintainability, and unintended effects. * Improve the instructions, documentation, context, and feedback that help AI tools produce more reliable results. * Identify inefficient database behavior, including N\+1 queries, missing indexes, unnecessary work, and other performance risks. * Test changes across related workflows rather than evaluating features only in isolation. * Help diagnose production issues across the application, database, background workers, integrations, and deployment environment. * Develop well\-scoped production fixes and, with appropriate review, help deploy them safely. * Add practical automated tests and repeatable manual checks for critical behavior. * Review schema and data changes for deployment, rollback, and production\-data risks. * Monitor application behavior and improve logging, documentation, and incident\-response procedures. * Document defects, technical risks, and recommended corrections in clear language. * Learn the business rules behind payroll, invoicing, onboarding, and related financial workflows. * Work directly with company leadership to turn product ideas into reliable, supportable software. **Required Qualifications** * Foundational experience with Python and web application development through professional work, internships, education, or substantial personal projects. * Experience consuming web APIs and working with HTTP, JSON, authentication, and asynchronous workflows. * Practical experience using AI coding tools while retaining the ability to understand, test, and explain the resulting code. * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * Ability to follow application code and database queries methodically while investigating a failure. * Familiarity with Git\-based development and code review. * Understanding of common web security, data\-integrity, and error\-handling concerns. * A methodical debugging approach and willingness to escalate when the cause or safest repair isn't yet clear. * Clear written and verbal communication, especially when describing risk or challenging an implementation. * Willingness to learn a mature application with interconnected business rules and legacy behavior. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Django or a similar Python web framework. * Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, or SvelteKit. * Experience building or supporting third\-party integrations, webhooks, scheduled synchronization jobs, or data\-import pipelines. * Familiarity with OAuth, API keys, request signing, idempotency, rate limiting, and resilient retry strategies. * Familiarity with Linux production environments, Nginx, Gunicorn, background\-job systems, and Vercel. * Experience investigating slow queries, N\+1 behavior, worker exhaustion, or other application\-performance issues. * Experience writing automated tests or introducing tests into an application with limited existing coverage. * Familiarity with production deployments, rollback procedures, backups, monitoring, and incident response. * Experience designing effective prompts, project instructions, or agent workflows for software development. * Knowledge of payroll, accounting, banking, invoicing, employer\-of\-record services, or financial operations. **What Success Looks Like** In the first several months, you'll build a working understanding of the application's major workflows and external services, contribute to a consistent review and validation process, and learn to diagnose common integration and production failures with support. As you grow, you'll take increasing ownership of integrations, reviews, incident response, system design, and technical decision\-making. The long\-term goal is for this role to develop into a senior engineering position with broad knowledge of the platform and business. **Role Boundaries** This position supports code quality and production reliability but won't initially be the company's sole owner of architecture, security, infrastructure, or incident response. Significant production changes and high\-risk incidents will have a defined escalation path and support from the designated technical owner. Those boundaries can expand deliberately as the developer gains experience. Pay: $35\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Network Engineer

Proactively identify and remove barriers to meeting client expectations; document issues, action plans, and outcomes in a timely manner; and achieve all client satisfaction objectives and internal and external service\-level agreements. * Actively and consistently recommend and support efforts to improve, simplify, automate, and enhance day\-to\-day service delivery operations and the client experience. * Foster collaborative working relationships within operations and across all organizational levels and departments to execute deployment engineering functions and company priorities. * Use established escalation and exception paths, processes, and systems to report current performance and recommend performance improvements. * Achieve leadership\-established performance targets for applicable key performance indicators. * Perform other duties as assigned by management. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ==================================== **Accountability** ------------------ Understands how individual responsibilities connect to broader organizational goals and needs, and performs the role with those goals in mind. Identifies core problems by examining symptoms, resolves key issues behind major problems in the short term, and develops and executes long\-term solutions. Shows passion for improving service delivery and continuous improvement, and establishes and maintains high performance standards for self and others in support of the organization’s strategic plan. **Education and Experience Requirements** ========================================= * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a within the technology services industry. * Ability to work within established change management processes and procedures, understand requirements, gather end\-user requirements, and compile documentation that aligns with existing standards within specified timeframes. * Previous post\-sales engineering experience with network solutions, including requirements definition and implementation planning, end\-to\-end system design, equipment staging, configuration development and testing, and deployment of software and hardware solutions across geographically distributed environments. * Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Arista ACE, or related certifications preferred. * Experience working in a production data center environment, including direct management of routers, switches, firewalls, global and local load balancing, and demilitarized zones (DMZs), together with a solid understanding of DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI). * Proficient knowledge of industry\-standard networking technologies and infrastructure, including cabling, LAN, WLAN, and WAN. * Extensive routing experience, including a thorough understanding of BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, route subnetting, and route aggregation techniques. * Demonstrated switching experience and knowledge of data center switching, including the Nexus product line, spine\-and\-leaf architecture, Cisco ACI, and Arista CLOS. * End\-to\-end process thinking, supported by proven experience in business processes and workflow design. * Excellent problem\-solving and systems analysis skills, with demonstrated success in root cause analysis, effectiveness measurement, and related documentation. * Demonstrated success in continuously expanding and applying jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Rokt Residency
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **We are Rokt.** We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped. The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3\.5B company with 700\+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%\+ for over a decade. **At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation,** which is why we have a well\-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability. Compensation for this role is \~$50\.48/hour. In addition, you will receive a generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 \+ accessories: yours to keep after the residency. If you secure a full\-time offer post\-residency, total target compensation will be $127,000, including a fixed annual salary of $120,000, employee equity plan grant (RSUs), and world\-class benefits. This is the expected pay for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder. **About the role:** The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full\-time, paid early\-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City . This cohort of residencies will run from January 12th 2027 through to May 18th 2027\. Residents will have the opportunity to receive full\-time offers to join Rokt as Builders on the completion of their residency. **How your future team uses AI:** We are an AI\-first company. We’re a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and “someone should build a tool for that” is treated as a volunteer sign\-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here. Rokt Builders use AI coding agents to write, test, and review code, which means a small team ships what used to take a large one. Teams use AI to investigate production issues, generate test coverage, and prototype new features in hours instead of weeks. Residents get the same enterprise AI tools from day one and are expected to use them to build faster. **How you will contribute:** * Build and deploy production services and features on a Rokt engineering team, from prototype through to release. * Use AI tools and automation to speed up coding, testing, and deployment. * Find performance bottlenecks and use data to improve systems that run at the scale of billions of transactions. * Work with product managers, designers, and senior Builders to ship features that drive revenue for Rokt and its partners. * Deliver measurable contribution to your team by the end of the Residency.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. **About the role** ------------------ Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well\-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them. That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow\-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters. This is a fast\-moving, LLM\-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI\-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work remotely from anywhere in Europe, or hybrid from our offices in Helsinki, Oulu or Tampere. You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to. **What you will do** -------------------- You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own: * **Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline:** Make our existing ticket\-to\-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows. * **Close the loop across the SDLC:** Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post\-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge. * **Prototype fast, then harden:** Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure. * **Run AI in production properly:** Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM\-as\-a\-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time\-to\-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership. * **Make autonomy safe:** Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low\-risk, easily verified work runs hands\-off. * **Lead AI\-native engineering by example:** Set the bar for AI\-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline\-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you. * **Drive adoption with the teams:** Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend. * **Partner cross\-functionally:** Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade\-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones. **Requirements** ---------------- We'd love to hear from you if you are: * **An experienced builder:** 6\+ years building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure ineers, managers and non\-engineering partners. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- You don't need all of these, but they're nice signals of fit: * Experience with coding agents at depth: skills, MCP servers, hooks, sub\-agent orchestration, headless runs. * Built evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for coding agents, or LLM\-as\-judge grading tied to build and test outcomes. * Experience with sandboxed execution at scale: ephemeral dev environments, VM or container fleets, macOS build infrastructure. * Background in developer productivity measurement (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4\) and in turning metrics into decisions without turning them into targets. * Shipped to mobile apps or other environments with slow, expensive feedback loops. * Experience in digital health, wearables, MedTech, or other privacy\-sensitive or regulated products. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, or a portfolio of projects built on the latest agent capabilities. * Mentored engineers or led an engineering community of practice. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $198,050 \- $233,000 Region 2 $180,200 \- $212,000 Region 3 $169,150 \- $199,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Warp** At Warp Sciences, our mission is to help the world discover new medicines faster—and build the capacity to do it here in America. We bring AI, robotics, and life sciences together in automated labs that design, run, and learn from experiments, with each experiment making the next one better. We’re not developing drugs of our own. We’re building the infrastructure for the people who do. We're looking for an experienced full\-stack software engineer to take technical ownership of the software that connects people to our autonomous laboratories. In this product engineering role, you'll own staff\- and customer\-facing workflows from scientific objectives and experiment planning through execution and results, with hands\-on responsibility for the frontend, backend services, APIs, and data models. You'll combine AI\-native full\-stack engineering with strong product sense: work directly with chemists, researchers, operators, and customers, decide what to build, and carry it through to reliable production use. We're looking for someone who has already led substantial software initiatives and can turn an open\-ended problem into a technical plan, ship it, and improve it based on real use. **What You'll Do** * Lead full\-stack delivery of scientific workflows, from understanding user needs and defining scope through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Independently scope initiatives spanning multiple months and engineers. Write technical designs, identify dependencies and risks, and break the work into milestones that deliver useful software along the way. * Work directly with chemists and customers to capture objectives, constraints, procedures, and exceptions. Translate those needs into clear requirements and usable workflows for automated experimentation. * Build user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data models that connect experiment planning, robotic execution, and analysis. Work with other engineers to integrate across our internal systems. * Own the reliability and maintainability of what you ship. Add tests and monitoring, investigate production failures, and make deliberate tradeoffs among delivery speed, performance, and technical debt. * Make experiment status, results, uncertainty, and failures understandable so users can investigate problems and guide automated work. Use feedback and usage data to improve task completion and reduce manual effort. * Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and mentoring while continuing to write production code. Use AI development tools to accelerate work and verify the correctness of their output. **What We're Looking For** We're looking for someone who has set technical direction for a product area, independently identified and scoped important problems, and led multiple engineers through delivery while remaining hands\-on. You should be able to point to substantial systems you personally helped build, the decisions you owned, and the outcomes they delivered. * You're an experienced full\-stack engineer who has delivered and maintained production web applications, with substantial hands\-on contributions to frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data models. * You've personally led significant projects from an ambiguous problem to production adoption, with impact across a product area or team. You can explain what you owned and implemented, the tradeoffs you made, and how the work improved user or business outcomes. * You've served as a technical lead for work involving multiple engineers over multiple months: defining the approach, sequencing delivery, coordinating dependencies, and staying accountable through launch and follow\-up. * You have strong software engineering foundations and have designed systems for reliability, performance, and maintainability. You can point to architectural decisions you've made and how those decisions held up in production. * You demonstrate product sense and sound judgment about user experience. You've worked directly with users, identified the underlying problem, and made scope and interaction decisions that helped them accomplish their work. * You communicate technical plans and tradeoffs clearly to engineers and non\-engineers, and have helped other engineers deliver better work through code review, technical guidance, and mentoring. * You use AI development tools effectively and critically, with responsibility for understanding, testing, and maintaining the resulting code. * You've operated software after launch, used monitoring and user feedback to diagnose problems, and followed through on fixes and improvements. * Prior experience with chemistry or the life sciences is not required; curiosity and enthusiasm for learning are mandatory. **Helpful, but Not Required** Experience in any of the following is a plus: * Scientific software, laboratory workflows, or tools for technical users. * Domain knowledge in chemistry, drug discovery, or related scientific disciplines. * Robotics, automation, or products that interact with physical systems. * Complex workflow tools, operational interfaces, or collaborative applications. * Data visualization, experiment tracking, and communicating uncertainty. * AI\-powered products and interfaces for guiding, reviewing, or correcting automated work. **Example Problems You Might Work On** * Build a workflow for customers to specify scientific goals, constraints, and success criteria that our experiment\-planning systems can act on. * Turn a chemist's procedure, including exceptions and judgment calls, into a reviewable plan for robotic execution. * Build an experiment monitoring and results interface that helps users understand uncertainty, intervene when needed, and use what they learned to plan the next experiment. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Warp is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: **Position Summary** The AI Project Lead/Manager is responsible for leading and delivering artificial intelligence projects that enhance operational efficiency, decision\-making, and business outcomes. This role bridges the gap between traditional project management and advanced AI technologies, ensuring successful planning, execution, and delivery of AI\- driven initiatives. Key Responsibilities * Lead end\-to\-end AI project lifecycle from initiation to closure * Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and deliverables * Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets * Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders * Identify risks and develop mitigation strategies * Communicate status updates and manage expectations * Ensure quality standards and conduct post\-project evaluations Technical Oversight * Oversee AI model development, deployment, and evaluation * Ensure proper data management and governance * Stay current with AI trends, tools, and technologies Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management * Lead cross\-functional teams including AI engineers and data scientists * Translate business needs into technical requirements * Maintain strong stakeholder communication Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field * 2\-5 years of project management experience in technical environments Required Skills Core Competencies * Leadership and communication * Problem\-solving and analytical thinking * Business acumen and adaptability * Attention to detail The Project Lead/Manager will work closely with the sales, product, and customer success teams to provide technical expertise during the sales process, ensuring our solutions meet the specific needs of prospective and existing customers. You will serve as a trusted advisor, assisting with product demos, technical presentations, and solution design. This role requires a combination of strong technical skills, a deep understanding of our product, and the ability to communicate complex concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: * Pre\-Sales Support: Collaborate with the sales team to understand customer needs and present tailored solutions that meet those requirements during demos, technical discussions, and proof of concept (PoC) engagements. * Product Demos \& Presentations: Lead technical product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the value of our solution in addressing specific business challenges for potential customers. * Solution Design: Work closely with prospects to understand their business goals, gather technical requirements, and design customized solutions using our platform. Ensure technical feasibility and compatibility with their existing systems. * Technical Liaison: Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective customers during the pre\-sales process. Provide detailed answers to technical questions, and troubleshoot any issues or concerns that arise. * Customer Onboarding: Work closely with customer success and implementation teams to ensure a seamless transition from the sales process to post\-sale implementation, ensuring that customers get the most out of the solution. * Solution Troubleshooting: Assist in identifying and resolving technical challenges that arise during the implementation or pre\-sales process. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field * 2\-5 years of experience in a technical role * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, product, and engineering teams. * Experience with technical sales cycles, including pre\-sales demos, proof of concepts, and solution design. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a customer\-centric approach. Pay: From $20\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Remote
